jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer, Data Centers - Remote (U.S.)
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking to hire a highly skilled Senior Mechanical Engineer for the Data Center and Mission Critical team for our east region. The ideal candidate for this position should be familiar with the tech sector, mission critical and data center industry, understanding the requirements of scale, speed, and consistency in data centers.

This position offers the flexibility of a remote work schedule and can be based from a variety of locations in the US where AECOM has an office.

Although the position is primarily remote periodic travel may be required for client meetings, key project milestones, onsite collaboration sessions, or other business‑critical activities. Travel is expected to be occasional and scheduled in advance

AECOM is a leader in the global data center consulting industry with robust teams in the Americas, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Australia.  In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with our teams around the world on high-profile, fast-paced data center projects for global clients.  This is a hands-on, client-facing role with an opportunity for upward career mobility.

Responsibilities, required experience, and qualifications are summarized below:

Responsibilities:

• Data Center Heat Rejection and HVAC System Design: Developing and designing Heat Rejection and HVAC systems specifically tailored for data centers, considering factors such as type of cooling requirement as air cooled or direct fluid cooled, associated cooling loads, future flexibility of the system to accommodate variable heat distribution scenarios, phased construction and operation, airflow management, humidity control, system redundancy providing concurrent maintainability, energy efficiency, and compliance with industry standards and best practices.
• Cooling System Selection: Selecting appropriate air/water side cooling systems for data centers, including Fan wall units, computer room air handlers (CRAHs), chilled water systems, DX systems and CRAC units, in-row cooling, and containment solutions, based on the specific cooling requirements of the data center and the criticality of the equipment.
• Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) Analysis: Conducting internal CFD simulations to optimize airflow distribution, transient period analysis, identify hotspots, and ensure efficient cooling throughout the data center. Conducting external CFD on individual buildings and/or campus-wide to simulate effects of different electrical and mechanical components on each other and effects on design day selection criteria capacity of each component. For both types, prepare and/or direct preparation of models and analyse the results to recommend design modifications and optimize the Heat rejection and HVAC system performance. Coordinate the required changes and resulting effects with other trades on project.
• Redundancy and Fault Tolerance: Designing HVAC systems with redundancy and fault-tolerant features to ensure continuous operation of the data center in the event of equipment failure or maintenance activities. This includes the design of backup cooling systems, automatic switchover mechanisms, and monitoring systems.
• Heat Load Calculation and Capacity Planning: Performing heat load calculations for data centers to determine the cooling requirements based on the IT equipment, power density, anticipated growth, and phasing of the construction and operational steps. Conducting capacity planning to ensure the HVAC system can accommodate future expansions and upgrades. Performing HVAC loads for admin and common sections of the facility.
• Energy Efficiency and Sustainability: Implementing energy-efficient HVAC design strategies, such as utilizing economizers, variable speed drives, energy recovery systems, and optimizing airflow management techniques, to minimize energy consumption and support sustainability initiatives.
• Air Quality and Filtration: Ensuring the data center's air quality is maintained at optimal levels by designing appropriate filtration systems and implementing air quality monitoring mechanisms. Addressing concerns related to particulate matter, humidity control, and contaminant removal to protect sensitive IT equipment.
• Coordination with Electrical and Mechanical Systems: Collaborating with electrical engineers and mechanical engineers to integrate the heat rejection and HVAC system seamlessly with the electrical infrastructure, UPS systems, emergency power systems, fire suppression systems, and other critical infrastructure components.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's Degree with 8+ years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and or education.
• Experience in data center mechanical and electrical equipment installation and operation.
• P. E. registration is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

• A bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, HVAC engineering, or a related field from an accredited university is typically required. Preference would be given to candidates with a master's degree or advanced coursework in HVAC systems or energy management.
• Knowledge of data center TER Standard Topology as per Uptime Institute, TIA 942, ANSI/BICSI 002
• Professional certifications related to HVAC engineering, such as Certified Energy Manager (CEM), Building Energy Modeling Professional (BEMP), or Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED) accreditation, would be advantageous.

• We are interested in every qualified candidate eligible to work in the United States. Permanent residency sponsorship is available for current H1-B visa holders in the United States.
• Relocation assistance may be available for candidates interested in working from our Arlington, VA office.
• THIS POSTING IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND AECOM INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY DECEMBER 24, 2026.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. jobs.title: Director, Marketing
jobs.description:
Company Overview

DNA Diagnostics Center is the world leader in DNA relationship testing, processing over one million DNA samples from customers all over the world. Our broad portfolio of products includes our Paternity, Immigration, and other DNA Relationship services for consumers, government agencies, healthcare providers, and legal professionals; PeekabooTM Early Gender DNA Test for expecting mothers; SpermCheck fertility and vasectomy test; and Pets & Vets DNA testing for breeders and pet enthusiasts. Our corporate headquarters, including our DNA testing laboratory, is based in Fairfield, OH in the greater Cincinnati Area. DDC is part of Eurofins, a global scientific company with over 800 laboratories in 50 countries and more than 50,000 employees.

Opportunity Overview

The Director, Marketing is a visionary, hands-on leader, spearheading our dynamic marketing strategy to ensure our products reach their full potential on a global scale. Driving product positioning, communications, market research, pricing, customer satisfaction, budget planning, and implementing growth initiatives, they have the opportunity to shape both short and long-term achievement of department and organizational success. The Global Vice President, Marketing adeptly navigates difficult, impactful, and abstract issues, and influences key decisions as a member of the Company’s Senior Leadership team. They are integral in the development of company objectives and policies and the achievement of business goals.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

• Lead the development of comprehensive marketing strategies, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement within the marketing function, including nurturing talent and driving success across the division.
• Develop both long and short term strategic marketing plans in support of company product sales; ensure availability of tactics and resources for the sales function.
• Drive impactful and compelling marketing campaigns that resonate with our target audience while maintaining fiscal responsibility.
• Oversee marketing, operations, and service of international businesses, DDC Worldwide and AgeaCare.
• Implement robust reporting mechanisms to track and analyze performance metrics, enabling data-driven decision-making and proactive response to market trends.
• Stay ahead of the curve by analyzing market research data, monitoring competitors, and identifying new opportunities.
• Cultivate strong relationships with key stakeholders, including customers, vendors, and regulatory agencies, to drive collaborative success.
• Partner seamlessly across departments to align marketing efforts with organizational objectives, driving synergies and maximizing impact.
• Inspire and motivate our marketing team to achieve excellence, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and operational efficiency.
• Maintain knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), ISO-9000, and related regulations and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) ensuring all marketing materials adhere to regulatory standards.
• Ensure and maintain compliance with the company’s quality system requirements through training and adherence to policies, procedures and processes
• Travel to corporate office monthly and other travel, as needed.
• Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

• Bachelor’s degree required. Advanced degree and/or MBA preferred.
• At least ten (5) years at a senior management level
• Familiarity with FDA and other regulatory requirements.
• Prior experience with budgets in excess of $2 million.
• Prior business development, licensing, international regulations, and new product and opportunities experience preferred.
• Superior communication skills and demonstrated negotiation abilities, coupled with a strong focus on collaboration and teamwork.
• Superior knowledge of management methodologies.
• Demonstrated success implementing projects or solving issues that significantly impact the overall success of an organization.
• Must possess effective decision making skills and analytical ability.
• Demonstrated ability to maintain or improve fiscal efficiency.

In a fast growing group, successful leaders are frequently being offered increased areas of responsibility (subject to geographic mobility).

Eurofins offers international opportunities to strong performers.

jobs.title: High School Apprentice Teacher
High School AP Capstone Teacher
jobs.description:
Uncommon High School AP Capstone teachers are passionate about research and building an engaging, rigorous classroom culture focusing on helping all students gain the skills they need for college. Our teachers become experts in their course content, and have a keen sense of how to motivate and inspire high school students. At the heart of our AP Capstone classes is an emphasis on skill-building, communication and collaboration. Teachers facilitate student-directed research projects, building confidence in students to take on increasingly complex projects. At the conclusion of the AP Capstone program at Uncommon students will have planned, conducted, and presented their own research leaving them more prepared for the academic rigor and independence of college coursework.

Responsibilities

1.     Instruction

• You'll teach from a robust curriculum shared across our high schools that prioritizes topical issues, teaches students how to collaborate with others, and engages students in the research process.
• You’ll facilitate student-led research projects in AP Capstone courses by consistently reviewing student progress and using questions to steer projects in an appropriate direction.
• You’ll develop students’ independent and collaborative reading, writing, and discussion skills through several long term individual and group assignments.
• You'll prepare for and conduct one-on-one and small group conferences, teaching students how to critique and revise their own work.
• You’ll stay current on student progress and comprehension, regularly writing and adapting lessons to maximize student learning.
• You’ll partner with your department and your grade level team on content and instructional strategies that support your students and help all students succeed.
• You’ll attend a week long summer training required and led by the College Board for the AP Capstone courses you teach.

2.     Data Analysis

• You'll meet weekly with your principal and/or instructional coach to analyze and respond to trends in student work samples and assessments.
• You'll learn and implement strategies to differentiate instruction for all learners in your classroom.

• You’ll build positive relationships with students to ensure they feel seen, loved, and heard.
• You’ll partner with students’ families to ensure appropriate resources are available to support their child's learning needs.
• You'll engage in practice-based professional development, mentorship, and coaching sessions.
• You'll participate in weekly, school-wide meetings to cultivate community, model our core values, and encourage student achievement.
• You'll partner with your grade level team to develop academic goals and practice instructional strategies.

• Unwavering commitment to urban youth achieving greatness

• Mastery of and enthusiasm for relevant academic subjects
• Evidence of self-motivation, willingness to be a team player, and a strong sense of personal responsibility
• Ability and desire to implement feedback from school leaders and colleagues to become a more effective educator in service to our students.
• A background in education is not required for new teachers, but strong candidates should show a demonstrated passion for working with K-12 students and prior experience working in schools and/or urban communities is preferred.

Candidates must have received a Bachelor's degree from a college or university before employment begins Candidates must have also earned a cumulative Grade Point Average (GPA) of 2.75 or higher by the time employment begins

Proven track-record of high achievement in the classroom Minimum of two years teaching experience in an urban public school or charter school setting preferred Valid State Certification and Master’s degree are helpful but not required.

• Provide direct ENL instruction to small groups of students and/or provide inclusion support for ELA classes containing ELL students, based on case load.
• Work specifically with ELL students during assigned periods of the day to help access general education curriculum, build ELA skills, and support the use of additional technology-enhanced learning tools to promote ELL students’ language acquisition.
• Attend and participate in IEP meetings for English Learners and complete case management and compliance responsibilities as directed
• Advise teachers on modifying/accommodating curriculum for ELL students and share best practices to ensure high quality sheltered content instruction is provided.

• Focus constantly on student learning, thinking critically and strategically to respond to student learning needs
• Create a positive, structured learning environment to ensure that students observe the school’s core values, high expectations, and code of conduct

jobs.description:
The Nurse Practitioner/Physician Assistant (Sub-Investigator) plays a key role in maintaining the integrity and quality of clinical trials by ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, IRB requirements, and OMRC policies. In collaboration with the Principal Investigator (PI) or Medical Director, this position is responsible for accurately performing study visit procedures and collecting patient data in accordance with study protocols, while safeguarding the health, safety, and well-being of research participants. The NP/PA Sub-Investigator may also support select studies in a limited capacity as a Study Coordinator.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Reviews, comprehends, and adheres to assigned study protocol.
• Assists trial Investigators in screening and review of potential study participants' eligibility.
• Conducts subject visits.
• Maintains case report forms, patient charts and documentation.
• Ensures that all clinical activities are carried out in accordance with established research protocol and standards in compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, policies, and procedural requirements.
• Collects and enters data as necessary.
• Reviews lab results, imaging reports, and other study-specific reports.
• Completes required protocol training

Requirements:

• Master’s Degree required
• Licensed Nurse Practitioner/Physician Assistant
• At least 2 years of clinical research or sub-investigator experience is ideal, but not required
• Phlebotomy training required
• IV and infusion experience required
• Sound knowledge of FDA regulations, ICH-Good Clinical Practices (GCP) and ISOs
• Solid teamwork, organizational, interpersonal, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to multi-task, work under time constraints, work independently and cooperatively with interdisciplinary teams
• Strong computer skills in appropriate software and related company clinical systems is required

Ideal Experience:

• Candidates with a minimum of 1 year experience performing psychometric rating scales in a clinical setting or for clinical trials

About M3:

M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

Benefits:

A career opportunity with M3 Wake Research offers competitive wages of $50/hr - $90/hr for this role.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Project Manager | $110K-$130K + Remote | Inc. 5000 Award-Winning, High-Growth Coaching Company
jobs.description:
The Senior Project Manager is responsible for turning company priorities into clear plans and driving them through successful completion.

Working closely with leadership, you'll lead projects across Marketing, Copywriting, Marketing Automation, Customer Operations, Events, Coaching, Product, Sales, and external partners.

Projects may include coaching and course launches, webinars, book campaigns, sales funnels, email campaigns, digital products, live events, and other major company initiatives.

You'll need to understand how all of these pieces work together, what needs to happen and when, who owns each deliverable, what depends on what, and where a delay could put a launch or business objective at risk.

This is not an administrative project management position. Our client needs an experienced operator who can take a business objective, ask the right questions, gather requirements from stakeholders, determine the resources needed, identify milestones and dependencies, and build the complete project plan required to achieve it. From there, you'll lead multiple departments through execution, anticipate problems, hold owners accountable, and drive the project through successful completion.

Responsibilities

• Take high level business objectives and turn them into executable projects by interviewing stakeholders, gathering requirements, defining scope, identifying resources, mapping dependencies, establishing milestones, and assigning ownership.
• Own multiple projects at once across coaching and course launches, webinars, book campaigns, marketing campaigns, sales funnels, digital products, live and virtual events, and other company priorities.
• Personally architect detailed project plans, then translate them into clear timelines, dependencies, milestones, ownership, and workflows within Asana or similar.
• Lead projects across Marketing, Copywriting, Marketing Automation, Customer Operations, Events, Coaching, Product, Sales, leadership, and external partners.
• Drive revenue generating launches involving webinars, sales funnels, email campaigns, landing pages, copy, CRM and marketing automation, affiliates, promotional windows, testing, and hard launch deadlines.
• Manage major live events with 2.5K+ attendees, PM'ing the marketing, promotion, vendors, logistics, internal teams, timelines, and dependencies required for successful execution.
• Understand the commercial importance of deadlines and make sure teams know what must happen, by when, and what is at risk when a critical deliverable slips.
• Validate completion by reviewing critical deliverables, confirming requirements have been met, performing final QA checks, and closing execution gaps before launch.
• Assess the existing Project Management environment and Asana setup, preserve what works, improve what doesn't, and lead a Project Coordinator while creating greater visibility and accountability across the company.

• 7+ years of hands on Project Management, launch management, product/program management, or similar experience in a fast moving organization.
• Experience turning high level business objectives into complete project plans by gathering requirements, defining scope, identifying resources, mapping dependencies, establishing milestones, and assigning ownership.
• Experience leading complex projects across multiple established departments, driving accountability and keeping teams on track without becoming the individual executor for delayed deliverables.
• Experience inside a creator led coaching or personal development business selling courses, memberships, high ticket coaching, digital products, or live events through direct response marketing.
• Direct experience personally managing revenue generating launches involving webinars, sales funnels, email campaigns, landing pages, marketing automation, affiliates, or other major promotional initiatives.
• Experience identifying critical paths, risks, blockers, and resource gaps, developing recovery plans, and escalating decisions or additional resource needs when necessary.
• Experience managing large live events, ideally with thousands of attendees, across marketing, promotion, vendors, logistics, timelines, and execution.
• Exceptional attention to detail and ability to operate effectively across multiple simultaneous projects, hard deadlines, and high commercial stakes.

jobs.title: Geologist
jobs.description:
AECOM has an opening for an entry level Geologist in Sacramento or Oakland, California to assist with a variety of projects including data management, site investigations and remediation.

The successful candidate will assist with gathering and analyzing geological, hydrogeological and geochemical data in both the field and office settings. The field activities will consist of soil, groundwater, surface water, sediment, air and soil vapor sample collection, geological logging and interpretation, and the oversight of subcontractors including laboratories and excavation and drilling companies. The office activities will involve preparation of investigation reports.

This position is expected to begin ASAP.

Candidate must also be able to work as part of a project team comprised of AECOM staff and subcontractors. Flexibility to work on a multitude of diverse projects, a positive attitude, and commitment to workplace health and safety are imperative. Field work will be required including oversight of subcontractors.

Minimum Requirements:

• BA/BS in Geology or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• Valid U.S. Driver’s License required to visit project sites, clients, and other AECOM offices.
• As a condition of employment, selected candidate must pass a Motor Vehicle Records review.
• Candidate will undergo medical surveillance screening as part of the hiring process.
• Due to the nature of work, US citizenship is required.
• Ability to travel up to 80% to various job sites regionally.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Ability to understand and supervise advancement of soil borings and installation of monitoring wells.
• Ability to demonstrate a primary technical role in multiple site characterization, subsurface investigation and remediation projects at various client sites.
• Understand and assist with site conceptual models.
• Collect and evaluate environmental data in field and office settings.
• Prepare investigation reports and drawings.
• Possesses technical report writing skills. Independent field work and leadership of field teams.
• Contractor oversight.
• Selected candidate will be required to complete 40-hour HAZWOPER training or annual refresher class, if needed.
• Selected candidate will also receive First Aid/CPR training and AECOM-specific training.
• Learn and develop a keen understanding of hazard recognition, and environmental investigation or remediation.
• Candidate must be proficient with basic computer programs, MS Word and MS Excel.

• Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

AECOM is seeking a Senior Cost Estimator to help turn hurricane damage assessments into sound repair decisions for federal facilities in Kauai, Hawaii. • Document estimate bases, assumptions, exclusions, risks, and changes between estimate versions.

• 16+ years of developing construction cost estimates for complex facility or infrastructure projects.
• Experience estimating federal construction, emergency repairs, or building restoration.

jobs.title: O&M Technician I
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

The O&M Technician I performs a variety of operation and maintenance functions at water production and related facilities. This is an entry-level position that performs basic operational duties under the direction of a certified operator, performs maintenance tasks, and performs janitorial and laborer duties. Days and hours of duty may vary as required to fill other O&M Technician shift schedule, or under unusual circumstances.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Operates equipment manually and through instrumentation panels, computer terminals and programmable logic control units following process control procedures. Monitors and observes operating conditions, records observations and data in shift log. Diagnoses basic operational problems and takes corrective action per procedure.
• Performs routine CLAIR (cleaning, lubrication, adjustment, inspection and minor repair) on machines and related equipment which may include pumps, engines, centrifuges, generators, valves, gates, mixers, conveyors blowers, dryers, chemical feed, odor control, disinfection equipment, vacuum filters and belt presses. Reports and documents results of work performed and enters into appropriate database. Promptly reports any operational problems with machines or equipment to Lead or Supervisor.
• Collects water, wastewater, industrial waste, groundwater, sludge, residuals and/or gas samples according to schedule. Performs field tests (chemical, physical and biological) in order to pace chemical dosages for process and odor control units. Prepares chemical solutions, monitors supplies and recommends reorder.
• Performs routine lab tests and prepares reports per procedure.
• Performs routine instrument calibration for portable meters including, but not limited to, dissolved oxygen, pH, H2S, percent oxygen, lower explosive limit.
• Learns to inspect and becomes proficient at mechanical troubleshooting to determine repairs needed. Dismantles equipment to gain access to and repairs defective parts using hand tools, power tools and precision measuring and testing devices. Re-assembles and tests equipment ensuring safe and efficient operating condition is restored. Learns to troubleshoot hydraulic, pneumatic and electronic equipment and instrumentation.
• Performs manual labor including cleaning equipment, facilities and grounds as required and properly disposes of waste according to safety and environmental policies. Operates vehicles, mobile equipment and material handling equipment for operational and maintenance purposes.
• Other duties as assigned.

Work Environment:

• Requires working in outside and inside environments with noise and all temperatures and climatic conditions, and must be able to work under adverse weather conditions for extended periods of time.
• Spends 100% of the time in operations environment.
• Typically spends 25 – 35% of time exposed to outdoor and sometimes inclement weather.

Education/Experience/Background:

• High School Diploma/GED is required.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Requires good reading, math, writing, scientific, and verbal communication skills; a mechanical aptitude; and the ability to read, interpret, and record data from meters, gauges, scales, panels, computer consoles, and other equipment.

Required Certification/Licenses/Training:

• Minimum water/wastewater license as required by regulatory agencies at site.
• Must have and maintain a valid driver's license with a safe driving record in conjunction with policies and procedures.

Physical Requirements:

• Amount of time spent – Standing 25%, Walking 75% for as many as five miles per shift.
• Requires close visual and hearing observation to detect non-conformance and machine malfunction.
• Constantly uses hands to finger, handle or feel and frequently reaches with hands and arms. Works in various positions; works on ladders, catwalks, and supports at heights of 50 feet above the ground; and works with hands extended above and below head and body up to 40 minutes using hand tools weighing up to 15 pounds.

• Occasional stooping, bending or kneeling and entering confined spaces.

jobs.title: FP&A Lead
jobs.description:
About Us:

Here at Ambience, we never set out to be just another scribe. We’re building the AI intelligence platform that restores humanity to healthcare and drives meaningful ROI for health systems across the country.

Our technology helps providers focus on delivering great care by removing the administrative burden that pulls them away from patients and away from their most impactful work. Ambience delivers real-time coding-aware documentation and clinical workflow support across ambulatory, emergency and inpatient settings at the top health systems in North America.

Our teams operate relentlessly with extreme ownership to build the best solutions for our health system partners. We value candor, positivity and deep thought — and we expect a lot from each other because we know the problems we’re solving truly matter.

Ambience was ranked #1 for Improving the Clinician Experience in the KLAS Research Emerging Solutions Top 20 Report, recognized by Fast Company as one of the Next Big Things in Tech, named one of the best AI companies in healthcare by Inc., and selected as a LinkedIn Top Startup in 2024 and 2025. We’re backed by Oak HC/FT, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), OpenAI Startup Fund, and Kleiner Perkins — and we’re just getting started.




SUMMARY

Ambience is looking for a Strategic Finance / FP&A Lead to own and scale the company's financial forecasting, planning, and reporting infrastructure. In this role, you will build and maintain the financial models that drive high-confidence decision-making across GTM, Product, and Executive leadership. You will bring discipline to top-line modeling, support investor and board storytelling, and partner with accounting to ensure forecasting practices are GAAP- and audit-ready.



This is not a back-office finance role. You will be embedded in the business, working directly with sales, product, and operations leaders to translate operational reality into forward-looking financial visibility. The right person combines deep SaaS finance fluency with the ability to operate independently in a fast-moving, high-growth environment.




WHAT YOU WILL ACCOMPLISH

 - Fully own and maintain Ambience's 2-year financial model and rolling P&L forecast, including version control, updates, and internal distribution.

 - Lead the annual planning process end-to-end, including bottoms-up budgeting, goal alignment with department leads, and integration into the operating model.

 - Establish and run a monthly reporting cadence for forecast vs. actuals, including budget variance analysis, cash forecasting, and key variance commentary.

 - Lead financial preparation for quarterly board meetings, including top-line forecast updates, performance narratives, and investor-ready materials.

 - Build forecasting engines that link rep capacity, pipeline stages, and pricing into revenue forecasting, partnering with GTM and RevOps to validate assumptions.

 - Represent finance at deal desk to ensure effective margin representation across customer engagements.


EARLY SUCCESS INDICATORS (FIRST 3 TO 6 MONTHS)

 - Full ownership of the financial model and monthly forecast is transitioned, with a clear cadence for updates and scenario modeling.

 - Monthly reporting for forecast vs. actuals is stood up and running within 3-5 business days of close, with variance commentary that surfaces operational drivers.

 - A bottoms-up budgeting process is launched and underway with department leads, rolling into the operating model.

 - Financial preparation for board materials is delivered on time, with polished and exec-ready outputs that translate complex models into clean insights.

 - Pipeline-to-revenue forecasting models are operationalized, improving accuracy of long-range CARR forecasts.


WHAT WE LOOK FOR (MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS)

 - 6-10 years in strategic finance, FP&A, or investment banking with progression into operating roles at high-growth SaaS or technology companies.

 - Direct experience owning company-wide financial models and annual planning processes, including multi-year P&L forecasting and scenario analysis.

 - Strong fluency in SaaS metrics, cohort-based revenue modeling, and enterprise sales finance (pipeline conversion, rep productivity, CARR/ARR).

 - Demonstrated ability to partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, and G&A leaders to align financial planning with business strategy.

 - Excellent executive communication: translates complex financial models into crisp, defensible insights for leadership and board audiences.

 - High ownership mentality: independently manages forecast updates, builds repeatable processes, and drives automation without hand-holding.


NICE-TO-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS

 - Healthcare or other regulated industry experience.

 - Experience partnering closely with Accounting on GAAP revenue recognition, close processes, and audit readiness.

 - Familiarity with modern planning and BI tools such as Adaptive, Pigment, Sigma, or similar.

 - Experience supporting fundraising processes or investor relations at a venture-backed company.

 - Background in management consulting or investment banking prior to operating roles.



Life at Ambience 

Working at Ambience means opting into a high-ownership, high-trust environment built for people who want to grow fast, operate decisively and focus on work that matters. This could be the right place for you if you want to

 - Work on mission-critical AI technology that directly improves clinicians’ day-to-day lives and health system financial health across some of the most complex, high-stakes workflows in the world.

 - Join a “dream team” culture where we hire exceptional people, expect exceptional outcomes and invest deeply in feedback and continuous growth. We operate as a championship team, and that means being ok with hard, uncomfortable, ambiguous problems that lead to real greatness.

 - Operate with real ownership and accountability in an environment where there are no bystanders: If something is broken, we fix it! You will have meaningful autonomy and be expected to drive work to completion.

To help you do your best work, we pair these expectations with benefits intentionally designed to help you feel supported and safe at Ambience and beyond. Some of our key benefits include

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

 - 401(k) with a company match of up to 3% of base salary

 - A remote-friendly culture (with a San Francisco HQ) and full equipment provisioning to ensure you can work effectively from wherever you’re based.

 - Parental leave to support your family needs

 - Annual company-wide off-sites, team off-sites and regular team lunches and all-hands gatherings, with travel, lodging and meals covered

 - Flexible time off with no annual cap, company-wide holidays and an annual holiday shutdown from December 24–January 1 designed to support real rest and long-term sustainability.



Ambience Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected status. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Ambience is committed to supporting every candidate’s ability to fully participate in our hiring process. If you need any accommodations during your application or interviews, please reach out to our Recruiting team at accommodations@ambiencehealthcare.com recruiting@ambiencehealth.com. We’ll handle your request confidentially and work with you to ensure an accessible and equitable experience for all candidates.

We would never our ask candidates to download apps or make any form of payment(s). If you are contacted through WhatsApp, Telegram, similar but fake email domains, or asked to make a payment, these contacts are not legitimate. Report the issue immediately to LinkedIn and the FBI https://www.fbi.gov/how-we-can-help-you/scams-and-safety.

jobs.title: IAM Federation Services (Okta) Engineer
jobs.description:

The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), Okta, and Ping Federate to design, implement, and manage Directory and Authentication solutions for our global workforce of 80,000 users and customer identities.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for:

• Integrating federation technologies with enterprise and cloud systems (e.g., Active Directory, HR systems, cloud applications) using standards such as SAML 2.0, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0.

• Configuring and supporting various MFA technologies, such as PingID, Okta Verify, MS Authenticator, FIDO2, biometric, and OTP/push authentication.
• Troubleshooting and resolving federation authentication and authorization issues, including analyzing logs and diagnosing user provisioning challenges.
• Monitoring, optimizing, and ensuring the scalability and performance of federation infrastructure.
• Providing technical guidance and support to administrators and end-users on federation-related topics.
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams, vendors, and external partners to leverage integration opportunities and enhance federation capabilities.
• Documenting federation configurations, processes, and procedures; staying updated on industry trends and recommending improvements for ongoing enhancement.

Experiences that make you a strong candidate for this role:

• Proven experience as a Federation Engineer or in a similar role, with a strong understanding of identity and access management principles, using Okta, Entra ID, and PingFederate.
• Hands-on experience with Okta Identity Engine (OIE) for CIAM workflows (registration flows, self-service, and B2C/B2B identity patterns, Sign-in Widget).
• Solid knowledge of federation platform features and functionalities, including user lifecycle management, SSO, and MFA.
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze and resolve complex federation-related issues.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Strong attention to detail and ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• Bachelor’s degree with 5 years of experience OR Masters with 4 years of experience.

• Advanced proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation and management of identity systems.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, global environment.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator II - Cary, NC
jobs.description:
Iterative Health is a healthcare technology and services company powering the acceleration of clinical research to transform patient outcomes.

We built a leading performance-driven network of 100+ sites across the US, Europe, India, and Australia, conducting research directly in the communities where care is delivered across gastrointestinal, hepatology, obesity, and cardiology. By combining deep clinical trial expertise with cutting-edge AI, we connect sponsors' scientific ambitions with high-performing research teams that expedite and expand access to novel therapeutics for patients in need. Today, Iterative Health is headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, and New York City with 250+ employees world-wide.

As a Clinical Research Coordinator II (CRC II) at Iterative Health you will play a critical role in the successful execution of clinical trials by independently coordinating daily study activities and ensuring compliance with protocol requirements, regulatory standards, and patient safety guidelines.

This role is responsible for managing complex studies with minimal oversight while partnering closely with patients, investigators, sponsors, CROs, and internal teams to drive high-quality study execution and enrollment success.

Where You’ll Drive Impact

• Independently coordinate and manage industry-sponsored clinical trials from study start-up through closeout with minimal supervision

• Manage complex study visit schedules and protocol-related activities while ensuring adherence to study timelines and requirements

• Lead patient recruitment and retention efforts including chart review, patient outreach, informed consent discussions, and enrollment tracking to support study enrollment goals

• Conduct protocol-required patient visits and assessments in accordance with study protocols, GCP guidelines, and site SOPs

• Perform protocol-required clinical procedures including vital signs, ECGs, specimen collection, investigational product accountability, and phlebotomy, as permitted by applicable regulations, training, and organizational policy

• Process laboratory specimens and prepare shipments in accordance with protocol requirements and applicable IATA regulations

• Maintain accurate, complete, and timely study documentation including source records, informed consent forms, CTMS updates, and case report forms

• Ensure high-quality data entry and timely resolution of data queries in accordance with sponsor expectations and established timelines

• Serve as a primary point of contact for study participants throughout study participation

• Maintain ongoing communication with sponsors, CROs, investigators, site leadership, and internal teams to proactively resolve study-related issues

• Prepare for and support sponsor, CRO, and regulatory monitoring visits, audits, and inspections

• Review safety reports and ensure appropriate investigator review and documentation in a timely manner

• Maintain inventory and organization of study equipment, supplies, and investigational products onsite

• Contribute to process improvement initiatives to enhance site performance, operational efficiency, and patient experience

• Support the protection of human research participants in compliance with federal regulations, GCP, HIPAA, and institutional policies

• Maintain compliance with all site SOPs, privacy standards, and research protocols

• May support onboarding and mentorship of junior research staff and coordinators

• Perform job related duties as requested

What You Bring to the Team

• Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, healthcare, or related discipline required

• 3-5 years of clinical research or healthcare experience required

• Experience in [gastroenterology, hepatology, cardiology] therapeutic areas preferred

• CCRC® — Certified Clinical Research Coordinator or CCRP® — Certified Clinical Research Professional or equivalent clinical research certification preferred

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Ability to read, interpret, and apply research protocols and clinic policies

• Proficiency with CTMS, EDC systems, and standard office software applications

• Familiarity with CTMS or EDC systems preferred

Physical Requirements

• Ability to sit, stand, and move throughout clinical and office environments for extended periods of time

• Ability to lift and move up to 25 pounds as needed

jobs.title: Web Strategy & Optimization Manager
jobs.description:
Why this role exists

Our web experience is a company asset, owned and managed by marketing. It is a strategic growth platform and our most effective engine for brand, demand, customer engagement and education, and revenue.

We are hiring a Web Strategy and Execution Lead to run it that way. This is not a website management role. It is an ownership role for a commercial platform, accountable for what the asset returns to the business.

You will set the strategy for how our web estate earns attention, converts intent, educates customers, and contributes pipeline and revenue. You will then build, test, and ship against that strategy on a permanent cycle.

Primary accountability

Increase the commercial contribution of our web estate through strategy, customer experience, conversion optimization, content, search, technology, and continuous experimentation.

What you will own

Web strategy and development

• Own the strategy and roadmap for our web estate, tied directly to commercial outcomes rather than page count or release volume.

• Define what the platform is for by audience and stage, from first exposure through evaluation, purchase, onboarding, and ongoing customer engagement.

• Make the case for investment with a clear view of cost, return, and opportunity cost. Prioritize ruthlessly and be willing to retire what does not perform.

• Build the operating rhythm: intake, prioritization, delivery, measurement, and iteration.

Conversion and growth

• Own conversion performance end to end, from traffic quality through to qualified pipeline and revenue contribution.

• Run a continuous experimentation program with a live hypothesis backlog, clear success criteria, and honest read-outs on what did not work.

• Optimize the full journey rather than isolated pages: entry points, navigation, forms, demo and trial flows, self-serve routes, and handoffs to sales and e-commerce.

• Partner with demand generation on campaign landing experiences, personalization, and lead quality.

Content and search

• Own the search strategy across search engine optimization (SEO), answer engine optimization (AEO), and generative engine optimization (GEO), so we are found and cited in traditional search and in AI-generated answers.

• Build the technical, structural, and content foundations that support discoverability at scale: information architecture, schema, site performance, internal linking, and content governance.

• Work with brand, product marketing, and content to turn our domain expertise into web content that ranks, converts, and holds up to scrutiny from a compliance audience.

• Track share of visibility against the categories we intend to lead.

User experience and customer experience

• Be the advocate for the user inside the business. Know the journeys, the friction, and the drop-off points, and be able to evidence all three.

• Run continuous research and feedback loops: session analysis, user testing, surveys, and direct customer input.

• Raise the quality bar on usability, accessibility, and performance across every device and market we serve.

• Extend the experience beyond acquisition into onboarding, education, and existing-customer engagement.

Technology and execution

• Own the web technology stack and the roadmap for it, including content management, testing and personalization tooling, analytics, and the integrations that connect web to our marketing and revenue systems.

• Make build, buy, and partner decisions with a clear view of speed, cost, and long-term maintainability.

• Manage agency and contractor relationships where we use them, and hold them to the same standards we hold ourselves to.

• Work with information technology (IT), security, and data teams on privacy, consent, resilience, and compliance requirements.

Data and measurement

• Define the measurement framework for the asset: the metrics that matter, how they connect to pipeline and revenue, and how we report them.

• Build the instrumentation and attribution needed to make that framework trustworthy, in partnership with marketing operations and data.

• Turn analysis into decisions. Every significant change should have a hypothesis behind it and a read-out after it.

• Give the wider business a clear, regular view of how the platform is performing commercially.

Who you will work with

This role sits at the center of the marketing organization and reaches across the company.

• Marketing leadership. Align the web roadmap to the overall marketing strategy and investment case.

• Product marketing. Translate positioning, messaging, and launches into web experiences that convert.

• Demand generation. Deliver the conversion layer for campaigns, and improve lead quality as well as lead volume.

• Brand. Protect and build the brand experience online, and grow our share of visibility in the categories we want to own.

• Product. Connect the marketing site to the product experience, including trials, self-serve, and in-product education.

• Sales. Understand what turns web interest into qualified conversations, and close the gap between the two.

• Customer success. Extend the platform into customer education, engagement, and retention.

• People. Support the employer brand and the candidate experience on our careers pages.

• IT and data. Keep the stack secure, compliant, well-integrated, and well-instrumented.

What you will bring

• Significant experience owning a commercial web estate in a business-to-business (B2B) technology, software as a service (SaaS), or FinTech environment.

• A track record of measurable commercial improvement: conversion rate, pipeline contribution, revenue, or self-serve growth, with the numbers to evidence it.

• Depth across conversion rate optimization and experimentation, including how to design a test, size an opportunity, and interpret a result honestly.

• Strong command of search in its current form, including how AI-driven answer engines are changing discovery and what that means for content and technical strategy.

• Fluency with modern web technology and analytics, enough to make good architecture and tooling decisions and to hold technical partners to account.

• Experience leading through influence across marketing, product, sales, and engineering stakeholders.

• Comfort operating as both the strategist and the person who ships.

How you will work

• Innovative and future thinking. You look ahead of the current playbook and are already testing what comes next.

• Commercially minded. You think in return on investment, not activity, and can defend your priorities in commercial terms.

• Customer obsessed. You start with the user, and you can describe their journey in detail because you have watched it.

• Data driven. You form hypotheses, test them, and change your mind when the evidence says so.

• A strong strategic thinker. You can hold a two-year view of the platform and explain it clearly.

• An excellent executor. Strategy without shipping does not count. You move quickly and finish things.

• Influential. You bring stakeholders with you without needing authority over them.

• Growth minded. You seek feedback, share credit, and treat failed tests as information rather than embarrassment.

• Permanently experimental. The site is never finished, and you would not want it to be.

We especially like people who are obsessed by users, journeys, hypotheses, experiments, prioritization, conversion, data, and outcomes.

What success looks like in the first year

• A clear, funded, and agreed strategy for the web estate, with the commercial case behind it.

• A measurement framework the business trusts, and regular reporting against it.

• A live experimentation program with a consistent cadence and documented learnings.

• Demonstrable improvement in conversion and commercial contribution against an agreed baseline.

• Improved visibility in both traditional search and AI-generated answers for our priority categories.

Benefits:

• Equity as we want you to have a part of what we are building

• Unlimited Time Off Policy- A work-life balance and focus on our well-being are critical to keeping us performing at our best

• Annual learning budget to drive your performance and career development

• Budget to set up your home office upon joining

• Parental leave and childcare benefits

• Life Insurance to protect your loved ones

• Medical (100%), Dental (90%), and Vision (80%) contribution

• Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) to allow you to use tax free dollars for healthcare or day care related expenses

• 401k Contribution

• Financial Perks (Support with student loan, PerkSpot discounts, Pet Insurance discounts, Travel assistance

• Pre-Tax transit benefits

About us:

Our mission is to empower every business to eliminate financial crime.

By harnessing AI, a unified platform, and an extensive partner ecosystem, we help customers turn compliance into a catalyst for growth, operational resilience, and enduring regulatory trust.

More than 3,000 enterprises across 75 countries rely on our end-to-end platform and the world’s most comprehensive financial crime risk intelligence. With full-stack agentic automation, we help organizations automate up to 95% of KYC, AML, and sanctions reviews, cut onboarding times by 50%, reduce false positives by 70%, and handle 7x more work with the same staff.

ComplyAdvantage is headquartered in London and has global hubs in New York, Lisbon, Singapore, and Cluj-Napoca. It is backed by Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, Ontario Teachers’ Pension Plan, Goldman Sachs, and Andreessen Horowitz. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Fortune Brands is hiring a Product Manager to lead the Valve and Cartridge product line within our Moen water brand.

Every Moen faucet, shower, and bath product depends on a valve or cartridge to assembly effortlessly, seal perfectly, and provide the ideal tactile feel over years of use. This core technology serves as the foundation for our water control systems. As Product Manager, you will play a critical role in generating the growth and success of Valves and Cartridges and, consequently, Moen water products as a whole.

You will shape product strategies by aligning product offerings, channels, and pricing in ways that meet both customer and business needs. You propose strategic direction, drive the roadmap, and watch your decisions show up on shelves and in people’s homes.

This role calls for curiosity, empathy, and thoughtful analysis to understand market trends and customer experiences. You will work closely with cross-functional partners to develop meaningful strategies, communicate shared goals, and contribute to outcomes that strengthen market presence over time. This entails a strong business acumen with a technical aptitude to become a SME of the inner workings of Valves and Cartridges and the products they interface with.

The ideal candidate combines strong product management capabilities with a deep understanding of fluid-control technologies and consumer-facing products. They can translate customer insights, competitive analysis, and technical requirements into a compelling product strategy, while partnering with engineering teams to deliver innovative, reliable, and market-leading plumbing or fluid-control solutions.

POSITION LOCATION: This is a hybrid position based in our world-class Deerfield, IL campus, with flexibility to work from home on Mondays and Fridays.

What you will be doing:

• Development of strategic product plans by aligning performance, pricing, and supply chain with long-term business goals to support sustainable revenue and market growth.
• Partner with cross-functional teams to guide new product development and innovation initiatives through the full stage-gate process.
• Build collaborative relationships with external customers by sharing insights and helping identify opportunities for category growth.
• Work closely with Revenue Growth Management, Sales, Analytics, and Finance teams to better understand channel dynamics and evaluate pricing strategies.
• Contribute to go-to-market approaches by sharing perspectives and helping guide product and business decisions.
• Collaborate with Operations, including Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Quality, to support product launches and monitor ongoing product performance.
• Advocate for the voice of the customer by developing a deep understanding of customer needs, preferences, and market trends.
• Communicate product strategies and priorities clearly and thoughtfully to a variety of stakeholders.
• Support sales teams through training, participation in industry events, and ongoing engagement with partners and associations.
• Partner with Brand, Channel Marketing, Digital, and Commercialization teams to co-create marketing materials and promotional strategies.
• Review product-related communications to ensure clarity, consistency, and accuracy.
• Provide training and guidance to internal teams and external partners on product offerings and updates.
• Maintain regular, supportive communication with field sales teams, including occasional travel (approximately 15%).
• Contribute to additional projects and responsibilities as needed.

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Engineering, or related field.
• 3-5+ years of proven experience in product management, product development, or engineering leadership for high-volume manufactured products. (We will strongly consider engineering leaders ready to move into product management.)
• Experience managing products within the plumbing, kitchen and bath, or water delivery product categories OR other valve, cartridge, and fluid control technologies, including thermostatic and pressure-balancing mechanisms.
• Understanding of sealing technologies, including elastomeric and ceramic components, as well as flow performance, cavitation, acoustic/noise reduction, and durability requirements.
• Experience with high-volume manufactured products in industries such as plumbing, appliance, HVAC/R, water heating, beverage dispensing, irrigation, water treatment, pool and spa, or automotive fluid control systems.
• Ability to translate customer needs, competitive analysis, and engineering requirements into product strategy, roadmap priorities, and successful product launches through a stage-gate or equivalent process.
• Experience partnering closely with market-facing roles (such as Sales) and partnering with technical roles (engineering) to bring a quality product portfolio to market
• Strong analytical and communication skills to support collaborative decision-making.
• Technical aptitude and the ability to understand the engineering, functionality, and internal mechanics imperative to the product while having the business acumen (financials) to build strong business cases, derive market insights and product trends to ensure portfolio success.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
• Willingness and ability to travel up to 15%.

Preferred Qualifications:

• MBA or advanced degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.
• Ideal candidates will have experience in plumbing developing high-volume consumer, commercial, or automotive products that incorporate fluid control systems, including thermostatic and pressure-compensating valves, cartridges, elastomeric and ceramic sealing technologies, flow regulation, noise and cavitation management, and durability/lifecycle performance.
• Background in building products, home improvement, or durable goods.Experience with both B2C and B2B product environments.
• Familiarity with connected product technologies or smart home categories.

Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. We're seeking a passionate Product Designer who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and has experience designing intuitive, user-centered B2B software solutions. jobs.title: Director of Communications
jobs.description:
About Chicago Public Media

Chicago Public Media is one of the nation’s largest local nonprofit news organizations. Home to WBEZ 91.5FM, the Chicago Sun-Times, and Vocalo. Chicago Public Media reaches more than 3.3 million people weekly across broadcast, print, and digital platforms. As a mission-driven organization, we aspire to be the most trusted news source Chicagoans turn to for understanding the people, events, and ideas shaping our community.

Chicago Public Media is a 100% community-funded newsroom powered by nearly 97,000 members whose support makes our journalism possible. This sustained community investment helped drive nationally recognized work in 2025, including 29 awards from esteemed organizations, including the Public Media Journalists Association, the Edward R. Murrow Awards, and the National Association of Black Journalists.

We believe independent journalism is essential to a healthy democracy and that access to objective, fact-based news is a right for every citizen. We serve the public interest by creating diverse content that informs and enriches our community, supported by a dedicated staff of approximately 250 professionals.

For more information, please see the Chicago Public Media Annual Report.

The Opportunity

Chicago Public Media is seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Communications to lead external communications for our portfolio of trusted local media brands, including WBEZ, the Chicago Sun-Times, chicago.com, and Vocalo.

Reporting to the Vice President of Marketing & Communications, the Director of Communications will develop and execute a proactive communications strategy that advances the reputation, visibility, and influence of Chicago Public Media and its brands. Through earned media, executive communications, thought leadership, and strategic storytelling, this role will shape how the organization, its journalism, and its leaders are understood by audiences, partners, and stakeholders locally and nationally.

The Director of Communications is both a strategist and an executor. They will develop communications strategy while personally writing, pitching, and executing high-impact communications initiatives. They will cultivate relationships with journalists, position our reporters and leaders as trusted voices, and advise senior leadership on messaging and reputation. Working closely with colleagues across the organization, they will help ensure that Chicago Public Media tells a clear, compelling, and consistent story about its mission, journalism, and impact.

Responsibilities

Communications Strategy

• Develop and execute a comprehensive external communications strategy that advances the reputation, visibility, and influence of Chicago Public Media and its portfolio of brands.

• Partner with Marketing & Communications leadership to develop and maintain a clear, compelling, and consistent narrative across all external communications.

• Develop communications strategies for major organizational initiatives, partnerships, fundraising campaigns, product launches, and other strategic priorities.

• Establish goals, key performance indicators, and reporting to measure the effectiveness of communications efforts and continually refine strategy based on results.

Media Relations & Storytelling

• Serve as the primary point of contact for media inquiries and cultivate strong relationships with local, national, and industry reporters, editors, producers, and influencers.

• Lead proactive media outreach that elevates Chicago Public Media, its brands, its journalism, and its civic impact.

• Identify and secure opportunities for Chicago Public Media journalists, editors, and executives to appear in broadcast, print, digital, podcast, and live media.

• Write and distribute press releases, media advisories, statements, talking points, FAQs, and other external communications materials.

• Monitor media coverage and identify opportunities to amplify organizational priorities, respond to emerging issues, and strengthen the organization's public profile.

Executive Communications & Thought Leadership

• Partner with executive leadership to strengthen the organization's public profile through strategic communications and thought leadership.

• Collaborate on developing speeches, talking points, opinion pieces, award nominations, executive messaging, and other communications materials as needed

• Identify and secure speaking engagements, interviews, conferences, awards, and other opportunities that position organizational leaders as trusted voices on journalism, civic engagement, and the future of local media.

• Prepare executives for media interviews and public appearances through message development and media coaching.

Reputation Management

• Advise senior leadership on communications strategy and messaging during sensitive organizational issues.

• Serve as the primary liaison to the organization's external crisis communications consultant, coordinating planning, messaging, and response efforts as needed.

• Support communications planning and execution during high-profile or time-sensitive situations, ensuring alignment among leadership and external communications partners.

• Consult on sensitive internal communications to help ensure alignment between internal and external messaging.

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Partner closely with colleagues across marketing, editorial, development, legal, human resources, and executive leadership to ensure coordinated and effective communications.

• Provide strategic communications counsel on messaging, positioning, and audience impact across the organization.

• Represent communications in cross-functional planning for major organizational initiatives and announcements.

Qualifications

• Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex topics into clear, compelling communications for diverse audiences.

• Demonstrated success securing earned media coverage and building strong relationships with journalists and media outlets.

• Experience developing and executing communications strategies that strengthen organizational reputation and visibility.

• Strong executive communications experience, including speechwriting, messaging, media preparation, and thought leadership.

• Experience supporting organizations through high-profile or sensitive communications challenges.

• Strong judgment, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Highly collaborative, with the ability to build trusted relationships across departments and with senior leaders.

• Passion for local journalism, civic engagement, and the mission of public service media.

Compensation

The expected pay range for this position is $104,000 to $130,000 per ANNUM.

Chicago Public Media provides pay ranges representing its good faith estimate of what the organization reasonably expects to pay for a position. The pay offered to a selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as (but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the qualifications of the selected candidate, departmental budget availability, internal equity, geographical location, and external market pay for comparable jobs.

Working at Chicago Public Media

At Chicago Public Media, we care deeply about our employees as we know attracting, developing, and growing talent is key to our success and enhancing our impact.

Our culture is one where collaboration, diversity of ideas, and innovation are encouraged.  We value colleagues who will enhance our culture by bringing new ideas, divergent experiences, and talents to our dynamic workplace.

At Chicago Public Media we believe dedication to a great workplace includes supporting our employees and their families. As a result, we provide a broad and generous benefits package for employees at hire and in the years to come.

Our benefits include a competitive salary and benefits package which includes medical, dental, vision, vacation, holidays, life insurance, disability coverage, retirement savings, and a commuter benefits plan.

Chicago Public Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we actively seek and welcome people from all backgrounds, orientations, and life experiences to join our team.

The essential functions described above are not all-inclusive and are not intended to create any contractual or other legal commitment. Chicago Public Media may change the content or format of this job at any time in its sole and exclusive discretion without notice.

The completion of clinical trials is the rate-limiting step for filing of new drug applications and, ultimately, to product commercialization.  The on-time initiation, uninterrupted conduct, and completion of clinical studies is dependent on the timely delivery of clinical supplies of top quality to the clinical sites.

Responsibilities:

• Define and implement a global clinical supply strategy, in conjunction with mentor or experienced Drug Supply Manager
• Ensure all clinical supplies (early phase, affiliate studies, and IIS) are delivered on time, on budget and of top quality with no studies interrupted or delayed due to clinical supplies
• Define and manage external budget for compounds (comparators, co-meds, over-encapsulation, depots, and importation costs)
• Represent the clinical supply chain on Integrated Evidence Strategy Teams (IESTs)
• Participate and contribute to Product Presentation and Device Strategy Team (PPDST) meetings
• Define API and drug product requirements and delivery dates to support the clinical supply chain
• Matrix management of Clinical Supply Project Managers (CSPMs) supporting the global clinical supply chain
• Allocate bulk drug product to CSPMs, minimizing wastage
• Lead the recovery of clinical supplies during a product recall, support the evaluation and approval of non-medical complaints (NMCs), exception reports and recalls

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Pharmacy or Science
• 5-7+ years’ experience in the pharmaceutical industry
• Demonstrated understanding of the overall drug development process
• Experience in project management, planning, forecasting, budgeting
• Excellent interpersonal, team, and leadership skills
• Sound knowledge of GxP

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Specialist - Licensed Therapist
jobs.description:
CLINICAL OPERATIONS SPECIALIST – LICENSED THERAPIST

Employment Type: Full-time, Salaried
Reports To: Clinical Director
Location: Remote/Hybrid
Compensation: $83,000–$125,000 per year (commensurate with experience)
Equity: Offered
Benefits: 401(k), full health, dental, and vision insurance, generous unlimited PTO package
Role Type: Licensed Clinician
Caseload: No Caseload Requirement

 


ROLE SUMMARY

The Clinical Operations Specialist is a licensed therapist who provides critical support to clinical operations, leveraging their expertise to address issues involving patients, providers, documentation, quality, and care delivery. This role acts as a bridge between clinicians and the organization’s operational, product, quality, credentialing, and care-coordination teams. Other duties may be assigned as needed.

 


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Independent clinical license required: LCSW, LMFT, LPC, or PhD/PsyD (or state equivalent)

 - Minimum of 4 years post-licensure clinical experience

 - Experience with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems required

 - No specific EHR or scheduling platform experience necessary; training will be provided

 - Comfortable working in a hybrid clinical/operational role (not traditional caseload-based)

 - Strong cross-functional communication skills to collaborate with Product, Quality, Credentialing, and Operations teams

 - Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote/hybrid environment

 


RESPONSIBILITIES


1. MEMBER AND CLINICAL SUPPORT

 - Serve as a clinical resource for member issues requiring clinical judgment

 - Support pre-intake clinical review and outreach as needed

 - Review and follow up on member feedback requiring clinical attention

 - Manage rematch escalations and assist with enrollment-related clinical questions

 - Collaborate with the User-Success team to address member needs

 - Handle clinical escalations beyond the scope of non-licensed operations staff

 - Conduct consultation hours as needed

 - Participate in clinical interviews during periods of active hiring

 


2. CLINICAL QUALITY AND DOCUMENTATION

 - Address documentation issues requiring clinical interpretation or provider-to-provider communication

 - Support clinical review of incomplete or missing diagnoses

 - Participate in clinical quality initiatives and audits

 - Support and educate providers on clinical documentation standards

 - Participate in payer and similar clinically-oriented audits

 - Collaborate on quality-improvement initiatives

 - Review caseload and documentation integrity

 


3. THERAPIST DATA AND CLINICAL METRICS

 - Work with Product and Clinical Leadership on workforce and quality metrics

 - Use internal reporting and quality-monitoring tools

 - Interpret metrics for full-time/part-time providers

 - Identify trends in clinical quality and areas needing follow-up

 - Partner with technical teams as reporting and automation tools evolve

 


4. CLINICAL MEETINGS AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL REPRESENTATION

 - Represent Clinical Operations in cross-functional meetings (Clinical x Product, User-Success x Clinical, team meetings, Credentialing/Quality Committees, organizational meetings)

 - Serve as a clinical liaison to other departments requiring clinical expertise

 


5. MEDICATION MANAGEMENT OPERATIONS

 - Assist with manual rescheduling of medication-management follow-ups when necessary

 - Address exceptions to automated medication-management workflows

 - Support resolution of escalated prior-authorization issues

 - Handle documentation requests (e.g., FMLA, short-term disability) needing clinical review

 - Draft physician-facing documentation for review and signature

 - Coordinate member communication about documentation appointments

 - Support related scheduling changes

 


6. CLINICAL PROCESS IMPROVEMENT AND SPECIAL PROJECTS

 - Identify and propose improvements to clinical workflows

 - Collaborate with Product and Engineering for clinical input

 - Translate clinician and patient needs into operational or product requirements

 - Participate in clinical process redesigns and special projects needing clinical expertise

 - Help develop scalable clinical workflows as the organization grows

 


7. OTHER CLINICAL DUTIES AS REQUIRED

 

Marvin Behavioral Health is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and identities to apply.
