jobs.title: Scientist II
jobs.description:
At RES, we’re looking for purpose-driven individuals who are passionate about restoration and sustainability, and who want their work to make a lasting environmental impact. Our team members go above and beyond, bringing initiative, integrity, and a strong work ethic to every project. Collaboration is key—we thrive on teamwork, open communication, and diverse perspectives. In a field that constantly changes, we value those who are resilient, adaptable, and resourceful in the face of challenges. If you're intellectually curious, eager to learn, and ready to help restore ecosystems and protect natural resources, you’ll find your place here.

RES is looking for a Scientist II to join our team.

As a Scientist II at RES, you will support the implementation, monitoring, and success of ecological restoration projects across diverse ecosystems. This is a mid-level field and data-focused role that combines fieldwork, technical reporting, and cross-functional coordination to support permitting and compliance documentation. You will collect and manage data, contribute to project reporting, and bring applied knowledge of restoration science to project execution.

Watch the projects our scientists work on here.

Why You’ll Love This Job:

• You’ll get your boots dirty—literally. You’ll spend meaningful time in the field, collecting the data that drives real-world ecological restoration.

• You’ll see the impact of your work. Your efforts support the restoration of wetlands, streams, and habitats that improve ecosystems and communities across the region.

• You’ll learn from the best. With the support of senior scientists and cross-functional project teams, you’ll continue to grow your expertise in restoration science and applied ecology.

What your day-to-day might look like:

You’ll begin your day prepping field gear for a monitoring visit to a stream or wetland mitigation site. Once on-site, you may collect data using GPS, YSI meters, or turbidity sensors, following project-specific protocols and QA/QC standards. You’ll help guide junior team members, ensure field datasheets are accurate, and troubleshoot equipment as needed.

Back at the office, you’ll enter and analyze field data, draft sections of monitoring reports, and interpret site plans or planting palettes. You might meet with design or regulatory teammates to discuss crediting metrics, or help evaluate a site’s feasibility based on regulatory or ecological constraints. You’ll balance independent work with collaborative efforts to move restoration projects forward.

We would like to talk to you if you have many of the following:

• Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, biology, geology, or a related natural/physical science field

• 2+ years of experience in fieldwork, sampling, ecological monitoring, or technical writing (or 1+ year with an advanced degree)

• Proficient in field sampling protocols, GPS/GIS tools, and equipment use

• Experienced in collecting field data independently and following SOPs

• Skilled in data analysis and technical report writing

• Strong knowledge in one scientific discipline (e.g., hydrology, soils, stream morphology), with working knowledge in others

• Comfortable evaluating site conditions and regulatory constraints

• Familiar with project task tracking and regulatory requirements

• Able to perform functional assessments and related calculations with minimal supervision\

What will make you stand out:

• ArcGIS experience or certification

• Drone pilot certification

• Experience with functional assessment methodologies (e.g., HGM, BEHI)

• Experience using and maintaining field equipment (e.g., YSI multimeters, turbidimeters)

You Will Thrive in This Role If You:

• Are comfortable in the field and in the office—and enjoy a balance of both

• Can collect, organize, and interpret scientific data with care and accuracy

• Communicate effectively and take ownership of your tasks

• Can help guide junior field staff and contribute to team learning

Please note that the “Day in the Life” section is not intended to be an exhaustive list of job duties, but rather a representative snapshot of typical responsibilities and work experiences at RES.

RES is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a VEVRAA Federal Contractor. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Equipment Operator equip
jobs.description:
At SanMar, the work you do makes a difference.

What's the Short Version?

The Equipment Operator safely and efficiently locates product by using a radio frequency (RF) unit, manually pulls product from locations, and transports product to various departments and/or locations. They process a portion of customer orders throughout the production day and restock product into bins.

What Will You Be Doing?

• Operate powered lift equipment to move product and materials as assigned using a radio frequency (RF) unit to scan movement of product, identify locations, etc.

• Load, unload, move, stack, and stage product.

• Restock, pick, and pack product for customer orders.

• Inspect assigned equipment daily at start of shift; is responsible for checking out equipment and returning in same condition on a daily basis.

• Follow procedures for proper care and use of equipment, to include keys.

• Adhere to all safety requirements and guidelines.

• Complete and maintain SanMar's Lift Operator Certification in compliance with OSHA guidelines every three years.

What Are We Looking For?

• High School Diploma or equivalent

• 1-3 years of lift operator experience

• Ability to read, write and have sufficient ability to identify colors, sizes, quantity, label and SKU information

• Basic math skills in counting and quantity required

• Demonstrates ability to follow directions and change priorities or job duties as business needs require; rotate to other production functions as needed

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to work in fast-paced, high-volume environment while meeting deadlines

• Able to work both independently and within a team

• Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills

• Comprehend verbal and written instructions

• Essential days or overtime may be required

What's Our Offer?

Paid Time Off: You`ll accrue paid time off on a weekly basis based on hours worked up to 112 hours per year to start. Employees also receive 8 paid holidays and 1 paid family day off.

Additional Benefits:

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits

• 401k plan and matches $1 for $1 up to 4% of earnings, matched & vested at every pay cycle

• Life insurance

• Short/long-term disability coverage

• Paid maternity/paternity leave

• Pet insurance

What Should You Expect?

DC Warehouse (Equipment): While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to stand, walk, talk and hear. The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 60 pounds. The employee operates powered equipment requiring use of both hands as well as full range of motion of the neck, head and back. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms, grasp and perform repetitive hand, wrist and arm motions. The employee is frequently required to climb stairs, kneel/squat, bend and carry. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Employee may be required to wear a headset covering one or both ears. Employee will be required to wear Personal protective equipment such as a Protective harness while operating equipment. Basic English literacy is required for operation of machines and necessary daily paperwork. Work environment is moderately noisy. The employee is occasionally required to work near conveyor systems. There is exposure to dust and changes in weather conditions. Work is performed under typical warehouse conditions. Potential hazards exist with regard to machinery such as forklifts, pallet jacks, mechanized systems, etc. Work environment is hectic and fast-paced.The employee is regularly exposed to ambient lighting and can be exposed to extreme heat and extreme cold including climates consistent with outside weather conditions.

Why Work at SanMar?

Our people are at the heart of everything we do. They bring their talent, passion and dedication to work with them every day. Their hard work inspires us and gives us purpose. We love working here together.

Whether you work in our headquarters, from your home or in one of our distribution centers across North America, we believe that investing in you is just the right thing to do. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to support your health and well-being, life balance, career growth and (eventually) retirement.

SanMar works with brands you already know, like Nike, The North Face and Brooks Brothers, as well as providing industry-leading private label apparel and accessories. Our people come to work excited to do their part, providing clothing that helps people feel that they’re a part of something special.

Here’s your chance to be a part of this story. If you’re ready to work in a place where your participation matters and your growth is a priority, we’re ready for you.

SanMar is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, whoever you love or follow in faith, whatever your disability or superpower status, whichever ethnicity or gender you identify with, you are welcome at SanMar.

SanMar participates in E-Verify.

jobs.title: Distribution Admin Manager

jobs.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We’re looking for a Distribution Administration Manager who’s resourceful and excited about getting things done. You'll be responsible for performing administrative functions for our Distribution team as we rapidly scale our business in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Please note that the term Distribution refers to User Acquisition.

In this role, you'll;

• Support the user growth office and distribution teams from our office

• Support user growth leads to ensure distributors are recruited and managed as per internal policy and procedures

• Be responsible for requesting, dispatching, and tracking usage of distribution-related supplies

• Be an administrative focal contact point for Interim firms, Wave and distributors for user growth.

• Liaising with field teams to dispatch all required stationery and merchandising material required and any other required supplies, tracking dispatched and available supplies and their use.

Key details

• Our salaries are competitive and calculated using a transparent formula.

• Airtime reimbursement.

• Free food and a beautiful office space

Requirements

• Proficient in French and a local language with English being a plus

• Completed university degree

• Experience in an administration position or an HR/payroll position

• Be a good note-taker

• Strong computer skills, especially with spreadsheets, and experience using Google Maps

• Excellent organizational skills and communication skills

• Experience leading networks of salespeople, agents or retail networks in a back-office administrative position is an added advantage

• Experience running payroll for 20+ people and having a strong understanding of the DRC labour laws is also an added advantage.

You might be a good fit if you

• Are exceptionally organized, able to follow through on tasks independently, and able to manage priorities effectively

• Are very flexible and mission driven

• Are detail-oriented and seek to achieve excellence in everything you do

• Are a clear and proactive communicator, both on written and verbal forms

• Are a self-starter and proactive about achieving ambitious targets

• Always seek to improve yourself through honest self-reflection

• Demonstrate tenacity and a willingness to go the distance to get so

Our team

They process a portion of customer orders throughout the production day and restock product into bins.

What Will You Be Doing?

• Operate powered lift equipment to move product and materials as assigned using a radio frequency (RF) unit to scan movement of product, identify locations, etc.

• Load, unload, move, stack, and stage product.

• Restock, pick, and pack product for customer orders.

• Inspect assigned equipment daily at start of shift; is responsible for checking out equipment and returning in same condition on a daily basis.

• Follow procedures for proper care and use of equipment, to include keys.

• Adhere to all safety requirements and guidelines.

• Complete and maintain SanMar's Lift Operator Certification in compliance with OSHA guidelines every three years.

What Are We Looking For?

• High School Diploma or equivalent

• 1-3 years of lift operator experience

• Ability to read, write and have sufficient ability to identify colors, sizes, quantity, label and SKU information

• Basic math skills in counting and quantity required

• Demonstrates ability to follow directions and change priorities or job duties as business needs require; rotate to other production functions as needed

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to work in fast-paced, high-volume environment while meeting deadlines

• Able to work both independently and within a team

• Demonstrated verbal and written communication skills

• Comprehend verbal and written instructions

• Essential days or overtime may be required

What's Our Offer?

Paid Time Off: You`ll accrue paid time off on a weekly basis based on hours worked up to 112 hours per year to start. Employees also receive 8 paid holidays and 1 paid family day off.

Additional Benefits:

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits

• 401k plan and matches $1 for $1 up to 4% of earnings, matched & vested at every pay cycle

• Life insurance

• Short/long-term disability coverage

• Paid maternity/paternity leave

• Pet insurance

What Should You Expect?

DC Warehouse (Equipment): While performing the duties of this job, the employee is constantly required to stand, walk, talk and hear. The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 60 pounds. The employee operates powered equipment requiring use of both hands as well as full range of motion of the neck, head and back. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms, grasp and perform repetitive hand, wrist and arm motions. The employee is frequently required to climb stairs, kneel/squat, bend and carry. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Employee may be required to wear a headset covering one or both ears. Employee will be required to wear Personal protective equipment such as a Protective harness while operating equipment. Basic English literacy is required for operation of machines and necessary daily paperwork. Work environment is moderately noisy. The employee is occasionally required to work near conveyor systems. There is exposure to dust and changes in weather conditions. Work is performed under typical warehouse conditions. Potential hazards exist with regard to machinery such as forklifts, pallet jacks, mechanized systems, etc. Work environment is hectic and fast-paced.The employee is regularly exposed to ambient lighting and can be exposed to extreme heat and extreme cold including climates consistent with outside weather conditions.

jobs.title: Growth Engineer, GTM
jobs.description:
At Range, we’re building towards a world where anyone can live the financial life they imagine for themselves. If that sounds like a mission you want to be a part of, let’s create it together.

We’re building AI-powered wealth management. Investments, taxes, retirement, estate planning, all in one platform instead of scattered across different advisors and apps. ABOUT THE ROLE

Range is one of the fastest-growing RIAs in the US, and our Growth team is responsible for building the acquisition engine behind it. We’re hiring a Growth Engineer to own the technical infrastructure powering that engine. Sitting at the intersection of marketing, engineering and product, this role will work on a wide variety of projects - from landing pages and experimentation frameworks to data pipelines and ad platform signals. Your work will directly impact revenue by improving conversion rates, increasing signal quality, and enabling faster iteration across the entire go-to-market engine.

This position is based in New York City, and follows an in-office schedule Monday through Friday. If you’re not currently located in the area, relocation will be a contingency for employment.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the technical implementations behind Conversion Rate Optimization. Build and ship landing page experiments, signup funnels, scheduling and lead routing. Write the JavaScript that powers dynamic content and personalized experiences. Take projects from concept to production without needing a PM to define every step.

 - Run the experimentation system. Build and maintain the A/B testing framework, feature flags, and targeting logic that the team uses to ship experiments across landing pages, signup flows, and the broader funnel. Translate funnel insights into technical implementations that actually move conversion.

 - Build and maintain GTM infrastructure. Architect the integrations connecting our website, CRM, analytics, and ad platforms. Build the APIs, webhooks, and automations that move data cleanly between them. Debug across tools when something breaks - and these systems break in interesting ways.
   



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Strong JavaScript and SQL skills; experience with React a plus

 - Comfort building integrations across APIs, webhooks, and the tools in a modern GTM stack

 - Familiarity with tracking implementations: GA4, Segment or RudderStack, server-side GTM

 - A strong sense of ownership. You ship, you iterate, and you find the next problem to work on without being handed it.
   



NICE TO HAVE

COMPENSATION

jobs.description:
ABOUT GOODIE AI:

Goodie helps leading brands win AI search. As billions of people use ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and other AI systems to discover products and make buying decisions, brands need a way to understand and influence how they’re represented.

Goodie gives teams a full AI control plane: real-time visibility into how AI models speak about their brand and products, how competitors show up, and an optimization engine to improve visibility and performance. This category didn’t exist two years ago – we were early, and we’re defining it.

We’re backed by strong investors, trusted by category-leading customers, and scaling fast. We’re hiring curious, ambitious builders to help shape the future of AI search.



What we're looking for:

You own a portfolio of enterprise and scale-up clients end to end. You're accountable for whether they stay, grow, and can explain in their own words what Goodie did for them.

The work isn't advisory from a distance. You run onboarding. You hold the cadence. You walk into the call where the CFO wants to know what they're paying for, and you answer with data. AEO isn't SEO 2.0, it's a new discipline, and the clients who hired us are looking at you to tell them what to do.



What you'll do:



Own the relationship

 - Act as the primary strategic lead for a portfolio of enterprise and scale-up clients, from kickoff through renewal.

 - Own onboarding end to end: kickoff, workspace and prompt setup, competitive baseline, stakeholder enablement.

 - Build a relationship map on every account. Confirm the executive sponsor, multi-thread beyond your champion, re-onboard new stakeholders when people move.
   
   

Protect and grow the book

 - Own retention outcomes on your portfolio, with a weekly read on account health.

 - Distinguish leading indicators from lagging ones, and frame movement against the client's own business objectives rather than platform metrics.

 - Forecast risk and expansion early, and bring both to the account lead with the observation and the context.

 - Lead quarterly business reviews for enterprise accounts.
   
   

Bring the AEO substance

 - Build AEO strategies that maximize visibility across LLMs and AI search surfaces, and deliver the audit, strategy deck, and roadmap that go with them.

 - Make concrete technical recommendations (schema, llms.txt, crawlability, entity structure) prioritized so a client's dev or agency team can actually ship them.

 - Read citation patterns, source types, and competitor behavior across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and AI Overviews, and turn that into a point of view.

 - Present to executives, marketers, and technical teams, often in the same room, without losing either audience.

Close the loop internally

 - Bring client signal to Product with enough specificity to act on.

 - Develop case studies and references alongside Business Development.

 - Turn what you learn across accounts into frameworks the rest of the team runs.




What you have:

 - 4+ years in customer success, account strategy, SEO, content strategy, or search marketing, with real client ownership rather than participation on someone else's account team.

 - A track record leading multiple client relationships at once, including accounts you inherited mid-stream and took somewhere better.

 - Direct experience in commercial conversations: renewals, ROI pushback, budget scrutiny.

 - Fluency in both registers, technical (structured data, AI crawlers, entity SEO) and strategic (brand narrative, growth), and the judgment to know which one the moment calls for.

 - Composure in high-stakes conversations, including the ones where you push back on a client's plan, and curiosity about how AI systems interpret and present information.

Our mission-first software and data engineering platform modernizes data operations, utilizing advanced workflows, CI/CD, and secure DevSecOps practices. We focus on challenges in Information Warfare, Cyber Operations, Operational Security, and Data Structuring, enabling end-to-end solutions that drive operational impact.

We are committed to delivering cutting-edge tools and capabilities that address the most complex national security challenges, empowering our partners to stay ahead of emerging threats and ensuring the success of their critical missions. At Clarity, we are people-focused and set on being a destination employer for top talent, offering an environment where innovation thrives, careers grow, and individuals are valued. Join us as we continue to lead innovation and tackle the most pressing challenges in national security.

Position Summary

We’re building a secure, scalable web and mobile application for the United States Space Force (USSF), and content is central to its success. We’re seeking a Senior Content Strategist to lead the development and execution of content strategy across this platform. This role will shape how content is structured, governed, authored, and delivered to diverse user groups — from USSF personnel to broader Department of Defense audiences.

You’ll collaborate across teams—design, product, engineering, and communications—and guide a distributed group of content contributors to ensure that all content is effective, consistent, accessible, and aligned with mission needs.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead Content Strategy: Develop and document the overarching content strategy for the USSF platform, including voice/tone, structure, and delivery standards.

• Design Content Models: Work with developers and CMS admins to architect scalable, reusable content structures using Directus (headless CMS).

• Governance & Standards: Establish editorial standards, style guides, and publishing workflows. Ensure consistency and compliance across distributed authors.

• Contributor Enablement: Train, support, and onboard USSF personnel who contribute content. Create playbooks, templates, and onboarding materials to ensure quality and consistency.

• Content Design & UX Writing: Collaborate with UX designers to write and review interface copy, microcopy, and task-based content for clarity, usability, and accessibility.

• Audit & Optimize: Conduct content audits, user research, and stakeholder interviews to inform strategy. Use analytics to improve engagement and effectiveness.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the voice of content in product planning, sprint cycles, and stakeholder reviews. Advocate for user-centered messaging and plain language principles.

Required Qualifications

• 6+ years of experience in content strategy, UX writing, or content design for digital platforms

• Strong background in working with CMS tools—preferably headless platforms like Directus, Contentful, or Strapi

• Experience creating and maintaining editorial standards, content models, and governance frameworks

• Exceptional writing and editing skills with a focus on clarity, tone, and accessibility

• Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional product teams in Agile environments

• Familiarity with Section 508 accessibility standards and user-centered content practices

• Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills

Preferred Qualifications

• BS in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Information Systems, or Computer Science, from an ABET accredited or CAE designated institution

• Experience working with public affairs and legal teams within the DoD

• Experience supporting federal or DoD digital services or working within a regulated or secure environment

• Understanding of structured content design and content API delivery

• Familiarity with plain language, information architecture, and UX principles

• Exposure to security clearance processes or prior work with classified content workflows

• Experience working in or with the USSF

Salary Range: $100,000 - $247,000

Pay Range

The posted pay range reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position and is provided to give candidates a general understanding of the compensation opportunity. The actual salary offered will be determined based on the requirements of the position and a variety of job-related factors, which may include geographic location, applicable Federal Government contract labor categories and wage rates, relevant experience, skills and competencies, education, certifications, and the scope and responsibilities of the role.

Because this position may be performed in multiple locations and may be subject to different contract requirements, the salary ultimately offered may vary based on the applicable location and contract. The posted range is not a guarantee of a specific starting salary or an indication that an offer will be made at any particular point within the range.

Total Rewards

In addition to competitive base pay, Clarity provides a Total Rewards package designed to attract and retain exceptional professionals committed to excellence. Our benefits reflect the value we place on skilled individuals who drive our impact in critical digital missions.

At Clarity, a career means joining a high-performing team advancing vital work in the digital landscape. We encourage you to consider the total value of joining us—competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and resources that support your growth and impact.

Our Total Rewards package includes performance-based bonuses, extensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, substantial paid time off and holidays, flexible work arrangements where possible, and a range of income protection benefits. We are committed to supporting your well-being, professional growth, and ability to contribute to essential digital missions.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Security Integrations - Prompt Engineering
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Integrations Platform team and build the tools that make engineers' lives easier, both when they're building integrations and when they're pulling data together to actually make sense of it. This role is about developer experience: understanding what developers actually struggle with day to day, and building tools that remove that friction so they can move faster and get more done.

The Integrations Platform team owns the tooling that supports how integrations get built, deployed, and understood. That includes infrastructure and deployment tooling built on Terraform, telemetry pipelines running through BigQuery, and the AI-driven tools and evaluations we use to interpret that data and turn it into something people can actually act on. You'll build and maintain these tools, listen closely to the engineers who rely on them, and take ownership of projects that span infrastructure, telemetry, and AI-assisted data interpretation, from first idea to shipped result.

This is fast-moving, often ambiguous work. We are looking for someone who is comfortable operating without a fixed spec, listens thoughtfully, and collaborates well across teams. You should drive effectively toward outcomes while supporting your teammates, bring clear ideas on what should be built, care about the developers using your tools, and feel equally comfortable working independently or alongside product teams and partners.

Prior experience with the Elastic product suite isn't required, but it helps.

What you will be doing:

• Lead green-field initiatives that shape the future of the developer experience for building and maintaining Security Integrations

• Architect and drive the tooling and automation strategy, leveraging Gen AI to solve problems at scale rather than one-off fixes

• Set a collaborative tone for the team by fostering open communication, mutual respect, and thoughtful decision-making, while mentoring engineers along the way

• Represent the team in the open, working closely with Security and Ingest teams, Elastic users, and the broader open source community to shape direction and build trust

What you bring:

• Experience building and running evals for AI systems at scale, with a strong sense of measuring output quality and catching regressions

• Strong proficiency in Python and Go, with hands-on Terraform for infrastructure and deployment, and BigQuery for telemetry and data analysis

• Proven ability to run projects end to end with autonomy, alongside the judgment to bring others along and seek input when needed

Bonus Points:

• Production experience with the general Elastic ingest model

• Experience in cybersecurity

• Experience parsing logs and events, ideally with exposure to OpenTelemetry, ECS, or OCSF in a security or observability context

These ranges represent the lowest to highest salary we reasonably and in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting.  We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the ranges may be modified in the future.

An employee's position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.

Elastic believes that employees should have the opportunity to share in the value that we create together for our shareholders. Therefore, in addition to cash compensation, this role is currently eligible to participate in Elastic's stock program.  Our total rewards package also includes a company-matched 401k with dollar-for-dollar matching up to 6% of eligible earnings, along with a range of other benefits offered with a holistic emphasis on employee well-being.

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. jobs.title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst - Mid-Level & Senior [U.S. Citizenship, Top Secret Clearance w/SCI Eligibility Required]
jobs.description:
Start Your Adventure at Via Logic

Location: Primarily onsite at a government site in Ashburn, VA. Specific worksite expectations will be confirmed for the assignment.
Type: Full-time, W-2
Compensation: $110,000–$152,000 annually, depending on experience, qualifications, and assignment.
Experience: Mid-Level: 3+ years; Senior: 5+ years of relevant experience

Anticipated annual salary ranges by level are:

• Mid-Level: $110,000–$139,000

• Senior: $118,000–$152,000

Join Via Logic supporting U.S. Customs and Border Protection cybersecurity operations. As a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst, you'll collect, analyze, and disseminate threat information that helps security teams understand emerging threats and protect critical systems and networks.

You'll monitor threat intelligence sources, analyze threat data and adversary activity, and produce intelligence reports and products for technical and leadership audiences. Depending on your experience level, you'll also contribute to cyber investigations, threat intelligence sharing, and collaboration with other security teams to turn intelligence into actionable monitoring, detection, and defensive measures.

This posting covers both Mid-Level and Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst openings. We'll consider your experience against the requirements for the available level.

Eligibility & Clearance Requirements

Due to CBP requirements, applicants must:

• Be a U.S. citizen.

• Hold a Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility at the time of assignment.

• Meet and maintain CBP suitability requirements for access to government facilities and systems.

• Be available to work primarily onsite at a government site in Ashburn, VA. Specific worksite expectations will be confirmed for the assignment.

SCI eligibility means you are eligible to be considered for access to certain compartmented intelligence information. Access for a specific assignment requires separate government authorization and a need to know. Please include your current clearance status and SCI eligibility when applying.

Your Mission

• Collect, analyze, and disseminate cyber threat intelligence supporting security operations and the protection of CBP systems and networks.

• Monitor classified and unclassified threat intelligence sources to identify emerging threats, adversary activity, indicators of compromise (IOCs), and relevant tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).

• Analyze threat data and conduct research supporting cyber investigations, including analysis of IOCs, threat actor activity, personas, and Advanced Persistent Threat activity.

• Produce cyber threat intelligence reports, assessments, briefings, and other products for technical teams, leadership, and other stakeholders.

• Identify trends in cyber threats, attacks, targeting, and suspicious or malicious activity and communicate relevant findings.

• Support the Security Operations Center in validating IOCs and identifying appropriate monitoring, alerting, blocking, detection, or other defensive measures.

• Contribute threat intelligence to incident response, threat hunting, detection, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, and Purple Team activities as needed.

• Share actionable cyber threat intelligence with internal stakeholders and authorized federal partners.

• Research threats associated with third-party partners, vendors, and products that may affect CBP information systems or networks.

What You Bring to the Expedition

• Relevant professional experience in cyber threat intelligence, incident detection and response, or related cybersecurity operations.

• Experience collecting, analyzing, researching, or reporting on cyber threat information.

• Ability to analyze indicators of compromise, adversary activity, and threat data to identify relevant trends and potential risks.

• Experience developing clear threat intelligence reports, assessments, briefings, or other analytical products.

• Understanding of how cyber threat intelligence supports security operations, investigations, monitoring, and detection.

• Ability to communicate technical findings clearly and collaborate with security analysts, government partners, and other technical teams.

We are considering candidates at two levels:

• Mid-Level - 3+ years: At least three years of professional experience in incident detection and response and/or cyber threat intelligence analysis, along with a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

• Senior - 5+ years: At least five years of professional experience collecting, synthesizing, fusing, or authoring classified and unclassified cyber threat intelligence products.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience working in a Security Operations Center or similar cyber defense environment.

• Experience working with both classified and unclassified cyber threat intelligence.

• Experience collaborating directly with cyber threat hunting, incident response, or Purple Team functions.

• Experience translating threat intelligence into detection, monitoring, or other defensive security improvements.

Your Route Into Via Logic

One posting, two experience levels. Tell us about the threat intelligence work you've performed, the environments you've supported, and the reports, assessments, or other intelligence products you've developed.

Include your current clearance status and SCI eligibility so we can assess your fit for the available openings.

Why Explorers Stay

• Healthcare coverage and paid time off that give you room to take care of life outside work.

• Teammates who share knowledge, pitch in, and help each other grow.

• Opportunities to deepen your specialty and explore adjacent areas of cybersecurity as new assignments open up.

• Meaningful work protecting systems that support a federal mission.

How We Work

• These positions work primarily onsite at a government site in Ashburn, VA. Specific worksite expectations will be confirmed for the assignment.

• You'll collaborate with Via Logic teammates, government partners, and other technical teams using tools approved for your work environment.

• Core task coverage is generally weekdays, 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, with on-call support requirements based on assignment needs. We'll discuss specific scheduling expectations before moving forward.

• When virtual meetings are part of the work, we expect active participation and use video when appropriate and permitted by the client environment.

About Via Logic

Via Logic LLC is an information technology partner supporting mission-driven work across DevSecOps, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data science, and national security analytics for federal and commercial clients. Our teams help modernize complex systems through automation, secure engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, and scalable infrastructure solutions that support real-world impact. But beyond the work itself, we care deeply about how we work. We believe great teams are built through collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and trust. Whether you're supporting customer missions, strengthening business operations, or leading expeditions of your own, Via Logic is a place where Explorers are encouraged to grow, contribute, and continuously evolve.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Via Logic LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all Explorers are valued and supported. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. We believe different perspectives strengthen teams, improve innovation, and help us build better solutions for the missions we support.

Accessibility & Accommodations

Via Logic is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience for all candidates. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the application and interview process to support accessibility needs and ensure every candidate has an equitable opportunity to explore a career with our team.

Recruiting Fraud Notice

Via Logic takes recruiting fraud seriously. We will never ask candidates for payment, banking information, cryptocurrency, gift cards, or other personal financial information during any stage of the hiring process. All legitimate communication from our team will come directly from authorized Via Logic representatives using official company channels. Due to the rise of fraudulent recruiting activity across the industry, we encourage candidates to use caution if something feels unusual, rushed, or too good to be true. Real adventures should involve solving meaningful challenges - not wiring money to strangers pretending to be recruiters on the internet. If you have concerns about the legitimacy of a communication claiming to represent Via Logic, please verify the information through our official website before sharing personal information or taking further action.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Senior Software Engineer, Endpoint Fabric (Rust/C++)

jobs.title: Senior Sensor Engineer
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril’s Air Defense team builds autonomous robots that find other robots and knock them out of the sky. This team is the nexus of premier Anduril-built products such as Roadrunner, Sentry, Anvil, Pulsar, and Wisp integrated into a software-enabled Air Defense family of systems tailored to the modern battlespace. At a time when air superiority can no longer be taken for granted, we provide critical force protection capabilities to support the warfighter. Our autonomous family of networked sensors and effectors enables our users to rapidly close the kill chain against a broad range of UAS threats that continue to evolve at a rapid pace.

ABOUT THE JOB

Every kill chain we close starts with multiple networked sensor modalities to identify threats far before we can see them. We are looking for a Senior Sensor Engineer to join our rapidly growing Air Defense team based in Irvine, CA. In this role, you will be responsible for integrating new sensor modalities into our family of systems: RF and radar front ends, electro-optical/infrared assemblies, acoustic arrays, and the detection hardware behind them. You will lead the development and integration of first party and third-party sensors to take integrated sensors through conceptual design, system integration and test, and field deployment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own sensor hardware integrations end to end, from requirements through architecture, block diagram, and simulation

• Evaluate performance of multiple sensing modalities such as RF/radar front ends, electro-optical/infrared assemblies, acoustic arrays, and other emerging sensor families. Drive the verification and validation strategy for perception and make the determination of which sensor fits which mission.

• Integrate sensor hardware with the rest of the kill chain, working alongside effector, autonomy, and Lattice teams to turn a raw detection into a closed engagement

• Represent Anduril externally as a technical authority on airborne sensing, including standards and industry bodies, sensor vendors and development partners, and technical engagement with customers

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of relevant experience and a B.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent

• Demonstrated depth in multi-modal sensor architecture and sensor selection, with a working command of the detection physics that bounds each one.

• Ability to exercise high ownership over a complex system across design, integration, test, and production.

• Demonstrated experience specifying and verifying sensing performance quantitatively, including detection and false alarm characterization, range performance analysis, and validation of a model against measured data

• Must be authorized to work in the United States

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with environmental qualification of military systems, such as MIL-STD-810 and MIL-STD-461

• Experience with networks of distributed sensors

• Experience with modeling systems of sensors using AFSIM

• Knowledge of common communication busses (I2C, SPI, UART, RS-422/485, Eth, PCIe)

• Active Secret or Top Secret clearance

US Salary Range

$166,000—$220,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

Rightway is seeking a Director of Finance to join our growing team. In this role, you will lead our FP&A and strategic finance function and serve as a key partner to Accounting, senior leadership, and the board. You will own the models and numbers that leadership and investors rely on, and shape the strategy behind them.

This position is ideal for a strategic thinker and hands-on operator who can move fluidly between building an investor-grade financial model and partnering with department leaders on the decisions behind it. The ideal candidate brings finance leadership experience within the PBM and/or healthcare industry, is a strong communicator, and has exceptional attention to detail. You will join a lean, high-performing team of technology and healthcare experts who share a mission to humanize the healthcare experience.

This role reports to the SVP of Finance.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Build, own, and continuously improve a dynamic, integrated 3-statement financial model (P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow) that serves as the analytical backbone for planning, scenario analysis, and fundraising.

• Lead annual budgeting, monthly and quarterly forecasting, and long-range financial planning across all business functions.

• Own cash forecasting including near-term (13-week) and full-year models tied to budget and growth assumptions.

• Build runway and scenario models that layer hiring plans and churn to inform strategic decisions.

• Prepare board decks, investor reporting, and diligence-ready materials.

• Own key SaaS and healthcare metrics, including CARR, net revenue retention, and gross margin.

• Lead headcount and compensation planning tied to department budgets and the hiring plan.

• Partner with department leaders to drive accountability against plan and advise on the financial implications of business decisions.

• Partner with Accounting during monthly close cycles to ensure accurate variance analysis and timely reporting.

• Mentor and develop members of the finance team.

WHO YOU ARE:

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required; MBA or CPA preferred.

• 10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, or investment banking, including finance leadership at a growth-stage tech or healthcare company.

• Expert in building dynamic, integrated 3-statement financial models that provide clarity, accuracy, and insight into business performance.

• Strong quantitative and problem-solving abilities with a deep understanding of SaaS and healthcare business models (e.g., NRR, CARR, gross margin).

• Experience supporting or preparing for a fundraise or due diligence process.

• Proficiency with NetSuite, Salesforce, Excel, and Google Sheets; familiarity with modern financial planning tools is a plus.

• Able to translate complex financial concepts into clear, actionable insights for business and technical stakeholders.

• Excited by ambiguity and motivated to design and implement scalable processes in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

• Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and a methodical approach to troubleshooting and problem solving.

EXTRA CREDIT:

• Experience within the healthcare technology industry or Pharmacy Benefit Management space.

• Exposure to M&A or post-acquisition integration.

• Prior experience at a Series C through E venture-backed startup.

COMPENSATION:  $175,000 - $200,000 annually, in addition to bonus and equity

Compensation offered will be determined by geographic location, experience, and qualifications.

CYBERSECURITY AWARENESS NOTICE

In response to ongoing and industry-wide fraudulent recruitment activities (i.e., job scams), Rightway wants to inform potential candidates that we will only contact them from the @rightwayhealthcare.com email domain. We will never ask for bank details or deposits of any kind as a condition of employment.

ABOUT RIGHTWAY:

Rightway is on a mission to harmonize healthcare for everyone, everywhere. Our products guide patients to the best care and medications by inserting clinicians and pharmacists into a patient’s care journey through a modern, mobile app. Rightway is a front door to healthcare, giving patients the tools they need along with on-demand access to Rightway health guides, human experts that answer their questions and manage the frustrating parts of healthcare for them.

Since its founding in 2017, Rightway has raised over $300mm from investors including Khosla Ventures, Thrive Capital, Francisco Partners, and Tiger Global. We’re headquartered in New York City, with satellite offices in Denver and Dallas. Our clients rely on us to transform the healthcare experience, improve outcomes for their teams, and decrease their healthcare costs.

HOW WE LIVE OUR VALUES TO OUR TEAMMATES:

We’re seeking those with passion for healthcare and relentless devotion to our goal. We need team members that embody our core values:

1) We are human, first
Our humanity binds us together. We bring the same empathetic approach to every individual we engage with, whether it be our members, our clients, or each other. We are all worthy of respect and understanding and we engage in our interactions with care and intention. We honor our stories. We listen to—and hear—each other, we celebrate our differences and similarities, we are present for each other, and we strive for mutual understanding.

2) We redefine what is possible
We always look beyond the obstacles in front of us to imagine new solutions. We approach our work with inspiration from other industries, other leaders, and other challenges. We use ingenuity and resourcefulness when faced with tough problems.

3) We debate then commit
We believe that a spirit of open discourse is part of a healthy culture. We understand and appreciate different perspectives and we challenge our assumptions. When working toward a decision or a new solution, we actively listen to one another, approach it with a “yes, and” mentality, and assume positive intent. Once a decision is made, we align and champion it as one team.

4) We cultivate grit
Changing healthcare doesn’t happen overnight. We reflect and learn from challenges and approach the future with a determination to strive for better. In the face of daunting situations, we value persistence. We embrace failure as a stepping stone to future success. On this journey, we seek to act with guts, resilience, initiative, and tenacity.

5) We seek to delight
Healthcare is complicated and personal. We work tirelessly to meet the goals of our clients while also delivering the best experience to our members. We recognize that no matter the role or team, we each play a crucial part in our members’ care and take that responsibility seriously. When faced with an obstacle, we are kind, respectful, and solution-oriented in our approach. We hold ourselves accountable to our clients and our members’ success.

Rightway is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that believes in the strength of diverse thought, beliefs, backgrounds, and education. We foster an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated to drive the best business decisions possible. We do not discriminate on any basis protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, need, and performance.

jobs.title: Ръководител отдел  - Mall Veliko Tarnovo
jobs.description:
Като ръководител отдел ти ще си лидерът, който подкрепя и мотивира своя екип. Приемайки нашата приобщаваща култура, която насърчава екипна работа и предприемачески дух, ще създадеш среда, в която всеки може да се развива. Следвайки нашите ценности, ще допринасяш както за своя успех, така и за развитието на компанията.

Ти ще:

• Ръководиш екипа към предоставяне на неповторимо клиентско преживяване, като гарантираш отлични оперативни и мърчандайзинг стандарти, докато с увереност представяш и продаваш нашите продукти.
• Носиш отговорност за представянето на магазина.
• Анализираш продажбите, идентифицираш възможности за подобрение, поставяш амбициозни цели и създаваш стратегии за повишаване на резултатите, печалбата и ефективното управление на наличностите.
• Организираш работния процес и графика на екипа, като гарантираш безпроблемно отваряне и затваряне на магазина.
• Избираш нови таланти, провеждаш обучения и развиваш екипа, като същевременно насърчаваш приобщаваща култура, екипна работа, професионално развитие и иновативно мислене.
• Следиш най-новите модни тенденции, предпочитанията на клиентите и динамиката на пазара, за да подсигуриш актуалност и конкурентно предимство.
• Представяш себе си и компанията по позитивен и професионален начин.
• Промотираш активно лоялната ни програма.

С КОГО ЩЕ РАБОТИШ

Магазините ни са сърцето на компанията – мястото, където клиентите се запознават с нашата марка от първа ръка. Като част от динамичния екип в магазина, всяка роля – от продавач-консултант и ръководител отдел до управител, визуален мърчандайзер и главен касиер – допринася за създаването на вдъхновяваща и приветстваща обстановка. Ще имаш възможност да си сътрудничиш с колеги от различни магазини, да обменяте опит и да постигате успехи заедно. Работейки с твоя екип, ще имаш ключова роля в това да помагаш на клиентите да се чувстват уверени и свободни да изразят себе си чрез най-новите модни тенденции и класически модели. Изграждайки значима връзка с клиентите в нашите магазини, ние създаваме достъпна и устойчива мода за всички.

КОЙ СИ ТИ

Ние търсим човек с…​

• Опит в управлението на екип в сферата на търговията.
• Умения за планиране, анализ и проследяване, използвайки различни системи и отчети.

И човек, който е…​

• Уверен и вдъхновяващ лидер, който развива екипа си и олицетворява ценностите и културата на компанията.
• Успяващ в динамична среда, със силни комуникативни умения и целеустременост в решаването на проблеми.
• Мотивиран да създаде неповторимо клиентско преживяване, като с увереност препоръчва и продава нашите продукти.
• Проявява интерес към модните тенденции, динамиката на пазара и анализира конкурентите с цел увеличаване на продажбите.
• Комуникативен, креативен и любопитен.
• Адаптивен, аналитичен и ориентиран към постигане на резултати.
• С добри познания както писмени така и говорими по английски език.

КОИ СМЕ НИЕ

H&M Group е международна група от утвърдени модни марки и инициативи. Нашата цел е да докажем, че няма компромис между изключителния дизайн, достъпните цени и устойчивите решения. Стремим се да направим модата достъпна за всички, като поставяме клиентите в центъра на всяко наше решение.

Нашият екип се състои от хиляди отдадени и талантливи професионалисти, обединени от обща култура и ценности. Заедно използваме силата, различията и знанията си, за да изградим бъдещето на модната индустрия, като го направим по-приобщаващо и устойчиво.

ЗАЩО ЩЕ ОБИКНЕШ РАБОТАТА СИ ПРИ НАС ​​

В H&M Group се гордеем с това, че сме динамична и приветстваща компания. Предлагаме на нашите служители атрактивни придобивки и множество възможности за професионално развитие по целия свят.

• 25% служителска отстъпка за всички марки част от H&M Group, както в магазините, така и онлайн (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories и ARKET);
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Научи повече за програмата ни тук;
• Ваучери за храна на стойност 78€;
• Осигуровки върху реално брутно възнаграждение;
• Допълнително здравно осигуряване;
• Възможност за издаване на Multisport карта на преференциална цена;
• Обучения и възможност за световно кариерно развитие в компанията;
• Програма “Препоръчай приятел” с включен бонус;
• Бонусна система, формираща се от определени условия;
• Платен отпуск при сключване на брак;
• H&M карта-подарък при раждане на бебе;
• Ваучер при навършване на 10 години в компанията;
• Възнаграждение при пенсиониране;

ПРИСЪЕДИНИ СЕ КЪМ НАС

Нашите ценности, приобщаваща и сплотена култура ни различават от всички останали. Но най-важни са хората, които ни правят това, което сме.

Това е постоянна позиция на пълен работен ден, намираща се в град Велико Търново.

Очакваме твоята кандидатура като ни изпратиш актуално CV на английски език. Поради политиката за личните данни, приемаме кандидатури единствено през кариерната ни страница.

Направи следващата крачка в кариерното си развитие с нас. Пътешествието започва тук.

* Стремим се да имаме справедлив и прозрачен процес и затова любезно молим да не прилагаш мотивационно писмо към кандидатурата си, тъй като то често съдържа информация, която лесно би могла да бъде разбрана пристрастно.

jobs.title: Social Media Specialist & Content Creator (PART-TIME, CONTRACT, US-BASED ONLY)
jobs.description:
We are on a mission to empower people of all ages to thrive in an increasingly connected world. By uniting Aura and Qoria, organizations driven by personal experiences with identity theft and cyberbullying, our combined company brings together global category leaders to create a safer internet for everyone across all stages of life. Today, our $340M+ ARR platform protects over 9 million families and 32,000 schools across 100+ countries. Driven by a global team of over 1,000 people, we are combining intelligent digital threat protection with student and child wellbeing tools so everyone can navigate the digital world safely and with confidence.

As Aura expands, we are seeking a creative, results-driven Social Media Specialist & Content Creator to support our content and social strategy. This is a PART-TIME (approximately 30 hours per week) CONTRACT role and must be based in the US (Eastern Timezone preferred).

This role will help make organic social a meaningful awareness engine for Aura by creating engaging, platform-native content that expands our reach, drives conversation, and builds cultural relevance. The ideal candidate is a socially native storyteller who understands what captures attention online, who eagerly looks for new AI tools to implement, and is excited to turn ideas, trends, and audience insights into content people want to watch and share.

What you'll do:

• Create social-first content: Appear on camera regularly across short-form video, Stories, and other organic formats, bringing scripts and briefs to life with confident, authentic delivery. This is the core of the role.

• Support content production: Help concept, film, and edit content alongside your on-camera work, and publish across formats including static posts and carousels.

• Bring creative ideas to life: Turn briefs, trends, audience insights, and cultural moments into compelling content for TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.

• Support Aura’s organic social channels: Help manage the day-to-day content calendar, including scheduling, publishing, quality assurance, and coordinating assets, while also pulling performance metrics for the team to analyze.

• Spot trends and move quickly: Stay current on emerging formats, conversations, and platform behaviors, identifying opportunities for Aura to participate in timely and relevant ways.

• Test, learn, and iterate: Experiment with hooks, formats, creative treatments, and posting strategies, then use performance insights to strengthen future content.

• Engage with our community: Help Aura show up authentically in comments, creator conversations, and relevant online communities while maintaining a consistent brand voice.

• Use AI thoughtfully: Explore AI-powered tools that can accelerate ideation, production, editing, and audience research while maintaining strong creative judgment and brand standards.

• Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with social, brand, design, product marketing, and paid media teams to support campaigns and broader business priorities.

jobs.title: Project Quality Manager
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Blue Energy is transforming how nuclear power gets built. Instead of constructing each plant on-site from scratch - a process that takes 10-15 years and is too expensive and unpredictable to finance - we build our plants like ships: in a factory, on an assembly line, then transport and assemble them at the site. This cuts costs by over 60% and brings plants online in just three years. We also pair natural gas with nuclear at our sites, so customers can start receiving power from gas turbines right away and then switch over to clean nuclear power once it comes online - getting energy to the grid faster while nuclear is being built. Our mission is to make nuclear energy abundant, affordable, and repeatable at global scale. We use proven, already-approved reactor designs and work with existing nuclear and industrial sites, giving us a faster path to regulatory approval. By manufacturing this way, we put nuclear power on the same cost-reduction curve that has made wind, solar, and batteries cheaper every year.



Role Summary

The Project Quality Manager is a senior leadership role within Blue Energy's Quality Assurance organization, reporting directly to the Director, Quality, and owning project-level quality execution across engineering, procurement, and construction activities. This role manages the Project Quality Assurance (PQA) Leads and Project Quality Engineers (PQE) assigned per project, developing project quality plans, executing surveillances and hold-point inspections, and verifying that deliverables meet contractual and regulatory acceptance criteria. This role will initially include Quality Control responsibility

This position will help ensure alignment with NRC regulatory requirements, 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, ASME NQA-1, and ASME BPVC keeping project execution defensible and audit-ready as Blue Energy's nuclear development program moves from licensing into construction.

This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced, innovative project quality professional who thrives in highly regulated environments and is motivated to develop an initial project quality program growing it to scale a for FOAK gas-to-nuclear site development program.



Key Responsibilities

Project Quality Planning & Governance

 - Develop and maintain project quality plans aligned to 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, ASME NQA-1, ASME III and contractual/regulatory acceptance criteria.

 - Establish quality hold points, witness points, and surveillance schedules for each active project.

 - Maintain project-level quality metrics and reporting to support leadership visibility and NRC inspection readiness.

Surveillance & Inspection Operations

 - Perform and oversee site surveillances, hold-point inspections, and receipt inspections across active project sites.

 - Review purchase orders and contracts to verify correct quality requirements are specified before award.

 - Verify deliverables meet contractual and regulatory acceptance criteria prior to release or turnover.

 - Identify, track, and ensure proper closeout of non-conforming conditions and conditions adverse to quality.

Supplier & Contractor Quality Interface

 - Coordinate with Supplier Quality on audits, assessments, and approved-supplier status for project-assigned suppliers.

 - Support disposition of nonconformances and corrective actions identified during project execution through the Corrective Action Program (CAP).

Reporting, Quality & Compliance

 - Maintain dashboards and reporting tools that provide visibility into surveillance status, inspection findings, and outstanding actions.

 - Support internal and NRC or third-party audits and inspections related to project quality.

 - Ensure documentation and records generated by project quality activities are controlled per Document Control and Records Management requirements.

Team & Stakeholder Support

 - Manage and mentor Project Quality Assurance (PQA) Leads and Project Quality Engineers (PQE) assigned per project.

 - Foster quality (nuclear and non-nuclear) quality culture and concepts to the Blue Energy project team.

 - Partner with engineering, construction, and project management teams to embed quality requirements throughout the project lifecycle.

 - Represent Quality in project meetings, design reviews, and change control processes as required.

Qualifications

 - 10+ years of experience in nuclear quality assurance and quality control.

 - Solid working knowledge and experience of nuclear and non-nuclear codes, standards, and methodologies, including 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, ASME NQA-1, and ASME BPVC.

 - Qualified nuclear Lead Auditor.

 - Demonstrated managerial and leadership experience, including managing embedded project quality staff.

 - Experience developing project quality plans and performing surveillances and hold-point inspections.

 - Strong organizational and communication skills, with a service-oriented mindset partnering across engineering, procurement, and construction.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Quality Control (QC) and receipt inspection experience preferred.

 - Experience supporting large-scale infrastructure, construction, or energy projects; nuclear development projects strongly preferred.

 - Experience developing project quality processes from the ground up in a program build-out setting.

 - Familiarity with NQA-1 program elements and 10 CFR 50 Appendix B criteria at the project level.

 - Relevant certifications in quality assurance, auditing, or project management (e.g., ASQ CQA, certified nuclear Lead Auditor).



We look forward to your application and helping foster an era of safe, clean, affordable, and abundant energy.

Blue Energy is dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this or other roles at Blue Energy now or in the future.

jobs.title: Care Manager, RN (Springfield, MA  Market  /Field Based)
jobs.description:
FreedomCare is a healthcare company that has been dedicated to revolutionizing the home care industry since 2016. We support our patients by ensuring they have the power to choose a caregiver who will care for them in the comfort of their own homes. Our mission spans coast to coast, supporting patients across the U.S.

We pride ourselves on our values which drive the level of care that we deliver to our patients:

- Here For You (An attitude of service, empathy, and availability)

- Own It (Drive and ownership)

- Do the Right Thing (High integrity)

- Be Positive (Great attitude and a can-do positive approach to challenges)

Join our team and make a positive impact on the lives of others! We are looking for a Care Manager, RN for our Massachusetts team!

This is a field-based RN position that requires regular travel throughout an assigned Massachusetts territory to conduct in-home visits and support member care. Coverage areas may include the North Shore, Boston Proper, South Shore & Cape Area, Worcester, and Western Massachusetts.

Department & Position Overview:

FreedomCare’s Massachusetts operations support the MassHealth Adult Foster Care (AFC) program, which helps eligible adults with medical, physical, cognitive, or behavioral health needs receive daily assistance in a home setting from a qualified caregiver with professional care team support.

The Care Manager, RN is responsible for conducting initial in-home assessments, orientations for new patients and caregivers, and providing ongoing care management and support. This role combines clinical assessment, care coordination, patient and caregiver education, and quality assurance to ensure safe, effective, and person-centered care.

The Care Manager, RN collaborates closely with patients, caregivers, and interdisciplinary care teams to assess needs, develop individualized plans of care, and facilitate the seamless initiation and delivery of services. Through regularly scheduled home visits, the RN completes and coordinates applicable clinical assessments and evaluations; develops, implements, monitors, and reviews member plans of care; monitors member health status; provides clinical oversight, education, support, and evaluation of AFC caregivers; and coordinates care with the member, responsible party, care manager, primary care provider, and other service providers. The Care Manager, RN proactively communicates clinical concerns, changes in condition, and potential barriers to care with the appropriate team members to ensure timely intervention, effective care coordination, and optimal patient outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct initial in-person clinical assessments and coordinate timely service activation, ensuring all required documentation, approvals, and standard procedures are completed.

• Develop, implement, and manage individualized plans of care, making and documenting revisions as the patient’s needs or condition change.

• Educate patients, caregivers, and internal teams regarding care needs, safety considerations, service requirements, caregiver responsibilities, and next steps.

• Coordinate patient care through timely communication and documentation with physicians, clinical disciplines, internal partners, and appropriate community resources.

• Provide ongoing education and coaching to support effective use of established best practices, promote caregiver competency, and connect patients and families with appropriate resources.

• Review caregiver documentation regularly and respond appropriately to identified changes in the patient’s condition, environment, or service needs.

• Identify changes in condition, safety concerns, service gaps, incidents, or other urgent issues and escalate them in accordance with established clinical protocols.

• Complete and document assessments, visits, clinical observations, care-plan updates, incidents, communications, and follow-up actions accurately, thoroughly, and within required timeframes.

• Support authorization, renewal, start-of-care, and continued-service processes, as applicable.

• Maintain compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements, professional standards, and company policies and procedures.

• Perform other related duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Credentials:

• Current, unrestricted license as a registered nurse issued by the Massachusetts Board of Registration in Nursing.

• At least two years of recent experience providing direct care to elders or adults with disabilities, preferred.

• Completion of tuberculosis screening before assignment and ongoing screening consistent with applicable CDC, Massachusetts Department of Public Health, and MassHealth requirements.

• Successful completion of required CORI, SORI, OIG exclusion, reference, employment-history, and professional-license checks.

• Must not be related to or legally responsible for a member assigned to the RN.

• Valid driver’s license, required automobile insurance, reliable transportation, and ability to travel to member qualified settings.

Qualifications:

• Strong clinical judgment, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.

• Knowledge of person-centered care, professional nursing standards, and home- and community-based services.

• Knowledge of the health, functional, cognitive, behavioral, and safety needs of elders and adults with disabilities.

• Ability to learn, interpret, and consistently apply Massachusetts Adult Foster Care regulations, MassHealth requirements, clinical protocols, and organizational policies.

• Demonstrated commitment to high-quality member and caregiver service.

• Ability to communicate with empathy, patience, professionalism, cultural sensitivity, and respect.

Department & Position Overview:

FreedomCare’s Massachusetts operations support the MassHealth Adult Foster Care (AFC) program, which helps eligible adults with medical, physical, cognitive, or behavioral health needs receive daily assistance in a home setting from a qualified caregiver with professional care team support.
