jobs.title: Réceptionniste night (H/F)
jobs.description:
MISSION/ PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES :

Premier contact du client, vous êtes l’ambassadeur de notre marque et de notre hôtel.

Sous la responsabilité de votre chef de service, vous aurez pour missions principales :

Vous assurez un accueil chaleureux et de qualité à vos clients, et veillez au bon déroulement de leur séjour en accédant à leurs demandes dans le cadre des standards de la marque, en appliquant notamment les attitudes Novotel Spirit et vous incarnez l’esprit Heartist dans vos interactions avec les clients.

Vous renseignez le client sur ses diverses demandes et lui proposez une réponse adaptée à ses besoins en vous assurant de sa satisfaction.

Vous assurez les opérations liées à l’arrivée et au départ du client, et gérez les litiges en cas de besoin en veillant à effecteur un suivi auprès de votre hiérarchie.

Vous gérez la facturation et l’encaissement pendant le service et êtes responsable de votre fonds de caisse. Toute erreur / différence sera immédiatement remontée à votre Chef de Service.

Vous appliquez les recommandations tarifaires et cherchez à effectuer des ventes additionnelles en appliquant les politiques commerciales et tarifaires de l’hôtel.

Vous participez à la coordination de la gestion et l’attribution des chambres avec les différents services de l’hôtel.

Vous préparez les arrivées groupes pour assurer un accueil rapide et conforme aux demandes des clients.

Vous participez à la concrétisation des objectifs quantitatifs et qualitatifs de votre service, et participez à la fidélisation de la clientèle existante.

Vous assurez la clôture des opérations de la journée et distribuez aux services concernés les rapports dont ils ont besoin

Vous gérez les délogements et toutes autres situations pouvant intervenir la nuit au sein de l’hôtel.

Vous répondez aux besoins des clients la nuit concernant le room service, les interventions techniques de base (changement de piles, d’ampoules, problème de climatisation, etc.), les besoins de matériel tels que fer à repasser et planches, assistance pour des bagages, etc.

Vous gérez le dépose-minute afin qu’il soit toujours accessible

Vous assurez la sécurité de l’hôtel la nuit et effectuez les rondes et contrôles de sécurité tels que défini dans vos procédures

Toutes autres tâches reliées au poste et au service : prise de réservations, aide administrative et rédactionnelle, saisie de rooming lists, ou encore remise de factures ou relevés de comptes en chambre, etc.

PROFIL :

Expérience dans un hôtel de même catégorie exigée

Connaissance du logiciel Opéra est souhaitée

Maitrise de l’anglais indispensable, bonne pratique de l’italien souhaitée

Qualités d’organisation, réactivité et diplomatie sont indispensables, ainsi qu’un sens aigu du service

Excellente présentation et aisance relationnelle sont impératives

A savoir :

Horaires de nuits, jours de travails tournants à raison de 39 heures par semaine

Disponibilité :

Permanence les Week-end

Horaires à raison de 39 heures par semaine.

jobs.title: People and Culture Business Partner
jobs.description:
NOTE: This role is not open to Relocation or Sponsorship. Only Jersey residents are eligible to apply.

To work independently and provide end-to-end People and Culture (P&C) value chain business partner support for relevant portfolio/s, applying specialist knowledge and judgement to resolve complex challenges. To provide business partnering advisory support to business stakeholders within the allocated portfolio/s of responsibility, giving P&C guidance in support of the overall people experience and business objectives in an ever-changing environment.

Minimum Qualification:

• First Degree in Human Resources

Experience Required :

• 5 - 7 years experience in People & Culture
• Knowledge and understanding of the role P&C management plays in enabling business commercial and social relevance, acquired through relevant experience. Demonstrated track record successfully implementing integrated, effective & lasting P&C products/solutions in support of business specific objectives and driving better performance in the businesses. Knowledge and application of best in class P&C impact measures. Experience within a multinational company working with senior management teams in a complex environment.

Key Outputs :

• Act as custodian of COE business systems, identifying issues related to their usage and initiating the appropriate action with the relevant stakeholders; promoting effective and efficient usage of all P&C systems.
• Adhere to and advise on the P&C risk and governance framework to ensure that risks are appropriately mitigated in the portfolio/s.
• Adhere to P&C data policies in line with Standard Bank Group (SBG) data standards so that quality data is consistently and appropriately stored, used and managed.
• Collaborate with finance and operations teams regarding workforce planning within work area, confirming compliance with budgetary requirements; contributing to accurate information on costs.
• Engage in the implementation of organisational design and change management initiatives within the portfolio/s to support the successful implementation and acceptance thereof, delivering on the People Promise.

Behavioural Competencies:

• Adopting Practical Approaches
• Articulating Information
• Embracing Change
• Establishing Rapport
• Interpreting Data
• Inviting Feedback

Technical Competencies:

• Decision Making
• Digital Advocacy
• Inclusive Facilitation
• Integrative Leadership
• Organisational Navigation
• Storytelling

jobs.title: SMB Account Director, Sales Solutions
jobs.description:
At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centred on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

We are looking for an Account Director to join our Sales Solutions team in acting as a trusted adviser and bringing value to our customers. You will be responsible for helping our customers effectively engage with the LinkedIn network using our professional talent solutions. You will be dedicated to making our customers stronger and seeking out opportunities for growth. Although you possess a strategic approach to selling and strive to meet/exceed revenue goals, you will always have your clients’ best interest in mind and act as their internal advocate to ensure they are set up for success.

Responsibilities:

• Drive revenue by prospecting and building pipeline while building strong personal relationships with potential clients
• Close new business consistently at or above quota level
• Develop and execute on a strategic plan for the territory and create reliable forecasts
• Work to develop and circulate the set of best practices that will be the foundation of this growing team
• Listen to the needs of the market and share with product and marketing teams

Basic Qualifications:

• 2+ years of applicable sales experience

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience selling SaaS solutions in a quota-carrying sales role, with a focus on prospecting and new business development
• Proven ability to meet or exceed revenue targets and build strategies to drive consistent sales results
• Strong communication, negotiation, and forecasting skills
• Ability to identify and develop new business opportunities with senior decision-makers
• Data-driven approach to managing pipeline and informing sales decisions
• Strong discovery skills with the ability to understand customer needs and position solutions effectively
• Experience collaborating with cross-functional partners to close deals and position solutions competitively

Suggested Skills:

• Negotiation
• Relationship Building
• Strategic Planning
• Forecasting

LinkedIn is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The pay range for this role is $112,000 to $160,000 OTE. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total compensation package for this position may also include annual performance bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans. For more information, visit https://careers.linkedin.com/benefits.

jobs.title: Junior Campaign Manager
jobs.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for.

Job Description:

The New York Times' Advertising team is looking for a Junior Campaign Manager to join our Campaign Management team. You will support the daily operations of the Ad Ops department and the execution and optimization of digital advertising campaigns across several platforms.
This is a hybrid role based in our New York headquarters, reporting to the Senior Manager, Ad Operation. You can typically expect to be in the office 3 days per week.

About the Role:

Working with Campaign Managers, you will ensure the success of campaigns by maintaining quality, accuracy, and customer service. The Junior Campaign Manager role offers an excellent opportunity for individuals interested in developing a career in digital advertising.

Responsibilities:

• Support the setup and launch of digital advertising campaigns across multiple platforms, including desktop, mobile, video, audio and newsletters.

• Ensure accurate implementation of campaign elements such as ad creatives, targeting parameters, and tracking tags.

• Monitor campaign performance metrics on a daily basis to identify trends, anomalies, and areas for optimization.

• Collaborate with team members to implement optimization strategies to improve campaign performance and achieve client goals.

• Create wrap reports detailing campaign performance metrics, including impressions, clicks, interactions, and other measurements.

• Conduct data analysis to obtain insights and make data-driven recommendations for campaign optimization.

• Help communicate with clients to provide campaign updates and address inquiries.

• Collaborate with the sales and client success teams to ensure client satisfaction and retention.

• Provide support for ad operations tasks, including billing, ad trafficking, troubleshooting technical issues, and resolving discrepancies.

• Help maintain documentation and standard operating procedures related to campaign management processes.

• Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, or related field.

• Experience with the ability to interpret data and draw applicable insights.

• Experience with complex, multi-faceted and multi-discipline projects including varying partners within an organization

• Experience with diverse ways of working

Preferred Qualifications:

• Previous internship or entry-level experience in digital advertising, ad operations, or media planning.

• Familiarity with ad serving platforms (e.g., Google Ad Manager, DoubleClick Campaign Manager)

REQ-020711

Additional Compensation and Benefits:

For roles in the U.S., dependent on your role, you may be eligible for variable pay, such as an annual bonus and restricted stock. Benefits may include medical, dental and vision benefits, Flexible Spending Accounts (F.S.A.s), a company-matching 401(k) plan, employee stock purchase plan, paid vacation, paid sick days, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement and professional development programs.

The annual base pay range for this role is between:

$60,000—$70,000 USD

Candidate Use of GenAI Tools:

We’re excited to learn more about you and your experience. To keep our hiring process as fair and authentic as possible, we ask that you submit your own work and not use GenAI tools to generate substantive content during the application and interview process.

If you’re an engineering candidate, we’ll let you know what specific GenAI tools you are permitted to use for your technical assessment.

The New York Times Company is committed to being the world’s best source of independent, reliable and quality journalism. To do so, we embrace a diverse workforce that has a broad range of backgrounds and experiences across our ranks, at all levels of the organization. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate on the basis of an individual's sex, age, race, color, creed, national origin, alienage, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation or affectional preference, gender identity and expression, disability, genetic trait or predisposition, carrier status, citizenship, veteran or military status and other personal characteristics protected by law. All applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics. The U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC)’s Know Your Rights Poster is available here.

The New York Times Company will provide reasonable accommodations as required by applicable federal, state, and/or local laws. Individuals seeking an accommodation for the application or interview process should email reasonable.accommodations@nytimes.com. Emails sent for unrelated issues, such as following up on an application, will not receive a response.

For information about The New York Times' privacy practices for job applicants, click here.

Please beware of fraudulent job postings. Scammers may post fraudulent job opportunities, and they may even make fraudulent employment offers. This is done by bad actors to collect personal information and money from victims. All legitimate job opportunities from The New York Times will be accessible through The New York Times careers site. The New York Times will not ask job applicants for financial information or for payment, and will not refer you to a third party to do so. You should never send money to anyone who suggests they can provide employment with The New York Times.

If you see a fake or fraudulent job posting, or if you suspect you have received a fraudulent offer, you can report it to The New York Times at NYTapplicants@nytimes.com. You can also file a report with the Federal Trade Commission or your state attorney general.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At Cision, we believe in empowering every individual to make an impact. Here, your voice is heard, your ideas are valued, and your unique perspective fuels our collective success. As part of our global team, you'll thrive in an environment that champions curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, all while making meaningful contributions to the brands we accelerate.

Join us in shaping the future of communication and building authentic connections that matter. Whether you're solving complex problems or driving bold innovations, your growth is our success, and together, we’ll create the conversations of tomorrow.

Empower your impact at Cision. Be seen, be understood, be you.

Staff Software Engineer – DevX

We're looking for an accomplished Staff Software Engineer (DevX) to drive the development of tools and platforms that enhance our developers’ experience. In this role, you'll build and integrate software solutions that streamline coding, testing, and deployment processes, making our engineering teams more effective and efficient. You will collaborate closely with other engineers to identify workflow bottlenecks and implement innovative solutions, acting as a technical leader in shaping our internal development ecosystem. Reporting to the DevX Manager (Observability & DevX), you'll also mentor other engineers and uphold best practices in code quality, automation, and performance.

What You’ll Do

• Design and develop internal software tools, services, and frameworks that improve the developer experience (e.g. custom CLI tools, development environment enhancements, test automation frameworks).

• Work with engineering teams to gather requirements and feedback for developer tools, then iterate on solutions to ensure they address real-world needs.

• Improve and maintain our CI/CD pipeline code and infrastructure, ensuring build and deployment processes are efficient, reliable, and scalable.

• Contribute to the architecture of our developer platform by evaluating new technologies and integrating open-source solutions to enhance productivity.

• Mentor and guide other software engineers in using DevX tools and adopting best practices for efficient software delivery.

• Ensure all DevX solutions are well-documented, maintainable, and secure; actively participate in code reviews and design discussions to uphold high standards.

• Partner with engineering teams to define and enforce AI standards within the developer ecosystem, ensuring consistent, scalable, and secure adoption of AI-driven solutions.

Essential Skills & Experience

• 7–10 years' experience in Software Engineering or DevOps roles, with a focus on building developer tooling or platforms.

• Expert programming skills in one or more languages (such as Python, Java, Go, or C#), with the ability to write clean, maintainable code for internal tools and services.

• Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines and build/release processes, including familiarity with tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions.

• Solid understanding of software development best practices (version control, code reviews, automated testing) and experience integrating these into automated workflows.

• Proficiency with containerization and cloud infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS/GCP) to support on-demand development and testing environments.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and frameworks that improve developer productivity.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
At Range, we’re building towards a world where anyone can live the financial life they imagine for themselves. If that sounds like a mission you want to be a part of, let’s create it together.

We’re building AI-powered wealth management. Investments, taxes, retirement, estate planning, all in one platform instead of scattered across different advisors and apps. We're backed by Google's Gradient Ventures, Cathay Innovation, Scale Venture Partners, and more. We’re growing fast while still small enough that everyone's work is visible and impactful.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Range is hiring a Content Marketing Manager to work shoulder-to-shoulder with our content team across our three biggest growth channels: newsletter, Instagram, and webinars. You'll research, write, produce, and ship — partnering with the team to grow our audience through sharp operations and steady production.

You won't run a lane in isolation. You'll act like an owner inside a small, fast team where AI fluency, journalistic instincts, and operational discipline are non-negotiable.

This position is based in New York City. Employees hired for this role will work in office Monday–Friday. If you are not currently located in this area, your willingness to relocate will be a contingency for employment.



WHAT YOU'LL DO WITH US

 - Work in AI every day. We run the entire content team in Claude Cowork — research, drafting, editing, repurposing, ideation, audience analysis, and asset production. AI isn't a tool you reach for occasionally; it's the operating environment. If AI isn't already core to how you work, this role won't be a fit.

 - Be self-sufficient with assets. You build your own social graphics, thumbnails, slides, and visual content using AI tools. No briefing a designer for every asset, no waiting in queue. If you can describe it, you can ship it.

 - Support newsletter production and growth. Partner on research, drafting, editing, scheduling, and performance review for our weekly cadence — and help us grow it into a top-tier wealth newsletter through smart operations, subscriber acquisition tactics, and repurposing across channels.

 - Support webinar production and growth. Partner end-to-end: webinar calendar management, slide building, landing page copy, registration and reminder emails, day-of execution, post-event follow-up, and turning each event into 4–6 pieces of repurposed content. Webinars are a primary growth engine — you help keep them running and expand reach.

 - Support Instagram production and growth. Research what's hitting in fintech, finance Twitter/X, wealth management TikTok, and finance YouTube — and translate it for Instagram. Produce social copy, graphics, and short-form video alongside the team. Help us grow followers, engagement, and saves through operational rigor and trend awareness. As we expand to additional social channels, you'll grow with us.

 - Help grow our audiences across all three channels. Every piece of content is an audience lever. You think about what gets shared, what gets saved, and what brings new subscribers in — and partner with the team to scale what works.

 - Pitch in on video. Capture clips, basic edits, prep assets for our editor. Willing to learn the basics if you don't have them yet.

 - Act like an owner. Range is small, fast, and lean. No layers above you, no process to hide behind. See something broken, fix it, ship it.
   


WHAT WILL SET YOU APART

 - 5–7 years of professional writing or content marketing experience, with at least 2 as a reporter, editor, staff writer, or producer at a publication.

 - 2+ years in-house at a company (not agency or freelance) — you act like an owner inside a team.

 - Daily AI fluency. Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Descript are already part of how you work — not experiments, not curiosity. You can show how AI has changed your output, including how you build skills to operate like a team on your own.

 - Sharp eye for what's resonating on Instagram and adjacent platforms — you can talk credibly about creators, formats, and trends in finance, business, or adjacent verticals.

 - Demonstrated experience producing across newsletter, social, or live event formats.

 - A portfolio that shows speed and range, not just polish.
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - 1+ year producing content about personal finance, investing, fintech, or wealth management.

 - Newsletter production experience (Beehiiv, Substack, ConvertKit, Mailchimp).

 - Webinar or live event production experience (calendar management, slide building, registration flows).

 - Hands-on audience growth track record (newsletter subscribers, Instagram followers, webinar registrants).

 - Basic video editing (Premiere, CapCut, Descript).

 - Comfort on camera, or coaching others to be.

 - Zero ego.



COMPENSATION

Base salary range: $100,000 – $170,000

This is the base salary range we expect in good faith to pay for this role at the time of posting. Where an offer lands within the range depends on the scope and complexity of work the candidate can own independently and demonstrated depth at this level.



OTHER COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

The range above reflects base salary only. Our offer packages also include equity in the form of stock options, so total compensation for this role will exceed the base salary range.

We do not ask for or consider salary history. You are welcome to ask questions about compensation at any point in the process.



BENEFITS

 - Health & Wellness: 100% employer-covered medical insurance for employees (75% for dependents), plus dental and vision coverage

 - 401(k): Retirement savings program to support your future

 - Paid Time Off: Dedicated time to reset and recharge plus most federal holidays

 - Parental Leave: Comprehensive leave policy for growing families

 - Meals: Select meals covered throughout the week

 - Fitness: Monthly movement stipend

 - Equity & Career Growth: Early exercise eligibility and a strong focus on professional development

 - Annual Compensation Reviews: Salary and equity refreshes based on performance

 - Boomerang Program: After two years at Range, you can take time away to start your own company. We’ll hold your spot for 6 months - and pause your equity vesting, which resumes if you return

Range is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. As a company, we are committed to designing products, building a culture, and supporting a team that reflects the diverse population we serve.

jobs.title: SBAS Lead Program Management Analyst
jobs.description:
The Student and Exchange Visitor Program (SEVP) is a critical national security program within the Department of Homeland Security. Housed within ICE, Homeland Security Investigations' National Security Division, SEVP oversees the F and M nonimmigrant classes and, with the Department of State, the J exchange visitor class: more than one million international students and exchange visitors, plus the schools and sponsors that host them. Its system of record, SEVIS, is designated an ICE high-value asset. Dynamis, Inc. is seeking a SBAS Lead Program Management Analyst that will lead the team that keeps SEVP's business automation backbone (SEVPAMS, RPA bots, the SEVP Interactive Dialog chatbot, and Tableau analytics) organized, documented, and mission-ready, so HSI investigators, compliance officers, and SEVP leadership can act fast on reliable information. As Dynamis key personnel, the Lead will direct the SBAS team, partner daily with SBAS federal leadership, and own the quality of every SBAS product.

Responsibilities:

• Lead SBAS section-level operations: track taskings from intake to closure, coordinate strategic planning, and report status to SBAS federal leads and the contractor Program Manager.

• Direct and assign work to SBAS Program Management Analysts and the Technical Writer/Editor; review all products for technical accuracy and compliance with government standards and approved templates before delivery.

• Own SBAS communications and collaboration products, including templates, SOPs, articles, and presentations; manage the SBAS program repository and digital libraries in SEVPAMS (SharePoint) using records management best practices.

• Run SBAS meeting management (scheduling, agendas, minutes, and action items) and prepare activity, productivity, and strategic reports, including SBAS input to weekly, monthly, and strategic plan deliverables.

• Train SEVP staff on templates and documentation standards; use DHSChat and other ICE-approved GenAI tools to draft and refine content; track SBAS performance against PWS measures (98% on-time taskings, 100% template compliance) and recommend improvements.

Requirements:

• Minimum 8 years of experience in administrative or program management roles, preferably in a federal environment; education may substitute for experience (bachelor's = 3 years, master's = 4 years, doctorate = 5 years)

• Demonstrated expertise managing section-level operations, tasking, and strategic planning, and developing and reviewing templates, SOPs, articles, and presentations.

• Proficiency managing digital repositories and collaboration sites with SharePoint, MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), and Teams; strong experience using generative AI tools to create and revise content.

• Key personnel leadership skills: strong business writing, active listening, adaptability to shifting priorities, building cooperation across stakeholders, briefing executives on technical issues, and leading and mentoring teams.

• U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable ICE background investigation (Entry on Duty).

Preferred:

• Prior SEVP experience, including working knowledge of SEVPAMS user units such as SCU, SAOC, SRC, and Policy.

• Familiarity with DHS/ICE documentation, records management, quality assurance, and compliance review processes.

• Knowledge of federal documentation, Section 508 accessibility, and information assurance standards; experience with Tableau dashboards and visualizations.

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Public Administration, Communications, Information Management, or a related field.

Salary range: $125,000-155,000

The salary range for this position represents the anticipated hiring range. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, education, certifications, and potential contract funding.

jobs.title: Principal Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Blue Energy is transforming how nuclear power gets built. Instead of constructing each plant on-site from scratch - a process that takes 10-15 years and is too expensive and unpredictable to finance - we build our plants like ships: in a factory, on an assembly line, then transport and assemble them at the site. This cuts costs by over 60% and brings plants online in just three years. We also pair natural gas with nuclear at our sites, so customers can start receiving power from gas turbines right away and then switch over to clean nuclear power once it comes online - getting energy to the grid faster while nuclear is being built. Our mission is to make nuclear energy abundant, affordable, and repeatable at global scale. We use proven, already-approved reactor designs and work with existing nuclear and industrial sites, giving us a faster path to regulatory approval. By manufacturing this way, we put nuclear power on the same cost-reduction curve that has made wind, solar, and batteries cheaper every year.



Position Summary

The Principal Mechanical Engineer serves as the senior technical authority within Blue Energy's Owner's Engineering organization, leading the design, integration, and delivery of Blue Energy's gas-to-nuclear bridge. This role provides technical leadership across the full project lifecycle, from FEED through detailed engineering, construction, commissioning, and startup. As the technical owner of the gas generation bridge, the Principal Mechanical Engineer drives critical engineering decisions, and ensures alignment across process, mechanical, electrical, controls, civil, and construction disciplines. The position is accountable for resolving complex technical challenges, managing design risk, and ensuring the plant is safe, reliable, operable, maintainable, and fully compliant with applicable codes, standards, and regulatory requirements. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring both deep technical expertise and the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels. The Principal Mechanical Engineer serves as the primary engineering representative, translating technical decisions into clear business impacts on schedule, cost, performance, and project risk.



Key Responsibilities

 - Develop and maintain the technical basis for utility-scale gas generation projects as part of an owner’s engineering team, including plant configuration, major equipment selection, and performance requirements.

 - Lead FEED and detailed design reviews, providing technical direction and approving key engineering deliverables from EPCs, OEMs, and engineering consultants.

 - Perform and review plant performance studies to evaluate design options, operating scenarios, and commercial impacts.

 - Drive resolution of complex technical issues, design conflicts, and field challenges throughout project execution.

 - Support development of project scopes, engineering cost estimates, schedules, and technical execution plans.

 - Lead technical evaluations for major equipment procurements, including bid reviews, vendor selection, design reviews, and factory acceptance testing.

 - Coordinate technical interfaces across mechanical, process, electrical, controls, civil, and construction teams to ensure an integrated plant design.

 - Support construction, commissioning, startup, and performance testing activities, including field troubleshooting and design clarifications.

 - Ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, regulations, and company engineering requirements.

 - Develop and maintain engineering standards, specifications, and design practices that support current projects and future deployments.

 - Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and provide technical guidance to project teams across the organization.


Minimum Qualifications

 - 12+ years of engineering and project delivery experience in simple-cycle or combined-cycle natural gas power generation.

 - Demonstrated experience leading projects through the full lifecycle, including concept development, feasibility studies, FEED, detailed design, construction, commissioning, startup, and operational handover.

 - Strong technical foundation in power generation systems, including combustion turbines, heat recovery systems, balance-of-plant equipment, utility systems, and plant integration.

 - Working knowledge of thermodynamics, heat transfer, hydraulics, rotating equipment, piping systems, instrumentation and controls, and plant performance analysis.

 - Experience developing, reviewing, and validating plant performance models using industry-standard software such as THERMOFLEX, GateCycle, GT PRO, or equivalent tools.

 - Ability to review, comment on, and approve engineering deliverables, drawings, specifications, calculations, and contractor design packages using tools such as Bluebeam and other engineering document management systems.

 - Working knowledge of applicable codes, standards, and industry practices governing utility-scale power generation facilities.

 - Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and managing EPC contractors, OEMs, and external engineering consultants.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills.

 - Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

Preferred Skills/Qualifications

 - Professional Engineer (PE) license.

 - Experience with first-of-a-kind or emerging technology deployment — nuclear balance-of-plant, small modular reactors, carbon capture, hydrogen, advanced power cycles, or similar.

 - Experience managing technical interfaces between EPC contractors, OEMs, regulators, utilities, and project stakeholders.

 - Experience supporting field teams during construction and start-up phases.

 - Familiarity with project risk management, design risk assessment, resource planning, and scenario-based decision-making.

 - Willingness to travel to project sites, including remote and international locations as required.
   
   

We look forward to your application and helping foster an era of safe, clean, affordable, and abundant energy.

Blue Energy is dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this or other roles at Blue Energy now or in the future.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Feedlot IQ
jobs.description:
Account Executive, Feedlot IQ

Southwest Nebraska or Southwest Kansas | Field-Based | Full-Time, Exempt | 70% travel

Sell what you know to the people you know

Feedlot operators make high-stakes decisions every day, on cost of gain, closeouts, breakevens, and margins. Feedlot IQ helps them make those decisions with better data and more confidence, and we need someone in the field who can show them how.

As our Feedlot IQ Account Executive, you'll build the sales motion for a new product in the beef feedlot market. You'll spend your days in the yard and at the office table with owners, managers, nutritionists, and vets, finding where the money is and proving it. This is a ground-floor role with real ownership: the territory, the relationships, and the results are yours.

What you'll do

Win new business

• Build and run your own territory plan covering priority feedlots, referral sources, industry partners, and events

• Fill your pipeline through field visits, demos, partner introductions, and the relationships you've already built

• Lead deals from first conversation to signed agreement, with sharp forecasting and clean CRM records

Prove the value

• Learn each operation's priorities and financial goals, then position Feedlot IQ around the decisions that matter most to them

• Set account baselines and document measurable outcomes, so customer success stories come from real numbers

• Help customers turn Feedlot IQ insights into practical actions that improve performance and profitability

Own the relationship

• Stay with your customers after the sale, working with our Product, implementation, and technical teams on onboarding, adoption, and renewal

• Spot expansion opportunities (more sites, more users, cross-sell within Ever.Ag) and risks early

• Bring field feedback back to Product, so what you hear from customers shapes what we build next

What you bring

• Proven field sales success, including prospecting independently, closing new business, and meeting or exceeding revenue goals

• Deep knowledge of beef feedlot operations and existing relationships in the feedlot industry

• Fluency in feedlot economics: cost of gain, closeouts, breakeven, margins, and how management decisions affect the bottom line

• The credibility to earn trust with owners, managers, veterinarians, nutritionists, and other decision-makers

• Strong organization across multiple prospects and accounts, with clear next steps and a disciplined CRM habit

• A valid driver's license and willingness to travel up to 70% of the time

Bonus points

• Bachelor's degree in animal science, nutrition, agriculture, business, or a related field (equivalent industry and sales experience counts)

• Experience with SaaS, analytics, or data-driven solutions

• Experience supporting customer adoption, renewals, or account expansion

How you'll succeed here

• Commercial drive: You create urgency, build pipeline on your own, and see deals through to a decision.

• Customer focus: You know how feedlots run and connect product features to real operational and financial value.

• Accountability: You do what you say, keep forecasts honest, and own your commitments.

• Business acumen: You can explain how health, nutrition, and financial drivers affect performance in plain terms.

• Collaboration: You work well with Product, technical, and commercial teammates to give customers one consistent experience.

• Communication: You run strong demos and document decisions and next steps clearly.

• Adaptability: You pick up new software and data workflows quickly and turn field feedback into commercial insight.

Who you will be working for

Ever.Ag offers innovative AgTech solutions and services that empower agriculture, food, and beverage supply chains to feed a growing world. The breadth of the portfolio is uniquely capable of supporting the complex needs of companies involved in dairy, livestock, crops, and agribusiness. With decades of experience and industry-leading innovations, our technology, risk management, and market intelligence provide our customers with the tools and insights they need to operate more efficiently, sustainably, and strategically across every stage of the supply chain.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds to contribute their unique perspectives to our team. Your success is our success!

Please note, at this time, Ever.Ag does not hire candidates residing in California, Hawaii, or Alaska.

jobs.title: Senior Content Producer, HubSpot Academy
jobs.description:
HubSpot Academy is on a mission to be the place people go to learn how to start and grow a business. We offer a variety of educational and inspirational content — from blog posts to lessons and full certification courses — that provides valuable business training to people all over the world. This educational content generates new customers for the business and delights our existing ones in service of achieving their business and career goals.

We're looking for a Content Producer who is passionate about getting world-class expertise out of the classroom and into the hands of the professionals who need it most. This role is ideal for a creative, detail-oriented content professional who thrives at the intersection of education, social media, and video — and who understands that a great piece of educational content is only as valuable as the audience it reaches.

As a Content Producer at HubSpot Academy, you will turn existing Academy courses, transcripts, webinars, and event recordings into multi-channel assets designed to reach new audiences on LinkedIn, YouTube, and beyond. You’ll work directly with our three Academy evangelists and wider professor team, building assets that scale their personal reach—carousels, short-form scripts, video clips, thumbnails, and post drafts—without requiring extra recording time from them. This role sits within the Engage pillar of HubSpot Academy and reports to the Senior Manager of HubSpot Academy Marketing.

In this role you'll get to:

Content Production — Anchor & Remix

• Turn Academy course transcripts, lesson recordings, and webinars into social-ready posts and video clips.

• Draft LinkedIn carousels, short-form scripts, and supporting assets for Academy evangelists to post on their personal accounts.

• Produce LinkedIn carousels, short-form video scripts, asset packages, and draft post copy for Academy professors to review, finalise, and post in their own voice

• Dig through long-form training to pull out the most valuable moments—finding clear hooks, fresh perspectives, and practical frameworks worth sharing.

Video Production & YouTube

• Create and publish content to the HubSpot Academy YouTube channel.

• Repurpose long-form recordings into YouTube Shorts and short-form clips optimised for social distribution.

• Design and produce YouTube thumbnails that are on-brand and drive click-through.

• Manage the YouTube publishing workflow including titles, descriptions, tags, and scheduling.

Podcast & Newsletter Support

• Help produce the Crystal Clear podcast by writing show notes and summaries, cutting social clips, and building promotional assets.

• Adapt course material and evangelist content into fresh sections for Academy newsletters.

Cross-team Collaboration

• Partner directly with Academy evangelists to stay aligned on their content calendars and production goals.

• Connect with Academy professors globally to spot strong anchor content and help expand their reach.

• Work closely with the Academy Social Media Manager to ensure all assets match platform best practices and fit our broader social strategy.

• Join content planning sessions to ensure production time goes toward our highest-impact projects.

You'll be successful in this role if you have:

• Extensive experience in content production, social media content creation, or a closely related role — ideally at a media company, or with an influencer or creator.

• Strong writing skills — you can take complex material and distill it into clear, compelling copy that performs on LinkedIn and other social platforms.

• Demonstrable experience producing LinkedIn carousels, short-form video content, or similar multi-format social assets using Canva.

• Practical video editing skills using tools like CapCut, Premiere Pro, or Final Cut — and a curiosity for AI-assisted editing tools like Runway.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Medical Communications
jobs.description:
About Lockwood: Lockwood collaborates with clients in the pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device industries to identify effective, holistic, science-based strategies to address their objectives through medical communications. Our clients count on us to challenge their assumptions and help them creatively navigate around obstacles. From strategy through execution, we focus on accuracy, transparency, and scientific value to create programs that are evidence-based, clinically relevant, and contribute to the development of our clients’ brands. Over a third of our staff hold advanced scientific or medical degrees, and most work from where they live. Because our flexible structure provides better work-life balance, we attract the best talent, facilitate their best work, and as a result, are more responsive to our clients, wherever and whenever they do business.

Summary: In this role, the Project Manager is responsible for managing all aspects of medical communications projects from inception to completion, including but not limited to, content development, advisory boards, and speaker training.

Responsibilities include facilitating multidisciplinary project teams, interfacing with each department within the company, meeting client and management expectations, establishing strong faculty relationships, and ensuring programs remain on target and within agreed-upon parameters. The Project Manager is responsible for budget development, maintenance and reconciliation, managing external suppliers, keeping programs on time and focused on primary objectives, providing ongoing updates to internal team members and client contact(s), and resource management. The number of simultaneous programs managed by each Project Manager is dependent on the scope and nature of each initiative.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional communicator with experience successfully leading multidisciplinary teams. We are seeking individuals with strong financial management skills who are highly organized, adept at multitasking/prioritizing, and have the ability and willingness to motivate others.

Responsibilities:

• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and faculty members

• Maintain and manage timely and professional written and verbal communications with clients and faculty members

• Ensure client expectations are met on all levels of program activity

• Establish and maintain a strong knowledge of client organizations, products, disease states, and medical education

• Develop new project budgets

• Contribute to new business development activities within the account team

• Manage budgeting, financial monitoring, and reconciliation of individual projects

• Schedule and conduct start-up, interim, and final team meetings for each project, establish and maintain time and events schedules, and provide ongoing updates to client and team as required by account team on each initiative to ensure successful management and completion

• Facilitate progress of multidisciplinary project teams to ensure within-budget, on-time, on-strategy performance

• Own the detail of daily account work on each project

• Oversee and facilitate development of all project activities, including faculty recruitment and ongoing communication, audience generation, content development, logistics management, registration/participant communication, production of materials, supplier performance, central file management

• Assist in training new account team members as required

• Maintain company policies as they pertain to all activities

• Adhere to all Lockwood Group policies and standard operating procedures

Education: A bachelor’s degree is required.

Professional Skills & Experience:

• Three to five years of relevant project management experience in a healthcare communications environment is required.

• Candidates must have the ability to grasp and retain scientific information, along with a strong technical aptitude and working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Access.

This position can be performed remotely in all but the following locations: Colorado, New York City, San Francisco County, CA.

jobs.title: Quality Engineering Domain Lead
jobs.description:
Come join one of America’s fastest-growing insurance companies. Since 1848, National Life Group has aimed to keep our promises, providing families with stability in good times and in bad. Throughout that history, we have provided peace of mind to those families as they plan their futures.

Our mission extends beyond the insurance and annuities policies that we offer. We strive to make the world a better place through our grants from our charitable foundation, paid volunteer time for our employees, environmentally sustainable and healthy workplaces, and events that promote the work of nonprofits in our own backyard.

We foster a collaborative environment with opportunities for growth and encourage our associates to live our values: Do good. Be good. Make good.

Please note that we do not offer visa sponsorship for this position.

Role Summary

The Quality Engineering (QE) Domain Lead position at National Life Group is a key leadership role responsible for end-to-end quality within a portfolio of business domains. This is a unique opportunity to affect change and directly improve the lives of our customers and employees.

This role demands a high degree of independence, organizational skills, emotional intelligence, and ability to juggle multiple projects and competing schedules. Collaboration, an open mind, humility, and ability to influence others will be instrumental to success.

The position reports to the Head of Quality Engineering. You will be part of a 100+ member team that continuously drives innovation while delivering end-to-end solutions in support of National Life’s business needs.

This position currently offers an onsite work schedule, with the expectation that you will be in the office four (4) days per week during onsite core days.  Our current onsite core days are Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday.  The work schedule type and core days are subject to change with advance notification and manager discretion.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Lead QE delivery teams by example

• Motivate and inspire QE delivery teams

• Foster a culture of excellence, collaboration, innovation and shared responsibility for quality

• Understand the business “why” behind the solutions we deliver

• Oversee the definition and execution of test plans

• Collaborate with engineering teams to identify and proactively resolve quality issues

• Monitor capacity of highly outsourced, global teams and address constraints and key person risks

• Roll up your sleeves and help teams overcome challenges

• Mature our test automation portfolio, requirement traceability practices, and promote transparency of testing activities

• Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry trends, technologies, and QE best practices

• Experiment with emerging technologies and leverage the most promising to mature our quality practices and deliver business value

• Foster and maintain trusting relationships with all parties

• Work closely with cross-functional teams including business, engineering, and external vendors to ensure quality objectives are met

• Communicate quality metrics, issues, and progress to senior management and stakeholders

• All other duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences, related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience

• 3-5 years of demonstrated progressive technical leadership experience leading a geographically dispersed, global workforce

• Life & Annuity insurance industry experience

• Strong QE knowledge and skills with demonstrated ability to lead teams through complex initiatives

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

• Experience with automated testing tools and Agentic AI

• Ability to think creatively and drive innovation

• Ability to work collaboratively across business units and IT customers

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, both technical and non-technical

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience with QE tools such as Zephyr Enterprise, Tosca, and/or NeoLoad

• Broad IT technical experience

AI Proficiency Expectations (All roles):

At National Life Group, we view AI as an enabler of human potential. We use AI to help us work smarter, serve more clients, and keep our promises, while remaining a relationship-driven business where our people are our greatest strength.

All applicants are expected to:

• Leverage approved AI tools, where appropriate, to improve the efficiency, quality, and impact of their work.

• Stay curious and open to new AI-enabled ways of working.

• Exercise sound judgment by reviewing and validating AI-generated content.

• Maintain accountability for the accuracy, quality, fairness, and integrity of work products by adhering to National Life's AI guiding principles.

• Use AI responsibly and in accordance with company policies related to confidentiality, data privacy, security, compliance, retention, and intellectual property.

Core Competencies

Cultivates Innovation - Fosters innovation by taking calculated risks; Work cooperatively with others to produce innovative solutions.

Ensures Accountability - Holds self and others accountable to meet commitments and performance goals.

Directs Work - Provides direction, delegates, and removes obstacles to get work done.

Demonstrates Emotional Intelligence - Exhibits the ability to recognize, understand, and manage emotions and how emotions can influence others; Uses a combination of feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and opportunities.

Exhibits Critical and Creative Thinking - Engaging thinking skills that focus on logic and reasoning to make decisions (critical) and innovative solutions to solve problems (creative).

Leads Change - Facilitates change and transition at the individual and team level; Develops strategic goals for aligning with change.

Develops Talent - Builds team(s) equipped for the future by applying coaching techniques for developing team members to meet their professional/personal goals and the organizational goals; Listens and responds with empathy; Asks thought provoking questions.

Inspires Others - Motivates and influences others by creating an environment where teams can do their best work; Partners across the organization to achieve results.

Benefits

• Your benefits start day one and are flexible and customizable to your and your family’s specific needs. Check out the BENEFITS of a Career at National Life!

Base Pay Range.  The base pay range for this position is the range National Life reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors, including: prior experience and job-related knowledge; education, training and certificates; current business needs; and market factors.  The final salary or hourly wages offered may be outside of this range based on other reasons and individual circumstances.

The total compensation package for this position may also include a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), dependent on the position offered. jobs.description:
About Our Company

FreedomCare is a healthcare company that has been dedicated to revolutionizing the home care industry since 2016. We support our patients by ensuring they have the power to choose a caregiver who will care for them in the comfort of their own homes. Our mission spans coast to coast, supporting patients across the U.S.

We pride ourselves on our values which drive the level of care that we deliver to our patients:

Here For You An attitude of service, empathy, and availability

Own It Drive and ownership

Do the Right Thing High integrity

Be Positive Great attitude and a can-do positive approach to challenges

Join our team and make a positive impact on the lives of others! We are looking for a Case Manager, RN for our Ohio team! New Graduates Welcome!

This is a field-based position that requires frequent travel to patient's homes in Youngstown, OH.

Overview

The Case Manager, RN is responsible for conducting initial in-home assessments, orientations for new patients and caregivers, and providing ongoing care management and support. This role combines clinical assessment, care coordination, patient and Personal Care Attendant (PCA) education, and quality assurance to ensure safe, effective, and person-centered care.

The Case Manager, RN collaborates closely with patients, PCAs , and interdisciplinary care teams to assess needs, develop individualized plans of care, and facilitate the seamless initiation and delivery of services. Through regularly scheduled home visits, the RN evaluates patient and caregiver well-being, monitors the quality and effectiveness of care, and identifies opportunities to enhance health outcomes, safety, and regulatory compliance. The Case Manager, RN proactively communicates clinical concerns, changes in condition, and potential barriers to care with the appropriate team members to ensure timely intervention, effective care coordination, and optimal patient outcomes.

Responsibilities

• Conducts initial in-person clinical assessments and coordinates service activation, ensuring that all required forms and standard procedures are followed.

• Develops, implements, manages patient's activity plan(s).

• making revisions and documenting changes as needed.

• Completes all client documentation, to include written records, reports, and notes in accordance with agency policy and procedure following client visits or contacts in an accurate, timely, complete, concise and legible manner.

• Actively coordinates the care of the client through communication and written documentation to the physician, and other disciplines involved in the client’s care and community resources.

• Provide ongoing coaching to drive effective utilization of established best practices, encourage PCA education, and connect families to appropriate resources.

• Reviews the PCA notes and appropriately addresses changes in the consumer’s condition or environment.

• Ensure continuous compliance with all regulatory standards as well as company policies and procedures.

• Performs other job-related duties as may be required or directed by the supervisor.

Education and Experience

• Diploma from an accreditted nursing program. New graduates welcome!

Is a Plus:

• Home care case management

• Care coordination experience

Qualifications

• Valid and Active Registered Nursing License issued by the Ohio Board of Nursing

• Ability to articulate cases through effective summaries.

• Ability and flexibility to travel (usually by car) within assigned geographic area

• valid driver’s license and car insurance required.

• Proficient in common software and web-based applications (e.g. Case Management Systems, MS Office) with the ability to teach others.

• A passion for providing a high level of customer service, including the ability to show empathy, active listening and patience.

• Is a Plus: Bilingual

Why work at FreedomCare?

Benefits include:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Life insurance

• Short-term and long-term disability insurance

• 401(k) with company match

• Continuing education and professional development opportunities

• Opportunities for career growth

• Wellness programs

• Gym reimbursement

• Internet reimbursement

• Competitive compensation

• Technology and tools designed to support communication, documentation, and care coordination

jobs.title: Senior Data Platform Engineer
jobs.location: Boston, MA; San Francisco, California, United States; Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada
jobs.description:
Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.

Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.

By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at later.com.

About this position

As a Senior Data Platform Engineer at Later, you'll own the foundation our data ecosystem runs on. You'll design, build, and evolve the infrastructure, backend services, and platform capabilities that move data from source to decision, and that help engineers, analysts, and data scientists do their best work.

This is a data engineering role with a platform mindset. Our analytics platform runs on GCP and BigQuery, and our operational databases live in AWS. You'll shape how data moves between them, modernize what we have, and get our data ready for the AI-powered products we're building. You'll treat the platform as a product and the teams who depend on it as your customers.

This role is for someone who likes building the system more than the individual report or model. It isn't a traditional ETL/ELT role focused on SQL, dashboards, and pipeline maintenance, and it isn't an ML engineering or data science role. You'll build the data foundation that makes AI work, and other teams will build on top of it.

What you'll be doing

Build, own, and evolve the data platform

• Design and own scalable infrastructure across ingestion, orchestration, storage, transformation, and consumption, including our BigQuery warehouse and lakehouse. Make architectural decisions, explain the tradeoffs, and modernize the parts that have outgrown their original design.

• Build reliable batch and real-time pipelines and dbt transformation layers. Evolve our orchestration (GCP-native tools plus our custom orchestrator) and shape our ingestion strategy, including how we evaluate Fivetran against custom connectors.

• Spot weaknesses in the platform and drive the fixes. Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar.

Engineer backend systems and keep them reliable

• Build the APIs, services, and integrations that move data in and out of the platform, including secure, cost-aware data movement between GCP and AWS. Manage infrastructure as code and automate deployment with CI/CD.

• Build observability, data quality checks, and access controls, and optimize performance and cost. Create reusable tooling and standards that make the right way the easy way.

Build the foundation for AI

• Make trusted company data accessible for analytics, machine learning, and AI applications, including LLMs and AI agents. Invest in data quality, metadata, lineage, governance, and freshness.

• Design the platform to absorb new AI use cases without major rework, and partner with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams on what they need.

What you'll bring

Experience

• 6+ years in data engineering, backend engineering, or platform engineering, with a track record of owning production data systems at scale and improving their reliability, performance, and cost.

• Strong backend programming skills (Python or similar), solid SQL, and experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework.

• Hands-on cloud experience, ideally GCP and BigQuery, and comfort working across more than one cloud.

• Experience with infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and workflow orchestration.

• Experience with batch and streaming architectures, and a working understanding of security, access control, and data governance.

• The judgment to make architectural decisions and explain the tradeoffs to technical and non-technical partners.

Nice to have

• Kubernetes, and experience migrating or redesigning orchestration systems.

• Managed ingestion tools like Fivetran.

• Experience building internal platforms or tooling that other engineers adopt.

• Data foundations for AI, such as vector stores, feature pipelines, or governed LLM access.

Our approach to compensation:
We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only. The salary range listed for this role reflects the zones that applies to the location of this posting.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted.

Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package.

Salary range:
For candidates located in the US: $125,000-205,000 USD
For candidates located in the Canada: $110,000-160,000 CAD

We're committed to building an inclusive, supportive place where you can do the best and most rewarding work of your career. If this sounds like you, even if you don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you.

Where we work:

We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located.

Diversity, inclusion, and accessibility:

At Later, we are committed to fostering a culture rooted in an inclusion-first mindset at every level of the company, embracing the importance of hiring and building teams for culture add rather than culture fit. We openly build and maintain unbiased hiring, pay, and promotion practices to create a foundation for an equitable workplace, paving the way for systemic change.

jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title: People Operations Manager

Department: Talent Operations

Location: Overland Park, KS (Kansas City metro), in office

Employment Type: Full-time


HI, WE'RE STEADILY.

We're building the easiest way for landlords to insure their rental properties. We're a Series C company, we've landed on Forbes' Best Startup Employers list and the Inc. 5000, and we're growing fast.



That growth is great. It also means someone needs to keep the whole machine running smoothly. That's where you come in.



We're hiring a People Operations Manager to own the people side of Steadily. HR, benefits, onboarding, compliance, the office, and yes, the occasional laptop that refuses to connect to Wi-Fi. If it helps our people do their best work, it's probably yours.



This isn't an HR coordinator role where someone hands you a checklist. You'll be the first call when something needs figuring out, and you'll build the systems that keep us organized as headcount climbs.



You'll report to the Director of Talent and work closely with our COO and leaders across every team.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - People Ops, end to end. Employee relations, performance support, leave and accommodations, investigations, documentation, compliance, and the full employee lifecycle from offer letter to offboarding.

 - Systems that scale. Onboarding, policies, workflows, documentation. You'll build the structure that lets a fast company stay fast without getting messy.

 - Being a trusted partner to leadership. Managers and founders will lean on you for tricky people situations. You'll help them handle things well, keep accountability high, and spot issues before they become problems.

 - Benefits. Enrollment, employee questions, open enrollment, and renewals with brokers and vendors. You're the person who makes benefits make sense.

 - First line IT. Laptop setup, common troubleshooting, and wrangling vendors when something's bigger than a restart. Nobody stays stuck for long.

 - Licensing and renewals. Own licensing for team members who need it, plus the tracking for renewals, continuing education, and deadlines. Nothing slips.

 - An office people like showing up to. Snacks, supplies, catering, furniture, vendors, upkeep. All the small details that make a workplace feel good.

 - The culture. Help us keep Steadily a place where strong people enjoy working hard and winning together.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years in People Ops or HR. Ideally at a fast-growing company where you moved quickly and wore a lot of hats.

 - Real ownership. You can run HR with minimal oversight, make judgment calls, and build processes from scratch. You see what needs doing and you do it.

 - Organization that borders on a superpower. You juggle competing priorities, stay ahead of deadlines, and keep a lot of plates spinning without dropping any.

 - Discretion and good judgment. Sensitive situations don't rattle you. You handle them with maturity, care, and confidentiality.

 - Tech comfort. Software, systems, and setting up a laptop don't intimidate you. Bonus points if you've been the office's unofficial IT person before.

 - Low ego, high hustle. You're excited to join a company that's growing fast and want to grow right along with it.


YOU'LL PROBABLY LOVE THIS IF

 - You'd rather build the playbook than follow one

 - You like variety: a benefits question at 9, a laptop fix at 10, a leadership conversation at 11

 - A perfectly organized tracker brings you a little bit of joy


WHY STEADILY

 - Top of market pay + equity in a high-growth Series C company

 - 401(k) retirement plan

 - Comprehensive health, vision, and dental insurance

 - A modern office in Overland Park with snacks (you'll be in charge of them, so choose wisely)

 - Good company to keep:

 - #16 on Forbes' 2026 Best Startup Employers https://www.forbes.com/lists/americas-best-startup-employers/

 - #179 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 Fastest Growing Companies https://www.steadily.com/press/steadily-insurance-inc-5000-list-2026

 - One of the Best Landlord Insurance Companies of 2026 by CNBC https://www.cnbc.com/select/best-landlord-insurance-companies/ and in Investopedia's Best Landlord Insurance Companies https://www.investopedia.com/the-best-landlord-insurance-11705333

 - A Newsweek Top Startup Workplace of 2025 https://rankings.newsweek.com/americas-greatest-startup-workplaces-2025

 - Winner of Austin Business Journal's Best Places to Work 2025 https://www.bizjournals.com/austin/c/best-places-to-work-austin-2025/35046/steadily-is-one-of-austins-best-places-to-work.html
