jobs.title: Cyber Threat Hunt Analyst - Junior, Mid-Level & Senior [U.S. Citizenship, Top Secret Clearance w/SCI Eligibility Required]
jobs.description:
Start Your Adventure at Via Logic

Location: Primarily onsite at a government site in Ashburn, VA. Specific worksite expectations will be confirmed for the assignment.
Type: Full-time, W-2
Compensation: $100,000–$153,000 annually, depending on experience, qualifications, and assignment
Experience: Junior: 1+ years; Mid-Level: 5+ years; Senior: 7+ years of relevant experience

Threat hunting starts with a question: What could be happening that our existing defenses haven’t caught? At Via Logic, you’ll help answer that question through proactive investigations that protect systems supporting U.S. Customs and Border Protection. We are hiring for multiple openings across junior, mid-level, and senior experience levels through this posting. Whether you’re building your threat hunting skills or bringing years of investigative experience, we’ll consider you for the opening that fits your background.

Anticipated annual salary ranges by level are:

• Junior: $100,000–$115,000

• Mid-Level: $115,000–$144,000

• Senior: $120,000–$153,000

Eligibility & Clearance Requirements

Due to CBP requirements, applicants must:

• Be a U.S. citizen.

• Hold a Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility at the time of assignment.

• Meet and maintain CBP suitability requirements for access to government facilities and systems.

• Be available to work onsite, primarily in Ashburn, VA, with specific worksite and travel expectations confirmed for the assignment.

SCI eligibility means you are eligible to be considered for access to certain compartmented intelligence information. Access for a specific assignment requires separate government authorization and a need to know. Please include your current clearance status and SCI eligibility when applying.

Your Mission

• Conduct proactive hunts across networks, endpoints, systems, and high-value assets to identify compromises and advanced threats that may evade existing security controls.

• Develop and test hunting hypotheses using threat intelligence, adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures, and knowledge of the environment.

• Gather and analyze logs, endpoint telemetry, network activity, and other security data to identify suspicious behavior and indicators of compromise.

• Use threat intelligence, open-source research, and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK to support scheduled and ad hoc hunts.

• Coordinate with incident responders, system owners, and other technical teams to validate findings, distinguish malicious activity from authorized behavior, and support follow-up investigations.

• Document hunt methods, findings, potential impact, and recommendations in clear reports that support action.

• Help improve detection rules, alerts, workflows, and security coverage based on hunt findings and purple team exercises.

• Maintain hunting procedures and playbooks, share lessons learned, and contribute to the team’s investigative methods.

What You Bring to the Expedition

• Relevant experience in threat hunting, security operations, incident response, digital forensics, malware analysis, or related technical work.

• Ability to interpret security logs, endpoint activity, and network data to investigate suspicious behavior.

• Familiarity with SIEM, endpoint detection and response, network analysis, or other security investigation tools.

• Understanding of attacker behavior, indicators of compromise, operating systems, and network protocols.

• Sound judgment about validating evidence, escalating findings, and involving other technical teams.

• Clear writing and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings and recommend practical next steps.

We are considering candidates at three levels:

• Junior - 1+ years: You bring technical foundations and experience working with security data. You’ll support hunts, investigate findings with guidance, and build your investigative skills.

• Mid-Level - 5+ years: You bring hands-on investigative experience and can carry out assigned hunts, evaluate evidence, and coordinate findings with other teams.

• Senior - 7+ years: You bring depth in complex investigations, help refine hunting methods and detection coverage, and share your expertise with other analysts.

Preferred qualifications:

• A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

• Experience with scripting, automation, malware analysis, digital forensics, detection engineering, or purple team exercises.

Tell us where you have the strongest experience and which areas you want to develop further.

Your Route Into Via Logic

One posting, three experience levels. Tell us about the environments you’ve supported, the tools you’ve used, and the investigations or hunts you’ve contributed to. Include your current clearance status and SCI eligibility so we can assess your fit for the available openings.

Why Explorers Stay

• Healthcare coverage and paid time off that give you room to take care of life outside work.

• Teammates who share knowledge, pitch in, and help each other grow.

• Opportunities to deepen your specialty and explore adjacent areas of cybersecurity as new assignments open up.

• Meaningful work protecting systems that support a federal mission.

How We Work

• These positions work primarily onsite at a government site in Ashburn, VA. Specific worksite and travel expectations will be confirmed for the assignment.

• You’ll collaborate with Via Logic teammates, government partners, and other technical teams using tools approved for your work environment.

• Core task coverage is generally weekdays, 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Eastern Time. Mission needs may require surge support or travel to other CBP locations. We’ll discuss assignment expectations before moving forward.

• When virtual meetings are part of the work, we expect active participation and use video when appropriate and permitted by the client environment.

About Via Logic

Via Logic LLC is an information technology partner supporting mission-driven work across DevSecOps, cloud engineering, cybersecurity, data science, and national security analytics for federal and commercial clients. Our teams help modernize complex systems through automation, secure engineering practices, cloud-native technologies, and scalable infrastructure solutions that support real-world impact. But beyond the work itself, we care deeply about how we work. We believe great teams are built through collaboration, curiosity, accountability, and trust. Whether you're supporting customer missions, strengthening business operations, or leading expeditions of your own, Via Logic is a place where Explorers are encouraged to grow, contribute, and continuously evolve.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Via Logic LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where all Explorers are valued and supported. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. We believe different perspectives strengthen teams, improve innovation, and help us build better solutions for the missions we support.

Accessibility & Accommodations

Via Logic is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring experience for all candidates. Reasonable accommodations are available throughout the application and interview process to support accessibility needs and ensure every candidate has an equitable opportunity to explore a career with our team.

Recruiting Fraud Notice

Via Logic takes recruiting fraud seriously. We will never ask candidates for payment, banking information, cryptocurrency, gift cards, or other personal financial information during any stage of the hiring process. All legitimate communication from our team will come directly from authorized Via Logic representatives using official company channels. Due to the rise of fraudulent recruiting activity across the industry, we encourage candidates to use caution if something feels unusual, rushed, or too good to be true. Real adventures should involve solving meaningful challenges - not wiring money to strangers pretending to be recruiters on the internet. If you have concerns about the legitimacy of a communication claiming to represent Via Logic, please verify the information through our official website before sharing personal information or taking further action.

jobs.title: Staff Mask Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

We are looking for an experienced Staff Mask Design Engineer to join a highly skilled layout organization working on Analog and Mixed-Signal ICs for Automotive applications. The role involves defining, developing, and delivering high-quality, manufacturable IC layouts using industry-standard technologies and tools.

The successful candidate will contribute at block and Chip top level, lead layout activities, collaborate closely with design and cross-functional teams, and ensure robust physical implementation that meets performance, reliability, and quality requirements.

Job Purpose:

The purpose of this role is to deliver robust, high-quality physical layouts for complex analog and mixed-signal ICs, ensuring manufacturability, reliability, and on-time delivery, while contributing to layout methodology, team capability, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Staff Mask Design Engineer, you will be responsible for:

· Implementing physical layouts for Automotive Business Line products at IP, block, and/or Chip Top level.

· Driving and delivering floorplanning activities for blocks and top-level designs.

· Participating in power supply strategy definition and signal distribution between blocks.

· Delivering analog and mixed-signal layout blocks and contributing to top-level floorplan strategy.

· Applying state-of-the-art layout techniques for device matching, parasitic reduction, ESD protection, latch-up prevention, and yield optimization.

· Executing and signing off physical verification flows, including DRC, LVS, ERC, DFM, and parasitic extraction (PEX).

· Working according to Analog-on-Top and Mixed-Signal-on-Top layout methodologies.

· Attending relevant project and design reviews, reporting progress, risks, and schedule impacts.

· Collaborating closely with design, verification, CAD, and technology teams to minimize rework and resolve physical implementation issues.

· Identifying root causes and proposing solutions for issues observed during first silicon or prototype evaluation.

· Contributing to design-for-quality, ensuring layouts are verified, validated, and suitable for long-term reliability and zero-defect goals.

· Leading layout team activities, including task planning, execution, and knowledge sharing.

· Participating in and contributing to training activities, technical documentation, and layout guidelines.

· Taking a proactive role in personal development, continuous learning, and methodology improvement.

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Microelectronics Engineering.

· 8+ years of experience in Analog and Mixed-Signal IC layout design.

· Proven experience delivering complex layouts at IP, block, and Chip Top level.

· Experience in automotive or safety-critical semiconductor products is highly desirable.

Technical Skills:

· Strong expertise in analog layout techniques, including:

o Floorplanning and top-level integration

o Device matching and symmetry

o Parasitic management

o Latch-up prevention and ESD protection

· Solid understanding of electronics, semiconductor physics, and fabrication processes.

· Hands-on expertise with layout and verification tools, including:

o Cadence Virtuoso / Virtuoso XL (OA, PVS)

o Mentor Graphics Calibre (DRC, LVS, PEX, DFM)

o R3D and related parasitic extraction tools

· Experience with advanced CMOS BCD technologies

· Experience using Mixed-Signal-on-Top (MSoT) flows

· Ability to define and execute advanced floorplan strategies

Soft Skills & Ways of Working:

· Strong team player, self-motivated, and results-oriented.

· Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a multisite, multicultural environment.

· Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

· Clear, concise communication and presentation skills.

· Ability to propose innovative and pragmatic solutions.

· Strong focus on quality, reliability, and on-time delivery.

· Willingness to undertake occasional international travel if required.

· Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams including design, test, program management, and quality.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. CoreWeave runs the infrastructure behind some of the world's most advanced AI. The Strategic Finance team is built with a diverse mix of talent coming from top-tier financial institutions, global technology companies, and some of the fastest-growing startups in AI and software. Our team is a small, but mighty Strategic Finance team that works directly with the CFO. Your work will shape how leadership, the Board, and the public markets understand the company, and you will have the opportunity to own critical aspects of our overall forecasting and planning workstreams.

Our team is designed to operate under uncertainty. Revenue is contracted years out. Capex is measured in billions. Growth depends on how well we plan capacity, capital, and customers together. There isn't a playbook for this business yet, and this role helps write it.

Key Responsibilities:

• The forecast. Own key parts of our three-statement model and cash forecast. Turn contracted revenue, capacity deployment, and capex plans into an outlook leadership can make decisions on.

• Planning. Drive planning that leads up to our public earnings cycles. Pressure-test assumptions and explain clearly what changed and why.

• KPIs and unit economics. Define and track the metrics that show how the business is actually performing, from contract economics to margins to capital efficiency. Present to leadership critical topics on what's working and what isn't.

• Executive and Board materials. Build the monthly, quarterly, and annual materials the executive team and Board rely on.

• Earnings and capital markets. Support earnings preparation, guidance, and investor dialogue. Contribute analysis to financing and rating agency work alongside the CFO.

• Cross-functional partnership. Work with Accounting, Business Finance, Treasury, and operating teams to keep numbers consistent from contract to cash to reported results.

Qualifications:

• 4+ years in finance, ideally most recently in central or corporate FP&A at a large-scale technology company or fast-paced startup

• Deep modeling skill: three-statement models, cash forecasting, and scenario analysis you can build and defend

• Sound judgment about what matters. You can take a messy set of inputs and produce a clear recommendation

• Clear writing and presenting for senior audiences, including executives and the Board

• Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You build structure where none exists and own critical processes

• Working knowledge of accounting that affects the forecast (revenue recognition, leases, capex)

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast!  We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. jobs.title: Staff Software Architect - Data Intensive Web-Applications - Personalization
jobs.description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What you'll do:

• Lead the system design and hands-on delivery of a data-intensive web product on Microsoft Azure. You own how the application is shaped end to end — services, APIs, the Next.js layer, integrations, security, and how it behaves under load.

• This role is defined by two things: designing the system and shipping a performant application. You write the code for the most critical paths and own them from design through production. Architecture without implementation, or features that do not hold latency, throughput, and cost targets, is not the job.

• Design how the product queries, processes, and presents large volumes of data — modeling, SQL performance, caching, pagination, aggregation, search, and asynchronous processing — and ship dashboards, reports, and data exploration on top of existing data platforms. Every design choice is judged by whether the product stays fast, correct, and operable as data volume and concurrency grow.

• Choose and document the system shape (modular monolith, microservices, synchronous, or event-driven) against performance, consistency, security, cost, and operational complexity. You make the trade-offs explicit, including when a simpler design is enough.

• Set standards for authentication and authorization, observability, automated testing, code review, and continuous delivery, using AI-assisted engineering as part of how the team builds. Partner with the teams that own ingestion, pipelines, and the data platform. You own how the application queries, secures, and serves that data at production performance.

What you'll need:

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or another quantitative field. A master's degree or PhD is a plus.

• Experience as a Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, Software Architect, or equivalent, designing and shipping large-scale, high-performance web applications and backend systems.

• Proven system design at production scale: service boundaries, data flow, consistency, failure modes, and the ability to defend those choices with trade-offs, not slides.

• Deep, hands-on Java, plus Go and/or Python where they fit the problem.

• TypeScript, React, and Next.js, enough to shape and contribute to the web application.

• Microsoft Azure in production, API and integration design, and distributed systems (queues, events, idempotency, consistency, resilience, and fault tolerance).

• Strong SQL, data modeling, and query optimization, plus NoSQL, caching, and search — with a track record of making data-heavy UIs and APIs fast (latency, throughput, pagination, aggregation, cache strategy).

• Automated testing, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and production diagnosis with logs, metrics, and traces.

• Plus: Analytics or BI products, conversational interfaces, multi-tenant systems, Domain-Driven Design, feature flags, and progressive delivery.

More about you:

• You combine architectural judgment with implementation and stay close to the code. You treat system design and performance as first-class product work, not afterthoughts.

• You make pragmatic trade-offs and choose the simpler design when it is enough — and you do not ship a design that cannot meet its performance envelope.

• You explain risks, decisions, and limits clearly to technical and business audiences. You raise the team’s quality through example, review, and collaboration, including when requirements are incomplete.

What We Offer:

jobs.title: Yard Supervisor
jobs.description:
Build the Future with Us — Forge & Build is Hiring a Yard Supervisor

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

Forge & Build is hiring a Yard Supervisor at our facility in Ashland, MO, and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. The Yard Supervisor is responsible for leading daily yard operations and standards, managing the yard team, ensuring a great customer experience, and driving safety standards at all times throughout the yard.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and offers overtime pay after working 40 hours. (Includes working weekends)

Primary Responsibilities

• Responsible for maintaining yard inventory control and procedures.

• Responsible for planning and coordinating all deliveries and transfers.

• Responsible for coordinating all shipping and receiving activities.

• Maintains a safe and organized yard environment.

• Ensures completion of all routine inspections, repairs, maintenance, and equipment cleaning.

• Responsible for all loading and unloading of building materials while strictly maintaining safety standards.

• Responsible for general yard standards and building cleanup in accordance with company standards.

• Maintains a safe and hazard-free workplace at all times.

• Serves as an advocate for driving and promoting company culture and upholding high standards of customer experience.

• Maintains all safety requirements and ensures all safety training is completed.

• Maintains organization and proper maintenance of all yard operations.

• Ensures all loads are accurate and delivered in a timely manner.

• Communicates issues that could impact the business to the Store Manager in a timely and effective manner.

• Assists with various other duties as assigned by the Store Manager.

Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits

• Monthly Family Dinner Night — We treat you and your family to dinner every month, because family comes first. (An employee favorite!) *restrictions apply

• Competitive compensation

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

• Generous PTO + paid holidays

• Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

About Forge & Build

Forge & Build is a place contractors and customers can access all the materials and hardware they need to get the job done, as well as tech-powered equipment rentals.

At its foundation, Forge & Build was started by contractors for contractors. Its leadership team is different from our competitors because they know what it feels like to be a builder. They remember walking into a hardware store hoping to find everything in one place, but many times having to head to another store.

As a partner of EquipmentShare, Forge & Build is backed by one of the largest construction equipment buyers in the country, a nationwide support team and T3 technology that helps builders of America increase overall productivity, efficiency, and visibility. EquipmentShare is building connectivity for all verticals in construction including materials – which means having accurate and up-to-date information around inventory and location of materials to ensure our customers always have what they need.

Skills & Qualifications

Required Skills/Abilities:

• Ability to operate and maintain all equipment and vehicles in the yard.

• Must maintain a minimum of a Class B Valid driver’s license.

• Responsible for upholding and executing all safety regulations and guidelines.

• Self-starter with a mindset of continuously improving yard operations.

• Ability to lead and support team members through driving company culture.

• Detail-oriented with the ability to proactively solve problems as they arise.

• Provides and delivers excellent customer experience.

• Helps identify new business opportunities with contractors, builders, developers, homeowners, etc., by referring them to outside sales representatives.

• Consistently assesses the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of all assigned work.

• Able to thrive in both collaborative and autonomous environments.

• Self-driven with an entrepreneurial mindset for continuous knowledge growth within the business.

• Adaptable and agile to quickly learn new and changing technologies and processes.

• Embodies the EquipmentShare mission and culture.

• Adherence to all company employee policies.

• Regular and reliable attendance.

• Other duties as assigned by management.

Education and Experience:

• High school diploma or equivalent is required.

• Experience providing excellent customer service.

• General knowledge of the construction industry is a plus.

• Solid written and oral communication skills.

• Understanding of basic math for calculating quantities and ensuring accurate inventory counts.

• Effective organizational, time management, detail orientation, and problem-solving abilities.

• Effective and consistent communication skills with internal and external customers.

• Ability to adapt quickly, thrive, and succeed in a fast-paced environment.

• Must be able to drive and maintain a valid driver’s license.

• Inherent desire to learn and develop on an individual basis.

• Strives for continuous improvement.

Physical Requirements:

• Must be able to be outside during extreme and varying weather conditions and temperatures.

• Constantly lifts and/or moves objects up to 20 pounds.

• Regularly lifts and/or moves heavy objects, equipment parts, and tools, often weighing up to 50 pounds or more.

• Occasionally moves objects up to 100 pounds or more.

• Spends extended periods of standing and walking on varying, possibly uneven surfaces within the field environment while performing tasks such as inspections, repairs, maintenance, and/or maneuvering throughout the yard.

• Remains stationary in one position for long periods of time, which can include standing or sitting.

• Moves self into different positions to accomplish tasks in various environments including tight and confined spaces, which will require bending and stooping.

• Uses hands, fingers, and arms to manipulate tools, equipment, and small parts with precision and control; specifically, constantly uses hands and wrists to finger, handle, feel, or make repeating motions and reach with hands and arms.

• Performs repetitive motions such as gripping, twisting, and turning.

• Good vision and hearing are essential for safely operating machinery, reading technical manuals, and communicating with colleagues and customers.

• Performs specific tasks with eyes that include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

• Must wear personal protective equipment (PPE) such as safety glasses, gloves, steel-toed boots, and hearing protection at all times.

• Moves around large equipment and navigates obstacles within the field and yard; may occasionally move about to accomplish tasks or move from one worksite to another.

• Operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer.

• Constantly assesses the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned.

A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

EquipmentShare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

Employment is contingent on passing a background check. Additionally, some roles require passing a drug test, depending on the job responsibilities.

At Range, we’re building towards a world where anyone can live the financial life they imagine for themselves. If that sounds like a mission you want to be a part of, let’s create it together.

We’re building AI-powered wealth management. Investments, taxes, retirement, estate planning, all in one platform instead of scattered across different advisors and apps. We're backed by Google's Gradient Ventures, Cathay Innovation, Scale Venture Partners, and more. We’re growing fast while still small enough that everyone's work is visible and impactful.


About the role

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Financial Planner to join our team of industry leading wealth advisors, reporting directly to the General Manager of Financial Planning. This individual will be responsible for crafting financial plans for members and continuing to support them through our asynchronous messaging platform.  Members are not assigned to one planner, instead they get access to the whole team so that planners can collaborate and dive into their subject expertise based on the specific questions members are asking. 

But we’re looking for more than just a great advisor - you’ll be a key component of helping to reinvent the wealth management space through tech. From collecting financial information, to evaluations and projections, to custom plan delivery, this person will partner with our product team to loan their expertise and provide feedback as we continue to build out our suite of proprietary tools.

This role is based at Range's Headquarters in McLean, VA or one of our hubs in New York City, or Bellevue. Employees hired for this position will work in office Monday-Friday. If you are not already located in one of these areas, your willingness to relocate will be a contingency for employment. 


What you’ll do with us

 - Gain a deep understanding of our members’ unique needs and aspirations to confidently advise them on their financial goals

 - Build and implement iterative financial plans and wealth strategies

 - Maintain an in-depth understanding of financial planning, investments, and tax planning

 - Be an active part of a collaborative team and share best practices

 - Assist our engineering and product teams with prioritizing and creating product plans and roadmaps

 - Research and present investment strategies

 - Coordinate tax filing and estate planning


What will set you apart

 - Active designation(s) as a Certified Financial Planner (CFP), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), Enrolled Agent (EA), Equity Compensation Associate (ECA) or similar

 - 6-9+ years experience in a client-facing financial services roles

 - Experience with in depth tax planning and building tax projections for clients

 - Exceptional investment acumen and knowledge of broader planning topics

 - Significant experience using financial services technology 

 - Interest in or passion for the tech space, and a desire to change the industry

 - Strong organizational, leadership, and written communication skills

 - BS or BA in Finance, Accounting, or other related major preferred


Compensation:

Base salary range: $130,000 - $230,000

This is the base salary range we expect in good faith to pay for this role at the time of posting. Where an offer lands within the range depends on the scope and complexity of work the candidate can own independently and demonstrated depth at this level.


Other compensation and benefits

The range above reflects base salary only. Our offer packages also include equity in the form of stock options, so total compensation for this role will exceed the base salary range. 

We do not ask for or consider salary history. You are welcome to ask questions about compensation at any point in the process.


Benefits

 - Technology allowance

 - Hybrid work environment opportunities available for select employees

 - PTO

 - Paid parental leave

 - In-person team & company events

We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. As a company, we are committed to designing products, building a culture, and supporting a team that reflects the diverse population we serve.

Fortitude Reinsurance Company Ltd. (Fortitude Re) is one of the world’s leading providers of legacy reinsurance solutions. Fortitude Re manages a general account of approximately $111 billion across life, annuity, and property & casualty insurance products. The company takes a long-term view on growth and is proud to be backed by a consortium of sophisticated institutional investors led by The Carlyle Group and T&D Insurance Group. Incorporated under the laws of Bermuda on January 1, 2017, Fortitude Re’s roots in the insurance industry and the experience of their leadership go back many decades. Fortitude Re’s leadership team has an average industry tenure of over 20 years, and an impressive track record of successfully managing the most complex legacy liabilities. Their deep insurance experience and proprietary risk modeling capabilities allow them to structure bespoke transactions that benefit both insurance companies and their policyholders. Fortitude Re continues to strengthen its ability to pursue further growth and provide innovative solutions for the global insurance industry.   Click here for more information about Fortitude Re.

The Senior Vice President, Investment Business Management is responsible for designing and delivering the process and control improvements required to produce investment data and reporting the enterprise trusts. The role evaluates investment operations and accounting processes end to end, identifies the root causes of recurring data and reporting issues, and leads the design of the process, control, and system changes that prevent them from recurring. The role also oversees project management for those improvements, allocates resources across teams to deliver them, and facilitates and drafts the cross functional operating model between Investment Accounting and Investment Operations, for ratification by the Chief Investment Officer and the Chief Financial Officer. The role also defines the cross functional performance measures for investment data and reporting and owns the system used to produce them.

This role owns cross functional process and control design; operational execution and accounting accountability remain with Investment Operations and Investment Accounting respectively. This is a hands-on leadership role. The successful candidate will work directly in the detail with the operations and accounting teams to solve problems and implement improvements, reducing the workload on those teams rather than adding to it, and will communicate progress and risks to executive management.

What You Will Do:

·       Evaluate investment operations and accounting processes end to end, identify enhancements, and lead the design of the improvements needed to raise data quality and eliminate misreported net investment income and unclosed OPR and suspense items.

·       Own root cause analysis of recurring breaks, working hands on in the data and the process with the teams that run it, and translate findings into process, control, and system changes that prevent recurrence, working through the function that owns execution rather than performing it.

·       Lead the design and implementation of the control environment over investment data and reporting, including control definition, evidence standards, and testing approach.

·       Define the cross functional key performance indicators that measure success across the functions supporting investment data and reporting, covering accuracy, timeliness, break volumes and aging, manual effort, and control effectiveness. Each function continues to define and track its own internal operational metrics.

·       Own the measurement and reporting system behind those indicators, and produce the cross functional reporting on investment data and reporting quality to executive management. Operational status reporting on each function remains with that function's leader.

·       Oversee project management for related improvements, sequencing and prioritizing the work so that each effort delivers usable value to business users incrementally.

·       Allocate resources across teams to ensure that key projects and programs are completed successfully.

·       Facilitate and draft the cross functional operating model between Investment Accounting and Investment Operations, including activity ownership, handoff acceptance criteria, and escalation paths. Investment Operations and Investment Accounting contribute as subject matter authorities for their functions, and the Chief Investment Officer and Chief Financial Officer ratify the model.

·       Lead onboarding of new investment operations and accounting software platforms, the system and process change, and partner with the data and technology teams to translate process requirements into platform capability that retires manual work.

·       Define and maintain process documentation and standard operating procedure standards across both functions, to a single standard.

·       Establish the continuous improvement discipline, including daily exception detection, aging and recurring issue metrics, and the cadence that turns them into process redesign or automation.

·       Report progress, risks, and issues to executive management, and work directly with internal and external auditors on control design and evidence.

What You Will Have:

·       Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field; advanced degree or professional certification such as CPA, CFA, or PMP preferred.

·       At least 12 years of experience in investment operations, investment accounting, or financial process and controls transformation, preferably at an insurer, asset manager, or financial services firm.

·       Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and testing internal controls over financial reporting.

·       Strong working knowledge of the investment lifecycle across complex asset classes, including private credit, mortgage loans, derivatives, and alternatives, and of the reference data, reconciliation, and valuation processes that support them.

·       Experience leading cross functional process design and operating model work between operations and accounting functions, with the credibility to drive change without direct operational ownership.

·       A hands on approach to problem solving. This role requires a leader who is willing to work in the detail alongside the teams, analyze data and processes directly, and take ownership of solving problems rather than delegating them to other teams.

·       Track record of delivering process improvement and system implementation in increments that produce usable value for business users, rather than long cycle programs.

·       Experience with investment accounting and operations platforms and data environments, such as Clearwater, SAP, Palantir Foundry, or comparable systems.

·       Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, and the ability to explain complex process and control topics to executive management, auditors, and regulators.

·       Experience working with internal audit, external auditors, and regulators, and knowledge of the control and reporting requirements of the insurance industry.

·       Strong analytical, problem solving, and influencing skills, with attention to detail, accuracy, and quality.

·       Demonstrated experience owning a process end to end across functions that do not report to them, and driving change through standards, measurement, and influence rather than authority.

·       Experience defining and implementing key performance indicators and operational metrics, including the data and reporting needed to measure them.

jobs.title: HVAC Equipment Mechanic
jobs.description:
Copper River Technologies is seeking an experienced HVAC Equipment Mechanic to join our team supporting commercial and industrial facilities. In this role, you’ll install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair a wide range of HVAC and refrigeration systems—including equipment supporting large office buildings, warehouses, aircraft hangars, hospitals, data centers, and other specialized environments in Crane, IN.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

• Install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair commercial and industrial HVAC and refrigeration systems.

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and refrigeration system issues.

• Service equipment including chillers, compressors, condensers, evaporators, pumps, motors, fans, valves, thermostats, and controls.

• Check system pressures, temperatures, refrigerant levels, and overall equipment performance.

• Charge refrigeration systems and perform leak testing.

• Disassemble, repair, and reassemble HVAC and refrigeration components.

• Install and connect piping, tubing, controls, gauges, and related equipment.

• Read and interpret blueprints, schematics, specifications, and technical instructions.

• Use diagnostic and precision tools such as multimeters, pressure gauges, vacuum pumps, thermometers, and other HVAC test equipment.

• Identify equipment deficiencies and make adjustments or repairs to keep systems operating safely and efficiently.

• Follow all applicable safety, environmental, refrigerant-handling, and facility procedures.

Essential Job Qualifications and Requirements:

• Certification: EPA Section 608 Universal Certification

• Experience: Hands-on experience working with commercial or industrial HVAC and refrigeration systems Experience working with HVAC diagnostic and testing equipment

• Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: Strong knowledge of refrigeration cycles, heat transfer, chilled-water systems, and environmental control systems Ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical and electrical systems Ability to read blueprints, schematics, and technical documentation

• Physical & Work Requirements This is a hands-on position that may require: Lifting up to 40 pounds independently Climbing ladders and scaffolding Working on rooftops, in equipment rooms, confined spaces, and other challenging environments Standing, walking, bending, kneeling, crouching, crawling, and reaching Working indoors and outdoors in hot, cold, noisy, or occasionally poorly ventilated environments

• Additional Requirements Subject to pre-employment and annual physical examinations. Subject to random drug testing Must obtain and maintain required certifications, licenses, and security clearance, as applicable May require overtime, emergency callback, weekend/holiday work, and approximately 1–2 days of travel per month

jobs.title: Associate - Tax Operations
jobs.description:
About Clear Street:

Clear Street is modernizing the brokerage ecosystem. Founded in 2018, Clear Street is a diversified financial services firm replacing the legacy infrastructure used across capital markets.

We started from scratch by building a completely cloud-native clearing and custody system designed for today’s complex, global market. Clear Street’s proprietary prime brokerage platform adds significant efficiency to the market, while focusing on minimizing risk, redundancy, and cost for clients. Our goal is to create a single source-of-truth platform for every asset class, in every country, and in any currency.

By combining highly-skilled product and engineering talent with seasoned finance professionals, we’re building the essentials to compete in today’s fast-paced markets.

The Team

The Global Tax Operations is responsible for ensuring compliance with Clear Street Group; This includes U.S. information reporting and withholding, FATCA, CRS, QI/QDD and securities taxation and filing obligations globally. The team works closely with all business lines including institutional brokerage, custody and retail businesses. This is an integrated team providing guidance on securities taxation obligations, managing tax risk and running tax processes.

Within this expert group US Tax Ops team is responsible across all booking locations for:

• S. Withholding Tax Compliance (Chapters 3, 4, 61, 871(m), 1446(f), 305(c))

• Cost Basis and Wash Sale Reporting

• S. Tax Information Reporting (Forms 1099, 1042-S, 1042)

• Nonresident Alien (NRA) withholding and treaty eligibility validation

• Tax documentation and W-8/W-9 validation

The Role

This is a hands-on, data-driven operational role requiring a foundational understanding of U.S. information reporting and withholding obligations. You will maintain daily tax records, collaborate with third-party providers, and support the broader Global Tax Operations team to deliver accurate, timely client reporting and annual Form 1099 & 1042-S filings within a fast-paced broker-dealer, custody, and retail environment.

Key Responsibilities:

• Review and cleanse tax information day-to-day.

• Review and validate tax documentation (W-8/W-9).

• Calculate, apply, and reconcile U.S. withholding under Chapter 3, Section 871(m), Section 305(c), and 1446(f).

• Prepare and file U.S. information returns including 1099 Series, 1042-S, and related IRS filings.

• Perform reconciliations of withholding and reporting data ensuring accuracy and completeness.

• Respond to and support IRS, audit, and regulatory inquiries.

• Execute test cases for tax reporting and withholding system enhancements.

• Partner with Operations & Technology to resolve data issues and streamline automation.

• Maintain detailed process documentation and contribute to continuous process improvements.

Requirements

• 1-3 years of hands-on experience in tax operations

• Experience of and U.S. information, reporting & withholding obligations

• Technical knowledge of IRS obligations under Chapter 3, Chapter 4 (FATCA), Chapter 61, §871(m), and s.1446(a) and (f).

• Practical experience with broker-dealer, prime brokerage and custodial operations

• Familiarity with IRS systems (FIRE, EFTPS & the forthcoming IRIS system) and tax documentation platforms.

• Proven ability to work with large data sets, reconcile reporting / withholding amounts, and identify discrepancies.

• Detail-oriented, with a control and risk-focused mindset.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent communication skills to coordinate with internal stakeholders and respond to regulatory queries.

• Series 99 and/or Series 7 preferred, or willingness to obtain.

We Offer:

The Base Salary Range for this role is $90,000-115,000. This range is representative of the starting base salaries for this role at Clear Street. Where a candidate falls in this range will be based on job related factors such as relevant experience, skills, and location. This range represents Base Salary only, which is just one element of Clear Street's total compensation. The range stated does not include other factors of total compensation such as bonuses or equity.

At Clear Street, we offer competitive compensation packages, company equity, 401k matching, gender neutral parental leave, and full medical, dental and vision insurance. Our belief has always been that we are better as a business when we are all together in person. As such, we are requiring employees to be in the office 4 days per week. In-office benefits include lunch stipends, fully stocked kitchens, happy hours, a great location, and amazing views.

Our top priority is our people. We’re continuously investing in a culture that promotes collaboration. We help each other through challenges and celebrate each other's successes. We believe that modern workplaces succeed by virtue of having high-performance workforces that are diverse — in ideas, in cultures, and in experiences. We put in the effort to make such a workplace a daily reality and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Financial Planner
jobs.description:
At Range, we’re building towards a world where anyone can live the financial life they imagine for themselves. If that sounds like a mission you want to be a part of, let’s create it together.

We’re building AI-powered wealth management. Investments, taxes, retirement, estate planning, all in one platform instead of scattered across different advisors and apps. We're backed by Google's Gradient Ventures, Cathay Innovation, Scale Venture Partners, and more. We’re growing fast while still small enough that everyone's work is visible and impactful.


About the role

We’re looking for an experienced Financial Planner to join our team of industry leading wealth advisors, reporting directly to the General Manager of Financial Planning. This individual will be responsible for crafting financial plans for members and continuing to support them through our asynchronous messaging platform.  Members are not assigned to one planner, instead they get access to the whole team so that planners can collaborate and dive into their subject expertise based on the specific questions members are asking. 

But we’re looking for more than just a great advisor - you’ll be a key component of helping to reinvent the wealth management space through tech. From collecting financial information, to evaluations and projections, to custom plan delivery, this person will partner with our product team to loan their expertise and provide feedback as we continue to build out our suite of proprietary tools.

This role is based at Range's Headquarters in McLean, VA or one of our hubs in New York City, or Seattle. Employees hired for this position will work in office Monday-Friday. If you are not already located in one of these areas, your willingness to relocate will be a contingency for employment. 


What you’ll do with us

 - Gain a deep understanding of our members’ unique needs and aspirations to confidently advise them on their financial goals

 - Build and implement iterative financial plans and wealth strategies

 - Maintain an in-depth understanding of financial planning, investments, and tax planning

 - Be an active part of a collaborative team and share best practices

 - Assist our engineering and product teams with prioritizing and creating product plans and roadmaps

 - Research and present investment strategies

 - Coordinate tax filing and estate planning


What will set you apart

 - Active designation(s) as a Certified Financial Planner (CFP), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), Enrolled Agent (EA), Equity Compensation Associate (ECA) or similar

 - 4-8+ years experience in a client-facing financial services roles

 - Experience with in depth tax planning and building tax projections for clients

 - Significant experience in delivering financial advice directly to consumers

 - Exceptional investment acumen and knowledge of broader planning topics

 - Significant experience using financial services technology 

 - Interest in or passion for the tech space, and a desire to change the industry

 - Strong organizational, leadership, and written communication skills

 - BS or BA in Finance, Accounting, or other related major preferred


Compensation:

Base salary range: $100,000 – $200,000

This is the base salary range we expect in good faith to pay for this role at the time of posting. Where an offer lands within the range depends on the scope and complexity of work the candidate can own independently and demonstrated depth at this level.


Other compensation and benefits

The range above reflects base salary only. Our offer packages also include equity in the form of stock options, so total compensation for this role will exceed the base salary range. 

We do not ask for or consider salary history. You are welcome to ask questions about compensation at any point in the process.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Gap International is seeking a Senior Manager, Integrated Marketing & Demand Generation to help define how we translate our distinctive point of view, expertise, and body of work into meaningful market impact.

This is a significant opportunity to shape and elevate how Gap engages the market—building an integrated demand generation capability that creates relevance, earns attention, develops relationships, and ultimately drives growth. You’ll operate at the intersection of strategy, marketing, and sales, bringing rigor and creativity to how we identify opportunities, engage the right audiences, and convert market interest into lasting business value.

The right candidate will be energized by the opportunity to build something sophisticated and enduring: a high-performing marketing engine that reflects the quality of Gap’s work, raises our presence in the market, and plays a meaningful role in the company’s next stage of growth.

ABOUT GAP INTERNATIONAL

Gap International is a global performance consulting company that works with executives and their organizations to produce extraordinary business results in an ever-changing marketplace. For nearly 50 years, we’ve helped leaders articulate and fulfill the boldest possible future for their business — creating breakthrough outcomes and aligning the organization’s actions to be consistent with that future.

Our work spans 65 countries and has reached more than 50,000 executives across 1,500 organizations, from Fortune 1000 companies to entrepreneurs.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Develop and execute integrated demand generation strategies and plans that translate business objectives, market insights, and target audience opportunities into measurable pipeline, revenue, retention, and growth outcomes.

• Own Marketing’s contribution to pipeline and revenue, partnering closely with Sales to align growth priorities, optimize lead management, and improve conversion, pipeline velocity, and revenue outcomes.

jobs.title: Registration Coordinator
jobs.description:
The New York Independent System Operator (NYISO) manages the efficient flow of electricity on more than 11,000 circuit-miles of high-voltage transmission lines, dispatching power from hundreds of generating units across the state.

The New York Independent System Operator (NYISO) applies cutting-edge technology to operating a reliable electricity system, managing competitive markets for wholesale electricity, and planning for the Empire State's energy future.  The NYISO’s External Affairs department invites applications for a full-time Registration Coordinator.

SUMMARY:

The primary responsibility of the Registration Coordinator is to facilitate the registration of Market Participants into the NYISO’s wholesale markets in accordance with the MST-Market Services Tariff and OATT-Open Access Transmission Tariff. This role necessitates a strong customer service focus, providing direct support to prospective and existing Market Participants registering to participate in NYISO’s wholesale markets. The Registration Coordinator role aligns with the department’s efforts to address technical inquiries from a diverse group of electric generators, utilities, demand response providers, traders, and consumers that seek to participate in New York’s wholesale power markets.

The position requires working independently and collaboratively across multiple departments within the NYISO, as well as with external entities, including prospective customers and existing Market Participants seeking to make amendments to applications, process name changes, mergers, and acquisitions. This includes consultants, attorneys and industry professionals representing clients to understand registration requirements in NY’s wholesale electric markets.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills are critical to this role, which involves extensive collaboration across the NYISO and with a diverse range of industry stakeholders. The position leads discussions with engineers, attorneys, accountants, energy consultants, and business professionals, requiring the ability to communicate complex information clearly and effectively. Strong attention to detail and experience reviewing contractual documentation related to ownership, credit, finance, affiliate relationships, and NYISO tariff requirements are essential.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Manage the intake, coordination, and tracking of new registration applications and amendments to existing registrations for NYISO markets and market related systems in accordance with NYISO tariffs.

• Analyze, interpret, and apply complex technical information such as the NYISO tariffs, operating manuals, technical bulletins, procedures, business processes, NYISO systems and a general understanding of customers organizational documents and tax forms/financial relationships in relation to Market Participant registration.

• Assist with training of staff in registration procedures including developing educational materials.

• Ability to manage large caseloads, competing priorities, and multiple cases at varying complexities to process inquiries in accordance with NYISO tariff requirments.

• Ability to coordinate with Market Participants, Transmission Owners, consultants in conjunction with internal NYISO SMEs to ensure required registration requirements are compliant with NYISO’s tariffs and service agreements.

• Identify, initiate, and contribute to the continual improvement of registration work processes/documents in accordance with the evolving NYISO markets.

• Maintain current knowledge of the energy industry and NYISO system applications by following pertinent energy news as well as NYISO technical bulletins and Manual documentation changes. This includes attending project meetings directly involved in the development and implementation of new products and services in the NYISO wholesale markets.

• Responsible for understanding all applicable NYISO applications that are associated with the NYISO markets, this includes but is not limited to data entry into the MIS-Market Information Systems and Salesforce. Facilitate discussions with new generators on the direct connect for metering / base point signals.

• Adhere to NYISO internal departmental audit controls / requirements. Perform queries / data collection within multiple NYISO applications to support annual and ad hoc audits, including adherence to SOC1 auditing controls.

• Communicate technical/procedural information directly to Market Participants, external customers, and NYISO staff to facilitate processes on market entry, maintenance, and exit.

• Collaborate with Senior Manager Client Services & Technical Solutions, Manager of Stakeholder Services to improve the NYISO registration process and customer journey with a seamless handoff from registration to participation.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently or in a team environment under demanding time constraints, in a deadline driven environment.

• Generate Salesforce reports and dashboards with registration data for senior management.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

None.

EDUCATION

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university or college required (Engineering, Finance, Business, Economics or Communications).

EXPERIENCE

Three to five years’ experience with registration applications for participation in the energy markets or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

Experience in the energy or utility industry with strong understanding of technical products or services is desired.

Salesforce experience is preferred but not required.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

Technical, Business Process, Salesforce or Customer Service-related certificates are a plus but not required.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Strong oral and written communication skills; Strong interpersonal and leadership skills; PC proficiency; sound business acumen; Able to effectively interface with all levels of internal and external customers; Ability to perform in a team enivorment.

• Ability to read, analyze and interpret common scientific and technical documents. Ability to respond to a wide variety of inquiries from Market Participants, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community. Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to Market Participants, department managers and other employees.

• Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference and fundamentals of geometry / trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations. Ability to understand more advanced mathematical concepts in interpreting technical bulletins and documents.

• Ability to resolve problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

• General level of competency in Windows operating environment using MS Office applications, such as Word, Excel, Access, and PowerPoint, e-mail, and internet programs. Intermediate competency is desired in market support software systems.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to stand, walk, sit, and use hands to perform routine office tasks. The employee is occasionally required to reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Contact with staff and public will occur. Travel may be required to attend and/or conduct meetings, conferences, and training. This position may require work on nights, weekends, or holidays.

At the NYISO, we realize the importance of balancing the availability of remote work with the inherent value of bringing people together to attain success in the areas of maximum collaboration, relationship building and growth, teamwork, innovation and problem solving, as well as professional development and mentoring. In this role, you will be required to work onsite from our Rensselaer, NY location several days per workweek, with the option to work remotely on the remaining days. You will also be expected to respond to all business needs that may require any increase to the regular onsite requirements.

The NYISO takes pride in recruiting, developing and retaining highly talented individuals. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a comprehensive benefits package and innovative reward programs.

All offers of employment will be made contingent upon the successful completion of a drug screening and background check.

The NYISO is an Equal Opportunity Employer and as such, does not discriminate in its hiring or employment practice

Salary Range

$65,800—$101,600 USD

jobs.title: Principal Risk Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Risk Development – Principal Risk Systems Engineer

Company Overview

Soros Fund Management LLC (SFM) is a global asset manager and family office founded by George Soros in 1970. With $28 billion in assets under management (AUM), SFM serves as the principal asset manager for the Open Society Foundations, one of the world’s largest charitable foundations dedicated to advancing justice, human rights, and democracy.

Distinct from other investment platforms, SFM thrives on agility, acting decisively when conviction is high and exercising patience when it’s not. With permanent capital, a select group of major clients, and an unconstrained mandate, we invest opportunistically with a long-term view in a wide range of strategies and asset classes, including public and private equity and credit, fixed income, foreign exchange, and alternative assets. Our teams operate with autonomy, while cross-team collaboration strengthens our conviction and empowers us to capitalize on market dislocations.

At SFM, we foster an ownership mindset, encouraging professionals to challenge the status quo, innovate, and take initiative. We prioritize development, enabling team members to push beyond their roles, voice bold ideas, and contribute to our long-term success. This culture of continuous growth and constructive debate fuels innovation and drives efficiencies.

Our impact is measured by both the returns we generate and the values we uphold, from environmental stewardship to social responsibility. Operating as a unified team across geographies and mandates, we remain committed to our mission, ensuring a meaningful, lasting impact.

Headquartered in New York City with offices in Greenwich, Garden City, London, and Dublin, SFM employs 200 professionals.

Team Overview

The Risk Development team designs, builds, and maintains the technology and analytics that enable the firm to measure, monitor, and manage risk across all strategies. The team partners closely with risk managers, quants, operations and other teams to translate investment activity into timely, accurate, and actionable risk insights.

Job Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Principal Risk Systems Engineer to join our Risk Development team and own the design of the firm-wide risk platform. The role sits where engineering, data and investment risk meet. You will work closely with Risk Managers, Portfolio Managers, Quants, Strats, Operations and senior technology leaders.

The ideal candidate has designed and delivered fast, large-scale risk analytics platforms, is still a strong hands-on developer, and can explain complex technical and risk ideas clearly to senior people.

Deep knowledge of investment risk is required. We are hiring mainly for system design and architecture, technical depth, and the ability to work with senior stakeholders.

Major Responsibilities

• Set and own the overall design of the risk platform: data models, how risk is calculated and aggregated, and how it connects to upstream and vendor systems

• Design and build fast aggregation of risk and P&L data, including VaR and expected shortfall, with drill-down from firm to fund, strategy and position

• Stay hands-on: write production code in Python and SQL, and set the bar on code quality, testing and performance

• Run design reviews, set engineering standards, and mentor the team

• Design data models and compute that support both intraday and end-of-day risk

• Deploy and run workloads on AWS, using containers and Kubernetes to scale up and down

• Lead build-versus-buy decisions on analytics technology, weighing cost, performance and fit

• Work with Risk Managers and Portfolio Managers to turn what they need into designs, and explain the options and trade-offs to senior stakeholders

• Improve reliability, speed and monitoring across the platform, and be the go-to person for hard production problems

What We Value

Architecture & Design:

• 15+ years of software development, including significant time as lead architect on large data or analytics platforms in financial services

• A track record of designing systems that run reliably in production at scale, with real limits on data size, speed, memory and SLAs

• Deep experience with in-memory analytics or OLAP tools on top of data warehouses or lakehouses

• Able to set a design direction, write it down, and bring the team along

Technical Depth:

• Expert in performance tuning: memory, CPU profiling, query and load speed

• Strong Python, with clean, testable, maintainable code. Java or C++ a plus

• Strong SQL on large analytical databases

• Solid grasp of data structures, concurrency, parallelism and distributed computing

Risk & Financial Context:

• Deep knowledge of market risk: historical and stressed VaR, expected shortfall, sensitivities, stress and scenario analysis, and P&L vectors

• Experience with factor risk models, risk attribution and portfolio construction

• Experience across asset classes (e.g., Equity, Fixed Income, FX, Derivatives) and their risk models

• Experience on Risk, Front Office or trading systems at hedge funds or large banks

Communication & Stakeholders:

• Has worked directly with senior risk, trading and technology people

• Can explain complex technical ideas to non-technical people, in writing and in person

• Willing to push back on requirements, and offers a better option when saying no

Adaptability:

• Comfortable in a fast-paced team, balancing design and delivery work with production support

Preferred:

• Experience building user interfaces and charts for risk or analytics tools

• Uses AI coding tools in practice to design, build and troubleshoot faster

We anticipate the base salary of this role to be between $200,000 and $250,000. In addition to a base salary, the successful candidate will also be eligible to receive a discretionary year-end bonus.

In all respects, candidates need to reflect the following SFM core values:

Smart risk-taking   //   Owner’s Mindset   //   Teamwork   //   Humility   //   Integrity

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
The Business Analyst (BA) is a key link between business stakeholders and technical teams within Global IT. The role is responsible for understanding business needs, gathering and documenting requirements, analyzing processes, and translating those requirements into functional solutions. Business Analysts support the full solution lifecycle, from requirements gathering and workshops through testing (UAT/SIT), deployment, and post-implementation support, ensuring that delivered solutions meet business expectations and organizational objectives.

The team supports a broad portfolio of ERP, EPM, reporting, and transformation initiatives, including Oracle EBS, cloud transformation, Power BI, finance-related projects, and emerging technology initiatives. The team is expanding due to resource movements to other strategic projects, creating a need for additional Business Analysts to support delivery priorities and maintain project momentum.

What Success Looks Like

Business Analysts are expected to:

• Gather, analyze, and validate business requirements from a variety of stakeholders.
• Facilitate workshops and discussions to identify solutions and improvements.
• Create functional specifications, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.
• Act as the bridge between technical teams and business users throughout project delivery.
• Support testing activities and ensure solutions are delivered according to business needs.
• Build strong relationships with stakeholders and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

What We Are Looking For:

While ERP, SAP, Oracle, EPM, or finance process experience can be beneficial, the hiring managers are primarily looking for candidates with outstanding soft skills, strong communication abilities, curiosity, and a proactive mindset. They have strong technical expertise within the team and are confident in developing technical knowledge internally when the right attitude and potential are present.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• An inquisitive mindset and the ability to ask the right questions.
• A self-driven approach with a desire to learn and develop new skills.
• Confidence working with both business and technical stakeholders.
• Ownership of requirements throughout the end-to-end project lifecycle.

Learning & Development Opportunities

The team places a strong focus on development and knowledge sharing. New hires will receive support from experienced Business Analysts, Solution Engineers, and subject matter experts. There are opportunities to gain exposure to Oracle technologies, cloud solutions, ERP modernization programs, and future-focused initiatives, including AI-related projects. Internal training resources and certification paths are available to help employees build both functional and technical expertise.

Working Environment

The role is based in Spain and offers significant flexibility. While candidates can eventually work remotely, new joiners, especially those with less experience as an IT Business Analyst, are expected to spend time on-site during their first few months to accelerate learning, collaboration, and knowledge transfer. Experienced candidates may be given greater flexibility from the outset.

Why Join This Team?

This is an excellent opportunity for Business Analysts who enjoy working in a global environment, partnering with stakeholders across functions, and contributing to large-scale transformation initiatives. The team values fresh perspectives, continuous learning, strong communication, and collaboration, making it an attractive environment for professionals looking to develop their BA career while gaining exposure to enterprise-level technologies and business processes.

Why SGS?

• Global and very stable company, world leader in the TIC (Testing, Inspection and Certification) industry.
• SGS university and Campus for continuos learning options.
• Multinational environment where you will work with colleagues from multiple continents.
• Benefits platform.

Join Us: At SGS we believe in innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.  We offer a supportive and inclusive work environment that encourages professional growth and personal development.

• Excellent listening and communication skills

• Excellent analytical, critical thinking and troubleshooting skills.

• Excellent organization and time management skills

• Ability to work flexible hours to meet the needs of the shop including holidays, evenings and weekends

• Experience with consultation-based customer service models

• Ability to develop and train staff through positive coaching and feedback

• Proficient in excel, Microsoft suit, and adaptable to other systems as required

jobs.title: Senior Technology Partner Engineer
jobs.description:
Technology Partnerships Team at Datadog

About the Role

Datadog’s Technology Partnerships team builds and scales partnerships with the technology companies that matter most to our customers from AI/ML platforms to data platform providers. As a Technology Partner Engineer, you will be the technical bridge between Datadog and our partner developer community, acting as a consultant who helps partners build world-class monitoring solutions on the Datadog platform. You will be the primary technical contact for our partners, guiding them through the entire integration lifecycle from initial architectural design to final product integrations, and launching on the Datadog Marketplace. This is a unique role that combines deep technical troubleshooting with high-level consulting and platform advocacy, working directly with external developers and seeing your contributions immediately reflected in the Datadog ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

• Technical Advisory: Act as the technical lead for partners, advising on OAuth flows, log pipelines, OpenTelemetry, and MCP-based and API-based integrations and configurations.

• Co-Build: Partner closely with Datadog Partner, Product and Engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and drive joint integration roadmaps; ensure integrations are built, launched, and continuously improved to meet customer needs.

• Architectural & Code Review: Perform architectural assessments and deep-dive code reviews for partner integrations and marketplace repositories, ensuring they meet Datadog’s quality rubric.

• Technical Troubleshooting: Solve complex technical challenges for partners via dedicated technical consultations.

• Platform Advocacy: Identify friction points in the Datadog platform and partner with internal Product and Engineering teams to build a better developer experience.

• Documentation & Tracking: Maintain public-facing developer documentation including blog posts, and internal tracking systems to ensure transparency and scale.

• Market Awareness: Track trends across the AI/ML and data platform ecosystems to identify new partnership opportunities and ensure Datadog’s partner strategy stays ahead of a fast-moving market.

Who You Are

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, or a related field

• A technical expert with 7+ years of experience in a technical role (Partner Engineering, Support Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Software Development).

• Proficient in at least one programming language (Python or Go preferred).

• An observability enthusiast who understands monitoring fundamentals (Metrics, Logs, Traces) and modern standards like OpenTelemetry.

• A natural consultant with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to developers of varying skill levels.

• A tinkerer who is comfortable working with APIs, Linux environments, and cloud infrastructure.

• Someone who thrives in a hybrid work environment and values pragmatism, honesty, and simplicity.

• Self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment with a bias toward action.

• Bonus: Demonstrated ability to use AI coding tools in day-to-day workflows and validate, critique, and refine AI-generated output.

• Bonus: Motivated to push the boundaries of how AI can improve software engineering best practices and contribute to building AI-enabled products.

To conform to US export control regulations, candidates should be eligible for any required authorizations from the US government. This job is available in various departments within our company; to conform to US export control regulations, some of these roles may require candidates to be eligible for any required authorizations from the US government.
