jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Of the 10 million Americans struggling with opioid misuse, only 1 in 10 receive treatment. This is an accessibility crisis, and we are on a mission to solve it by bringing life-saving care to the 89% currently left behind. Through a single app, Bicycle Health combines Medication for Opioid Use Disorder (MOUD) with behavioral healthcare, drug screening, therapy, and peer support.

The Senior Full Stack Software Engineer is responsible for defining, architecting, enhancing and maintaining the technology that our provider and operations team use to deliver the highest quality of care possible for our patients. The systems you will be building and maintaining help us provide efficient, modern, secure, and comprehensive telehealth care.

Target Pay Range: $142,000-$175,000 + Equity - Compensation to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

Benefits:

• Discretionary PTO + 8.5 days of additional sick time + 10 paid holidays

• Paid parental leave

• 100% Employer Paid Employee Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• Employer Paid STD & LTD

• 401k

• $50 monthly Remote Work Stipend

What you will do:

• Use your knowledge of modern, open-source technologies (like Typescript, React, GraphQL, and Node.js) to architect, implement, test and maintain critical product features.

• Collaborate with product managers, physicians, nurse practitioners and other staff members to define and build solutions that help provide the best patient care.

• Work up and down the stack, from our web interfaces to our datastores and cloud infrastructure, doing anything it takes to solve problems and see projects through to completion.

• Operate with openness and integrity and be a role model for diverse, inclusive, low ego collaboration.

• Hold a high bar for execution; delivering value to our users reliably, repeatedly and transparently.

• Build strong relationships with teammates, managers and stakeholders across the organization.

jobs.title: Instrumentation Technician
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

This role supports KE's industrial and field service teams by ensuring instrumentation systems operate safely, accurately, and reliably across a variety of project environments. You'll be responsible for installing, calibrating, troubleshooting, and maintaining instrumentation equipment that directly impacts plant operations, system performance, and project success. Success in this role means minimizing downtime, maintaining system accuracy, and supporting safe and efficient operations, all while upholding KE's commitment to Safety, People, Passion, and Performance. If you're someone who takes pride in doing things the right way and thrives in a fast-moving environment, this position is built for you.

---

What You'll Do

You'll be part of a team that gets things done, works with purpose, and takes pride in the results. Your day-to-day responsibilities may include:

- Install, calibrate, test, troubleshoot, and repair instrumentation systems and equipment.

- Perform preventative and corrective maintenance on pressure, temperature, flow, and level instruments.

- Utilize HART communicators and diagnostic tools to configure, test, and verify instrument performance.

- Troubleshoot analog (4-20mA) and discrete wiring circuits, control loops, and communication systems.

- Conduct loop checks, functional testing, commissioning, and startup activities.

- Diagnose instrumentation failures and implement effective corrective actions.

- Read and interpret P&IDs, loop drawings, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation.

- Support routine maintenance, turnarounds, outages, shutdowns, and project work.

- Maintain calibration records, inspection reports, and maintenance documentation.

- Coordinate with operations, engineering, and maintenance teams to resolve instrumentation-related issues.

- Work independently while maintaining a strong focus on safety, quality, and productivity.

What You Bring

You're someone who shows up ready to work hard, learn fast, and contribute to a team that takes pride in doing things right. Successful candidates typically bring:

- 3+ years of industrial instrumentation experience preferred.

- Technical degree or certification in Instrumentation, Electrical Technology, Automation, or a related field preferred.

- Proficiency using HART communicators and instrument calibration tools.

- Strong understanding of analog signals (4-20mA), discrete I/O systems, and process instrumentation.

- Experience calibrating, testing, troubleshooting, and maintaining instrumentation systems.

- Ability to interpret technical drawings, schematics, and P&IDs.

- Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting abilities.

- Excellent problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.

- Valid driver's license and ability to travel to project sites as needed.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in industrial manufacturing, power generation, oil & gas, food processing, or similar process environments.

- Familiarity with PLCs, DCS systems, and process control equipment.

- OSHA 10, OSHA 30, or other applicable safety certifications.

Pay Range

We believe in paying for the value you bring to the team, and we aim to be competitive in every market we hire in.

Pay Range: $26 - $29 per hour plus per diem and incentive opportunities.

Total Rewards Statement

As a full-time employee at Knobelsdorff, you'll have access to a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and future.

-100% employer-paid health and dental coverage for employees

-HSA contributions to support your medical expenses

-Company-paid life insurance and disability coverage

-401(k) with competitive company match

-Paid weekly with competitive wages

-PTO, six paid holidays, and education reimbursement

-Exclusive employee discounts through Working Advantage

We believe your work should be rewarded with more than just a paycheck. At KE, we invest in your total wellbeing.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be provided for individuals with disabilities.

-Ability to sit, stand, kneel, stoop, walk, and remain in various positions for long periods

-Ability to work in inclement outdoor conditions, including extreme heat or cold

-Ability to lift and carry up to 80 lbs.

-Ability to travel long distances and work on active construction sites

Accessibility: If you need accommodations as part of the employment process, please contact Knobelsdorff Human Resources at HR@KEway.com.

Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO)

Knobelsdorff (KE) is an EEO to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law.

Applicants have rights under Federal Employment Laws:

• EEO is the Law (English/Spanish)

KE participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States. For more information about E-Verify, please review the E-Verify Participation and Right to Work posters

If you need accommodation during the hiring process, let us know and we’ll work with you.

jobs.description:

We’re looking for automotive mechanics with a minimum of 3 years of professional automotive repair experience to join us at Carvana - the fastest-growing used automotive retailer in U.S. history and one of the four fastest companies to make the Fortune 500.

As an Experienced Auto Technician, you will perform a full range of automotive repairs—from light maintenance to heavy engine work—and diagnostics on our vehicles, including:

• Performing general to complex repairs on all makes and models, ranging from timing belts and suspension systems to heavy engine work.

• Diagnosing and repairing advanced vehicle electrical issues, including work on electric and hybrid vehicles.

• Completing repairs for wheel bearings and axles, as well as vehicle climate control systems including ACs and heater cores.

At Carvana, you’ll receive a competitive wage and amazing perks – including but not limited to: 100% company paid healthcare, dental & vision insurance, a 401(k with a Carvana match and even a vehicle purchase discount – all while using state of the art tools in one of our high-tech Inspection Centers (click here to learn more). Other perks of the Job

• Generous paid-time off and your birthday is a holiday!

• Tuition reimbursement and student loan repayment

Schedule:

We do everything we can to deliver an exceptional customer experience, and that includes delivering great vehicles when expected. If we're in a pinch, mandatory overtime is one way in which we can follow-through on this commitment to our customers. We're looking for team players who are all in on our mission and are able to work mandatory overtime based on our business needs.

Join the Carvana team by applying on this page, or call one of our recruiters by phone at (888) 508-4749, Monday through Friday, between 6 AM and 4 PM MST.

Not a match for this role?

We also have a variety of other automotive roles available across our Inspection Center network. Check out our Careers site to learn more!

General qualifications and requirements

• Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Some positions may be subject to an Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check

About Carvana
At Carvana, we sell cars but we aren’t car salesmen. Our promise is simple: we won’t sell a car to a customer that we wouldn’t sell to our own Mom. Period.

To make sure our cars are in first-rate condition, we’ve built multiple vehicle Reconditioning Centers around the country, where our cars are inspected, perfected, and photographed before reaching the Carvana website.

Think you’ve got what it takes to join our team? Apply today!

Carvana is an equal employment opportunity employer. Carvana also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories.

Hiring is contingent on passing a complete background check. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Must be at least 18 years of age and possess a valid driver’s license. Must be able to read, write, speak and understand English

jobs.title: Product Manager - UX/UI Focus (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As a Product Manager at Reonic, you’ll own product problems from discovery through execution.

You’ll work closely with customers, product, design, and engineering to understand what users need, define the right solutions, and bring them to life. A strong focus of your role will be shaping the UX and UI of our product — from improving existing workflows to designing entirely new experiences.

You’ll combine product thinking with a strong eye for design, constantly asking: What problem are we solving, for whom, and how can we make the experience as simple and valuable as possible?

You’ll have significant ownership and the opportunity to directly shape how the product looks, feels, and works.

Please note: This is a fully onsite role in Augsburg.


What you'll do

 - Own product problems end-to-end: Take ownership of product areas from discovery and problem definition through prioritization, design, development, launch, and iteration.

 - Shape the user experience: Design intuitive, efficient, and delightful experiences across the product. Turn complex workflows into simple solutions that users can understand and adopt quickly.

 - Understand our users: Talk to customers, analyze feedback and usage data, identify pain points, and develop a deep understanding of how renewable installers work.

 - Think beyond the brief: Challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and make sure we’re solving the right problem rather than simply building what was initially requested.

 - Design and prototype: Work hands-on with wireframes, prototypes, and UI concepts to explore solutions quickly. Iterate with users and the team before investing heavily in development.

 - Set the UX/UI bar: Maintain a high standard for usability, consistency, accessibility, and visual quality across the product.

 - Balance user and business needs: Make thoughtful product trade-offs based on customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, and available data.

 - Work closely with engineering: Collaborate with engineers throughout the product development process, communicate requirements clearly, and make pragmatic decisions when trade-offs arise.

 - Iterate after launch: Treat shipping as the beginning, not the end. Measure outcomes, collect feedback, identify opportunities, and continuously improve the product experience.

 - Leverage AI in your workflow: Use AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, prototyping, analysis, and product development.


What Makes You a Great Fit

 - Product experience: 2+ years of experience in product management, product design, UX/UI, or a similar product-focused role, ideally in a startup or fast-growing product environment.

 - Strong product sense: You naturally think about customer problems, business impact, and outcomes rather than simply features and output.

 - UX/UI expertise: You have a strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, visual design, and usability. You care deeply about how a product feels to use.

 - Hands-on approach: You’re comfortable getting into Figma, creating wireframes and prototypes, testing ideas, and iterating on designs yourself.

 - Customer obsession: You enjoy talking to users and can translate qualitative feedback and observed behavior into clear product opportunities.

 - Comfort with ambiguity: You can take an unclear problem, structure it, identify what matters, and move towards a solution without needing every detail defined upfront.

 - Strong communication: You can clearly explain product decisions, design rationale, and trade-offs to engineers, designers, leadership, and other stakeholders.

 - Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes, make decisions, and follow problems through from initial idea to measurable impact.

 - Technical curiosity: You enjoy working closely with engineers and are interested in understanding the technical constraints and possibilities behind the products you build.

 - AI-native mindset: You’re curious about how AI can improve both the products we build and the way we build them.

 

Why Join Us?

 - Real impact: Help build software that enables businesses to accelerate the transition to renewable energy.

 - A product people use: Our platform is already used by 3,000+ paying B2B customers, giving you the opportunity to work on a product with real users and real-world impact.

 - High ownership: We’re a growing company, and nothing is set in stone. You’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work and how the product evolves.

 - Fast-moving environment: Work closely with engineering and other teams, make decisions quickly, and see your work reach customers.

 - A great international team: We work hard, learn from each other, and make sure we have fun along the way.

 - Great setup: MacBook, gym membership subsidy, regular team events, coffee, Deutschland ticket and other perks.

 - Competitive compensation: We offer competitive pay based on your experience and responsibilities.


Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn't hold you back— we value talent and passion above all.



ABOUT REONIC

At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology.

Our AI operating system helps renewable energy installers run and grow their businesses — from planning and selling solar, battery storage, and heat pump solutions to managing their day-to-day operations.

Today, more than 3,000 businesses use Reonic, and we’re growing fast.


Location
This is a full-time, on-site position based in Augsburg.


Ready to shape the future of renewable energy? Apply now!

jobs.title: Strategic Program Manager
jobs.description:
The Strategic Program Manager manages one of the Strategy team’s three portfolios—a group of related departments and the mission-critical annual priorities that connect their work to Clickstop’s 10-year roadmap. Rather than directly executing the work, the Strategic Program Manager holds the full picture, partnering with department leaders to ensure the highest-priority initiatives are clearly scoped, sequenced, resourced, aligned, and progressing toward measurable outcomes.

Serving as the bridge between Clickstop’s strategic vision and team-level execution, this role brings the structure, cadence, and cross-functional alignment needed to turn priorities into results. By embedding within teams and maintaining clarity around what matters, what it will take, and how progress is measured, the Strategic Program Manager enables leaders to make confident decisions, stay focused on leading their teams, and successfully deliver the initiatives that move Clickstop’s long-term strategy forward.

"The Strategy team exists to help us keep the momentum we've built over our first 20 years while being intentional about where we're headed. That means turning big ideas into real plans and making sure the things that matter get done. You'll be surrounded by people who hold a high bar, say 'tell me more' when you bring a new idea, and trust you to run with it."
- Lauren Gilbertson, VP of Strategy

Embedded & Cross-Functional Facilitation

Systems Thinking

• Assess the system a project operates within and distinguish issues that need an underlying process fix from those solvable within the project.

• Trace recurring friction to its root cause and recommend the structural change rather than a project-level workaround.

Change Adoption & Communication

• Own change management for strategic initiatives, preparing employees for new processes and ways of working and sustaining adoption after launch.

Portfolio Governance

• Serve as the intake point for the assigned portfolio, evaluating, theming, and qualifying emerging requests from its departments.

• Partner with leadership and subject-matter experts to translate strategic priorities into actionable roadmaps with clear boundaries, milestones, success metrics, and ownership.

• Lead quarterly planning and reprioritization cycles alongside leadership, ensuring resource allocation matches shifting business needs without losing sight of active commitments.

• Establish transparent tracking, status cadences, and visibility across all initiatives in the portfolio.

Capability Building & Continuous Improvement

• Lead retrospectives and post-implementation reviews to capture learnings and refine workflows.

• Coach leaders and teams on planning frameworks and deploy scalable templates and standards that raise project management capability organization-wide.

What we value in this role:

• Translating Ambiguity into Action: Exceptional ability to synthesize high-level ideas into clear, structured execution plans.

• Influence Without Authority: Builds trust quickly with leaders and teams and holds initiatives accountable without owning the work or the reporting line.

• Judgment Under Competing Priorities: Comfortable saying no, sequencing trade-offs, and communicating a prioritization decision to leaders and teams.

• Framework Fluency: Picks up planning methodologies and project management frameworks quickly and applies them pragmatically rather than rigidly.

• Experience in project and/or stakeholder management.

What does Clickstop provide?

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Senior Product Owner will focus on business automations and AI applications, serving as a high-impact, strategic product leader responsible for end-to-end product execution, roadmap definition, and business outcome delivery. This role combines rigorous day-to-day tactical product ownership (sprint planning, backlog health, high-velocity engineering partnership) with strategic, data-driven vision. Operating with high autonomy, consistency, and a relentless sense of urgency, the Senior Product Owner leverages data and product analytics to build roadmaps, align senior executive stakeholders, and establish product best practices. This position is designed for an exceptional, senior-level operator with the readiness and ambition to rapidly step into a Manager of Product Management capacity.

• Maintain pristine backlog hygiene, well-defined user stories, Acceptance Criteria, and clear Definition of Ready/Done to maximize engineering velocity and predictability.
• Lead daily and sprint agile ceremonies (backlog grooming, sprint planning, retrospectives) in close partnership with Product Engineering, ensuring sprint readiness and zero developer downtime.
• Own project delivery timelines with high reliability and an acute sense of urgency; actively identify, communicate, and eliminate blockers and cross-team dependencies before they impact milestones.
• Partner alongside Engineering and QA throughout the product lifecycle to verify functionality, oversee user acceptance testing (UAT), and guarantee enhancements meet the highest quality standards.
• Maintain existing production systems and products, ensuring continuous compliance with agreed-upon Service Level Agreements (SLAs), uptime, and operational performance metrics.
• Manage incoming product requests and bug escalations from diverse functional areas, rapidly triaging and resolving critical production issues.

Data-Driven Strategy & Strategic Roadmapping

• With direction from with leadership, formulate and prioritize product roadmaps backed by quantitative data, operational KPIs, and business ROI rather than anecdotal requests
• Define measurable success criteria and KPIs (e.g., user adoption, workflow efficiency, cycle time reduction, financial/VBC performance) for every initiative, tracking post-launch metrics to validate / share value delivery.
• Translate complex technical architectures, regulatory/compliance requirements, and operational trade-offs into crisp, business-oriented storylines for senior and executive leadership.
• Manage stakeholder expectations across functional areas with transparent, data-backed rationale, detailed milestone tracking, and clear trade-off analyses.

Emerging Leadership & Practice Scaling

• Own strategic projects independently while mentoring, coaching, and upskilling more junior Product Owners and Business Analysts across the organization.
• Establish and scale reusable product frameworks, intake models, PRD/story templates, and operating standards across the broader product management team.
• Lead high-ambiguity, cross-functional initiatives that span multiple product lines, engineering teams, and executive stakeholders, demonstrating the capacity to oversee a broader portfolio.
• Partner with product leadership to evaluate team capacity, sprint health, and delivery metrics, identifying continuous improvement opportunities to elevate team operating rhythms.
• Other duties as assigned.

• 5+ years of relevant product ownership, product management, or business analysis experience in high-velocity agile environments, with a demonstrated track record of progressive responsibility and informal or formal leadership.
• Proven track record of defining and leveraging product analytics, and business KPIs to build business cases, justify roadmap prioritization, and measure post-launch value.
• Exceptional day-to-day tactical product ownership skills: backlog grooming, user story writing, acceptance criteria definition, dependency mapping, and engineering partnership.
• Demonstrated bias for action, high consistency, reliability, and an acute sense of urgency in managing competing deadlines and operational escalations.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, align senior/executive stakeholders, and mentor team members.
• Hands-on experience understanding and leveraging modern AI tools, workflows, and capabilities to accelerate productivity, product discovery, and backlog delivery, with an active pulse on future-thinking AI developments.
• Exceptional written, verbal, and executive-level communication skills, with the ability to distill complex system logic into high-level business impact.
• Strong problem-solving skills, extreme attention to detail, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, geographically distributed team environment.
• Adaptable, flexible, and self-motivated with an ownership mentality.
• Bonus: Practical AI knowledge and skills (e.g., experience leveraging modern AI/LLM tools for workflow efficiency, prompt engineering, or designing AI-enabled product workflows).

The salary range for this role is $102,000.00 to $120,000.00 in base pay and exclusive of any bonuses or benefits (medical, dental, vision, life, and pet insurance, 401K, paid time off, and other wellness programs). jobs.title: Civil Engineer / Senior Civil Engineer – Data Centers
jobs.description:
Hybrid-based position in our Pennsylvania, Seattle, Texas, or Louisiana office.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position

We invite you to bring your civil engineering and land development experience into play as you support the planning, permitting, and design of data center and other large-scale industrial sites. This role will provide hands-on technical leadership for site feasibility, conceptual layouts, grading, drainage, stormwater management, utilities, access, and civil permitting. The successful candidate will have direct experience coordinating with local AHJs and will help strengthen Ramboll's technical capabilities in one or more strategic U.S. data center markets. To succeed in this role, you should have a bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering and approximately 5+ years of relevant experience.

Are you excited about understanding, interpreting, and navigating complex projects with real-life implications? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature? Are you a curious and open-minded person?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Environment & Health Division as our new Civil Engineer / Senior Civil Engineer – Data Centers and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

You will join Ramboll's Civil Engineering and Design team within the Environment & Health business. The team supports data center, mission-critical, industrial, and other large-scale development programs through site due diligence, conceptual master planning, preliminary engineering, permitting, detailed design, and construction support. You will collaborate with civil engineers, CAD designers, environmental specialists, geotechnical engineers, transportation professionals, utility specialists, and other technical disciplines.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Lead civil engineering and land development services for data center, mission-critical, and large industrial projects from site selection through construction.
• Manage project scope, schedule, budget, staffing, risk, client communication, proposals, and subconsultants across multiple projects.
• Direct technical work including site layout, grading, stormwater, drainage, utilities, access roads, erosion control, and permitting.
• Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams, clients, agencies, and authorities while navigating codes, permitting requirements, and development standards.
• Review technical deliverables, mentor engineers and CAD staff, support team growth, and contribute to client development and market expansion.

About you

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Civil Engineering with approximately 5+ years of relevant civil/site engineering experience.
• Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred, with ability to obtain licensure by comity in target states.
• Extensive experience with land development and site civil design for large, complex projects, ideally in industrial, logistics, manufacturing, or mission-critical environments.
• Strong project management and technical expertise, including grading, drainage, stormwater, utilities, permitting, budgeting, scheduling, and client coordination.
• Experience working with AHJs and leading multidisciplinary teams; familiarity with Civil 3D and permitting practices in Pennsylvania, Washington, Texas, or Louisiana preferred.

Additional skills:

• Strong ownership of project outcomes with a practical, solutions-oriented approach.
• Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues to clients and nontechnical stakeholders.
• Strong commercial judgment and ability to manage scope, schedule, budget, and risk.
• Collaborative leadership style with strong prioritization and mentoring skills.
• Client-focused approach with a commitment to safety, quality, and professional standards.

What we can offer you

• Investment in your development
• Being valued for the unique person you are
• Never being short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
• The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $81,515 - $101,894 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Ready to join us?

Please submit your application with your up-to-date CV. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do.  Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

jobs.title: Store Manager - Cherry Creek
jobs.description:
Position: Store Manager

Internal Deadline to Apply: October 7, 2026

Interview Plan

Ever wondered what it’s like behind the bubbles?  #lushcareers

Lush North America has been creating fresh and handmade cosmetics for the past 20 years- keeping our customers’ bathtubs and showers a little more magical through our retail shops across Canada and the US. We are dedicated to the practices of fair trade sourcing and supporting sustainable communities as well as giving back to organizations that can make a difference.

We Offer:

• A fun and funky store atmosphere where individualism is encouraged

• A 50% discount off all our products to keep you smelling and feeling fresh

• An unconventional retail structure to support your entrepreneurial spirit

• The opportunity for growth as Lush loves to promote from within

Store Manager

As a Lush Store Manager, you're a true leader who embodies our core values in everything you do. Whether you're interacting with customers, motivating your team, or making important business decisions, you always keep the following in mind: Be Real, Be Curious, Lead Fearlessly, Adapt and Evolve, Grow Talent, and Live with Purpose. These are more than just buzzwords to you – they're a way of life.

As the Store Manager, you're responsible for:

• Recruiting your team

• Training and developing your management team

• Training and developing your team on brand, product, and service

You oversee all aspects of the retail business, from managing budgets to exceeding sales targets. But you know that there's more to it than just the numbers – it's also about creating an environment that fosters a strong customer experience, staff experience, and operational excellence. And as you lead your team to greatness, you'll be constantly assessing your own performance and seeking feedback, resources, and opportunities to grow and develop.

Responsibilities:

Sales & Customer  Experience:

• Customer Service: collaborate with your team on plans to exceed daily sales goals and ensure a unique and inclusive customer experience that makes every visitor feel welcome, meets their needs, and makes their day.

• Building the Brand: educate our customers and staff on our brand values, and articulate our position on Fighting Animal Testing, Freshest Cosmetics, Ethical Buying, 100% Vegetarian, Handmade, and Naked Packaging in the shop and through community engagement and other traffic-driving initiatives.

• Product Passion: increase the depth of your product knowledge through constant learning and consistently make informed and product recommendations for every need.

• Driving Sales: demonstrate strong business acumen and understanding of your metrics and reports by developing and executing business plans that align with the American business strategy to achieve both short- and long-term goals that improve KPIs and achieve sales goals.

Team Leadership:

• Leadership Practices and Staff Development: demonstrate the Leadership Practices and coach and develop your team in their careers by creating development plans, encouraging learning through Lush tools, coaching behaviors as they arise, and providing constructive feedback that inspires and motivates.

• Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging: actively committed to maintaining a diverse team and creating an inclusive environment by prioritizing DEIB training and initiatives and actively collaborating with your team on solutions that promote equity and belonging.

• Engagement and Performance: balances analysis, experience, and perspective when making decisions about performance concerns and creates action plans to improve staff engagement, demonstrating empathy and considering personal situations/struggles when approaching performance concerns.

• Recruitment and Selection: forms teams with appropriate and diverse mix of styles, perspectives, and experience and demonstrate equal employment opportunity practices by providing transparency and equity in the interview and promotion process and supporting staff to grow and develop in their retail careers.

Operational Excellence:

• Policies and Procedures: prioritize shop compliance and ensure your staff have completed training and are practicing company standards for time and attendance, breaks and meals, product integrity, respectful workplace, anti-harassment and anti-discrimination guidelines, health and safety protocols, daily communication, all within your budget.

• Stock and Inventory: Ensure your team is trained and equipped to abide by standards and rotation rules and manage ordering to ensure the right products, in the right amounts are in the store at the right times; using inventory reporting tools, create and execute action plans to manage orders, inventory and waste, within your allocated budget.

• Visuals and Merchandising: Create and execute merchandising plans to improve KPIs and train and manage your team to take pride in a clean and beautiful work environment and follow the merchandising and design standards to provide a consistent customer experience and drive sales.

• Scheduling, Time, and Attendance: ensure the right number of staff with the right skill levels are scheduled at peak times and that breaks, and meals are allocated and recorded appropriately to ensure staff wellbeing and payroll accuracy, while staying within your labor budget.

Qualifications:

Required:

• 3-5 years managing in a retail environment.

• Strong HR skills in hiring, scheduling, training, conflict resolution and performance management

• Excellent listening and communication skills

• Excellent analytical, critical thinking and troubleshooting skills.

• Excellent organization and time management skills

• Strong customer service, supervisory and sales skills

• Knowledge and interest in skincare, natural beauty, and ethical business

• Ability to work flexible hours to meet the needs of the shop including holidays, evenings, and weekends.

Preferred:

• Experience with consultation-based customer service models

• Ability to develop and train staff through positive coaching and feedback.

• Strong record of accomplishment of developing retail staff careers.

• Proficient in excel, Microsoft suit, and adaptable to other systems as required.

• Experience in cross cultural collaboration and DEIB or social justice training

• Fluency in Spanish, French, or other languages

At Lush, we believe when we continue to foster a culture of inclusion and respect within a diverse workforce, we are doing our part in building a world where there is equal opportunity for all. We recruit from a variety of employment agencies, community groups, non-profits, and online social and job sites, and in our business practices, strive to leverage the gift that diversity brings.

Lush North America unequivocally supports equal opportunity employment for all applicants regardless of religion, race, color,  gender identity or expression,  sexual orientation, ancestry,  ability, adverse mental health, and other characteristics both defined, protected and enforced by the law under federal or provincial/state jurisdiction.

Cherry Creek Pay

$77,500—$77,500 USD

Best of luck on your job search, and don't forget to follow us to learn more!

We Are Lush

YouTube
LinkedIn

Lush Cosmetics North America respectfully recognizes that our business operates on Indigenous territory across Turtle Island. As a business headquartered in Canada, our largest facilities are located on the unceded territories of the Musqueam, Squamish and Tsleil-Waututh, as well as here on the lands of the Mississaugas of the Credit, Anishnabeg, Chippewa, Haudenosaunee and Wendat, and now home to many diverse First Nations, Inuit and Métis peoples.

Our commitment to reconciliation and decolonization is guided by the Truth and Reconciliation Commission of Canada: Calls to Action #92. We recognize that our facilities, along with our settler and newcomer staff are guests on this land and as we act to repair past harm, we do it together in allyship with Indigenous People everywhere, including staff, customers and with leadership from organizations and communities we work with.

jobs.title: Director, Audit Transformation
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners with AI agents. They are based in San Francisco and have raised over $125M+ in venture funding from top Silicon Valley investors to accomplish their ambitious vision, including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

Fieldguide has become the defining agentic company for CPAs, with more than 50%+ of the top-100 CPA firms as customers, including several Big 4, and an industry-leading NPS to match. They save up to 75% of time on manual tasks and unlock over 4x capacity for audit practitioners, helping provide the work-life balance that is rare in the profession. Fieldguide is on the same growth curve as the later-stage vertical AI leaders, but you would be joining early enough to have a meaningful impact.

Fieldguide values diversity, both in backgrounds and in experiences to help build the future of audit and advisory. They are deliberate in preserving a winning culture with their FFLOWI values - Fearless, Fast, Lovable, Owners, Win-Win, Inclusive - providing space for teammates to do their career’s best work through a tightly-knit support network.

If you want to shape the most important shift in how commerce and capital markets establish trust, alongside world-class teammates, Fieldguide would love to build with you.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Director, Audit Transformation will lead the shift from traditional audit execution to an agentic operating model. Reporting to the Head of Audit, you will set the direction for how financial audit agents are designed, adopted, and scaled across our customer base.

You will serve as the connection point between the Fieldguide agentic platform and the profession it serves. In partnership with product, engineering, sales, and customer success, you will define the scope of the audit expertise behind an agentic operating model rather than layering agents onto legacy processes, including the documentation required to satisfy professional standards and withstand regulatory inspection. With Customer Success, you will establish the change management framework that guides firms from initial adoption through full transformation, built for consistent delivery at scale.

You will also support the Head of Audit on the strategic planning and special initiatives that translate audit strategy into execution and go to market initiatives.

This role calls for a leader with audit credibility earned through leading engagements, shaping methodology, or driving innovation within a leading firm, together with the conviction that professional judgment remains central to the audit. This is an opportunity to define how audit is delivered in the next decade, not to refine how it is delivered today.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

Product Partnership

 - Serve as the audit domain expert in product discovery, prioritization, and roadmap planning for agent-based workflows, translating practitioner and firm needs into product specs

 - Work with AI architects and engineers to translate professional standards and practitioner judgment into the prompts, workflows, and guardrails behind our integrated methodologies and testing agents

 - Determine which procedures are suitable for agent execution, what level of autonomy is appropriate, and how output must be documented to satisfy professional standards and withstand regulatory inspection

 - Pressure-test new agent capabilities with practitioners before they ship, creating a tight feedback loop between the field, Methodology, and Product

Customer Transformation

 - Own, with Customer Success, the transformation motion that guides firms from initial adoption to full agentic audit transformation, including the playbook, maturity model, and program structure behind it

 - Equip Customer Success with the frameworks, content, and training to deliver transformation engagements repeatably and at scale, rather than one-off and bespoke

 - Serve as executive sponsor and audit subject-matter expert on transformation engagements with Fieldguide's most strategic accounts

 - Act as an escalation point on complex methodology and adoption issues

 - Monitor customer health and methodology fit, feeding what you learn back into the product and methodology roadmaps

 - Represent Fieldguide externally through written content, webinars, and speaking engagements such as AICPA ENGAGE and state CPA societies, and through relationships with standard-setters, regulators, and industry analysts

 - Monitor regulatory and standard-setting developments across the PCAOB, AICPA, and SEC, and translate the implications into Fieldguide's product, methodology, and messaging

Go-to-Market Support

 - Partner with Sales and Solutions Engineering on go to market opportunities, leading executive briefings, product demonstrations, and technical validation conversations with firm leadership

 - Represent Fieldguide on customer onsites, building credibility with both firm leadership and technical evaluators

 - Support Sales and Marketing with audit-credible narrative, competitive positioning, and content across top-of-funnel and late-stage deals




ABOUT YOU

 - CPA with 10+ years of financial audit experience at a public accounting firm, including senior leadership, national office, or innovation/transformation exposure, including direct experience with regulatory and standard-setting bodies.

 - Experience designing or scaling a repeatable transformation or change-management program (playbooks, maturity models, training)

 - Strong expertise in auditing standards and audit methodology

 - Experience with audit technology, automation, or AI-enabled tools, audit methodologies, templates, or workpapers.

 - Working knowledge of quality control/quality management standards as they relate to methodology and audit documentation.

 - Ability to translate professional standards into structured workflows and logic

 - Strong analytical thinking and ability to work cross-functionally with product and engineering teams

 - Executive presence and the confidence to lead demos, onsites, and validation sprints directly in front of firm leadership and regulators.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Active involvement with AICPA, state CPA societies, or standard-setting bodies.

 - Experience building or scaling a firm-wide innovation or transformation initiative.

 - Experience working in audit methodology, quality or national office roles.

 - Expertise in international auditing standards and methodologies.

 - Experience with LLM-based or agentic workflows, prompt design, or AI-enabled audit tooling.




MORE ABOUT FIELDGUIDE

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

 - Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

 - Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

 - Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

 - Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

 - Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

 - Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.




SOME OF OUR BENEFITS INCLUDE

 - Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership

 - Flexible PTO

 - 401k

 - Wellness benefits starting on your first day

 - Technology & Work from Home reimbursement

 - Flexible work schedules

US Conec, Ltd. is a trusted, global company that prides itself on engineering excellence—creating innovative connectivity solutions that support today’s most important technologies. We foster a friendly, inclusive culture that values teamwork, creativity, and mutual respect. At US Conec, you’ll find real opportunities to grow and make a meaningful impact in a company that genuinely cares about its people and its customers. With competitive compensation, excellent benefits, and a supportive environment, this is a place where you can build your future—whether your interests lie in manufacturing, engineering, operations, or beyond.

Process Engineer - Fiber Optic Assembly & Termination

Overview

US Conec is seeking a Process Engineer to support the development, qualification, industrialization, and continuous improvement of fiber optic connector assembly and termination processes. This role partners closely with Applications Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, R&D, Product Management, Global Sales, customers, and equipment suppliers to create capable, repeatable, and well-documented manufacturing processes that drive product quality and performance.

Responsibilities

• Develop expertise in fiber optic connector assembly and termination processes, including equipment, materials, process variables, measurement methods, and sources of variation

• Support the development, validation, and industrialization of new and existing manufacturing processes for fiber optic connectivity products

• Design and execute process characterization, verification, validation, and capability studies to ensure process performance and compliance with customer and industry requirements

• Plan and conduct engineering experiments to evaluate process settings, materials, equipment interactions, and manufacturing methods

• Analyze process and product performance data, including insertion loss, return loss, ferrule quality, and end-face geometry, using statistical and engineering methodologies

• Investigate process-related quality issues and support root-cause analysis for manufacturing concerns, qualification failures, and customer-reported issues

• Develop and maintain process maps that identify critical inputs, outputs, controls, measurement points, and opportunities for process improvement

• Perform tolerance analyses to assess the impact of process, equipment, material, and dimensional variation on product quality and optical performance

• Support engineering change management activities for new or modified processes, tooling, equipment, and documentation

• Evaluate fiber optic termination and assembly equipment for capability, repeatability, usability, and compatibility with US Conec products and applications

• Apply knowledge of fiber optic polishing processes to process development, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement initiatives

• Identify opportunities to improve process capability, yield, efficiency, repeatability, and robustness across manufacturing operations

• Create and maintain process instructions, equipment guides, best-practice documentation, engineering reports, test plans, and technical recommendations

• Provide process-focused technical support to internal teams and customers requiring detailed analysis, troubleshooting, and engineering expertise

• Collaborate with customers, suppliers, and external partners to investigate process performance and translate field observations into process improvements

• Maintain project schedules, communicate progress, and provide regular updates to stakeholders

• Present technical findings, recommendations, and conclusions to both technical and non-technical audiences

• Represent US Conec in customer meetings, supplier discussions, industry organizations, conferences, webinars, and technical forums as needed

Must Haves

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related engineering discipline

• 2-5 years of engineering experience in fiber optics, connector technology, precision manufacturing, process engineering, connectivity, cable manufacturing, or a related technical industry

• Strong understanding of process development, validation, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement methodologies

• Experience designing experiments, collecting data, analyzing results, and making data-driven recommendations

• Knowledge of process capability, engineering statistics, measurement systems, and root-cause analysis techniques

• Ability to analyze manufacturing and product performance data to drive process improvements and resolve technical issues

• Understanding of manufacturing processes, process mapping, process controls, and sources of variation

• Experience reading and interpreting engineering drawings, specifications, tolerances, work instructions, and technical standards

• Strong technical writing skills with the ability to create process documentation, reports, test plans, and work instructions

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate complex technical information clearly

• Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment

• Demonstrated problem-solving skills and a hands-on engineering mindset

• Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required

Nice to Haves

• Experience with optical fiber termination, connector assembly, or fiber optic connectivity products

• Knowledge of fiber optic polishing processes, equipment, and associated quality measurements

• Experience with insertion loss, return loss, end-face geometry, ferrule inspection, or related optical performance metrics

• Proficiency with statistical and data analysis tools such as JMP, Minitab, or MATLAB

• Experience evaluating manufacturing equipment, tooling, and automation solutions

• Exposure to engineering change management and product industrialization programs

• Experience working directly with customers, equipment suppliers, or contract manufacturing partners

• Familiarity with ERP systems, process mapping software, and engineering collaboration tools

• Knowledge of telecommunications, data center, broadband, or optical networking technologies

What We Offer

• Competitive salary with performance-based bonus potential

• 4 weeks of PTO plus paid holidays

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

• 401(k) with employer match

• A collaborative culture focused on innovation and continuous improvement

• Opportunities for career growth within a global technology leader

US Conec will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

Join US Conec today and be part of a team that values each other, promotes innovation and growth, and strives to exceed customer expectations in everything we do.

US Conec is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics

jobs.title: Senior Privacy Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-duckduckgo-for-mac/, Windows https://spreadprivacy.com/windows-browser-open-beta/, iOS https://spreadprivacy.com/duckduckgo-privacy-browser-ios14/, and Android https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-app-tracking-protection/, our search engine https://duckduckgo.com/, and the DuckDuckGo subscription https://duckduckgo.com/pro. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai https://duck.ai/, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-work of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!




YOUR TEAM AND ROLE

Working on the Privacy Functional Team, you'll lead complex projects across key company-wide objectives. You'll protect the privacy of our users using Go, Node.js, Python, and (sometimes) Perl to write pragmatic, performant, testable code, and work on related projects. Potential projects include:

 - Designing systems for improving our search indexes and AI features without compromising user privacy

 - Building new features on top of our Tracker Radar https://spreadprivacy.com/duckduckgo-tracker-radar/ crawler to detect emerging privacy threats

 - Implementing new privacy features and maintaining existing ones, such as our Web Tracking https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/privacy/web-tracking-protections and Email https://duckduckgo.com/duckduckgo-help-pages/email-protection/privacy Protections

 

As a Senior Privacy Engineer, you'll own major components of our privacy technology, taking responsibility for their maintenance and improvement over time. A key part of the role will also be participation in our privacy review and audit processes, ensuring that all product developments align with our privacy principles. In time, you'll formally mentor other engineers, supporting their career growth and the growth of the Privacy Team at DuckDuckGo.




ABOUT YOU

 - Ability to lead and collaborate on high-impact and complex projects from proposal through post-mortem.

 - Skills to wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them effectively, involving others when necessary.

 - Experience working on privacy solutions in an engineering capacity (e.g. tracker blocker, differential privacy, or similar technology).

 - Deep technical understanding of online privacy threats and the existing solution space to protect against them.

 - Proficiency in any of the following: Go, Node.js, Python, Perl.

 - Excellent communication skills. You can validate your decisions and communicate them clearly to a variety of audiences, including non-technical stakeholders. 




COMPENSATION 

$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide https://duckduckgo.com/assets/hiring/team_support_guide.pdf explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.




HIRING PROCESS 

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-hire.




DIVERSITY, EQUITY AND INCLUSION 

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.



We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to careers@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request.




PLEASE NOTE THAT: 

 - You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

 - Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

 - While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

 - A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.

 - By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.



Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process

As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.



Key Principles:

 - Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy https://duckduckgo.com/static-assets/files/pages/careers/DuckDuckGo-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-effective-September-30-2025.pdf. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.

 - Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.
   
   

By submitting your application, you acknowledge and consent to the use of AI technology in our review process. If you would like to request an alternative selection process, please contact us as at careers@duckduckgo.com. Thank you for your interest in joining DuckDuckGo!

jobs.description:

The Recruiter supports recruiting operations and a broad mix of technical, professional, field, and corporate positions across the company. This person will be a trusted partner to hiring managers, a thoughtful advocate for candidates, and an active contributor to a recruiting function that is becoming more scalable, strategic, and data-driven.

What You’ll Do

• Proactively source and engage qualified candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter, Greenhouse, networking, referrals, and other creative sourcing channels.

What We’re Looking For

• Demonstrated success proactively sourcing passive candidates and building pipelines—not simply managing applicants.

• Strong consultative skills and the ability to build credibility with hiring managers at all levels.

• Comfortable using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools to identify and engage talent.

Why Join EnSafe?

• A Culture of Freedom & Ownership At EnSafe, our career philosophy is built on freedom. The freedom to take initiative, achieve your goals, and shape your own career path Employees are encouraged to pursue growth in a flexible, entrepreneurial environment.

jobs.title: Director, OT/IoT Security Services- Remote (Anywhere in the U.S.)
jobs.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

The systems our OT clients run treat drinking water, move natural gas, run production lines, and keep hospital equipment working. Many were installed before anyone thought about attackers, and plenty still run software the vendor stopped supporting years ago. You can't take a refinery controller offline on a Tuesday afternoon to patch it, and you can't reboot a substation to check whether a fix worked. This work needs people who understand the physical process as well as the network, and we've built a team of them. When we do it well, nobody outside the plant ever hears about it. GuidePoint Security is hiring a Director, OT/IoT Security Services to lead that team.

You'll report to the SVP of Offensive Security and own the practice: the team, the service catalog, delivery quality, and the P&L. The delivery managers already run day-to-day projects well, so expect to spend most of your time with engineers and clients, and to be the senior escalation point when a technical or client issue gets complicated. The rest goes to supporting regional sales teams, other GuidePoint Security practices, and technology partners.

In this practice, "Wow Them" means an account executive gets a scope and price back quickly, our engineers work safely on a running plant floor, and the client calls us for their next site.

About the OT/IoT Security Services Practice

The OT/IoT Security Services practice protects the industrial systems our clients depend on in energy, water, manufacturing, healthcare, transportation, and other critical infrastructure sectors. We deliver in every GuidePoint Security region and provide the services behind GuidePoint Security's OT technology partnerships.

Most of the team came to security from the plant floor or the military: veterans and former engineers from utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, and nuclear power. They know what an operator is thinking when a consultant walks into the control room with a laptop, and safety and uptime come first on every job.

A typical client relationship starts with finding out what's actually on the OT network and where it's exposed. From there we design segmentation and controls that don't interrupt operations, and many clients stay with us for ongoing OT vulnerability management. The work in between includes OT risk assessments against ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, NERC CIP, and the TSA security directives; OT penetration tests scoped for live environments; and deployment and tuning of OT visibility and secure remote access platforms.

OT has problems you won't find in IT security, like hunting for an attacker on a network that can't handle an active scan, or explaining a firewall change to someone who has to keep a turbine running. Every site is different, and that's a big part of why we stay.

What sets the practice apart

• A multi-vendor OT lab with PLC hardware and several visibility and remote access platforms, so clients can compare them side by side before buying

• Vendor-objective advice. We work with many platforms and can tell a client which one fits their environment

• A fast-growing OT practice on track to become one of GuidePoint Security's top practices, with leadership support and the autonomy to shape the service catalog, lab, and team

Roles and Responsibilities

• Lead and grow the OT team of managers, engineers, and operations staff while fostering an environment that supports long-term retention. Meet regularly one-on-one with your managers, spend time with the engineers, and stay close enough to active engagements that problems come up early instead of at closeout. Adapt the team structure as the practice scales, guided by input from those performing the work.

• Build a mentorship program that pairs experienced OT engineers with those who are new to OT or to client-facing services delivery, and define clear career and certification paths. Give engineers supported time in client conversations before asking them to lead one.

• Standardize how the practice runs: shared templates, delivery playbooks, and a clear path from scoping through closeout for each service, building on what the team already has.

• Refine the delivery methods the team already uses: OT-safe rules of engagement, passive-first testing, quality review, and coordination with plant operations around change and outage windows.

• Own the practice's financials, including bookings, revenue, delivery margin, utilization, and operating cost. Produce a monthly forecast leadership can plan on, and plan staffing and capacity so the team can take on new work without burning out.

• Support a growing service catalog: OT assessments (ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, NERC CIP, TSA security directives), architecture and segmentation, OT penetration testing, platform implementation and tuning, managed OT vulnerability services, and IoT security services.

• Make our deployment and operations services the obvious add-on when a client buys an OT platform. Work with technology partners to define a services path for each platform, and report results to clients in terms they can check: assets covered, detections tuned, alerts reviewed, vulnerabilities fixed.

• Support regional sales leaders and account executives on OT opportunities. Turn scoping requests around quickly, help qualify and price deals, and work on key pursuits and RFPs. The account executive owns the client relationship. Your job is to make bringing in the OT team simple for them.

• Manage the OT lab. Work with leadership and partners to keep it current, use it for training and presales, and set up a model for charging for workshops and demos.

• Represent the practice in the OT security community through select speaking, writing, and standards work, while keeping your focus on the team and clients.

Required Experience and Education

• BS/BA + 7 -10 years of experience OR MS/MA + 5-12 years of experience

• 5+ years leading people managers on OT/IoT security delivery or consulting teams, including coaching managers as they grow leaders of their own, with accountability for bookings, margin, or utilization

• Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

• Experience developing engineers into consultants, presales contributors, or leaders

• CISSP, GICSP, or GRID, or equivalent experience

Preferred Experience and Education

You don't need all of these. If you have most of them, or comparable experience, we'd like to hear from you.

• A recognized presence in the OT/ICS security community, for example speaking at industry events or contributing to standards and research, and a track record peers, partners, and clients can vouch for

• Hands-on work in industrial environments (ICS, SCADA, DCS, PLCs, safety systems, industrial protocols) as an engineer, operator, integrator, or consultant in utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing, nuclear, transportation, healthcare, or the military

• Working knowledge of OT frameworks or regulations, such as ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800-82, NERC CIP, or the TSA security directives, and the ability to explain it to both a CISO and a plant manager

• Experience deploying or tuning OT visibility platforms and working with technology partners

• Experience turning custom engagements into standard, priced services that a larger sales team sold regularly

• Additional certifications such as GCIP, ISA/IEC 62443, or CISM

Travel Requirements

• Up to 30% travel to client industrial sites, regional sales teams, and occasional industry events

Physical Requirements

• Sedentary work

• Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day

• Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day

• Occasional travel to client industrial sites, which may involve walking plant floors and entering operational areas, and to conferences that involve prolonged standing or walking

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity.

This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.

Some added perks….

• Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions)

• Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options)

• Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans

• 12 corporate holidays and a Flexible Time Off (FTO) program

• Healthy mobile phone and home internet allowance

• Eligibility for retirement plan after 2 months at open enrollment

• Pet Benefit Option

jobs.title: Sr. Statistician, Client Intelligence
jobs.description:
Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.

This role can be filled in the Northeast (New York, NJ, Philadelphia, Boston), our San Francisco headquarters, OR other remote locations in the U.S.

As a Senior Statistician, you’ll work within a cross-functional team alongside other analysts, data-scientists, engineers, and commercial stakeholders in generating actionable insights to help improve healthcare.

How you’ll make an impact:

• Take ownership and evolve our existing program impact measurement capabilities, built in-house and in partnership with third-party experts such as IQVIA.

• Develop and maintain analytically rigorous program performance benchmarks.

• Discuss standard and bespoke measurement methodologies with clients during pre-sale and present analysis results to brand marketing team as well as client analytics team

• Mentor and help Business Analytics Managers with interpreting measurement results, identifying actionable insights and preparing for client discussions leading to increased sale and renewals

• Serve as statistical consultant and provide guidance to Data-Science team for advanced modeling

• Help implement and scale survey / market research based measurement capabilities

• Manage vendor relationships for third party data procurement.

The Core Values of the Client Intelligence team

As an organization we value diversity - in backgrounds and in experiences. Healthcare is a universal concern, and we need people from all backgrounds to help build a better future for all. Below are additional core values specific to the Insights Team.

• Collaboration—The best candidates and teammates are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

• Passion for Data—You’re going to help our clients and team members with data-driven decision making. We need someone that can manipulate millions of rows of data and also ask the right questions to find the important insights.

• Reliability – Our team is efficient, flexible, and agile only because we trust the reliability of each member. We need self-starters and goal-oriented individuals for our continued success.

• Curiosity – Continuous learning is a cornerstone at Doximity, and curious individuals thrive in our environment. We’re looking for someone who is curious enough about data to go above-and-beyond the task for the true insight.

• Respect – A key dynamic that allows our team to flourish is respect: for ourselves and our quality of work, for our teammates, and for our internal clients who are under the pressure of deadlines and finance goals.

About you:

• 10+ years of professional experience in a quantitative or statistical role (e.g., statistician, biostatistician), within healthcare, pharma, or a related industry.

• Hands on experience with statistical methodologies and techniques such as test-vs-control study designs, covariate adjustment methods (e.g., ANCOVA), clustering, etc.

• Strong context into HCP prescription and claims data, including how they're recorded and tracked by data vendors, what they represent, and typical data gaps.

• Advanced SQL and python proficiency including writing complex queries across multiple tables and familiarity with data science libraries

• Experience working with third party analytics vendors such as IQVIA, including running independent studies, engaging in RFPs and contract discussions, and maintaining relationships.

• Experience applying data science techniques such as clustering and machine learning to sponsored engagement, using Rx and Dx data to measure impact.

• Experience representing yourself externally and leading client conversations around program performance analysis.

Fun Facts About the Client Intelligence team

• We have access to one of the richest healthcare datasets in the world, with deep information on hundreds of thousands of clinicians and their connections.

• Business decisions at Doximity are driven by our data, analyses, and insights.

• The members of our team bring a diverse set of technical and cultural backgrounds.

• We like to have fun - company outings, team lunches, and other social events!

Compensation

The anticipated total compensation for this role is $151,000 - $207,000, depending on factors such as experience, skills, location, and internal equity. Our total compensation package may include:

• Equity (where applicable)
