jobs.title: Emergency Veterinarian (Relief) - Paramus, NJ
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a per diem Emergency Veterinarian, you’re more than just passionate about helping people and their pets; you thrive on it, especially when they need you most. At VEG, we find a way to say yes to supporting you, so you can be the best, most confident ER professional possible and grow your career in unexpected directions. With a culture rooted in mentorship and continuous learning—from on-the-floor guidance to VEG Education programs and unlimited ER-focused CE—you’ll never stop learning. You’ll handle any emergency that comes through the door, from routine cases to complex surgeries, and treat every kind of pet, including exotics! As a leader on the hospital floor, you’ll have the chance to be a superhero for your customers, backed by a team and resources that empower you to take your career further than you ever imagined.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Answer medical questions over the phone

• See patients right away as part of the VEG Triage and VEG Spikes, our unique, customer-centered way of doing things—like ensuring people see a doctor right away and allowing families to stay with their pets

• Gather the signalment, presenting complaint, vitals, and physical exam

• Conduct physical examinations of animals, along with other required investigatory measures such as ultrasounds, X-rays, bloodwork, and biopsies

• Complete a diagnosis of each pet's condition to create a diagnostic and therapeutic plan

• Communicate diagnosis and treatment options directly with customers

• Prepare estimates and present them to customers

• Create and review medical records to ensure accuracy

• Demonstrate the value of tests and treatments performed by speaking with the customer and addressing their concerns

• Perform minor and major emergency surgeries

• Perform endoscopic procedures

• Educate customers on after care and preventative measures where appropriate

WHAT YOU NEED

• A DVM or equivalent degree

• Live and breathe emergency medicine, including emergency surgery (the soft tissue kind!) and endoscopy

• Thrive in team-oriented environments (think hospital retreats, team dinners, happy hours, and more)

• Ability to stand for prolonged hours, kneel, and work on the floor as well as ability to lift up to 25 kg on own and able to support up to 40 kg with assistance

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous referral reward program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Meta AI
jobs.description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is a leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. You will be an essential part of a high powered team that keeps all of this running smoothly – helping millions of people find the best hotels and the best ways to fly from A to B every day!

This role requires commuting to the Concord, MA office 3 times a week.

 


IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Design, implement and maintain reliable production software for KAYAK’s travel-search and trip-planning experiences.

 - Build and evolve APIs and services supporting AI-assisted search, conversational travel planning, itineraries and related user experiences.

 - Investigate technical problems, assess trade-offs and choose practical solutions that improve reliability, performance and maintainability.

 - Help make AI-assisted features dependable, transparent and useful to travelers.

 - Learn unfamiliar systems and share knowledge with teammates through documentation, pairing and technical discussions.

 - Monitor and improve production behavior through effective debugging, observability and root-cause analysis.

 - Contribute to the evolution of development tools, engineering processes and delivery practices.

 


PLEASE APPLY IF YOU HAVE:

 - Experience building and maintaining production software.

 - Proficiency in Java or another relevant programming language.

 - Familiarity with APIs, data structures and software-design principles.

 - Experience testing software and investigating defects or production issues.

 - The ability to explain technical decisions clearly in writing and conversation.

 - The ability to take ownership of assigned work while asking for input or support when needed.

 - Experience contributing to projects from design through implementation, release and maintenance.

 - Equivalent practical experience is welcome in place of a specific degree or educational path.


THE FOLLOWING WILL HELP YOU STAND OUT:

 - Experience with distributed systems, search, personalization or other high-volume consumer products.

 - Experience with AI, machine learning or large language model applications.

 - Experience with relational databases or other structured data stores.

 - Experience working on web products, mobile products or travel-related products.

 - Experience improving accessibility, reliability or usability.

 - Experience working with Java and Spring.

 - Experience with cloud services, CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks.

 


BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

 - Focus on mental health and well-being:
   
   - Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth
   
   - Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace
   
   - Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)
   
   - No meeting Fridays
   
   - Paid parental leave
   
   - Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday
   
   - Paid volunteer time

 - Focus on your career growth:
   
   - Development Dollars
   
   - Leadership development
   
   - Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

 - Travel Discounts

 - Employee Resource Groups

 - Competitive retirement and health plans

 - Free lunch 2 days per week

 - Fun quarterly events such as boat trips, arcades, ski trips, Thursday happy hours, and more

jobs.description:
About Formlabs:

Do you want to change how the world creates?

At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.

We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.

Electrical engineering at Formlabs bridges the gap between the analog and digital worlds. If you love to design and build boards from the ground up, develop firmware to control complex electromechanical systems, and produce elegant solutions to real-world problems, we want you as an Electrical Engineer.

You are highly encouraged to share an example of your work that demonstrates your skills and experience.

The Job:

• Design and build prototypes and production electronic systems, including circuit design, PCB layout, embedded firmware development, bring up and validation

• Own projects, not skills -- this role is for a “full-stack” engineer with a focus on shipping products, not a specialist in any one area of electronics engineering

• Go beyond the board -- be responsible for the design of subsystems such as sensors, actuators, and optoelectronics that require tradeoffs between electrical and mechanical requirements

• Back up your design decisions with data gathered through simulations and experiments

• Hone your skills and grow: engineers at Formlabs have grown into deep technical experts, system architects, product technical leads, and team leaders / managers. We support talented people growing in any direction.

You:

• Have a minimum of 2 years of experience designing and debugging electronics that have gone into products

• Are an electrical engineering generalist, comfortable with analog and digital design, PCB layout, validation, and debugging techniques

• Are comfortable working with electronics that interact with the physical world -- our most complex problems tend to involve the integration of electronics, mechanical designs, and software.

• Are hands-on and interested in supporting your designs throughout the product life cycle, from early research to debugging field failures

Bonus Skills:

• Familiarity with embedded software development, for example: microcontroller firmware developed in C or C++, device drivers or board support packages for embedded Linux systems, or C++ application development. Hardware design is a core part of our team’s responsibilities, but we also extend into low-level software development when knowledge of the physical system is key to writing the best code.

Our Benefits & Perks:

• Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs

• Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

• Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits

• Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats

• Regular sponsored professional development opportunities

• Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community

• And of course… unlimited 3D prints

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

Equity will be a significant portion of your total compensation, and will increase over time in proportion to your impact. jobs.title: Head of Payroll & Equity
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced leader to oversee Anthropic's global equity administration and payroll operations. In this role, you will lead the teams responsible for our equity compensation administration programs and global payroll operations, ensuring both functions scale accurately, compliantly, and efficiently as we grow — including through listing readiness and public-company operations. You will manage senior functional leaders across equity and payroll, and partner closely with Legal, Tax, HR, and the broader Accounting organization to support our mission to make AI beneficial for humanity.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Lead and develop the equity administration and payroll teams, setting strategy, priorities, and operating cadence across both functions

• Own the control environment for equity and payroll: design and document to public-company standards.

• Oversee scaling to public-company standards across both functions.

• Drive systems strategy across the compensation platforms, from equity to payroll, and surrounding integrations, ensuring a coherent architecture as we scale

• Serve as the primary escalation point and executive interface for equity and payroll matters with Legal, Tax, HR, and external providers

• Oversee international expansion of both functions, including new-country payroll setup, cross-border equity compliance, and mobility programs

• Partner with Accounting on stock-based compensation and payroll accounting, ensuring clean handoffs for close, reporting, and audit

• Drive automation and continuous improvement of manual processes across both teams through technology solutions

• Build headcount and resourcing plans that scale with the business

YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

• Have 15+ years across equity compensation and/or payroll operations, with significant experience leading senior functional leaders

• Have operated equity and payroll functions to a public company standard.

• Have deep familiarity with equity management platforms (such as Shareworks or E*TRADE) and Workday payroll, with experience owning cross-system architecture

• Have built and scaled global operations across multiple jurisdictions

• Are a strong people leader who develops senior functional experts

• Thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and default to building scalable processes over adding headcount

STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO

• Hold CEP (Certified Equity Professional) or CPP (Certified Payroll Professional) certification

• Have experience with international mobility programs, worker secondments, and cross-border tax considerations

• Have led complex system implementations or migrations at scale

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$570,000—$610,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description:
We are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our team as Behavior Technicians. As a Behavior Technician, you will have the opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of children with autism.

In this role, you will work one-on-one with children, implementing individualized behavior intervention plans under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA). You will use evidence-based techniques to teach communication, social, and daily living skills while reducing interfering behaviors.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about helping children with autism reach their full potential. You will need to be patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team environment. We will provide comprehensive training so that you are equipped and empowered to help each child, even if you don’t currently have experience. Children can be unpredictable and potentially confrontational, so this role is not for the weak of spirit, mind, or body. Part of the joy of working with kids is exercise! Our clients move, so you need to be comfortable standing, walking, sitting, grasping, reaching, bending, kneeling, crouching, squatting, lifting, and at times carrying children or objects that weigh up to 50 pounds.

At the end of each day, you will go home knowing that you have made a meaningful impact on the life of a child and their family. Join us and become a part of a dedicated team that is changing lives for the better. Apply now to start your journey as a Behavior Technician with us!

• Passionate about helping children with autism

Our clients move, so you need to be comfortable standing, walking, sitting, grasping, reaching, bending, kneeling, crouching, squatting, lifting, and at times carrying children or objects that weigh up to 50 pounds.

At the end of each day, you will go home knowing that you have made a meaningful impact on the life of a child and their family. Join us and become a part of a dedicated team that is changing lives for the better. Apply now to start your journey as a Behavior Technician with us!

• Patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team

• 18+ years of age

• High school diploma or GED

• Ability to obtain a CPR, First Aid Certification and Tuberculosis test (if you haven’t had one in the last year)

• Ability to pass a pre employment background check

• Ability to move in various positions (sit, squat, bend, etc.)

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds

Perks of Working at Centria:

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
jobs.description:
About Formlabs:

Do you want to change how the world creates?

At Formlabs, we’re building the tools that make it possible for anyone to bring their ideas to life, from cutting-edge products to life-saving medical devices. Our 3D printing technology powers innovation at more than 50,000 industry leaders worldwide, including Apple, Google, Tesla, New Balance, and NASA. Together, we’re helping everyone design, prototype, and manufacture faster than ever before.

We’re a team of hands-on builders, engineers, and innovators reinventing how the world makes physical things. If you’re ready to shape the future of fabrication, come build it with us.

Electrical engineering at Formlabs bridges the gap between the analog and digital worlds. If you love to design and build boards from the ground up, develop firmware to control complex electromechanical systems, and produce elegant solutions to real-world problems, we want you as a Senior Electrical Engineer.

The Job:

• Design and build prototypes and production electronic systems, including circuit design, PCB layout, embedded firmware development, bring up and validation

• Design sensing and motion systems from scratch when off the shelf options have been proven unsuitable

• Apply a scientific approach to engineering design problems by creating experiments, collecting and analyzing data, and making informed decisions

• Grow into owning system-level architecture and mentoring other engineers

You:

• Have a minimum of 3 years of experience designing production-ready electronics

• Can share a portfolio that demonstrates your skills and experience

• Are able to support your design choices with data

• Are comfortable with code as well as with circuits: electrical engineers at Formlabs often get involved with bare-metal microcontroller firmware, embedded Linux, Python tooling development, and other software-related tasks

• Are hands-on and interested in supporting your designs throughout the product lifecycle, from early research to debugging field failures

Bonus Skills:

• Experience with line-voltage or high-power electronics

• Experience with signal processing and/or digital feedback control systems

• Experience debugging signal integrity and EMC issues

Our Perks & Benefits:

• Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs

• Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)

• 401K matching and access to financial advisors

• Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks)

• Tenure-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks)

• Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it

• Ample on-site parking & pre-tax commuter benefits

• Healthy on-site lunches, snacks, beverages, & treats

• Regular sponsored professional development opportunities

• Many opt-in culture events across our diverse community

• And of course… unlimited 3D prints

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.  We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Even if you don't check every box, but see yourself contributing, please apply. Help us build an inclusive community that will change the face of 3D printing.

Compensation

Every Formlabs employee receives equity because everyone contributes to building the company. You’ll have the opportunity to share financially in the value we create together, with a shared incentive to build a business that succeeds over the long term. Equity will be a significant portion of your total compensation, and will increase over time in proportion to your impact. The base pay will be determined by your skills, qualifications, experience, location, and expected impact on the organization.

The annual base pay range for this role is:

$125,000—$200,000 USD

jobs.title: Transit Safety Manager
jobs.description:
Via is using technology to transform transportation around the world. From changing a single person’s daily commute to reducing humanity’s collective environmental footprint — we’ve got huge goals.

Via has partnered with 100+ cities and public transit agencies around the world to deploy our mobility technology. As the Transit Safety Manager, you will oversee driver safety programs, lead in-person and virtual training, and support market operations to ensure our drivers meet the highest standards of safety and service.

What You’ll Do:

• Serve as the primary safety lead for the service - conducting post-incident reviews, safety audits, and ride-alongs to ensure compliance with company and regulatory standards.

• Monitor trends in safety data and collaborate with central operations to identify opportunities for proactive coaching or process improvements.

• Support and occasionally act as the Designated Employer Representative (DER) for DOT compliance, ensuring accurate recordkeeping and timely follow-up on testing or incidents.

• Lead root cause analyses for accidents and incidents and develop corrective action plans.

• Design, deliver, and continually improve driver training programs - including onboarding, remedial, and refresher sessions - with a strong focus on safety, defensive driving, and passenger assistance.

• Defensive Driving

• Serve as a visible leader across markets - fostering a culture of safety, accountability, and support.

• Partner with operations, safety, and compliance teams to align local practices with company-wide goals.

• Assist in driver scheduling for trainings and ensure operational readiness.

• Support reporting and communication between field teams and central operations

Who You Are:

• 3+ years of experience in driver training, operations management, or field supervision, preferably in fixed route and paratransit settings.

• Proven ability to coach, motivate, and manage performance among diverse driver teams.

• Strong understanding of safety protocols, ADA requirements, and DOT regulations.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; able to train and inspire adult learners.

• Comfort balancing field work with administrative and compliance tasks.

• Proficiency with digital tools (LMS platforms, dashboards, spreadsheets, etc)

• PASS (Passenger Assistance Safety and Sensitivity)

• Final salary will be determined based on experience, knowledge, and skills.

• Comprehensive benefits package, including medical coverage, paid time off, and 401(k) matching.

• Opportunities for certification, advancement, and leadership development.

Ready to join the ride?

Via is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description:
About the Organization

Short Summary

Pursuit is a pioneering AI-native organization building the nation's premier tech workforce pipeline to unlock lasting economic mobility for low-income and underrepresented communities.

Long Summary

For over a decade, Pursuit has unlocked economic mobility by propelling thousands of adults from low-income backgrounds into high-wage tech careers, taking average starting incomes from $17K to $94K and generating nearly $1B in lifetime wage gains. We've also pioneered the Pursuit Bond, an innovative outcomes-based financing model that aligns investor returns with long-term economic mobility, allowing us to scale impact in a financially sustainable way.

Now, as AI reshapes the global economy, Pursuit is pioneering the nation's premier AI-Native workforce pipeline. We are transforming how economic opportunity works at scale through a rigorous, full-funnel training model combining in-person collaborative learning, real-time curriculum adaptation, and deep employer integration.

Powered by $20M in scale funding from organizations like Google, Anthropic, Adobe, Blackstone, Robin Hood and others, Pursuit is building a roadmap of growth to directly train thousands of more Americans and to build enduring workforce training solutions that can support the ecosystem at large.

About the Position

What You'll Do

As Pursuit scales its AI-Native workforce model and launches in early 2027 the New York AI Jobs Institute (AIJI)—our new premier NYC institute backed by $13M in public funding to unite leaders across government, industry, and education to train millions of residents for AI careers—we are strengthening our operational infrastructure to match our accelerating impact. We are seeking a Chief Operating Officer (COO) to serve as our chief architect of operational excellence. Reporting directly to the CEO, this leader will be a central pillar of the executive leadership team, driving strategic decision-making and actively shaping the future of Pursuit's training programs and job placement initiatives. While managing the finance, operations, and people functions, they will architect the foundational systems required to scale our mission and impact.

Beyond executive strategy, as a true strategic partner to the CEO, the COO will translate organizational vision into high-performing infrastructure—architecting the KPIs, dashboards, and organizational systems that power our next phase of scale.. More than building systems, they will cultivate a culture of accountability and high performance, aligning elite teams around shared standards while fiercely protecting the values that brought us here. This is a rare opportunity for a transformative leader to elevate an organization at a defining inflection point.

Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Organizational Leadership and Performance Excellence

• Serve as key organizational leader who helps lead strategic decisions and embeds operational rigor and accelerates enterprise-wide execution across all functions and in particular, Program, Go-To-Market Job Placement, Partnerships, Growth and Earned Revenue .

• Serve as the executive architect of organizational performance, establishing the enterprise metrics, dashboards, and analytical systems that guide executive decision-making and Board governance.

• Design and maintain the dashboards and KPI architecture that give the CEO, leadership team, and Board a real-time, accurate view of organizational health.

• Spearhead the optimization of Pursuit's internal infrastructure, scaling the tools, workflows, and AI-native processes necessary for rapid, sustainable growth

• Establish robust performance management systems and accountability structures that empower elite teams to excel.

Organizational Design & Scale

• Architect Pursuit's evolving organizational structure, designing reporting lines and team topologies intentionally aligned with our forward-looking strategy rather than historical growth.

• Partner with the CEO and other leaders on enterprise-wide workforce planning, capacity building, and talent scaling.

• Establish robust change management strategies and cross-functional collaboration frameworks to ensure seamless organizational transitions as Pursuit scales its impact.

Business Operations

• Exercise executive ownership over all business operations, unifying finance, HR, talent, culture, and core organizational workflows into a seamlessly integrated operational backbone.

• Provide direct managerial leadership and oversight to the VP of Finance and VP of People, guiding their strategic direction and aligning team priorities with enterprise goals.

• Drive financial leadership in partnership with the VP of Finance, overseeing multi-year budgeting, resource allocation, financial modeling, and sound fiscal governance across all departments.

• Champion talent acquisition, HR infrastructure, and human capital strategy alongside the VP of People to attract, retain, and develop world-class teams.

• Cultivate and safeguard Pursuit's organizational culture, fostering an environment of accountability, continuous learning, high performance, and mission alignment.

• Oversee core operational processes, facilities management, internal systems, and revenue collections (including the Pursuit Bond) to scale efficiency as the organization grows.

Who You'll Work With
You will report to the Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the executive team you will be a key strategic shaper of the future and optimization of every function at Pursuit — Program, Go-To-Market Job Placement, Partnerships, Growth and Earned Revenue. You will directly manage the VP of Finance, VP of People, General Counsel, Head of AI implementation, Head of Facilities and Operations and more.

Required Skills and Experience

• 8–12 years of experience in business operations or leadership operations roles, ideally spanning both a strategy/consulting environment and a hands-on operating role inside a growing company or organization.

• Previous consultative experience (e.g., management consulting or a similar advisory background), paired with real experience actually running operations, not just advising on them.

• Exceptional analytical and strategic thinking skills with experience leading or partnering closely with strategic finance functions

• A history of cultivating elite teams and establishing high-performance standards amidst rapid organizational scaling.

• Demonstrated success and track-record in architecting robust operational systems, processes, and infrastructure that drive enterprise-wide execution and long-term quality.

• Extensive experience designing and governing executive-level KPI frameworks, real-time dashboards, and strategic reporting systems for complex, fast-growing organizations.

• Deep expertise in organizational design, structural transformation, and team topology scaling to align operational architecture with long-term enterprise strategy.

• Experience building or running business operations and HR/People systems and practices at scale.

• High tolerance for ambiguity and bias toward building, comfortable creating structure where none exists yet.

• Deeply motivated by Pursuit's mission of economic transformation and expanded opportunity for low-income and underrepresented communities.

• MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.

Compensation
The salary range for this role is $300,000 - $330,000, inclusive of base and bonus and a full benefits package.

The compensation above reflects the expectations laid out in this job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this posting. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated to you as a candidate.

Additional Details

Location and Work Environment

This role is based in NYC. Pursuit currently operates on a hybrid schedule, Tuesday through Thursday on-site at our office in New York City,, with a Monday/Friday work-from-anywhere policy.

Benefits

• Full benefits package including vision and dental

• Unlimited PTO, plus an all-Pursuit summer break (last week of August) and a week-long holiday break (last week of December)

• 401k match

• Hybrid and flexible work policy, as described above

• Dedicated time to build in AI and develop your own AI skills

Equity at Pursuit

We prioritize the richness of diversity across all categories. We welcome new perspectives and make employment decisions without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, familial or marital status, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. Pursuit is an equal-opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Mental Health Therapist, 1099 - Pennsylvania (In-Person, Philadelphia Area)
jobs.description:
About the Company:

Octave is a modern behavioral health practice creating a new standard for care delivery that’s both high-quality and accessible. With in-person and virtual clinics in multiple states, the company offers evidence-based individual, couples, and family therapy, while pioneering relationships with payers to make care more affordable through insurance. By raising the bar on how care is delivered and how providers are supported, we are building a sustainable system that values equity, affordability, and effectiveness.

About the Role:

Octave is hiring Licensed Clinicians to work within an organizational structure to provide high-quality behavioral health care to our clients. Octave Clinicians will join a diverse clinical team in providing therapy in a collaborative, client-centered, evolving environment. Octave Clinicians demonstrate strong clinical service thinking, informed by evidence-informed therapies. It is our effort to drive quality access and customize mental health treatment plans and service delivery for our clients. You will treat adult clients with stress, depression, anxiety, or other mental health concerns via video, using short-term, evidence-based therapies. Candidates must be licensed in Pennsylvania at the master's or doctoral level, well-versed in evidence-based therapies, like CBT or DBT, and an expert in the delivery of culturally responsive care.

We are seeking out Licensed Clinicians who are willing to work both in-person and remotely, but an office space is required to start. As a Clinician with Octave, you will be able to build out a caseload that gives your clients the option to see you virtually or in-person. It is required that you already have a commercial clinical space that you can operate from to see clients in person through Octave. At this time, we are not providing an office space within the state of Pennsylvania. You can see clients in person from your home office or commercial office setting.

You are a good fit if you are:

• Passionate about expanding access to high-quality mental health care.

• Skilled at providing short-term, evidence-based therapies to a diverse range of adult clients.

• Adept at building and maintaining a strong therapeutic alliance.

• Willing to deliver feedback-informed care using standardized measures.

• Expert at providing culturally responsive and culturally competent care.

• Open to learning from your colleagues and clients.

• Someone who thrives in a culture of thoughtful feedback and transparency.

Qualifications:

• LMFT, LPC, LCSW, PsyD

• Current License in Pennsylvania.

• Master’s Degree or higher from an accredited school of Social Work, Psychology, Counseling or Marriage, or Family and Child Counseling.

• Must be licensed and in good standing with your governing licensing board.

• Preferred 1 year of related post-license clinical experience required.

• At least 2 years of experience preferred in one or more of the following areas: CBT for depression or anxiety DBT for emotion dysregulation Unified Protocol for emotional distress CPT or PE for trauma

• Must have your own office space and are willing to provide in-person services in the Boston area.

Octave's Company Values:

The below values drive our day-to-day operations.

• We’re human beings first. We operate with empathy and kindness – with our clients, with our collaborators, and with ourselves.

• People deserve better than status quo. We’re willing to tackle the intractable problems, no matter how big, because someone should. We ask big questions, we craft big solutions, and we challenge ourselves and others to make it happen.

• No bystanders. No stars. No tourists. Each person has been selected to be here, and with that comes a responsibility to bring your expertise, share your ideas, and help make this company better.

• Partnership paves the path ahead. We don’t operate in a silo, internally or externally. To transform the system, we believe in working with others to create something bigger, better, and stronger.

• Quality is crucial at scale. Quality is core to our business, and we refuse to sacrifice it as we grow.

• Progress is a process. In the pursuit of progress, we iterate, reflect, learn, adjust – and always leave things better than we found them.

• There are people behind every data point. We recognize that numbers tell only one part of the story, and we also do the work to understand impacts at the individual level.

Physical Requirements:

• Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

• Must be able to frequently communicate with others through virtual meeting applications such as Zoom and Google Meet.

• Must be able to observe and communicate information on laptop.

• Move up to 10 pounds on occasion.

• Must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future.

• Octave’s policy requires that all clinical sessions be conducted while you are physically located in the United States.

System Requirements:

Octave IT supports these minimum system requirements for the most optimized experience using Octave telehealth tools:

• Computers that are Mac OS (Ventura or later) and Windows OS (10/11)

• Computers kept up with the most recent security updates

• An unmanaged device (a device not provided to you by another company/organization)

Additionally, Octave IT does not support using iOS, Android, or ChromeOS as your primary device.

Compensation:

Starting pay for qualified applicants will depend on a combination of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected salary range for this role is set forth below and this range may be modified in the future.

The hourly compensation range for this role is listed below dependent on licensure:

In-Person Rates:
$83-$143/hour for master's level license.
$113-$143/hour for doctoral-level license.

Virtual Rates:
$80-$140/hour for master's level license.
$110-$140/hour for doctoral-level license.

How We Use Technology in Hiring:

As part of our hiring process, we may use technology tools, including AI-supported systems, to assist with reviewing applications or documenting interviews. These tools are designed to support our team, not replace human judgment, and final hiring decisions are always made by our team.

This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Application Instructions:

Please complete the following application. Please note that the U.S. Equal Opportunity Employment Information questions below are used for the purposes of EEOC reporting and are optional to complete. Octave is unable to change these questions and we acknowledge that many of the U.S. Equal Opportunity Employment Information questions are not inclusive or affirming of all aspects of cultural identity. Octave is committed to an inclusive workplace environment, and this information will not inform how we approach hiring or employment.

jobs.title: Pessoa Estagiária de Inteligência Artificial e Inovação
jobs.description:
Nosso propósito é criar tecnologias que desafiam as melhores do mundo e mudam o jogo para nossos clientes. Por isso, buscamos profissionais que desejam fazer parte de uma cultura pautada pela excelência e inovação. Se você se identifica com um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e movido por curiosidade, venha construir o futuro da tecnologia conosco.

Buscamos uma pessoa estagiária com perfil curioso, analítico e investigativo para atuar na vanguarda da Inteligência Artificial Generativa. Você fará parte de um time focado em explorar, testar e configurar soluções inovadoras baseadas em IA para otimizar processos e criar novos produtos digitais. Se você gosta de entender como a tecnologia funciona na prática, quer aprender a criar agentes de IA e deseja transformar testes e dados em conhecimento estruturado, este desafio é para você!

O que você fará por aqui

• Apoiar pesquisas aplicadas e experimentações focadas no uso de Inteligência Artificial Generativa.

• Auxiliar na configuração e parametrização de agentes de IA baseados em bases de conhecimento e dados estruturados.

• Executar testes práticos, funcionais e comportamentais em plataformas de IA generativa e modelos de linguagem (LLMs).

• Organizar, documentar e estruturar os resultados de experimentos, hipóteses e respostas geradas pelos modelos.

• Colaborar ativamente no levantamento, tratamento básico e entendimento de dados para análise de performance dos agentes.

• Consolidar e analisar feedbacks de usuários para propor melhorias contínuas nas interações com a IA.

O que esperamos que você saiba

• Estar cursando graduação em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas (com previsão de formação a partir de 2027).

• Disponibilidade para estagiar 6 horas diárias.

• Entendimento conceitual básico sobre o funcionamento de Inteligência Artificial Generativa e Agentes de IA.

• Noções de utilização de plataformas, ferramentas ou interfaces de IA generativa (ex: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.).

• Boa capacidade de comunicação escrita, facilidade para seguir instruções técnicas e disciplina para documentar processos.

• Raciocínio lógico estruturado para análise primária de dados e solução de problemas.

jobs.title: Vice President of Programs & Training
jobs.description:
About the Organization

Short Summary

Pursuit is a pioneering AI-native organization building the nation's premier tech workforce pipeline to unlock lasting economic mobility for low-income and underrepresented communities.

Long Summary

For over a decade, Pursuit has unlocked economic mobility by propelling thousands of adults from low-income backgrounds into high-wage tech careers, taking average starting incomes from $17K to $94K and generating nearly $1B in lifetime wage gains. We've also pioneered the Pursuit Bond, an innovative outcomes-based financing model that aligns investor returns with long-term economic mobility, allowing us to scale impact in a financially sustainable way.

Now, as AI reshapes the global economy, Pursuit is pioneering the nation's premier AI-Native workforce pipeline. We are transforming how economic opportunity works at scale through a rigorous, full-funnel training model combining in-person collaborative learning, real-time curriculum adaptation, and deep employer integration.

Powered by $20M in scale funding from organizations like Google, Anthropic, Adobe, Blackstone, Robin Hood and others, Pursuit is building a roadmap of growth to directly train thousands of more Americans and to build enduring workforce training solutions that can support the ecosystem at large.

About the Position

What You'll Do

As AI reshapes the global economy, workforce development stands at a historic inflection point. Pursuit is seeking a visionary, outcomes-obsessed Vice President of Program and Training (VPPT) to lead and scale our groundbreaking AI-native training program. This role offers an unprecedented platform to architect workforce strategy, expand a proven economic mobility engine, and build the foundation for the upcoming AI Jobs Institute to serve thousands of Builders. Reporting to the CEO, the VPPT will serve as the chief architect and operator of the training and job readiness lifecycle. You will have end-to-end ownership across recruitment, community partnerships, persistence, AI-driven curriculum, and candidate-side job readiness. Leading a rapidly expanding multidisciplinary team, you will combine private-sector operational rigor with a deep commitment to human flourishing.

This is an invitation to solve one of the nation's most urgent workforce challenges. As VPPT, you will act as a national spokesperson and subject matter expert, setting the bar for what it means to build sustainable, scalable pathways into the future of work while ensuring underrepresented communities lead the AI revolution.

Key responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Program Vision, AI Pedagogy & Scalable Architecture

• Own the overarching vision, pedagogy, and architecture of Pursuit's AI-native training programs.

• Define and iterate on the curriculum, instructional design, and skill-acquisition model to reflect an evolving AI labor market.

• Establish replicable program delivery frameworks designed to rapidly scale capacity toward thousands of Builders annually.

• Define job-readiness standards for AI-adjacent roles in close alignment with employer expectations and labor market signals.

• Drive continuous pedagogical improvement using real-time performance data, Builder feedback, and industry trends.

• Partner with Product and Engineering to integrate Pursuit's AI-powered learning platform directly into the program model.

• Explore advanced growth models, including the licensing, franchising, or institutionalization of the AI Jobs Institute.

Full-Funnel Enrollment, Persistence & Builder Success

• Own the complete enrollment funnel, from community outreach and recruitment strategy through selection and onboarding.

• Build and manage strategic partnerships with community-based organizations, local institutions, and referral networks.

• Utilize data-driven recruitment campaigns to consistently meet cohort volume and quality targets for low-income Builders.

• Own Builder retention and persistence as core metrics, establishing early-warning systems and proactive intervention structures.

• Oversee the end-to-end Builder experience, cultivating a high-bar environment that balances rigorous challenge with support.

• Integrate industry leaders, volunteers, and corporate partners into fireside chats, capstone projects, and Demo Days.

• Maintain a relentless focus on final employment outcomes, ensuring tight alignment with candidate-side job placement teams.

Team Leadership, Operational Rigor & Scaling

• Cultivate a high-accountability culture driven by an obsession with outcomes, operational precision, and human flourishing.

• Oversee flexible program delivery schedules that accommodate non-traditional hours, including evenings and weekends.

• Establish robust operating infrastructure, including forecasting models, KPI frameworks, and data-driven team rhythms.

• Manage team operational performance to maintain consistency, quality, and strict standards across all program touch points.

• Model AI-native workflows by directly implementing AI tools, automated processes, and tech infrastructure across team operations.

Strategic Leadership, Thought Leadership & Ambassadorship

• Serve as a core member of the executive leadership team, shaping Pursuit's national expansion and growth strategy.

• Act as an internal and external spokesperson on what it takes to train, upskill, and place AI-native talent at scale.

• Synthesize program insights and workforce data to position Pursuit as a national authority on AI workforce development.

• Represent the program at milestone events, national conferences, and high-profile meetings with funders and partners.

• Collaborate closely with the CEO and Chief Product Officer to align program direction with market demands and funding opportunities.

Who You'll Work With

You will report to the Chief Executive Officer. You will build, manage, and hold accountable a multidisciplinary team growing from 10 to 25+ members over the next year.

Required Skills and Experience

• 12+ years of professional experience in fast-paced, outcomes-driven environments, with at least 5 years managing teams of 10+ people (ideally including managers of managers).

• Demonstrated success owning end-to-end program/project outcomes, ideally including community outreach, partner development, enrollment targets, retention, skill acquisition, and final job placements.

• Experience designing, shaping, and architecting learning models or programs at a curriculum or institutional level to ensure pedagogical rigor at scale.

• Proven track record of fostering critical thinking, professional behaviors, and applied technical skills in real-world, workforce, or adult-learning contexts.

• Skilled people leader adept at evaluating work quality against high standards, offering direct constructive feedback, building accountable teams, and developing talent in dynamic environments.

• Proficient in using data and building forecasting models to track KPIs, predict funnel metrics, surface risks, and drive ongoing program optimization.

• Scrappy, hands-on approach with the ability to thrive in ambiguity and actively implement (not just theorize) AI tools and tech infrastructure to improve daily team workflows and processes.

• Deeply motivated by Pursuit's mission of economic transformation through equity, tech access, and expanded opportunity for low-income and underrepresented communities.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $240,000–$265,000 base, with the ability to earn up to $300,000 based on performance bonus, and a full benefits package.

The compensation above reflects the expectations laid out in this job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this posting. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated to you as a candidate.

Additional Details

Location and Work Environment

This role is based in New York City and operates in an on-site/hybrid capacity. To build authentic relationships with Builders, observe instructional delivery, and provide real-time coaching to program teams, the VP of Programs & Training is expected to be on-site 4 to 5 days per week (including core staff days Tuesday through Thursday).

Schedule and Availability

This role requires flexibility to support programs that run on evenings and weekends (Saturday and Sunday from 10:00am to 5:00pm ET and Monday through Wednesday 6:30pm to 10:00pm ET). The VPPT is not expected to be on-site for every class, but must maintain flexibility to support off-hours operations, manage staff on non-traditional schedules, and participate in key programmatic milestones.

On average, candidates can expect 1 to 2 off-hours events or observations per week (averaging about 20 to 23 per quarter). In addition, as the VP of Programs & Training works to support Builders during these key programmatic hours, they may adjust their schedule as appropriate as long as they maintain outcomes. Key touch points include:

• Program Milestones & Capstones: Attending monthly evening hackathons, weekly Tuesday evening fireside chats (6:30pm–8:00pm), and major quarterly Demo Days or class launches.

• Instructional Observation: Periodically dropping into day, evening, or weekend classes to evaluate pedagogy, provide direct feedback to instructors, and connect with Builders.

• Community & Applicant Engagement: Selectively attending evening or weekend information sessions and recruitment workshops to observe staff and engage prospective applicants.

Benefits

• Full benefits package including vision and dental

• Unlimited PTO, plus an all-Pursuit summer break (last week of August) and a week-long holiday break (last week of December)

• 401k match

jobs.title: Assistant Manager
jobs.description:
Being in charge comes with great responsibility. You are responsible for everything that happens during your shift. jobs.title: Director of Demand Generation & Digital Marketing
jobs.description:
🏆 Great Place to Work® Certified | USA

Harbor Compliance is a leading technology platform for entity compliance, helping more than 80,000 businesses and nonprofits manage licensing, tax registration, and legal entity requirements nationwide. Founded in 2012 and recognized repeatedly by the Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500, we've grown through five strategic acquisitions — and are now backed by a 2026 majority growth investment from Bregal Sagemount to accelerate product, AI, and customer experience. We're a passionate team making compliance simpler and smarter for every organization we serve.

The Director of Demand Generation & Digital Marketing owns paid, organic, and web demand across Harbor Compliance and its owned companies and brands. This is a build role as much as a scale role: we are evolving from a predominantly sales-led motion into a business that also acquires and expands through self-service and product-led growth, while moving deliberately toward mid-market and up-market customers. You will lead the demand side of that shift, positioning us for a new audience, building the measurement foundation to prove what works, and owning acquisition efficiency as the guardrail on investment. You will work in close partnership with Product Marketing and with Lifecycle & Customer Marketing, who own positioning and the post-acquisition journey respectively.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the demand generation strategy and roadmap across all brands, accountable for qualified pipeline and new ARR growth.
• Build, lead, and develop a high-performing demand generation team, and own the web estate and conversion surface with the Web Developer as a direct report.
• Design and execute a testing roadmap (A/B and multivariate) across landing pages, campaigns, and conversion paths to continuously improve funnel performance.
• Scale qualified pipeline through GEO/SEO strategy, content, and multi-channel demand campaigns across every brand in the portfolio.
• Partner with Sales leadership to align messaging, targeting, and lead quality with pipeline and conversion objectives, across both sales-led and self-service motions.
• Own acquisition efficiency across brands and funnels, using LTV-to-CAC as the guardrail on investment decisions, and treat budget as an output of funnel performance rather than a fixed allocation.
• Establish data-driven reporting standards, translating web analytics and campaign performance into actionable insight for executive stakeholders.
• Lead the demand side of our shift from sales-led to product-led growth, building self-service acquisition and conversion paths that run alongside the existing sales motion rather than replacing it.
• Drive the move up-market, designing and executing demand programmes aimed at mid-market and larger customers, a segment the current funnel and positioning do not yet serve.
• Build the measurement and attribution foundation, establishing reliable tracking, definitions, and reporting standards before optimising against them.
• Play a pivotal role in pricing and packaging strategy, partnering with Product, Product Marketing, and Finance to shape how we price and how we present pricing in market, then leading the demand-side execution of those changes.
• Own competitive positioning in paid channels in a fast-moving, easily imitated category, keeping our acquisition defensible and managing to payback discipline.
• Collaborate closely with Product Marketing on positioning, messaging, and industry-specific conversion paths, ensuring campaign performance feeds back into positioning decisions.
• Collaborate closely with Lifecycle & Customer Marketing to hand off acquired demand cleanly and to align acquisition targeting with retention and expansion outcomes.

Requirements

• 7+ years of B2B marketing experience leading demand generation across both sales-led and product-led motions.
• 3+ years of people leadership experience, with a track record of building and developing high-performing marketing teams.
• Proven experience owning revenue and efficiency metrics (e.g., ARR contribution, CAC) in a high-growth environment.
• Technical proficiency with marketing automation, CRM platforms (HubSpot preferred), and web analytics tools (e.g., GA4).
• Demonstrated ability to align marketing programmes with sales objectives, and to build a self-service motion that complements rather than competes with the sales team.
• Strong track record of diagnosing funnel friction and implementing pragmatic, measurable improvements.
• Direct experience building or scaling a self-service / product-led acquisition motion inside a company that was previously sales-led.
• Experience positioning and generating demand for a new audience, including mid-market and enterprise buyers, and building the funnel, content, and channels to reach them.
• Has contributed materially to pricing and packaging decisions and led the go-to-market execution of a pricing change.
• Has built or rebuilt a marketing measurement and attribution implementation, not only operated a working one.
• Experience running demand generation across multiple brands or business units.

Skills and Knowledge

• Advanced understanding of SEO-informed content strategy and its role in pipeline generation.
• Familiarity with AI-powered outbound tools and workflows (e.g., Clay, Apollo, enrichment/automation platforms).
• Practical knowledge of conversion-focused UX principles and funnel optimization methodologies.
• Commercial fluency in pricing, packaging, and monetisation, and how each shapes demand.
• Understanding of product-led growth mechanics, including self-service onboarding, in-product conversion, and where they hand off to sales.

To support this belief, we’re building a team of dedicated professionals who genuinely care about improving lives, are passionate about work that can make a difference, and are driven to learn from one another.

The Opportunity

We are opening a newly expanded Primary Care clinic in Portsmouth, New Hampshire and are looking for a Practice Manager to join the team! As a Practice Manager at one of our Advanced Primary Care location, you will play a pivotal role in the day-to-day operational efficiency of the clinic while contributing to its long-term strategic goals. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in healthcare administration, financial management, and team leadership.

This is the perfect opportunity for someone who is looking for a company where their work is valued and recognized by leadership. If you are skilled in relationship building, are a strong people-manager, and thrive in a fast-paced role where you’re balancing multiple responsibilities at one time, we encourage you to apply!

Your Impact

• Operational Management:

• Oversee and optimize daily clinic operations to ensure efficient and effective patient care.

• Efficiently manage and lead the scheduling operations for the clinic, ensuring optimal utilization of resources and staff to meet patient needs.

• Collaborate with healthcare providers and support staff to maintain a high standard of patient service.

• Enforce clinic policies and procedures to ensure compliance with regulatory standards.

• Act as the point of contact for any patient feedback, working with the Medical Leadership team to address concerns.

• Place and manage orders for medical supplies, equipment, and other necessary materials in a timely and cost-effective manner.

• Monitor clinic financial performance and coordinate with the finance department to track expenses related to supplies and ensure adherence to the budget.

• Promote responsible stewardship of organizational resources through data-drive decision making and process improvement.

• Team Leadership:

• Recruit, train, supervise, and engage clinic staff, fostering a positive and collaborative and supportive work environment.

• Conduct performance evaluations and provide ongoing feedback to enhance staff development.

• Foster teamwork and effective communication among all clinic team members.

• Strategic Planning:

• Collaborate with the Regional Leadership team to achieve key financial, quality and operational performance metrics that support sustainable clinic growth.

• Support practice initiatives focused on improving patient attribution, access, retention and long-term value-based care performance.

• Analyze market trends and competitive landscape to identify growth opportunities.

• Implement strategies to enhance the clinic's market presence and community engagement.

• Quality Assurance:

• Lead population health initiatives focused on preventive care, chronic disease management, care gap closure and improving quality performance measures.

• Monitor value based care performance metrics and collaborate with providers and clinical teams to improve patient outcomes, patient engagement and overall quality score.

• Monitor and maintain compliance with quality standards, regulatory requirements, and accreditation criteria.

• Implement quality improvement initiatives to enhance patient outcomes and satisfaction.

• Communication and Collaboration:

• Partner with your leadership team along with corporate resources to ensure effective communication and goal alignment.

• Partner with providers, care teams and corporate stakeholders to advance population health strategies and achieve organization al quality and financial objectives.

• Partner closely with the Urgent Care Practice Manager to foster a collaborative, one-team culture across our co-located Urgent Care and Advanced Primary Care practices, ensuring seamless operations, strong cross-functional teamwork, and an exceptional patient experience.

• Exceptional people manager and team leader: 1-3 years of demonstrated success in leading, mentoring, and growing teams

• Experience in similar roles: Demonstrated skills in medical practice management, human resources, and data analysis

• Driven and self-motivated: Ability to work independently, possess a level of initiative and enthusiasm to help drive results

• Effective communicator (written and verbal) and cross collaborator: Ability to establish and maintain positive relationships with team members and stakeholders across the organization

• Knowledge of healthcare or adjacent industry: Familiarity with medical billing systems, basic medical coding, and basic medical terminology

• Technically savvy: Experience with Microsoft Office, specifically SharePoint, Word, and Excel

• Availability: Work in clinic Monday through Friday with a rotating on-call for weekends and flexibility to support the opening and closing of clinic regularly

Bonus Qualifications

• Experience as an LPN, RN or Medical Assistant

• Degree in Health Management, Health Administration, Nursing, Business Administration, or related field

• Experience with Value Based Care

• Experience using tools such as Clockwise, ADP, and Envi

Why You'll Love Working With Us

• Collaborative team environment that encourages professional growth

• Urgent care services at no cost to our team members and their families

• Extensive benefit offerings including health, dental, and vision coverage, company paid short-term disability, and optional pet insurance

• 401k match after one year of service

• Access to our primary care (depending on location)

• Educational Alliance with Purdue University Global and reduced tuition rates for team members and their families

• Employer rewards and access to discounts offered on services and products such as hotels, travel, entertainment, restaurants, and more

jobs.description:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

• Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.

• What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.

• It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

• Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options

• Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave

• Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees

YOUR MISSION

We are looking for a Mission Architect to join our team in developing the next generation of space domain awareness and rendezvous and proximity operations systems. The Mission Architect will play a critical role in defining, analyzing, and ensuring the successful execution of missions across a system of systems. In this role, you will own the mission definition, mission-level trades, mission technical direction, and customer alignment throughout the full program execution lifecycle, from contract award through mission completion.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Mission Design and Requirements Analysis

• Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and internal teams to define and document mission objectives, system requirements, and operational concepts.

• Translate customer and mission needs into actionable engineering solutions while ensuring alignment with technical and programmatic constraints.

• Define key mission technical performance measures to establish a mission-driven decision-making framework.

• Apply analysis and modeling techniques, including parametric analysis, to support engineering decisions in the absence of specific requirements.

• Lead system trade studies, performance evaluations, and feasibility assessments to ensure an optimal system architecture.

• Lead the design, simulation, and analysis of rendezvous and proximity operations mission trajectories.

• Optimize spacecraft maneuvers to achieve mission objectives while considering fuel efficiency, timing, and risk mitigation.

• Prepare detailed technical reports, presentations, and documentation for internal and external stakeholders, including government agencies and customers.

System Integration and Verification

• Oversee the integration of mission systems, ensuring seamless interaction among hardware, software, and operational components.

• Develop system-level integration and verification plans and conduct end-to-end testing to validate mission requirements.

• Coordinate with subsystem teams to troubleshoot and resolve integration challenges, ensuring mission readiness.

• Support mission operations teams during testing and real-time mission execution.

Modeling, Simulation, and Analysis

• Apply the fundamentals of astrodynamics using software and analysis tools, including orbit propagation, orbit determination, geometric orbit analysis, and mission engineering concepts.

• Design parametric analyses and Monte Carlo studies to support engineering decision-making.

• Conduct system performance analyses, including assessments of reliability, safety, and mission effectiveness under various environmental conditions.

• Assess mission success criteria and operational risks and propose mitigation strategies.

• Conduct pre-flight and post-flight mission analyses, including trajectory reconstruction and anomaly investigations.

QUALIFICATIONS

• 12+ years of experience in mission analysis, space operations, or orbital mechanics.

• Strong technical leadership and systems architecture experience.

• Demonstrated expertise in rendezvous and proximity operations mission design and spacecraft operations.

• Strong understanding of orbital mechanics, spacecraft dynamics, and autonomous space operations.

• Hands-on experience with mission analysis tools such as STK, FreeFlyer, GMAT, or similar software.

• Proficiency in simulation tools and programming languages such as MATLAB, Python, or C++.

• Experience with mission planning and real-time mission support.

• Must have or be able to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI or TS/SAP U.S. government security clearance.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• Advanced degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering.

• Active TS/SCI clearance.

• Experience supporting defense or classified space missions.

jobs.description:
About this job

At NIQ, we deliver the most complete and clear understanding of consumer buying behavior that reveals new pathways to growth.

We are looking for a US Renewal Lead who will be responsible for developing the commercial strategy, commercial construct, and negotiating contract renewals for our organization.

As a US Renewal Lead, you will support a critical part of our business by aiding in the retention and growth of our largest clients. You will be part of a team of unique experts focused against understanding how and why our clients license solutions from NIQ to translate into value and commitment via a contract. Leveraging your expertise, you will develop recommendations and strategies for a deal including solutions, pricing, and terms to address current and future needs. You will collaborate with various internal partners to align and negotiate the appropriate approach supporting the revenue function of our organization.  In this role you will be critical to ensure our offers are accurate, timely and best represent the strategy developed.

Responsibilities

• Plan renewal opportunities in advance year to year to set goal and objectives.

• Assess and track client health to formulate an objective assessment of risks and opportunities.

• Develop the renewal strategy for US manufacturing clients.

• Clear and concise communication skills to effectively engage with senior leaders.

• Lead the analysis and preparation of contract Renewals and Competitive Request for Proposals (RFP).

• Coach and consult internal teams regarding the generation of the deal regarding solutions, incentives, and terms.

• Collaborate internally with cross-functional teams to align the strategy.
• Effectively challenge and influence internal teams.
• Understand NIQ’s corporate strategy to aid in the process and proposed solutions.
• Partners with account leads to develop win themes aligning client priorities to NIQ.

• Review and interpret contract terms and conditions.

• Negotiate agreements with clients and other stakeholders.

• Identify and mitigate potential risks and liabilities associated with contracts.

• Ensure that contracts comply with requirements.

• Collaborate with legal and finance teams to develop contract terms.

• Develop and maintain relationships with clients.

A little bit about you

Do you have the necessary skill set to be successful in this role?

Are you someone that not only manages in the present but also plans the future? Do you set goals and make decisions based on your vision and framework for how you can accomplish these goals? Do you find opportunities in adversity and understand what needs to be done to be successful? Can you motivate others to work toward a specific vision, know how to deal with challenges, and have experience that allows them to develop new ideas for an organization? Can you effectively collaborate with others to gather information to then collate it to share back to the organization?

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Marketing, or related field.

• 5-8+ years of experience in commercial strategy, contract renewals, client management, sales strategy, or a related function within the CPG, manufacturing, consumer insights, market research, data, or analytics industries.

• Experience leading or supporting contract renewals, commercial negotiations, pricing discussions, and contract management.

• Strong strategic thinking and analytical skills with the ability to assess client needs, identify risks and opportunities, evaluate complex information, and develop actionable recommendations.

• Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, and active listening skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and confidently present recommendations to senior leaders.

• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy, organization, and attention to detail.
• Self-starter with strong time-management skills, capable of working independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.
• Familiarity with NIQ solutions, syndicated data, market measurement, consumer intelligence, or related analytics solutions is preferred.

US Benefits

• Comprehensive healthcare plan (medical, Rx, dental, and vision).
• Flexible spending accounts and a Health Savings Account (including company contributions).
• Life and AD&D insurance.
• 401(k) retirement plan including company matching contributions.
• Disability insurance.
• Tuition Reimbursement.
• Discretionary paid time off program and 11 paid holidays.
• Flexible working environment
• Volunteer time off
• LinkedIn Learning
• Employee-Assistance-Program (EAP)

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation of the following range: $78,500.00 - $90,000.00.  Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role is eligible for a sales-based incentive or performance-based bonus. Other benefits include a flexible working environment, comprehensive health insurance, industry-leading parental leave, life insurance, education support, and more.
