jobs.description:
WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

역할 세부 목표

매장 매니저는 매장 비즈니스의 모든 측면을 이끌고 관리하며 지속적으로 발전시킬 책임이 있습니다. 또한, ALO 미션에 부합하는 긍정적이고 생산성 높은 업무 환경을 조성하고 관리합니다. 그뿐만 아니라 매출 및 수익 세부 목표, 운영 세부 목표, 머천다이징 표준을 지속적으로 달성하고 매우 성공적인 판매, 운영 및 비주얼 팀을 개발해 나가야 합니다.

비즈니스 리더

• 매장 리테일 전략 수립 및 실행

• 고객층 및 경쟁 브랜드와 관련된 국내 시장 지식 보유

• 매장 성공에 영향을 미치는 비즈니스 트렌드 이해

• KPI를 활용하여 비즈니스 성장 전략을 수립하고 지원하는 뛰어난 비즈니스 감각 보유

• 회사 툴, 인센티브 및 전략을 활용해 매출 목표 달성을 지원하여 팀 주도

인재 리더

• 매장 팀이 ALO의 미션과 기본 원칙을 실천하여 고객에게 ALO의 정체성, ALO가 하는 일, 그 일을 하는 이유를 효과적으로 전달하도록 지원

• 역량 개발, 성과 관리, 트레이닝, 지속적인 코칭을 통해 성장, 책임, 포용성을 중시하는 환경 조성

• 동료에 대한 인재 분석을 실시하고 주요 역할 및 포지션을 위한 커리어 발전 계획을 수립하여 우수한 인재를 계속해서 유지하고 이직률을 줄임

• 승계 계획 및 채용 전략을 통해 내부 및 외부 파이프라인 구축

운영 리더

• 판매 및 서비스, 운영, 비주얼 매니저를 감독하여 모든 주요 전략 실행

• 주요 운영 및 비주얼 가이드라인 실행을 감독하고 지원

• 비즈니스 성과 데이터를 바탕으로 강력한 매장 비주얼 표준 수립

• 안전한 근무 환경을 조성하고 효율적인 운영 지원

• 비즈니스 성과를 내는 동시에 인력 효율성을 유지하도록 스케줄 설정

FLOW 경험 리더

• 다른 부서의 비즈니스 파트너와 협력하여 조직 목표 달성을 지원

• ALO 홍보 대사로서 ALO 미션에 부합하는 문화 확립

• 비즈니스 요구와 브랜드 문화의 균형을 통해 조직을 원활하게 운영하는 능력 보유

• 목표와 KPI 달성을 위해 매장 전반에 효과적인 커뮤니케이션 전략 수립 및 구현

매장 매니저 자격 요건

• 리테일 또는 관련 업계 리더십 경력 5년 이상

• MS Office(Word, Excel, Outlook) 관련 실무 지식

• 탁월한 대인 관계 형성 기술과 구두 및 서면 커뮤니케이션 기술

• 빠르게 변화하는 혁신적인 환경에서 비즈니스를 성장시켜 스스로 큰 동기를 부여

• 자기 주도적인 업무 수행 능력, 시간 관리 역량, 책임 의식

• ALO의 기본 원칙 준수 및 체화

• 기업가 정신을 갖추고 경영인 마인드 소유

• 매장의 모든 구역을 계속 다녀야 함

• 최대 22.7kg을 들거나 밀거나 짊어지거나 그 외의 방법으로 옮길 수 있음

• 들고, 구부리고, 무릎을 꿇고, 높은 곳에 올라가고, 기어가거나 몸을 비틀고, 사다리를 안전하게 오르내릴 수 있음

• 근무 내내 서 있고 움직일 수 있음

매장 매니저 스케줄

비즈니스와 팀의 요구를 충족할 수 있는 균형 잡힌 스케줄 계획을 위해, 모든 정규직 직원은 회사가 정하는 스케줄에 따라 근무할 수 있어야 하며 성수기와 주말을 포함해 다양한 시간대에 근무할 수 있어야 합니다. 모든 직원은 예외 없이 미국 추수감사절(블랙 프라이데이, 추수감사절 주말 포함)부터 연말 시즌 마지막(1월 첫째 주)까지로 회사가 규정한 휴가 금지 기간에 근무할 수 있어야 합니다.

문서 보존 및 반환 정책

모든 지원서 자료는 채용 프로세스 종료 시점까지 보존됩니다. 채용 프로세스가 종료되면 모든 전자 지원서 파일이 지원서 제출일로부터 180일 이내에 안전하게 삭제 또는 폐기됩니다. 지원서를 우편으로 제출한 경우, 반환을 요청할 수 있습니다. 자료를 반환받길 원한다면 채용 프로세스 종료 후 14일 이내에 요청하세요. 요청일로부터 14일 이내에 우편으로 발송되며, 관련 비용은 본인 부담입니다.

결과 통지

모든 지원자에 대해 이메일 또는 문자 메시지로 채용 결정을 통지합니다. 귀중한 시간을 내어 채용 프로세스에 참여해 주셔서 감사하며, 새로운 소식이 있으면 모든 지원자에게 시의적절하게 알려드리겠습니다.

Objective

The Store Manager is a true business owner for their store. They are responsible for leading, managing and continuously developing all aspects of their store's business. They are accountable for creating and maintaining a positive and highly productive work environment that aligns with the company's mission. They will be responsible for consistently achieving sales & profitability goals, operational objectives, merchandising standards and developing a highly successful Sales, Operations, and Visual team.

Business Leader

• Develop and execute the store’s retail strategies

• Local market knowledge of clientele base and brand competitors

• Aware of business trends that relate to the success of the store

• Demonstrate strong business acumen through KPI’s to develop and support business driving strategies

• Lead team by leveraging company tools, incentives & strategies to support meeting sales goals

People Leader

• Ensure that the store team exudes ALO's mission and guiding principles to effectively communicate to our guests who we are, what we do and why we do what we do

• Develops an environment of growth, accountability and inclusivity through development, performance management, training and consistent coaching

• Conducts talent analysis of colleagues and establish career progression plans for key players and positions to result in retention of best talent and turnover reduction

• Establish internal & external pipeline through succession planning and recruitment strategy

Operations Leader

• Oversee Sales & Service, Operations, and Visual Managers to ensure execution of all key strategies

• Oversee and support execution of key operational and visual guidelines

• Champion strong visual standards for the salesfloor by leveraging business performance data

• Support a safe work environment and efficient operation

• Develop schedules that deliver business results while maintaining labor effectively

Flow Experience Leader

• Collaborate with cross-functional business partners to support organizational goals

• Is an ALO ambassador and creates a culture that aligns with our mission

• Demonstrate an ability to navigate the organization with a balance of business need and brand culture

• Create and implement effective communication strategies throughout store to achieve goals and KPI’s

Store Manager Qualifications

• 5+ years of retail or related industry leadership experience

• Working knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel and Outlook)

• Extraordinary interpersonal and communication skills, both verbal and written

• Highly Motivated by driving business in a fast-paced, innovative environment

• Independent work ethic, time management skills, and personal accountability

• Aligns with and embodies ALO’s Guiding Principles

• Business owner mindset with an entrepreneurial spirit

• Requires constant movement in and around all areas of store

• Ability to lift, push, carry or otherwise move up to 50 pounds

• Ability to lift, bend, kneel, climb, crawl and/or twist, and safely climb up/down a ladder

• Ability to stand and move for an entire shift

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, ALO does not discriminate against applicants or employees because of race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, age, citizenship, marital or domestic/civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression or because of any other status or condition protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Document Retention and Return Policy

We will retain all application materials until the hiring process is complete. Once the process is over, all electronic application files will be securely deleted or destroyed no later than 180 days of the application submission date. If you submit your application by mail, you may request to have your materials returned. To do so, please contact us within 14 days of the end of the recruitment process, and we will mail your documents back to you at your expense within 14 days of your request.

Notification of Results

We will notify all applicants of the hiring decision via email or text message. We appreciate your patience throughout this process and will ensure that all applicants receive updates in a timely manner.

jobs.title: Digital and Interactive Content Developer (Active NOAA CAC Preferred)
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEMENT 84

Element 84 is a woman-owned small business that works with public, private, and non-profit sector clients to develop geospatial data processing pipelines & build software that helps answer big questions about our health, our infrastructure, and our changing planet. We solve challenging problems across a wide range of industries, but our super power is cloud-based geospatial data processing, remote sensing, and Earth science systems. Our headquarters is located in Alexandria, VA and we have a satellite office in Philadelphia, PA.




A FEW OTHER THINGS YOU SHOULD KNOW

 1. Element 84's values are: We Invest in Each Other, We are Reliable, and Our Work Benefits our World.

 2. Element 84 works on meaningful projects that are challenging—from a technical, people, and team perspective. We make an impact on large projects through our leadership and expertise, both formal and informal.

 3. Element 84 values life outside of work. We offer parental leave for everyone and support each other through family challenges like medical problems, adoptions, and new babies.

 4. Element 84 has had a flexible work schedule since our founding in 2010.

 5. Element 84 is committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and respect for all individuals as we constantly strive to create a work environment where everyone feels welcome and supported.




ABOUT YOU

You are curious about the world, are constantly learning, driven to lead (formally or informally), and have a strong work ethic. You're interested in solving impactful problems in science, medicine, and other projects that have a societal good. You can work independently or with a team, prioritize your projects, and be effective without micromanagement. You bring energy and initiative, you're a self-starter, and you're happiest on a small team where everyone pitches in.

You'll care about writing. Our team is remote and written communication is essential. In addition to caring about a well-crafted email and a succinct conference abstract, you understand that good writing is good design and engineering.




ABOUT THE ROLE

A talented digital and interactive developer is needed on the Element 84 team to support our federal clients in their mission. The Element 84 Federal Business Unit works primarily with NASA, NOAA, and USGS on projects involving the processing, distribution, and visualization of geospatial and remotely sensed data in the Cloud. As a member of this team, this developer will coordinate communication, education, and branding efforts for a large program focused on modernizing weather prediction capabilities.




PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Execute social media strategy through editorial planning, campaigns, publishing, monitoring, engagement, and measurement.

 - Develop newsletters, announcements, web stories, outreach materials, presentations, graphics, infographics, short-form video, and other multimedia.

 - Translate complex EPIC/UFS science and technology into clear, accurate, audience-appropriate content.

 - Maintain consistent EPIC/UFS/NOAA branding and editorial quality.

 - Support education, outreach, events, software releases, technical milestones, and community opportunities with coordinated communications products.

 - Quality control of deliverables

 - Manage stakeholder engagement workflows, community feedback processes, action tracking, approvals, and reporting.




QUALIFICATIONS

Here are the guidelines we're looking at to gauge experience and skillset:


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years of experience as a communications role (communications specialist or equivalent)

 - Experience creating and publishing multimedia content for web and social media platforms

 - Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and Canva for designing graphics and visual communications

 - Experience developing and executing digital communication campaigns that increase audience engagement and visibility

 - Experience using analytics, user feedback, and market research to optimize digital content and communication strategies

 - Ability to translate complex technical, policy, or scientific information into clear, accessible content for diverse audiences

 - Ability to work as a member of a small team, collaborating with subject-matter experts and external stakeholders

 - Proponent of continuous improvement; willingness to bring new ideas to the team

 - Outstanding all-round communication skills and ability to work collaboratively and proficiently in a remote environment

 - Energetic, self-motivated, team player


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Active NOAA CAC badge

As a Customer (Patient) Support Specialist, you are on the front lines of the patient experience; helping people successfully access the medications they need. jobs.title: Facilities Reliability Engineer
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Strive Pharmacy is a personalized compounding pharmacy built on a simple conviction: medicine should fit the patient, not the other way around. We started Strive because we believed the pharmaceutical industry was overdue for a more human approach—one that prioritizes individualized care, clinical nuance, and genuine partnership with patients and providers.

Compounding gives us the tools to do that. Every formulation we prepare is built to the specific needs of a specific person, and every interaction we have is guided by that same commitment to personalized care.

We're growing, and we're looking for people who share that conviction. If you're ready to be part of a pharmacy that takes the work seriously and the people even more seriously, we'd like to meet you.

Mission:

Strive exists to disrupt an industry long overdue for a more personal approach to care. We put the human element at the center of everything: every formulation, every patient interaction, every provider partnership. We're not just a compounding pharmacy. We're a team on a mission to change what personalized healthcare looks and feels like.

Location: Mesa, Arizona (On-Site)
Position Type: Full-time
Schedule: First Shift
Compensation Range: $105,000 - $120,000

Position Overview

The Facilities Reliability Engineer ensures maximum operational uptime, equipment integrity, and environmental compliance across all Strive Pharmacy facilities - including sterile and non-sterile compounding cleanrooms, manufacturing lines, warehouse operations, and corporate office spaces. This role leads the development and execution of Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM) strategies, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), predictive maintenance (PdM) programs, and critical HVAC/environmental system monitoring to comply with USP <797>, USP <800>, cGMP, and internal operational standards.

Key Responsibilities

Compounding Pharmacy & Cleanroom Systems

• Oversee reliability and preventative maintenance programs for sterile and non-sterile compounding equipment, biosafety cabinets (BSCs), laminar flow hoods, and automated filling systems.

• Ensure strict environmental controls, cleanroom pressure cascades, temperature, and humidity parameters comply with USP <797>, USP <800>, FDA, and state board requirements.

• Partner with Quality Assurance (QA) to manage critical equipment deviations, Out-of-Specification (OOS) investigations, and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) implementations.

Critical HVAC & Environmental Controls

• Manage reliability, monitoring, and lifecycle maintenance for specialized healthcare and manufacturing HVAC systems, including Air Handling Units (AHUs), chillers, boilers, exhaust systems, and HEPA filtration systems.

• Optimize Building Management Systems (BMS) and Building Automation Systems (BAS) for continuous 24/7 environmental monitoring and alert mitigation.

• Lead energy efficiency and air quality optimization initiatives across office spaces, cleanrooms, and warehouse storage zones.

Manufacturing & Warehouse Equipment Reliability

• Implement Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and track key reliability metrics (MTBF, MTTR, OEE) across automated manufacturing equipment, packaging lines, and warehouse automation.

• Design and refine Preventative/Predictive Maintenance (PM/PdM) schedules for material handling equipment (MHE), cold storage/walk-in freezers, conveyor systems, and backup power generators.

• Direct vibration analysis, thermal imaging, oil analysis, and ultrasound testing programs to identify equipment failures prior to operational interruption.

Facility Maintenance & Office Operations

• Oversee facility reliability standards for general infrastructure, plumbing, fire suppression/life safety systems, electrical distribution, and office facilities.

• Manage vendor relationships, service level agreements (SLAs), and contracted technical services for facility utilities and specialized equipment calibrations.

Continuous Improvement & Compliance

• Maintain accurate equipment histories, spare parts inventories, and maintenance records within the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS).

• Author, review, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for maintenance, calibration, and equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ).

• Participate in internal quality audits and external regulatory inspections (FDA, OSHA, State Boards of Pharmacy).

Required Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or an equivalent combination of professional training and documented industry experience).

• Experience: 4+ years of reliability, maintenance, or facilities engineering experience spanning compounding pharmacy/life sciences, manufacturing, and warehouse facilities.

• Regulatory Knowledge: In-depth understanding of USP <797>, USP <800>, cGMP, FDA regulations, ISO cleanroom classifications, and OSHA standards.

• Technical Expertise:

• Hands-on experience with industrial HVAC systems, cleanroom air distribution, differential pressure monitoring, and BMS/BAS software.

• Proficiency with CMMS platforms (e.g., Maximo, Fiix, SAP Maintenance).

• Applied expertise in RCM techniques, FMEA, RCA, and PdM technologies (thermography, vibration analysis).

Preferred Qualifications

• Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) via ASQ or Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP) via SMRP.

• Experience with cold chain storage reliability and automated warehouse systems (ASRS, conveyors).

• Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt certification.

Core Competencies

• Analytical Problem-Solving: Ability to dissect complex mechanical/electrical failures and identify true root causes.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Works seamlessly across Quality, Operations, Pharmacy, Safety, and Leadership.

• Regulatory Acumen: Maintains a compliance-first mindset in regulated pharmacy and cleanroom environments.

• Project Management: Capable of prioritizing multiple reliability projects and equipment overhauls simultaneously.

Work Environment
This position is primarily based in an onsite work environment. The role requires regular periods of sitting, standing, and computer use, with occasional lifting as needed. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

Annual Salary

$110,000—$130,000 USD

Join Us in Making an Impact:

At Strive, the work is real and the impact is direct. Every role here contributes to a patient experience that's more personal, more attentive, and more human than what most people have come to expect from a pharmacy. Apply today and help us raise the bar.

Benefits/ Perks:

Culture:

Culture isn't an afterthought at Strive. It's something we actively build. We foster a collaborative, engaging workplace where employees have opportunities to connect, celebrate, and build meaningful relationships with their colleagues. We're committed to supporting the personal and professional growth of every employee, both inside and outside the workplace.

EEO:

We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state or local laws.

• Build the system. Create job plans, checklists, and PM plans in D365, keep asset records accurate, and maintain equipment documentation and floor plans.
• Plan the big events. Scope and plan annual shutdowns months ahead, and prepare the site for contractor work.

• Multi-site support: Support planning at other locations remotely when needed, and take part in the monthly planner network to share standards and solutions across sites.

jobs.title: Director, Global Supply Chain Planning & Controls
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form! 



In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia. 



Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing -  might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.



Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.




ROLE DESCRIPTION

Form Energy is hiring a Director of Global Supply Chain Planning & Controls to build and lead the function that turns demand into a build. Based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, West Virginia, this role reports into our VP, Global Supply Chain and owns planning end to end: demand planning, supply and material planning, and the material coordination that keeps our production lines running day to day. You will own and run Form's Sales and Operations Planning process, the forum that connects commercial demand, engineering, and manufacturing into a single build plan, headcount plan, and deployment plan.

Form is in a distinctive moment. We are running new product introduction builds and scaling production at the same time, on the same factory floor, for a battery chemistry with no existing playbook to plan against. This role needs someone who can hold both realities at once: comfortable with the fluid, high-change cadence of NPI, and equally comfortable building the disciplined, throughput-focused systems that scale with production demands.

 Relocation assistance is available. 




WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Build and lead Form's Global Supply Chain Planning & Controls organization, spanning demand planning, supply and material planning, and material coordination, based at Form Factory 1.

 - Own and evolve Form's Sales & Operations Planning process, consolidating commercial, engineering, and internal test demand into a single, trusted demand signal and translating it into the build plan, headcount plan, and deployment plan.

 - Own demand planning end to end, aligning stakeholders across Commercial, Engineering, and Manufacturing around what we are building, when, and why.

 - Own supply and material planning strategy, including inventory strategy, MRP/ERP system parameters, master data integrity, and supplier ramp coordination across raw materials, components, and sub-assemblies.

 - Own material coordination and production control at FF1, ensuring materials, work in process, and finished goods flow to support daily execution across both NPI builds and scaling production lines.

 - Build and develop a team of planning and controls leaders across demand, supply/material planning, and material coordination, setting the standard for data-driven decision making and disciplined execution.

 - Deliver clear-to-build status, capacity and constraint analysis, and what-if scenario planning to inform executive decisions on ramp pacing, resource allocation, and risk.

 - Adapt planning cadence and rigor to the environment in front of you, running tight, flexible processes for NPI builds and disciplined, high-throughput processes for scaled production, often in parallel.

 - Partner closely with Global Supply Managers, Manufacturing Operations, Engineering, and Finance to keep planning systems and processes aligned as Form scales from pilot lines to full production volume.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Operations, Finance, or a related discipline. APICS/CPIM certification is a plus.

 - 10+ years of experience in supply chain planning, production planning, or manufacturing operations, including at least 5 years in a people leadership role building and scaling teams.

 - Demonstrated experience owning planning end to end, demand, supply, material, and production control, ideally spanning both new product introduction and high-volume scaled manufacturing.

 - Deep fluency in MRP/ERP systems, S&OP processes, and discrete manufacturing planning, including bills of material, product lifecycle management, and procure-to-pay processes.

 - A track record of building planning organizations and systems from the ground up in a fast-scaling or novel manufacturing environment.

 - Strong analytical rigor paired with the executive presence to bring senior leadership along on complex tradeoffs, constraints, and ramp decisions.

 - Willingness to be based onsite at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, West Virginia, with the range to operate comfortably across both NPI and scaled production contexts.
   




WHERE YOU'LL WORK:


This role is based at Form Factory 1 in Weirton, WV—an easy commute from the city of Pittsburgh, PA. This 550,000-square-foot facility is our hub for high-volume battery production and a leader in the new era of American energy manufacturing. Relocation assistance is available.



#LI-Onsite





Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here. 



When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed. 



To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.




If you may require reasonable accommodations to participate in our interview process, please contact accommodations@formenergy.com. Requests for accommodations will be treated with discretion.

Form Energy is committed to maintaining the privacy of our applicants. Please be aware that we will never solicit sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers or bank account details during the recruiting or hiring process.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, GTM Strategist
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:  Austin or London (Hybrid)

About the Role

More than 50% of Internet traffic is automated. Knowing who's human, who's an agent, and who's a malicious actor is core to Cloudflare's strategy, and one of the primary values we sell to our Customers. We're building the products that answer "can we trust this traffic?" and our story is differentiated, but the demand is outpacing the number of experts who can tell our story. This role will drive the solution to this challenge.

We think of this as the next generation of product marketing, built for a technical product and rebuilt as a part of the Product team. At Cloudflare, PMs are the first sellers, and own their own launches, content, and enablement. This role, like the rest of the team, will be both deep in R&D as well as in the field driving real Customer conversations, feeling firsthand what lands, and turning that into the enablement, materials, and programs the entire field runs on. Your credibility comes from carrying the pitch yourself.

You will work directly with the Director of Product and across the PMs who lead each product line. As a member of the product team, your work in the field shapes the strategy and the narrative. You own how far and how fast that story travels, and how well the field can carry it on its own.

What you'll do

Own the field's ability to win.

Build the enablement that lets any account team lead a conversation about agents, bots, attackers, or fraud, end to end. This includes training, playbooks, battlecards, demo environments, proof-of-concept guides, competitive intelligence, and certification. Amplify our story.

Who you are

jobs.title: Customer Success Specialist
jobs.description:
CUSTOMER SUCCESS SPECIALIST (AMS IMPECT/SOCCER)

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics .

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOCCER TACTICS, INTEGRATED VIDEO + WEARABLES, AND REVENUE-DRIVEN CUSTOMER SUCCESS

We are looking for a talented, proactive, and field-oriented Customer Success Specialist (Tactics & Coaching - Soccer) whose drive for elite performance aligns with our ambitious, fast-growing company. Based in the United States, you will be a key driver in onboarding, supporting, and elevating our professional soccer accounts across North America (MLS, USL, NWSL, and elite academies).

You will bridge the gap between tactical data (Impect/packing data), video analysis workflows (Focus/MatchTracker), athlete performance tracking (Catapult Wearables/GPS Integration), and organizational communication (Catapult Hub). Working hand-in-hand with our Business Development Managers (BDMs), you will play a critical commercial and strategic role: retaining existing clients, expanding product adoption, and identifying revenue opportunities and service threats beyond day-to-day user requests, reading executive and directional shifts within sports organizations.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• High-Impact Presentations & Industry Representation: Design and deliver compelling, high-value presentations and technical workshops tailored for professional clubs, federations, and high-level decision-makers. Represent Catapult as a speaker and subject matter expert at small tactical roundtables, large federation assemblies, industry conferences, and major business events.

• Full-Ecosystem Workflow Enablement (Video + GPS + Hub): Onboard and train professional soccer clubs on Catapult’s integrated suite: Video Analysis (Focus/MatchTracker), Integrated Wearable/GPS Data, Tactical Metrics (Impect), and Catapult Hub for organization-wide video and data sharing across technical staff, executive leadership, and players.

• Client Transition & Value Enablement: Support soccer clubs transitioning to Impect, Focus, and Catapult video platforms. Work alongside team analysts and performance staff to align analytical workflows with Impect data sets and Catapult wearable metrics, ensuring seamless migration and rapid time-to-value (hands-on data engineering is a plus, but consultative workflow guidance is the primary focus).

• Proactive Account Retention & Business Intelligence: Act as a trusted strategic consultant for Performance Directors, Head Analysts, and Technical Staff. Look beyond routine user tickets to evaluate account health, understand high-level club decisions, and protect core revenue.

• High-Frequency Field Presence & On-Site Support: Travel extensively across North America to conduct hands-on training, provide match-day or pre-season support, facilitate tactical workshops, and represent Catapult at key industry events and league meetings.

• Voice of the Customer & Product Alignment: Collect structured feedback from elite soccer analysts and coaches across video, GPS integration, and Hub features, collaborating with Product Management to influence the tactical software roadmap.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

• Proven Applied Background in Soccer Analysis: 3+ years of experience working within professional soccer environments (MLS, USL, NWSL, or elite collegiate level) as a Video Analyst, Tactical Analyst, or Performance Specialist.

• Exceptional Public Speaking & Content Creation Skills: Proven ability to create value-driven, professional presentation decks and deliver engaging keynote speeches or workshops to executive audiences, federations, large industry groups, or intimate club boardrooms.

• Integrated Software & Tactical Data Proficiency: Direct experience with professional video analysis software (Focus, MatchTracker, Hudl Sportscode, or similar), exposure to advanced tactical data platforms (Impect, StatsBomb, Opta, or similar), and familiarity with integrated Video + GPS/Wearables workflows and organization sharing platforms (Catapult Hub or similar).

• Commercial Acumen & Strategic Awareness: Ability to distinguish technical user feedback from commercial opportunities (upsell, cross-sell) and account risks (churn threats, executive decision shifts).

• Established Industry Network: Strong existing professional network and relationships with technical, tactical, video, and performance staff across MLS and USL organizations.

• High Travel Availability & Flexibility: Willingness and ability to travel extensively (up to 50%+ time) across the US and North America, including weekend travel aligned with match-day schedules.

• Strong Communication & Consultative Mindset: Exceptional ability to translate complex tactical data models, video integration, and physical data into actionable insights for Head Coaches, Analysts, and Sporting Directors.

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

In 6 months time…

• You will have established a joint commercial cadence with the BDM, completing account audits across primary MLS and USL accounts to identify upsell paths and mitigate churn risks.

• You will have built a portfolio of high-value presentation decks and delivered successful keynotes/workshops at regional soccer clinics, federation meetings, and key club accounts.

• You will have led successful client implementations of the integrated Video + GPS ecosystem and Catapult Hub across key professional soccer accounts.

• You will be fully autonomous in conducting on-site training workshops across North America for Focus, Impect, and Hub workflows.

In 12 months time…

• You will have achieved industry-leading retention rates and directly contributed to expansion ACV in collaboration with the BDM across your soccer portfolio.

• You will be recognized as a leading voice and speaker for Catapult at major sports tech conventions, business summits, and US Soccer/MLS/USL events.

• You will have established Catapult Hub and the integrated Video + GPS solution as the standard operational workflow across designated MLS and USL clubs.

• You will serve as an internal Subject Matter Expert for soccer tactical workflows and commercial account management within the Customer Success organization.

WHY CATAPULT?

• We have amazing people. We promise you’ll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.

• We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary.

• We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.

• Our workforce spans more than 32 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.

• We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you’re interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet!

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

Compensation & Benefits

The target Total Compensation range for this position is $49,990- $117,976 per year. This range is inclusive of base salary and a target incentive plan (which may include equity, commission, or other bonus structures).

Your specific compensation within this range will be determined by factors such as your geographic location, relevant experience, and job-related skills.

In addition to this compensation, Catapult also offers generous paid leave and recognized company holidays, and the opportunity to participate in our comprehensive benefits package, including Health, Dental, and Vision insurance, and 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

jobs.title: VP, Regulatory Affairs
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Prime Medicine is a leading biotechnology company dedicated to creating and delivering the next generation of gene editing therapies to patients. The Company is leveraging its proprietary Prime Editing platform, a versatile, precise and efficient gene editing technology, to develop a new class of differentiated, one-time, potentially curative genetic therapies. Designed to make only the right edit at the right position within a gene while minimizing unwanted DNA modifications, Prime Editors have the potential to repair almost all types of genetic mutations and work in many different tissues, organs and cell types.

Prime Medicine is currently progressing a diversified portfolio of investigational therapeutic programs organized around our core areas of focus: hematology, immunology & oncology, liver and lung. Across each core area, Prime Medicine is focused initially on a set of high value programs, each targeting a disease with well-understood biology and a clearly defined clinical development and regulatory path, and each expected to provide the foundation for expansion into additional opportunities. For more information, please visit www.primemedicine.com.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Vice President, Regulatory Affairs will report to the Chief Medical Officer and will partner closely with leaders across Research, CMC, Clinical Development, and Program Management. This is a critical role that will shape regulatory global strategy from early development through BLA/ MAA submission, while building and mentoring a high-performing regulatory affairs function.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Regulatory Strategy & Leadership

• Develop and own global regulatory strategies for all Prime Medicine programs, including gene editing (Prime Editing), cell therapy, pulmonary and combination product modalities

• Serve as the primary regulatory interface with the FDA (CBER/CDER), EMA, and other global health authorities; lead and manage high-stakes regulatory meetings, negotiations, and correspondences

• Provide strategic and technical guidance on INDs, CTAs, BLAs, MAAs, and related regulatory submissions, ensuring timely and high-quality filings

• Lead the development of regulatory risk assessments and mitigation strategies across all pipeline programs

• Represent regulatory affairs in executive leadership forums, Board communications, and due diligence activities for in-licensing, collaborations, and M&A

Submissions & Interactions with Health Authorities

• Oversee preparation, review, and submission of all IND and CTA filings, ensuring scientific rigor and regulatory compliance across US, EU, and other global regions

• Lead strategy and execution for Breakthrough Therapy, RMAT, Orphan Drug, and other expedited designation requests as applicable

• Direct interactions with FDA, EMA, and other regulatory agencies on all matters including clinical holds, major objections, product labeling, and post-approval commitments

• Maintain a thorough understanding of evolving regulatory guidance for advanced medicinal therapy products (ATMPs), gene therapies, and gene-edited cell therapies

Team Building & Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Able to function in lean teams and being a hands-on operator

• Partners with CMC, Clinical, Nonclinical, Program Management and Manufacturing teams to integrate regulatory strategy into all stages of program development

• Champion and drive cross-functional regulatory readiness, including preparation for pre-BLA meetings, advisory committee meetings, and inspection readiness activities

• Provide regulatory oversight and guidance for CMO/CRO activities, ensuring regulatory compliance throughout the supply and clinical development chain

• Manage regulatory consultants and CROs

Regulatory Intelligence & Compliance

• Monitor and interpret evolving global regulatory requirements, guidance, and precedents relevant to gene editing, cell therapy, and rare/genetic disease programs

• Champion continuous process improvements in regulatory operations, submission quality, and knowledge management

• Maintain compliance with ICH guidelines and all applicable regional regulatory requirements

KEY REQUIREMENTS

Education

• Bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline required; and advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, or MD) strongly preferred

Experience

• Minimum 15+ years of progressively responsible regulatory affairs or comparable experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, gene/ cell/ novel platform therapy will be preferred

• Minimum 5+ years of leadership experience in a global regulatory affairs role, with demonstrated success managing teams

• Significant experience in gene therapy, gene editing, cell therapy, or other advanced medicinal therapy products (ATMPs) is strongly preferred

• Experience working in rare and orphan disease, and familiar with unique regulatory frameworks guiding development in this therapeutic area.

• Demonstrated track record of successful IND and CTA submissions for novel modalities, including experience with CBER-regulated programs

• Demonstrated track record of successful BLA, NDA, and/or MAA submissions, including driving regulatory strategy and critical submission activities within expedited timelines across US and international regions.

• Prior experience engaging with FDA (CBER preferred), EMA, and other global health authorities on complex regulatory questions

• Familiarity with RMAT, Breakthrough Therapy, and Orphan Drug designation pathways is highly desirable

• Is enthusiastic about keeping up with regulatory guidance and the changing environment and putting into practice those updates

Skills & Competencies

• Exceptional strategic thinking with the ability to translate complex scientific and regulatory challenges into clear, actionable regulatory plans

• Hands-on mentality, with ability to work in a very lean environment and willingness to generate regulatory content when necessary.

• Comfort and experience managing contract research organizations.

• Strong leadership presence with proven ability to build, develop, and inspire high-performing teams in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

• Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills; ability to represent Prime Medicine credibly before regulatory agencies and external partners

• Proven ability to work cross-functionally and influence without authority across Research, CMC, Clinical, and Commercial functions

• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple programs simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver results on schedule

• Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort operating in an innovative, science-driven, start-up/growth-stage environment

• Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed

WHAT WE OFFER

• Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

• Performance-based annual bonus eligibility

• Equity participation (stock options) reflects our commitment to shared success

• Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and more

• A collaborative, mission-driven culture at the forefront of genetic medicine innovation

• The opportunity to shape the regulatory function of a leading gene editing company at a pivotal stage of growth

US citizenship or valid work authorization required

Prime Medicine is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

The pay range reflects the full-time base salary range we expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. Base pay will be determined based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education. This role is eligible for an annual short-term incentive award (e.g., bonus) and an annual long-term incentive award (e.g., equity).

Prime Medicine offers a comprehensive Total Rewards package with robust health, financial, and wellness benefits—including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, a 401(k) match, and equity programs—along with generous paid time off, wellness days, and company-wide recharge breaks.

Our commitment to employee well-being reflects our belief that when we care for our people, we strengthen our ability to put patients first and make meaningful impact together.

$313,000—$348,000 USD

Sr. Director, Sales Training
jobs.description:
Definium Therapeutics is a late-stage clinical biopharmaceutical company and our mission is to forge a new era of psychiatry by applying scientific rigor to psychedelics, with the goal of developing accessible treatments that unlock healing at scale.

Our lead product candidate, lysergide tartrate (our proprietary orally disintegrating tablet form of lysergide (LSD) D-tartrate), represents a highly differentiated, potential best-in-class opportunity for patients suffering from generalized anxiety, major depressive disorder, and posttraumatic stress disorder. Our early stage pipeline includes DT402, the R-enantiomer of MDMA and is under development to target the core symptoms of autism spectrum disorder (ASD), specifically addressing social communication challenges.

Guided by the recognition that patients deserve more than better, Definium is relentlessly advancing a new generation of therapeutics intended to address the underlying causes of psychiatric and neurological disorders. By turning evidence into impact, Definium aims to change the trajectory of today’s mental health care crisis and enable a healthier future. Headquartered in New York, Definium Therapeutics trades on Nasdaq under the symbol DFTX.

Together we are moving psychiatry forward—beyond better, into a boundless future. Join us!

This is a high-impact, foundational leadership role reporting to the VP of Sales. You will own the end-to-end strategy and execution of sales training and capability development for a novel CNS product that will require deep scientific fluency, nuanced patient and HCP engagement, and rigorous compliance. You will shape how our future sales organization and adjacent commercial field teams master the science, the patient journey, competitive differentiation, and the unique considerations of bringing a novel psychedelic therapy to market. Success in this role will directly influence launch readiness, field force excellence, and long-term commercial performance.

Location: Fully remote within the U.S., with frequent travel required. A significant portion of training delivery and team collaboration will occur at our Philadelphia office; therefore, candidates based in or near the Philadelphia area are strongly preferred.

Responsibilities:

• Design and lead a comprehensive sales training curriculum covering product knowledge, clinical data, disease-state education (GAD, MDD), competitive landscape, objection handling, account management, and compliant promotional practices

• Build training programs tailored to the unique aspects of DT120 ODT, including administration considerations, clinical observation, patient selection, and the evolving regulatory and market access environment

• Partner closely with Commercial Leadership, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Compliance, and Legal to ensure training content is scientifically accurate, strategically aligned, and fully compliant

• Develop and deliver high-impact live, virtual, and digital training experiences for new-hire onboarding, ongoing skill development, launch readiness, and continuous learning— with substantial in-person delivery expected at the Philadelphia office and other locations as needed

• Lead the sales training function, leveraging external partners and vendors as needed to deliver high-quality programs; establish best-in-class processes, tools, and metrics for training effectiveness and field capability

• Create measurement frameworks to assess knowledge retention, behavioral change, and business impact; use data and field feedback to continuously refine programs

• Support sales leadership in coaching frameworks, performance management, and the development of sales managers as trainers and coaches.

• Drive a culture of excellence, curiosity, and patient-centricity across the commercial organization

• Contribute to broader commercial readiness planning and serve as a key voice on field capability needs

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, life sciences, education, or related) preferred

• Minimum 12 years of progressive experience in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry within the commercial function, including but not limited to; sales training, sales excellence, and or commercial capability development

• Experience in leading successful sales training initiatives, product launch initiatives, leadership development, curriculum design and training evaluation

• Proven track record building or scaling training functions in specialty, CNS, psychiatry, or complex therapeutic areas required; experience with novel modalities, launch products, or highly regulated spaces is highly valued

• Deep understanding of adult learning principles, instructional design, and modern training delivery methods (live, virtual, e-learning, simulations, role-play, etc.)

• Experience in managing consultants and vendor relationships to ensure effective design and implementation of training solutions

• Strong scientific acumen and ability to translate complex clinical data into compelling, compliant field narratives

jobs.title: Director, Test Engineering
jobs.description:
ABOUT OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance.




THE ROLE

We're looking for a Director of Test Engineering to develop and industrialize the test solutions required to support OLIX's next-generation AI computing solution. You'll own manufacturing test strategy, test architecture, equipment, automation, and test processes across component, subsystem, and final product test, ensuring scalable test capability that meets quality, coverage, cycle time, and cost objectives from NPI through high-volume manufacturing.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Develop manufacturing test strategy: Define the end-to-end manufacturing test strategy, architecture, coverage, and requirements across component, subsystem, and final product test.

Develop and qualify test solutions: Design, integrate, validate, and qualify test equipment, fixtures, instrumentation, software, and automation required for production.

Deliver production test readiness: Partner with Engineering, NPI, Quality, Industrial Engineering, and manufacturing partners to develop test processes and ensure test capability is ready for manufacturing launch.

Optimize test performance: Improve test coverage, repeatability, throughput, cycle time, yield, and cost while reducing false failures and unnecessary test content.

Scale test manufacturing capability: Deploy, qualify, and sustain test solutions with manufacturing partners to support production ramp and high-volume manufacturing.




SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Optical Engineering, or related technical discipline.

 - 15+ years of engineering leadership experience in Test Engineering, Manufacturing Test, or Product Test within semiconductor, photonics, electronics, or advanced computing, including at least five years leading teams.

 - Subject matter expertise in manufacturing test architecture, test equipment, instrumentation, fixtures, automation, and test software.

 - Experience developing and qualifying test solutions for complex electrical, optical, and high-speed products from NPI through high-volume manufacturing.

 - Proven success optimizing test coverage, yield, throughput, cycle time, repeatability, and cost.

 - Experience developing automated test systems and analyzing test data to identify failures, improve test capability, and drive manufacturing performance.

 - Proven ability to partner with contract manufacturers to deploy, qualify, and scale production test capability.

 - Exceptional leadership, communication, and relationship-building skills with the ability to influence executive stakeholders and build high-performing teams.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Optical Engineering, or another advanced technical discipline.

 - Experience with high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, photonics, or advanced AI compute hardware.

 - Six Sigma or other advanced continuous improvement certification.




COMPENSATION & EQUITY

 - Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location

 - Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You’re not just joining the mission; you’re owning a piece of it

 - Proximity Bonus: We value your time. To minimise your commute and maximise your life, we offer an annual Living-Local Bonus if your residence is within 20 minutes of the office

 - Retirement Benefits: Employer-contributed retirement plans to help you build long-term financial security

Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates’ eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. We are generally unable to consider applicants whose most recent citizenship or permanent residence is in certain restricted countries (currently including Iran, North Korea, Syria, Cuba, Russia, Belarus, China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Venezuela). Applicants who have subsequently obtained citizenship or permanent residency in another country not subject to these restrictions may still be eligible.

jobs.title: Procurement Excellence Lead
jobs.description:
We are LOTTE BIOLOGICS! Delivering Therapies That Enable a Healthier World.

A new company, built on 80 years of tradition. We embody our core values of being Inspired by Science, Embracing Diversity, Fostering Talent, and Connecting Lives. Our mission is to be the most trusted partner in the industry, with high standards of quality and continuous innovation, to reliably deliver benefits for patients worldwide.

Position Summary

The Procurement Excellence Lead will support procurement operations, contract management, supplier management, data governance, and cost analysis in Syracuse, NY. This role will help strengthen contract visibility, procurement KPIs, dashboards, cost reduction tracking, and reporting tools while providing data-driven insights to support decision-making and cross-functional accountability.

Duties & Responsibilities

• Establish procurement standards, improve operational visibility, and drive accountability across procurement processes, with emphasis on contract management, supplier performance, reporting discipline, and cross-functional execution.

• Serve as the technical owner for procurement KPIs, metrics, dashboards, and reporting tools, including development, maintenance, and continuous improvement.

• Own procurement contract tracking and visibility, including contract data accuracy, obligation tracking, renewal and expiration awareness, KPI linkage, risk identification, and escalation of gaps or issues with supporting analysis.

• Lead assigned procurement initiatives and new supplier contract activities, coordinating stakeholders through RFQ support, vendor selection, NDA execution, contract review, negotiation support, and launch readiness.

• Establish supplier performance scorecards and review cadences, including supplier business reviews, to define meaningful metrics, interpret performance trends, and recommend actions that improve supplier accountability and business outcomes.

• Initiate vendor setup activities, coordinate required information across stakeholders, and establish data tracking, KPI, and governance expectations for new vendors.

• Lead invoicing governance by coordinating monthly invoice review meetings, owning invoicing trackers, establishing invoice-related KPIs and metrics, analyzing issue trends, and driving timely resolution with internal stakeholders and vendors.

• Prepare supplier and category spend analyses, monitor contract activity, track savings and cost reduction plans against goals, and identify cost avoidance, cost reduction, or process improvement opportunities.

• Collect, analyze, and visualize procurement and supplier performance data using tools such as SAP, Ariba, Excel, and related reporting platforms to support decision-making.

• Manage assigned procurement improvement projects to drive process efficiency, compliance, supplier performance, and operational visibility.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with site project teams and internal stakeholders to support procurement planning, contract readiness, supplier engagement, issue resolution, and timely execution of site priorities.

• Provide indirect leadership through training, coaching, and knowledge sharing on procurement best practices, tools, KPI interpretation, data discipline, and process expectations to support consistency, compliance, and adoption across stakeholder groups.

• Manage other activities to support site goals in procurement or supply chain as assigned.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, or a related field preferred; equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience will be considered.

• 5+ years of related experience in procurement, supply chain, quality, manufacturing, or a regulated operations environment.

• Experience supporting procurement activities such as sourcing, contracting, contract review, supplier management, purchase order processes, spend analysis, cost analysis, savings tracking, cost reduction initiatives, or invoice issue resolution.

• Experience using SAP, Ariba, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Power BI, or similar business systems and reporting tools to support procurement operations and data management.

• Experience working in a cGMP, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, manufacturing, or other regulated environment preferred.

• Professional certification such as CPIM, CSCP, CPSM, or equivalent supply chain/procurement certification preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

• Strong procurement knowledge and commercial acumen, including contracting, sourcing, and negotiations, and the ability to apply procurement best practices to support compliant, cost-effective, and timely business decisions.

• Strong data analysis, reporting, and visualization skills, with the ability to interpret procurement, contract, supplier, spend, and operational data and translate findings into clear insights, cost reduction opportunities, recommendations, and actions.

• Working knowledge of Lean methodologies and continuous improvement practices.

• Ability to prioritize, organize, and manage multiple concurrent tasks, projects, requests, and stakeholder needs in a fast-paced and changing environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate meetings, present data clearly, document decisions, align stakeholders, and communicate issues, risks, and recommendations effectively.

• Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally across departments, site project teams, vendors, and procurement stakeholders to achieve shared goals.

• Ability to influence without direct authority.

• Working knowledge of SAP/ERP system, Ariba, Sharepoint, PowerBI.

• Professional (CPIM, CSCP APICS) certification is desirable.

Physical Demands

• Prolonged periods of sitting and working at a computer while reviewing contracts, analyzing data, preparing reports, and participating in meetings.

• Frequent use of standard office equipment, including computers, telephones, printers, and audiovisual equipment.

• Ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, and through virtual collaboration platforms.

• Occasionally required to walk through manufacturing, warehouse, laboratory, and operational areas to support supplier activities, project initiatives, audits, investigations, or cross-functional meetings.

• Ability to move between office and operational areas throughout the facility.

• May occasionally lift and/or move materials weighing up to 15 pounds.

• Ability to travel domestically on an occasional basis to support supplier meetings, audits, business reviews, conferences, or company initiatives.

Work Environment

• Primary work environment is an office setting within a cGMP-regulated pharmaceutical and biotechnology manufacturing facility.

• Regular interaction with cross-functional teams including Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, Facilities, Validation, Project Management, and other business stakeholders.

• Occasional presence in manufacturing, laboratory, warehouse, and support areas where personal protective equipment (PPE) and adherence to site safety and cGMP requirements may be required.

• Work is performed in a fast-paced environment supporting commercial operations and client-focused priorities within a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO).

• Must maintain compliance with all company policies, safety requirements, quality standards, data integrity expectations, and regulatory requirements.

• May be required to work outside of normal business hours on a limited basis to support critical business initiatives, supplier escalations, audits, or project deadlines.

Travel

Less than 5% travel is required for this position.

Target Bonus

10%

Work Location:

East Syracuse, NY

New York Pay Range

$85,000—$118,000 USD

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity (“EEO”) Employer.

We believe that women, people of color, veterans and LGBTQ communities must participate in the work we do, so we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of underrepresented communities!  If this is the work that you want to do, in a culture of inclusion and excellence with the goal of making our world to be a healthier place, then please apply today!

jobs.title: Groundskeeper
jobs.description:
We have a fantastic Groundskeeper opportunity available!

Weinstein Properties, headquartered in Richmond, Virginia owns and manages over 60 apartment communities in Virginia, North Carolina, Texas, Tennessee, and Georgia. Still owned and operated by the Weinstein family after 70+ years, our continued success is attributed to our hands on approach to daily operations and our focus on the customer experience.

Location: Bexley at Brier Creek - Raleigh, NC

Groundskeeper Pay: Hourly rates are competitive (starting at $16/hour) + Quarterly Bonuses

Bonus*: Currently eligible for a $1000 stay on bonus after 90 days and in good standing. (*For the stay on bonus - the recruiter can discuss the details. Stay with us and be awesome and you get this great bonus!)

Benefits: Rent discount, paid holidays, birthday time off, vacation and sick time, health, dental and vision insurance, Employee Assistance Program, 401k with company match

Groundskeeper Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8am - 5pm

Who should apply?

This role is ideal for someone who is reliable, detail-oriented, self-motivated, and takes pride in their work. Groundskeepers are essential members of our team, keeping our communities clean, beautiful, and welcoming. At Weinstein Properties, we do things differently. We invest in people, not just resumes. We believe in training talent from the ground up.

Ideal Characteristics of Successful Groundskeepers

• Reliability & Punctuality: Shows up on time, dependable, and trustworthy.

• Independence & Initiative: Works well independently, is a self-starter, and takes initiative to go beyond assigned tasks.

• Attention to Detail: Notices issues proactively and maintains a clean, well-kept appearance of the community.

• Strong Work Ethic: Keeps busy, completes tasks thoroughly, and doesn’t shy away from dirty or repetitive jobs.

• Team Player: Communicates and collaborates well with maintenance and leasing teams; helps out when needed without hesitation.

• Positive Attitude & Pride in Work: Takes pride in maintaining the property and contributes to community appearance.

• Adaptable & Versatile: Willing to take on various responsibilities such as light painting, housekeeping tasks, or supporting maintenance as needed.

• Growth Mindset: Open to learning new skills, with potential to grow into maintenance tech or other roles.

Things Candidates Should Know Before Starting

• You will get dirty: Tasks include picking up trash, cleaning pet waste stations, trashing out apartments, and other potentially unpleasant (but necessary) duties.

• Repetition is part of the job: Many tasks (like picking up litter and pet waste) are daily, recurring responsibilities.

• Opportunity for Growth: Team members with a great attitude and willingness to learn can grow into more advanced roles in maintenance.

• This is a physically demanding role:. This position requires prolonged periods of standing and walking while performing tasks, frequently lifting and carrying items weighing up to 50 pounds or more, using hand tools and operating equipment (including backpack blowers, power washers), operating golf carts/trailers, frequently bending and stooping for planting, weeding and maintenance of outdoor spaces, and working in conditions with loud noise levels at times. This position also requires working outdoors year-round in potentially inclement weather conditions (i.e. heat, cold, rain, humidity). The person in this position must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation.

Weinstein Properties is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Gestor de Carteira e Reporte de Risco
jobs.description:
Identificar, analisar, avaliar e integrar o risco-país, recorrendo a conhecimentos especializados nas áreas social, económica, política ou noutras áreas relacionadas, de modo a formar uma visão temática de questões complexas de crédito para integração nas carteiras de risco-país, em consonância com os interesses e requisitos mais amplos do grupo.

Funções Essenciais

Analisar, avaliar e integrar o risco de concentração por país ao nível do Grupo e da carteira de atacado, através da interação com os responsáveis pelos tipos de risco e pelos negócios ou setores e, quando necessário, com partes interessadas externas, tais como agências de notação de risco e entidades reguladoras, a fim de compreender e identificar riscos que possam influenciar alterações na carteira.

Estabelecer e desenvolver relações em toda a estrutura do Grupo com várias partes interessadas, de modo a garantir que a gestão do risco da carteira e a comunicação associada sejam eficazes, apoiar a colmatação de lacunas na comunicação e no envolvimento das partes interessadas e apoiar as principais partes interessadas através da experiência e dos conhecimentos adquiridos.

Identificar, analisar, avaliar e integrar o risco-país (seja ele de natureza social, económica, política ou outras questões relacionadas) para permitir a definição de estratégias e ajustamentos de apetite de risco e de risco da carteira, com vista à sua implementação a nível nacional e ao alinhamento em todo o Grupo.

Propor o apetite de risco país e soberano, bem como análises de risco país, que sirvam de base para a aprovação do apetite de risco no PRMC (Comité de Gestão de Risco da Carteira) e no Govco (Comité de Governação), duas vezes por ano.

Manter-se a par dos desenvolvimentos do setor e do mercado, participando em debates, investigação e outras atividades (tais como formações e seminários), de modo a manter-se a par dos conhecimentos específicos do setor e dos principais desenvolvimentos e tendências do mercado, dos riscos, da economia e do setor, em relação às carteiras e aos riscos a elas associados.

Apoiar e contribuir para o desenvolvimento e implementação de uma perspetiva de gestão de risco de carteira a nível do grupo, que inclua visões adequadas do risco de carteira dos diferentes setores do banco, de modo a garantir o alinhamento e a adoção dos aspetos relativos ao risco-país nas áreas de Clientes por Grosso, Clientes Comerciais, Clientes de Retalho e Clientes de Elevado Património Líquido com os do grupo em geral.

Apoiar as equipas locais, sempre que necessário, na execução da estratégia de negócio do país e nas revisões dos seus indicadores de apetite de risco-país no âmbito do PRMC.

Gestão de risco de carteira

5 a 7 anosInteresse e conhecimentos especializados em análise e modelação de riscos, bem como experiência em gestão de riscos num banco. É obrigatória a experiência no mercado Angolano e noutros mercados africanos

jobs.title: Product Manager - QA & Release Coordination (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As a Product Manager at Reonic, you’ll sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and our customers.

You’ll help make sure new features are tested thoroughly, releases run smoothly, and customer feedback continuously makes its way back into the product development process.

You’ll have a lot of ownership and work closely with engineers and other teams to improve both our product and the way we build and release it.

Please note: This is a fully onsite role in Augsburg.


What you'll do

 - Own release testing: Coordinate testing for upcoming releases and continuously test new features during development. Identify issues early and provide clear, actionable feedback to engineering.

 - Coordinate software releases: Keep track of features, changes, dependencies, and release timelines. Act as a communication hub between product, engineering, and other teams.

 - Improve product quality: Look beyond whether a feature technically works. Think about edge cases, usability, customer workflows, and how changes affect the overall product experience.

 - Turn feedback into action: Triage user feedback and bug reports, investigate issues, reproduce problems, and translate findings into clear, well-described tickets for engineering.

 - Communicate what's new: Create release notes, run internal demos, and make sure colleagues understand what has changed and how new functionality works.

 - Work closely with engineering: Collaborate with engineers throughout the development process, ask the right questions, and help remove ambiguity before features reach customers.

 - Understand our customers: Build a deep understanding of the businesses using Reonic and use that context to make better product decisions.


What Makes You a Great Fit

 - Product mindset: You naturally think beyond checklists. You want to understand why something is being built, who it is for, and what makes it useful.

 - Attention to detail: You spot inconsistencies, edge cases, and potential issues before they become customer problems.

 - Strong communication: You can clearly communicate with engineers, product colleagues, and other stakeholders. Professional fluency in English (C1+) is required.

 - Technical curiosity: You enjoy understanding how software works and aren't afraid to dig into technical details, investigate bugs, or learn new concepts.

 - Customer orientation: You care about the experience of the people using the product and can turn qualitative feedback into actionable insights.

 - Ownership: You take responsibility, follow things through, and don't wait for someone else to solve a problem that you can help solve yourself.

 - Startup mindset: You’re comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and processes are still being built.

 - Relevant experience: Experience in product management, product operations, QA, software development, B2B SaaS, or a similar role is a plus. A degree in economics, engineering, computer science, or a related field is also helpful, but not required.



Why Join Us?

 - Real impact: Help build software that enables businesses to accelerate the transition to renewable energy.

 - A product people use: Our platform is already used by 3,000+ paying B2B customers, giving you the opportunity to work on a product with real users and real-world impact.

 - High ownership: We’re a growing company, and nothing is set in stone. You’ll have plenty of room to shape how we work and how the product evolves.

 - Fast-moving environment: Work closely with engineering and other teams, make decisions quickly, and see your work reach customers.

 - A great international team: We work hard, learn from each other, and make sure we have fun along the way.

 - Great setup: MacBook, gym membership subsidy, regular team events, coffee, Deutschland ticket and other perks.

 - Competitive compensation: We offer competitive pay based on your experience and responsibilities.


Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply! Imposter syndrome shouldn't hold you back— we value talent and passion above all.



ABOUT REONIC

At Reonic, we’re on a mission to simplify renewable technology.

Our AI operating system helps renewable energy installers run and grow their businesses — from planning and selling solar, battery storage, and heat pump solutions to managing their day-to-day operations.

Today, more than 3,000 businesses use Reonic, and we’re growing fast.


Location

Ready to shape the future of renewable energy? Apply now!

The Principal Executive Compensation Analyst is a senior-level compensation professional responsible for the design, administration, analysis, and governance of executive compensation programs for senior leaders and executives. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in executive compensation, equity and stock-based compensation, market benchmarking, governance, and compensation disclosures. The position requires strong analytical capabilities, exceptional attention to detail, executive presence, and the ability to manage highly confidential information.

Executive Compensation Strategy & Administration

• Support the design, implementation, and administration of executive compensation programs, including:
• Base salary
• Annual incentive plans (STI)
• Long-term incentive programs (LTI)
• Equity and stock-based awards
• Executive retention programs
• Conduct market analyses using executive compensation surveys and external benchmark data.

Board and Compensation Committee Support

Analytics & Reporting

• Analyze compensation trends, pay equity considerations, retention risks, and incentive outcomes.
• Deliver insights and recommendations to senior HR and business leaders.
• Serve as a subject matter expert on executive compensation matters.
