JOB SUMMARY
The Learning and Development Specialist is responsible for designing, implementing, and evaluating learning programs and initiatives to foster employee development and enhance organizational performance that are specific to the position.  The position leads the development and administration of on-the-job training (OJT) programs that support employee onboarding, skill development, qualification, and career progression.
Working closely with production supervisors and subject matter experts, this position establishes training pathways, competency verification processes, skills matrices, and employee qualification standards to ensure consistent training delivery and workforce readiness across departments and shifts. The position monitors program effectiveness through both qualitative and quantitative measures, including training records, competency attainment, KPI alignment, employee interactions, and feedback from department managers throughout the organization. 
This position ensures accurate training records, qualification documentation, and competency verification processes are maintained to support operational, quality, and safety requirements. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who enjoys working with people, is highly organized and detail-oriented, and is comfortable balancing multiple priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment. 
 
COMPANY OVERVIEW
Component Repair Technologies, Inc. (CRT) began as a locally family-owned business, with operations in Mentor, OH since 1985, and grew into a global leader (500+ employees) in the aerospace MRO sector.  Specializing in the repair and overhaul of turbine engine components, CRT proudly serves the world’s largest airlines and jet engine manufacturers. Component Repair Technologies is focused on our valued employees, customers, and community. 
In 2025, CRT became a Safran Aircraft Engines company as a Center of Excellence for the repair of large jet engine parts in the Americas.
For over 120 years, Safran, through its Aircraft Engines subsidiary, designs, produces, markets and supports, alone or in partnership, aircraft engines offering world-class performance and reliability. Its core purpose is to contribute to a safer, more sustainable world, where air transport is more environmentally friendly, comfortable and accessible.
Operating through CFM International, its 50/50 joint venture with GE Aerospace, Safran Aircraft Engines is the world’s leading supplier of single-aisle commercial jet engines, the CFM56 and LEAP. Safran Aircraft Engines is fully committed to sustainable aviation through the RISE (Revolutionary Innovation for Sustainable Engines) technology development program. Safran Aircraft Engines also deploys a global network providing a full range of support, maintenance & repair services. 
Visit www.componentrepair.com and www.safran-group.com for more information. Take-off in your career, learn new skills and become part of a world-class workforce.

Follow established safety protocols and guidelines to ensure full compliance with company safety policies and procedures.

We’re building the next generation of outbound: AI-first, multi-channel, highly personalized, and deeply integrated into the way modern sales teams work.

And we’re just getting started.



As a Senior Product Designer at lemlist, you’ll work hand in hand with Senior Product Managers and Senior Developers across squads to deliver meaningful impact for our users. You’ll own design from problem discovery to shipping, and help shape the future of Sales tech.



You will:

 - Develop a deep understanding of our market, industry, users, company, and product vision

 - Dig beneath the surface to uncover real problems and opportunities

 - Own the delivery process with Product Managers: from discovery to launch, ensuring users feel the impact

 - Identify problems, proactively suggest improvements, and help shape the roadmap

 - Own the overall quality of the product by driving consistency, simplicity and ease of use

 - Create world-class design experiences that position lemlist as the leading software in our space

 - Be hands-on, move fast, and learn fast, whether working within a squad or shipping directly to users

 - Work and switch between multiple opportunities

 - Shape what the future of Product Design looks like (including AI)

 - Shape what the future of Sales looks like (including AI)

 - Make your role evolve based on where you believe you can create more value
   
   

We’re not looking for designers who:

 - Only deliver Figma files

 - Wait for instructions instead of being proactive

 - Are uncomfortable speaking with users or digging into real value creation

 - Don’t make user impact their priority

 - Enjoy their comfort zone

 - Spend more time in processes and complexe methodologies than bringing value to users
   
   

What’s in it for you:

 - Drive innovation in the Sales tech space

 - Work with only senior talents

 - Challenge the statut quo of the industry

 - A lot of autonomy on how your squad should thrive to be successful

 - A place where best ideas win

 - A remote friendly environment

 - A chance to work with an innovative, fast-paced team with a bias for action
   
   


KEY RESULTS


WITHIN 3 MONTHS YOU WILL HAVE:

 - Gained a deep understanding of our product, industry, and vision

 - Built relationships with lemlist users, and have a deep understanding of them

 - Owned the entire delivery process from end to end

 - Successfully created value for users


WITHIN 12 MONTHS YOU WILL HAVE:

 - Launched solutions that positively impact users and the company’s revenue

 - Established yourself as an industry expert with deep insight into our customers

 - Influenced and improved the roadmap

 - Helped shape the future of lemlist and Sales prospection
   
   


PREFERRED EXPERIENCE


MUST HAVE

 - You have 4+ years of experience in Product Design. Scale-up experience is preferred.

 - You have a big bias for action → You are a “débrouillard”, and understand the value of speed & execution

 - Strong communication skills

 - Fluency in English & French

 - Strong pragmatism and good taste for software

 - Solid knowledge of SaaS markets & mechanisms

 - Strong business acumen

 - Ability to inspire and lead teams

 - Humility, curiosity, passion and a growth mindset


NICE TO HAVE

 - Ability to easily process and synthesize information

 - Experience in Sales tech

 - High tech literacy

 - Background in Sales or Operations

 - Background in Product Management
   
   

Recruitment process

 - Interview with Victoire our Talent Acquisition Manager

 - Interview with Kévin, our VP of Product & Design

 - Interview with Mael, our CPO

 - Business Case (async.) + Live Q&A with Maël & Kevin

 - Interview with Charles, our CEO

 - Reference Check

 - Offer
   
   

We value people’s work and believe the best way to assess people is by looking at their work. Whether it's real or fake work, we don’t care. We want to see what you can ship.

If you “don’t have time” to show some of your work (even a Figma link), it’s probably not the right place for you.

jobs.title: Payment Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

The Payment Operations team powers the accurate, timely, and secure movement of funds across the entire Raisin U.S. platform. As a multi-bank deposit marketplace supporting high-yield savings accounts, CDs, and a centralized cash account, Raisin facilitates inbound and outbound ACH transactions, reinvestments, and internal money movement across partner banks, custodial banks, and service bank relationships.

Payment Operations owns the end-to-end payment lifecycle: transaction processing, multi-entity settlement, ledger reconciliation, exception resolution, and operational risk mitigation. The team works hand-in-hand with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Custodial and Service Banks and other partners to build scalable financial infrastructure.

As Raisin expands, we are focused on designing a flexible operational architecture capable of supporting a broader multi-rail payment ecosystem.

Your Responsibilities

The Payment Operations Analyst will be responsible for the day to day execution and operational effectiveness of payments processes, payment accuracy, timeliness and reconciliation, across all of our deposit products. In this role, the analyst will work closely with the engineering and the product team to identify issues and address them on a timely basis to ensure timely and accurate payment processing, and reconciliation.

This role, given the need for accurate, timely payments and ledger accuracy expectations, requires individuals who are self driven, display great accountability for their work, and can operate with autonomy.

• Display high accountability to payment process timeliness, accuracy and reconciliation. Reconcile accounts and resolve payment-related issues promptly and accurately, ensuring timely payment processing.

• Be proactive in identifying payment processing or reconciliation issues, escalate appropriately, and take accountability to working with required operating partners to resolve the issue.

• Monitor payment processing activity diligently to identify and address any signs of fraudulent or suspicious behavior.

• Analyze existing operational processes, identify areas for enhancement, and develop actionable recommendations to optimize efficiency.

• Collaborate closely with engineering, product, service, partner banks, service bank and custodial banks to resolve payment and reconciliation issues and to implement process and productivity improvements.

• Establish, monitor and achieve critical payment operations success metrics.

• Identify opportunities for payment process automation and partner with product and engineering teams to implement automation solutions.

• Conduct data analysis to generate valuable insights and provide strategic recommendations to leadership.

• Support customer service and finance teams by addressing operational inquiries and issues effectively.

• Create, follow and maintain precise and comprehensive documentation for operational processes and procedures.

Your Profile

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field.

• Strong knowledge of financial products, services, regulations, and compliance.

• 2+ years of experience in operations analysis or a similar role within the fintech or financial services industry.

• Meticulous and extremely detail oriented approach to work.

• Exceptional analytical skills to evaluate complex data and provide actionable recommendations.

• Proven experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to implement process improvements.

• Proficiency in process automation and data visualization tools such as Excel, Looker, SQL, etc.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to excel both independently and collaboratively in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

Raisin US

• Flexible working hours and up to 28 days PTO accrued from your first month, plus 13 public holidays.

• Employee Development Budget of $2,200 and 4 full training days per year.

• Company 401k contribution of 5%.

• Healthcare coverage contribution, including medical, dental and vision.

• Commuter benefits and flexible working from home policy.

• Regular team events and yearly Summer and Winter Party.

Salary Range

$80,000—$100,000 USD

Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer - Developer Platform
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Lisbon, Portugal

About the Role:

Do you love solving complex problems and interacting with people? Are you passionate about helping customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking a Technical Customer Support Engineer to join our team. You will work with our customers on a variety of technical support issues as well as the Technical Operations team that is responsible for running our global distributed network. This is a position where you will learn the inner workings of Cloudflare's technology and gain a deeper understanding of internet technologies. You will focus on providing support on our Developer Platform products: Workers, Workers AI, Pages, KV, Stream, R2, D1, DO etc.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience:

• You are familiar with Developer Platform products

• You have previous experience working as part of a team in a customer-facing role

• You have experience solving HTTP, DNS and other networking-related problems

• You have experience with a common web development language (for example, Javascript)

• You understand how the Internet works

• You have experience working in a support role where you thrived every time you resolved a ticket

• You are comfortable communicating through various support channels and always put the customer first (Emails, Live Chats, Phone calls and virtual meetings)

• You are a motivated self-starter and always looking to expand your existing skill set

Bonus Points

• You are fluent in German, Japanese, French, Spanish, Portuguese or Mandarin

• You are familiar with Cloudflare and have a site actively using our platform

• You have a solid grasp of problem-solving with command line tools (curl/dig/traceroute/tcpdump)

• You are familiar with Nginx, Apache, IIS or any other web servers

• You are committed to gaining a deeper understanding of the following technologies: DNS / CDN - Cache / SSL / Cloudflare Workers

• You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL or other database servers

• You have experience with Cloudflare Workers and/or JavaScript

• You have experience with Video encoding and streaming solutions

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

• For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €37,000-51,000.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.title: Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) Specialist
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY
The Learning and Development Specialist is responsible for designing, implementing, and evaluating learning programs and initiatives to foster employee development and enhance organizational performance that are specific to the position.  The position leads the development and administration of on-the-job training (OJT) programs that support employee onboarding, skill development, qualification, and career progression.
Working closely with production supervisors and subject matter experts, this position establishes training pathways, competency verification processes, skills matrices, and employee qualification standards to ensure consistent training delivery and workforce readiness across departments and shifts. The position monitors program effectiveness through both qualitative and quantitative measures, including training records, competency attainment, KPI alignment, employee interactions, and feedback from department managers throughout the organization. 
This position ensures accurate training records, qualification documentation, and competency verification processes are maintained to support operational, quality, and safety requirements. The ideal candidate is a self-starter who enjoys working with people, is highly organized and detail-oriented, and is comfortable balancing multiple priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment. 
 
COMPANY OVERVIEW
Component Repair Technologies, Inc. (CRT) began as a locally family-owned business, with operations in Mentor, OH since 1985, and grew into a global leader (500+ employees) in the aerospace MRO sector.  Specializing in the repair and overhaul of turbine engine components, CRT proudly serves the world’s largest airlines and jet engine manufacturers. Component Repair Technologies is focused on our valued employees, customers, and community. 
In 2025, CRT became a Safran Aircraft Engines company as a Center of Excellence for the repair of large jet engine parts in the Americas.
For over 120 years, Safran, through its Aircraft Engines subsidiary, designs, produces, markets and supports, alone or in partnership, aircraft engines offering world-class performance and reliability. Its core purpose is to contribute to a safer, more sustainable world, where air transport is more environmentally friendly, comfortable and accessible.
Operating through CFM International, its 50/50 joint venture with GE Aerospace, Safran Aircraft Engines is the world’s leading supplier of single-aisle commercial jet engines, the CFM56 and LEAP. Safran Aircraft Engines is fully committed to sustainable aviation through the RISE (Revolutionary Innovation for Sustainable Engines) technology development program. Safran Aircraft Engines also deploys a global network providing a full range of support, maintenance & repair services. 
Visit www.componentrepair.com and www.safran-group.com for more information. Take-off in your career, learn new skills and become part of a world-class workforce.
 
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Follow established safety protocols and guidelines to ensure full compliance with company safety policies and procedures.
Create, coordinate, and support structured OJT programs for CRT production employees by partnering with production leaders, supervisors, subject matter experts, and designated OJT trainers to develop position-specific training plans, learning activities, qualification criteria, and competency sign-off processes.
Design, develop, coordinate and deliver training programs that support employee development, operational effectiveness, regulatory compliance, and organizational objectives, including onboarding, on-the-job training (OJT), leadership development, technical skills, and professional development initiatives.
Partner with department managers, supervisors and subject matter experts to assess training needs and skills gaps and develop training plans aligned with departmental goals, position requirements, and workforce development needs.
Evaluate the effectiveness of training programs through feedback, surveys, and other assessment tools and make recommendations for curriculum improvement.
Maintain training records and ensure compliance with company, customer, regulatory, and audit requirements, including FAA Part 145 and other applicable industry standards.
Monitor industry trends and best practices in learning and development to enhance organizational learning initiatives.
Support employee development, career progression, and succession planning initiatives by providing guidance, resources, and visibility to internal development opportunities.
Administer and maintain the Learning Management System (LMS), ensuring accurate tracking of training compliance, employee development, and training-related data.
 
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor’s degree in Education, Learning and Development, Human Resources, Organizational Management, or a related field; or a minimum of two years of experience in a related role within a manufacturing or production environment.
Experience developing or coordinating on-the-job training within a manufacturing or production environment, including training plans, competency verification, employee qualification, and training documentation.
Two to three years of experience in designing, implementing, and evaluating training and professional development programs for young adults and adult learners or relevant experience in a training or educational environment.
Strong interpersonal, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to build effective relationships and work successfully with employees, supervisors, subject matter experts, and other stakeholders.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook.
Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and drive projects to completion.
Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English and communicate effectively with employees at all levels of the organization.
Ability and willingness to support employees on all shifts, including adjusting work schedules as needed to deliver training, conduct observations, and verify competencies.
 
OTHER QUALIFICATIONS
Experience administering and maintaining a Learning Management System (LMS) and using instructional design or content authoring tools such as Articulate 360, Rise, Storyline, or similar platforms.
Experience working with competency-based training, skills matrices, qualification tracking, and workforce development programs.
Previous experience as a trainer, mentor, coach, instructor, or subject matter expert.
Experience creating, editing, and maintaining technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and other materials that support employee training and production operations.
 
 WORK ENVIRONMENT
Safety Sensitive Environment: the successful candidate will be required to follow general shop safety procedures including the occasional use of safety glasses, safety toe shoes, and hearing protection.
Work standing and/or sitting during a normal shift. 
May be required to occasionally lift or move up to 10 pounds.
 
COMPANY BENEFITS
At CRT, our employees and their families are our most valued asset. We offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package that includes:
CRT currently offers two excellent health care options, one being a fully funded program (no premiums for employee and family) and the other being a traditional employee premium contribution.  Programs include health, vision, and dental coverages. Additional programs include short- and long-term disability and life insurance.
The company offers a 401k program with company match.
Continuing education is offered via multiple sources and opportunities with tuition reimbursement based on eligibility requirements.
Traditional paid time off (PTO) is offered via vacation days and personal days.
Multiple shift opportunities with hourly premiums for off-shifts are offered.
To review other benefits, visit our website at www.componentrepair.com/careers or Facebook page www.facebook.com/ComponentRepair  to see, “what we are up to.”
  
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER AND AFFIRMATIVE ACTION PARTICIPATION
Component Repair Technologies, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer, M/F/H/V.
CRT is committed to providing a safe and healthy workplace and promoting the health and well-being of its employees. It is the Company’s policy to only hire individuals who do not use drugs. All candidates will be screened for drug use prior to hire. Employment opportunities at CRT are open to all qualified applicants solely based on their job-related experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. CRT complies with all applicable federal, state and local laws with regard to equal employment opportunity.

jobs.title: Parks & Recreation - Green Stormwater Infrastructure Program Manager
jobs.description:
Philadelphia Parks & Recreation (PPR) seeks a highly qualified and motivated Green Stormwater Infrastructure (GSI) Program Manager to lead implementation of a strategic program to restore underperforming GSI assets, establish a robust asset management system, and advance consistent maintenance practices across the park system. This is a full-time, grant-funded position for 1.5 years, with the possibility of extension contingent on future funding.

The GSI Program Manager will oversee all aspects of program implementation, including asset tracking and inspections, contract management, corrective action planning, community engagement, and the development of a sustainable maintenance framework. The position will work collaboratively across City departments, partner organizations, and community groups to ensure that PPR’s 50+ GSI sites deliver maximum environmental, social, and climate resilience benefits.

This role will play a pivotal part in shaping how PPR manages its growing portfolio of green infrastructure, with responsibilities that include leading a comprehensive GSI condition study across parkland, coordinating digitization of GSI assets, implementing restoration activities, and facilitating community-centered workforce development opportunities. By establishing the value and impact of a dedicated GSI program within PPR, the Program Manager will help lay the groundwork for long-term sustainability of green infrastructure management.

Essential Functions

• Lead implementation of Philadelphia Parks & Recreation’s Green Stormwater Infrastructure (GSI) program, overseeing planning, inspections, restoration, and maintenance activities across the park system.

• Manage a comprehensive GSI condition study on parkland, including field inspections, data analysis, and prioritization of corrective actions based on performance, environmental justice, and community impact criteria.

• Support the development and digitization of Parks & Recreation’s GSI assets within a citywide asset management system by providing data, coordinating updates, and ensuring alignment with department needs.

• Plan and implement corrective actions on underperforming GSI sites, including site restoration, repairs, and replanting, ensuring assets are returned to full function.

• Develop and manage contracts, budgets, and timelines for GSI maintenance and restoration work.

• Design and implement a sustainable maintenance framework that integrates internal staff roles, contracted services, and potential workforce development opportunities.

• Facilitate community and stakeholder engagement processes, including meetings, workshops, and feedback sessions, to ensure community perspectives inform program priorities.

• Collaborate with City departments, external partners, and community groups to align PPR’s GSI work with broader citywide green infrastructure and climate resilience goals.

• Monitor and evaluate program progress, preparing reports and presentations that demonstrate outcomes, challenges, and opportunities for long-term investment.

• Serve as a subject-matter resource on GSI for Parks & Recreation staff, partners, and community members, supporting education and shared stewardship of green infrastructure.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Technical Expertise

• Knowledge of green stormwater infrastructure (GSI) practices, design elements, and maintenance needs.

• Understanding of urban ecology, stormwater management, and environmental justice principles.

• Familiarity with asset management systems, data collection methods, and condition assessments.

Project & Program Management

• Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, and contract administration.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to track multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.

Collaboration & Relationship Management

• Ability to work effectively across City departments, partner organizations, contractors, and community groups.

• Strong skills in building partnerships, fostering collaboration, and managing diverse stakeholder interests.

• Ability to engage with residents and community-based groups in ways that are inclusive, respectful, and responsive.

Communication & Engagement

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

• Skilled in facilitating meetings, workshops, or public engagement sessions.

• Ability to prepare clear and compelling reports, presentations, and recommendations for decision-makers.

Problem-Solving & Innovation

• Ability to assess challenges, identify creative solutions, and adapt to evolving program needs.

• Competence in using data to inform decision-making and prioritize actions.

• Ability to remain flexible as priorities and timelines shift in a dynamic work environment.

We value diverse experiences and are open to flexible qualifications. If you are passionate about this role and meet some of the key criteria, we encourage you to apply.

• Bachelor’s degree in environmental science, environmental engineering, urban planning, landscape architecture, natural resource management, or a related field.

• Equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

• 3–5 years of professional experience in stormwater management, green infrastructure, urban sustainability, or related fields.

• Demonstrated experience with project management, including budgeting, contract administration, and scheduling.
• Experience conducting site inspections, condition assessments, or asset management activities.
• Familiarity with community engagement and stakeholder collaboration in an urban context.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and basic data management tools; experience with GIS or asset management software is a plus.
• Valid PA Driver’s License (Must be able to travel city-wide to program sites)
• Demonstrated experience working collaboratively with diverse stakeholder groups, including government agencies, community organizations, and residents.
• Commitment to equity, diversity, and community empowerment in environmental work.
• Familiarity with the city of Philadelphia and its neighborhoods.

TO APPLY: Interested candidates must submit a resume.

Salary Range: $75,000 - $87,000

Discover the Perks of Being a City of Philadelphia Employee:

• Transportation: City employees get unlimited FREE public transportation all year long through SEPTA’s Key Advantage program. Employees can ride on SEPTA buses, subways, trolleys, and regional rail for their daily commute and more.
• Parental Benefits: The City offers its employees 8 weeks of paid parental leave.
• We offer Comprehensive health coverage for employees and their eligible dependents.
• Our wellness program offers eligibility into the discounted medical plan
• Employees receive paid vacation, sick leave, and holidays

jobs.title: Chauffeur/Private Driver
jobs.description:
About Patrianna

Patrianna is a fast-scaling product development company headquartered in Gibraltar, with a dynamic, global team powering our growth. We operate at the intersection of technology and entertainment, building innovative solutions that shape the future of social gaming and deliver outstanding experiences to millions of players worldwide.

We're driven by speed, ambition, and bold ideas. At our core, we're product creators and problem-solvers who thrive in a high-performance environment. We're looking for exceptional talent—smart, adaptable, and motivated individuals eager to make an impact, scale business functions at pace, and continuously improve.

The Role

This is a varied role where you’ll be responsible for transporting senior team members, executives and visitors across Gibraltar and the surrounding areas, from meetings and appointments to airport transfers and cross-border journeys into Spain.

You’ll be someone who takes pride in being professional, discreet, punctual and dependable, and who understands that the experience matters just as much as getting from A to B.

What you’ll be doing

 - Driving senior team members and executives to meetings, offices, appointments and other destinations, ensuring they arrive safely and on time.

 - Managing airport transfers, including tracking flights and adapting to delays or changes in arrival times.

 - Planning efficient routes around traffic, border queues and changing schedules, using good local knowledge and initiative.

 - Keeping the vehicle in excellent condition, ensuring it is clean, fuelled, serviced and always road-legal.

 - Providing a professional and welcoming experience for executives, clients and visitors — you’ll often be one of the first people they meet.

 - Communicating clearly with the team, including via Slack, and flagging any delays, issues or changes as early as possible.

 - Handling last-minute changes calmly and professionally, using common sense to find the best solution.

What we’re looking for

 - A full, clean driving licence and a strong track record of safe, confident driving.

 - Fluency in English and strong interpersonal and communication skills.

 - Previous experience in a professional driving, private, executive or chauffeur capacity would be highly beneficial.

 - Additional professional driving qualifications or certifications would be a bonus.

 - Exceptional reliability and punctuality - if you say you’ll be there at a certain time, you’re there.

 - Strong knowledge of Gibraltar and the surrounding areas of southern Spain, including key routes and border crossings - or the ability and willingness to learn them quickly.

 - A professional, discreet and approachable manner, particularly when dealing with senior executives and visitors.

 - Good judgement and a calm head under pressure, especially when plans change at short notice.

 - A proactive attitude and the ability to work independently without needing constant direction.﻿

Equal Opportunities

We hire based on skills, drive, and ideas—nothing else. Your background, gender, age, race, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, religion, neurodiversity, or educational path will never be a barrier to joining us. We also welcome candidates from non-traditional career journeys and value diverse perspectives that challenge conventional thinking. Diversity fuels our innovation, collaboration, and growth, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can contribute their best work and thrive.

jobs.title: Senior Tunnel Construction Project Manager
jobs.description:
Join AECOM’s dynamic tunneling team as a Senior Tunnel Construction Project Manager in our Austin, Texas office. This is an opportunity to take a leadership role across two major Central Texas infrastructure projects, including an ongoing large-scale TBM drainage tunnel project and a separate   drainage tunnel pump station project.. You will serve as a senior point of contact for the client while leading multidisciplinary construction teams through complex project delivery, with a strong focus on safety, quality, schedule, cost, constructability and commissioning.

This role is ideal for a construction leader who understands the complexities of major tunnel and underground infrastructure projects and enjoys working directly with clients, contractors, designers, and field teams. You will help guide delivery of critical infrastructure while addressing the unique challenges associated with TBM operations, underground construction, dewatering, pump station facilities, drainage tunnels, and coordination with TXDOT and other project stakeholders. The position offers a hybrid work model with opportunities for significant field and client engagement.

Key Responsibilities

• Direct and manage construction activities across two major infrastructure projects, providing leadership to project managers, construction managers, field staff, and multidisciplinary teams.
• Provide senior construction leadership for an ongoing large-scale TBM tunnel project, coordinating project activities and design reviews associated with underground excavation, tunnel construction, support systems, and related infrastructure.
• Lead construction management activities for a separate project involving drainage tunnel pump station infrastructure, coordinating design reviews, construction sequencing, interfaces, commissioning requirements, and operational considerations.
• Serve as a primary liaison between AECOM, the client, and designers while maintaining strong communication regarding project progress, risks, cost, schedule, quality, value engineering, and construction issues.
• Coordinate closely with TXDOT, contractors, design teams, inspectors, and other stakeholders to resolve construction issues and maintain alignment with project requirements and applicable TXDOT standards.
• Maintain accountability for delivery of all facets of the constructed projects in accordance with the design, contract requirements, budget, schedule, safety expectations, and quality standards.
• Lead project planning and execution across the full construction life cycle, including pre-construction budgeting and scheduling, procurement, construction, facility start-up and operations, commissioning, and contract closeout.
• Manage construction scheduling, sequencing and interfaces between tunneling operations, pump station facilities, drainage infrastructure, utilities, surface improvements, and other project elements.
• Work with the client and project teams to identify and address value engineering concepts, construction risks, changes, claims, schedule impacts, cost issues, and constructability concerns.
• Provide leadership in coordinating client maintenance and operational requirements, helping ensure construction activities are planned around existing facilities, infrastructure, and ongoing client operations.
• Establish and maintain project controls for budget, schedule, cost forecasting, change management, risk, and overall project performance.
• Provide guidance and mentoring to subordinate managers and project personnel while leading a diverse team of construction professionals.
• Enforce AECOM and project-specific policies, procedures, safety requirements, quality standards, and contractual obligations throughout project delivery.
• Support client engagement, project reporting, issue resolution, and strategic decision-making at the senior project level.
• Lead coordination during facility start-up, testing, commissioning, and transition to operations, including resolution of outstanding construction and operational issues.
• Maintain primary fiscal responsibility for the assigned projects and proactively manage financial performance, risks, and opportunities for both the client and AECOM.

Minimum Requirements

• BA/BS + 10 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• BA/BS and 10+ years of relevant experience in tunnel and pump station construction or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• Registered professional engineer in the State of Texas.

Preferred Qualifications

• Project Manager for projects with construction costs exceeding $500 million USD including employee management of a diverse pool of professionals.
• Extensive knowledge of Texas DOT standard specifications.
• Some knowledge of AASHTOWare Project – Construction & Materials.
• Extensive knowledge of budget management and risks for the client and AECOM.
• 10+ years' experience in managing the entire project including direct client interface

• Relocation support may be available for qualified candidates and may include temporary monthly housing assistance as part of an approved relocation package.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. jobs.title: Senior Staff Digital Engineer
jobs.description:
Renesas is seeking an experienced Senior Staff Digital Engineer to lead verification and evidence

development for control-loop features and functions in advanced digital power management products

used in AI, datacenter, and high-performance computing applications.

This role focuses on proving that specific control-loop features behave as intended across requirements,

behavioral models, digital implementation, analog interactions, simulation, emulation, bench validation,

and silicon.

The successful candidate will translate feature intent into measurable test plans, define clear pass/fail

criteria, develop reusable verification methods, and correlate results across engineering environments.

The role requires a strong understanding of digital control loops, mixed-signal behavior, power-system

dynamics, data analysis, and verification automation.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on control-loop expertise with disciplined verification and the

ability to identify and resolve differences between expected behavior, implementation results, and

measured performance.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Build clear, repeatable evidence that control-loop features and functions operate as intended.

Improve confidence in feature and architecture decisions by connecting requirements, models,

implementation, tests, and measured results.

Identify feature-level gaps and unexpected interactions before they become product or customer issues.

Create reusable verification methods that improve engineering quality and reduce repeated manual

testing.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead verification and evidence development for digital control-loop features and functions.

Translate feature requirements and system intent into measurable verification plans, test scenarios, and

pass/fail criteria.

Verify control-loop behavior across operating conditions, configurations, limits, sequencing, and corner

cases.

Develop tests covering compensation, stability, bandwidth, transient response, latency, sampling,

quantization, saturation, limits, mode transitions, sensing behavior, telemetry, and feature interactions.

Correlate feature behavior across behavioral models, RTL, analog/mixed-signal simulation, emulation,

bench validation, and silicon measurements where applicable.

Evaluate interactions between digital loop functions and analog components, including sensing paths,

ADCs, DACs, references, PWM generation, timing paths, and power stages.

Produce clear verification evidence containing test conditions, configurations, metrics, plots, waveforms,

results, conclusions, and identified risks.

Develop reusable automation for parameter sweeps, corner testing, waveform analysis, regression

testing, and evidence generation.

Investigate discrepancies between expected feature behavior and results from simulation, emulation,

bench testing, or silicon.

Collaborate with systems, analog design, digital design, firmware, design verification, validation,

applications, and software/tool teams.

Identify missing requirements, test coverage, observability, or infrastructure needed to verify loop

features effectively.

Document test intent, assumptions, configurations, results, limitations, and residual risks clearly for

technical and leadership audiences.

Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers working on control-loop verification and

validation.

Required

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
• 8+ years of relevant experience in digital power control, mixed-signal verification, semiconductor validation, systems engineering, power electronics, design verification, or related product development.
• Strong understanding of feedback control systems, including compensation, stability, bandwidth, transient response, latency, sampling, quantization, saturation, and nonlinear behavior.
• Experience verifying or validating control-loop features and functions using measurable engineering evidence.
• Strong understanding of mixed-signal building blocks such as ADCs, DACs, sensing paths, amplifiers, references, timing circuits, PWM paths, and power stages.
• Experience developing test plans, test scenarios, pass/fail criteria, metrics, and technical evidence for complex electronic systems.
• Ability to analyze waveforms and data, isolate behavioral differences, and connect observed results to feature intent and implementation.
• Ability to independently lead technically complex verification activities from requirements through final correlation and documentation.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex loop behavior and verification results clearly

PREFERRED

• Experience with digital multiphase controllers, DC/DC converters, voltage regulators, power management ICs, or high-current datacenter power applications.
• Experience with model-to-silicon correlation, behavioral modeling, real-number modeling, Verilog-AMS, SystemVerilog RNM, MATLAB, Python, SIMPLIS, or equivalent environments.
• Experience with verification automation, data analysis, test infrastructure, dashboards, databases, or API-driven workflows.
• Familiarity with control loops, stability, latency, quantization, noise, telemetry, and power-system measurement techniques.
• Experience creating reusable verification frameworks that improve quality and reduce repeated manual test setup.

jobs.title: Maintenance Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview
At Dynamic Catholic, we have a culture of gratitude, fun, collaboration and results. The Maintenance Coordinator must be exceptionally talented, driven, organized and – most importantly – passionate about what we do.
The Maintenance Coordinator manages daily and long-term needs of the building to ensure the comfort and wellbeing of our team members.
The Maintenance Coordinator oversees all building maintenance, vendor/service contracts, and assessment of facility needs. They are responsible to be on-call for building related emergencies, coordinating bids, problem-solving, and recommendations on repairs and projects.
Who we are
At Dynamic Catholic our Mission is simple: to re-energize the Catholic Church in America. Catholics are leaving the Church at an alarming rate, and disengagement among those who remain is staggeringly high. This is where you come in. We are looking for driven, talented, and dynamic individuals who will work tirelessly to use their talents to inspire people to rediscover the genius of Catholicism.
 
The Role of a Maintenance Coordinator
Maintenance and Facility Improvement:
Regularly walk the property to identify needed repairs and cleanup
Perform and/or schedule preventative maintenance on company assets, including building, vehicles, and equipment
Coordinate planned maintenance activities to minimize disruption to operations and enhance the aesthetics of the building
Service Requests:
Receive and prioritize maintenance requests, including repairs, tidiness, and improvements
Assign tasks to appropriate vendors or perform tasks personally based on expertise and availability
Restock supplies in restrooms and kitchen areas as needed
Communication:
Conveying maintenance schedules, progress updates, and potential delays related to both maintenance and enhancement projects
Provide clear plans and meet or exceed expectations, ensuring that the building not only functions well but also looks its best
Prompt Response:
Respond promptly to urgent maintenance issues
Serve the executive team and their assistants in whatever way required to ensure seamless operations for leadership
Maintain a willingness to respond 24/7 to any building emergencies such as security breaches, power outages, water leaks, fire alarms, overnight snow
Groundskeeping:
Maintain the appearance of the grounds, including snow removal, grass cutting, and ensuring the grounds are aesthetically pleasing and free of debris
Coordinate with landscapers to enhance the overall appearance of our building
Inventory Management:
Maintain an inventory of spare parts, tools, and equipment required for maintenance
Ensure inventory levels are adequate to support operations, including breakroom supplies (e.g. toilet paper, paper towels, tissues, soap, etc.)
Purchasing and Remodeling:
Procure a wide variety of products for the building, including items related to office furniture, kitchen supplies, and bathroom supplies
Execute building improvements as requested, contributing to the enhancement of the building's function and appearance
Complete construction or remodeling projects to specifications such as set building for the studio or office space remodeling
Quality Control:
Monitor the quality of work, both in maintenance and enhancements, to ensure that repairs and enhancements are conducted to the highest standards
Security and Safety Compliance:
Ensure compliance with local codes for inspections and certificates, including fire safety and maintenance requirements
Monitor building access and question unknown individuals as needed to maintain security
Vendor Management:
Collaborate with external service providers and vendors for specialized maintenance and enhancement tasks
Obtain quotes, negotiate service agreements, evaluate vendor performance, and review invoices

jobs.title: Associate Director, Display, Video & App
jobs.description:
As the Associate Director of Display, Video & App Marketing, you will lead our global acquisition channels across Display, Video, and App—balancing performance and awareness objectives while driving cost-effective volume growth across the full HelloFresh Group brand portfolio.

Your primary mission is to strategically scale these channels in a way that is measurable, creatively sharp, and responsive to demand. That means embedding an always-on incrementality framework at the heart of how we measure effectiveness, defining and rolling out a unified measurement and creative framework across channels, ensuring technical infrastructure is scalable and robust, and making sure we show up effectively during HelloFresh Group's biggest peak and high-demand moments.

Above all, we are seeking ambitious individuals who are driven to make HelloFresh better. We firmly believe that skills are developed through diverse experiences and unique pathways. Therefore, even if your background doesn't "tick every box" but you are confident you would excel in this role, we strongly encourage you to apply and share your story with us.

You will...

• Lead and develop the team: Manage, coach, and grow the Display & Video Team Lead(s), App Marketing Team Lead, and their wider teams, building a high-performing, scalable multi-channel organization.

• Own the global Display, Video & App strategy: Set and drive the strategic direction across all three channels, balancing performance (conversion, CPA/CAC) and awareness objectives across all HelloFresh Group brands and markets.

• Embed always-on incrementality measurement: Define and roll out an always-on incrementality framework (geo-testing, regression, multi-touch attribution) as the core lens for evaluating channel effectiveness and guiding budget allocation across Display, Video, and App, partnering closely with Marketing Analytics.

• Define and launch a unified creative framework: Build and roll out a creative testing and refresh framework across Display & Video, setting standards for iteration cadence and creative-performance feedback loops in partnership with Brand and Creative teams.

• Manage global budget allocation: Set and dynamically reallocate budget across markets, brands, and channels to hit volume growth and CPA/CAC targets, forecasting and reporting with rigor.

• Own peak and high-demand moments: Lead planning and execution for HelloFresh Group's key peak and high-demand trading moments, ensuring budget, creative, and targeting are primed to capture demand spikes efficiently across all channels.

• Drive channel efficiency and close infrastructure gaps: Identify and resolve technical and setup gaps that impede efficient scaling, working cross-functionally with Tech, Product, and Marketing stakeholders to test, iterate, and scale improvements across campaign performance and user experience.

• Build scalable infrastructure: Develop infrastructure to enhance team efficiency, including implementation of tools for budgeting automation, advanced measurement models (incremental regression analysis, MMM), and tracking data pipelines.

• Lead senior agency and platform relationships: Act as the strategic lead and escalation point for external agencies and platform partners (including Google, DSPs, and mobile platforms), setting the agenda on plans, investment, and innovation.

• Test and scale new formats: Identify, test, and scale new opportunities within Display, Video, and App ecosystems—including YouTube, new creative formats, and app monetization—to diversify acquisition and support video adoption goals.

• Drive cross-channel alignment: Partner with cross-channel and measurement teams to connect Display, Video, and App activity to the broader full-funnel customer journey and shared measurement frameworks.

• Coordinate aligned messaging: Deploy aligned messaging across ad creative and app store landing pages, collaborating closely with the Brand team and relevant Performance Marketing channels.

• Enhance measurement integration and tracking: Collaborate with the Marketing Data Product and Tracking teams to enhance integration of Display, Video, and App data into Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), improve Mobile Measurement Partner (MMP) integrity, and optimize app tracking data pipelines.

What you'll bring...

• 8+ years of professional experience in Performance Marketing / Paid Media, with deep, hands-on expertise in Demand Gen, Google Ads, Display/Video DSPs (e.g. DV360), and Paid User Acquisition.

• 5+ years of experience leading and developing people managers (leading leaders), ideally within a Display, Video, App, or paid media function.

• Proven experience building and embedding incrementality-based measurement frameworks (e.g. geo-testing, regression, multi-touch attribution) and partnering with Analytics on marketing mix modelling (MMM) and advanced measurement.

• Strong understanding of mobile tracking platforms (e.g., MMPs) and measurement infrastructure, including hands-on experience with integration, troubleshooting, and optimization.

• A track record of defining and scaling creative testing frameworks that improve both performance and brand consistency across markets.

• Experience planning and delivering campaigns through high-demand or peak trading moments, with the agility to reallocate budget and creative at pace.

• Strong commercial acumen—comfortable owning budget, forecasting, and reporting against volume growth and CPA/CAC targets.

• Ability to identify and close tech/setup gaps quickly, partnering with product, tech, and marketing stakeholders to launch or optimize new campaigns.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including experience as the senior point of contact for agencies and platform partners such as Google. You will be the go-to person for multiple marketing and cross-functional teams.

• Understanding of digital marketing disciplines across digital display, paid social media, OTV, SEO, PPC, and e-commerce.

• An entrepreneurial mindset: you embrace ownership, make bold, data-driven decisions, and relentlessly pursue innovative solutions to drive sustainable growth. Comfortable navigating ambiguity, testing new approaches, and learning from both successes and failures.

• A true team player who values diversity of thought and actively fosters an inclusive culture.

You’ll get…

• Competitive Salary & 401k company match that vests immediately upon participation

• Generous parental leave of 16 weeks & PTO policy

• $0 monthly premium and other flexible health plans

• 85% discount on your subscription to HelloFresh (as well as other product initiatives)

• Employee Resource Groups

• Collaborative, dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company

This job description is intended to provide a general overview of the responsibilities. However, the Company reserves the right to adjust, modify, or reassign work tasks and responsibilities as needed to meet changing business needs, operational requirements, or other factors.

New York Pay Range

$160,319—$211,410 USD

jobs.title: Quantitative Cost Risk Analyst (Construction)
jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is looking for a Risk Manager to join our growing team. The ideal individual will be an experienced risk professional that has supported large scale construction projects.

The successful candidate will bring experience supporting the delivery of construction and capital projects within one or more of Turner & Townsend's key markets, including data centers, critical infrastructure, aviation, life sciences, and energy & natural resources. Exposure to complex projects, stakeholder management, and multidisciplinary teams across these sectors is preferred.

Responsibilities:

• Maintain visibility of threat/opportunity trigger points to facilitate risk cost profiling, timely drawdown of risk budget or retirement of threat/opportunity.
• Use risk data to inform investment planning.
• Monitor overall risk exposure and assess the remaining risk budget.
• Work with contractors to assess contractors held risks and their views on client held risks that impact upon them.
• Produce risk reports as required, in a timely manner, to support the effective communication of threat and opportunity status.
• Conduct quantitative risk assessment (cost and schedule) to inform project contingency levels.
• Initiate a proactive approach to the review, development and improvement of risk management services for the client.
• Undertake end-to-end project risk management practices on multiple projects/programs.
• Undertake the creation of risk management plans and processes in adherence to client requirements, processes, policies, and frameworks.
• Conduct risk reviews at regular intervals, identify and analyze, determine response plans, ensure that project and program risk profiles are being monitored and reported.
• Lead and run a comprehensive schedule and cost-effective risk assessment (QCRA & QSRA) process is delivered.
• Establish integration of the risk management function within the program and project controls team, with direct touch points to cost and schedule management, change control, and reporting.
• Work proactively and collaboratively with program and project control teams to eliminate redundancies and identify improvement opportunities.
• Provide opportunities to facilitate the transfer of knowledge within the immediate risk team, to the greater project controls team, and to the client. The transfer of knowledge may include informal one-on-one discussions with client stakeholders and more formal presentations to clients and colleagues.
• Create value stream mapping to quantify pain points and develop solutions to minimize waste (both in terms of speed and cost).
• Collaborate on the supplier performance management program including the collection of performance metrics and tracking supplier improvement action plans.
• Demonstrate a level of support to expert witnesses in arbitral or ligation processes.
• Lead, manage, and carry out construction stage contract and claims management.
• Carry out assessment of contractual claims in accordance with the contract.
• Provide strategic and contractual advice on disputes and related resolution issues.
• Evaluate delay recovery measures.
• Carry out change management and construction stage cost control.
• Supervise the measurement and valuation of completed works and variations.
• Manage the settlement of final accounts with contractors
• SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

• Bachelor’s degree in construction management, cost management, quantity surveying, engineering or field related to construction.
• Minimum 3 years of applicable experience
• Relevant construction project procurement and contract management experience.
• Demonstrated experience within a Program Management or Program Controls environment
• Deep knowledge and experience with risk identification, facilitation and techniques.
• Strong communication, analytical and negotiation skills.
• In-depth understanding of construction contracts, commercial models, and delivery methods.
• Proficient in process mapping, root causes analysis, problem solving, and value-stream mapping.
• Familiarity with web-based database tools – ARM, Predict, Tableau
• Highly self-motivated, analytical, and customer centric.
• Excellent communication skills.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs*

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life.

To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/ and https://www.heery.com/

jobs.title: Associate Director, Omnichannel Brand Partner
jobs.description:
The Associate Director, Omnichannel Brand Partner is a critical leadership role within the Customer Experience and Omnichannel team at Sobi North America, serving as the strategic hub balancing priorities between the enterprise Omnichannel/CX function and the brand marketing teams. This individual will collaborate closely with marketing, agency partners, analytics, and a broad range of other stakeholders to support the design and delivery of digital and omnichannel experiences, digital media, and digital analytics, including dedicated support for two upcoming Immunology launch brands. This role is accountable for translating customer and business insights into clear omnichannel strategies, prioritized roadmaps, executable plans, and measurable outcomes. The team member will have the opportunity to influence omnichannel activity aligned with the broader vision of enhancing customer experience (CX) across patients, caregivers, and HCPs, bringing deep knowledge of the customer journey and a sharp eye for identifying the moments that matter most. The Omnichannel Brand Partner will also be tasked with translating enterprise initiatives, such as modular content, into strategies that brand marketing teams can act on, helping to identify, define, and implement capabilities to support the broader enterprise omnichannel vision.

Key Responsibilities

Including, but not limited to the following:

• Partner closely with marketing and cross-functional teams to drive omnichannel and customer experience programs that generate value for the brands and key stakeholders
• Serve as the strategic hub connecting the enterprise Omnichannel/CX team and brand marketing teams, balancing enterprise priorities with brand-specific needs and operating with a high degree of autonomy to lead cross-functional omnichannel initiatives
• Lead agency management and coordination, including relationship, scope, budget, and performance
• Partner with marketing teams to understand their business and act as a strategic advisor for all omnichannel and digital efforts – including SEO/SEM, Social, Websites, Email, Display, etc.
• Develop and maintain omnichannel strategy roadmaps.
• Collaborate with the Digital Analytics team to translate customer and performance data into actionable insights, recommendations, and measurable outcomes; ensure recommendations are implemented, tracked, and evaluated.
• Apply deep knowledge of the end-to-end customer journey to identify and prioritize the moments that matter most for patients, caregivers, and HCPs, translating those insights into targeted omnichannel strategies
• Translate enterprise-level initiatives (e.g., modular content) into clear, actionable strategies for brand marketing teams, driving adoption, and consistency across brands
• Work autonomously, take ownership, and drive cross-functional initiatives with minimal oversight
• Ability to be a strategic business partner and trusted hub between omnichannel/CX and brand marketing teams, having impact above and across the organization
• The ability to thrive in situations of ambiguity and provide a clear path forward toward solutions
• Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills, confident executive presence, and ability to communicate with Senior Leaders
• Excellent diplomacy and facilitation skills; ability to influence without authority
• Adaptive and motivated to build and lead while "rolling up their sleeves" to get it done
• Passionate about omnichannel and CX- data, technology and marketing strategy
• Strong customer-oriented mindset and demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership

Required Qualifications & Experience

Education:

• Bachelor's degree required.

Experience:

Minimum of 8 years multi/omnichannel pharma marketing experience with an emphasis on digital engagement strategy that optimizes overall customer experience to drive business results

• Experienced in making quantitatively oriented recommendations to solve business problems, based on real customer information and trends
• Passion for data and analytics with ability to socialize key insights through persuasive story-telling that brings meaningful and actionable context to drive more data-informed decision making
• Recent experience at, or supporting, startup/emerging life science organizations; focus on rare/orphan diseases
• Proven background in consistently designing and delivering high-impact digital/ customer experience programs
• Deep understanding of core digital tactics, technology, data and how they work together. Including, but not limited to:
• Websites, UX, SEO/SEM, Media, Social, CRM, analytics, digital field tools
• Strong knowledge of marketing fundamentals and ability to align marketing strategy and customer behavioral objectives to tactical campaign design across multiple dimensions (customer, channel, content, cadence)
• Strong business acumen with ability to translate complex, technical concepts clearly and concisely to broad audiences
• Demonstrated ability to lead complex projects/solutions with hands-on, detail-oriented approach
• Demonstrated leadership experience managing agency partners, including relationship, project scope, budget, and contract management
• Deep understanding of the end-to-end customer journey, with experience identifying and prioritizing the moments that matter to shape omnichannel strategy
• Demonstrated ability to translate enterprise-level initiatives (e.g., modular content) into brand-level strategies and execution plans
• Demonstrated ability to connect insights to strategic decisions, execution, and measurable customer or business impact.
• Ability to prioritize and direct several projects simultaneously, meeting deadlines, and proposing solutions to support teams
• Experience supporting brand or product launches in a pharmaceutical/biotech setting, with the ability to stand up omnichannel infrastructure and customer engagement strategy from pre-launch through commercialization

Preferred Qualifications

• Work experience in commercial matrix organization
• Understanding of compliance-related concepts that govern pharmaceutical marketing and sales activities, as well as medical/science engagements
• Experience working with third party vendors for analytics and reporting
• Agency partnership experience, including relationship, project budget, and contract management
• Strong experience utilizing modern business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau)
• Experience with Veeva toolset and Salesforce Marketing Cloud highly desirable

Compensation and Total Rewards at Sobi

At Sobi, we are dedicated to providing our employees with a comprehensive and industry-competitive total rewards package. Our compensation philosophy is designed to recognize and reward talent, ensuring that your contributions are valued and reflected in your overall rewards.

Your total compensation at Sobi goes beyond just your base salary and annual bonus. It also includes a robust suite of benefits, such as:

• A competitive 401(k) match to support your financial future.
• Tuition and wellness reimbursements to invest in your personal and professional growth.
• A comprehensive medical, dental, and vision package to prioritize your health and well-being.
• Additional recognition awards to celebrate your achievements.

The base salary range for this role is $150,000 -190,000. Each individual offer will be determined based on several factors, including your experience, qualifications, and location. Additionally, this role is eligible for both short-term and long-term bonuses, as outlined in the plan details.

All Sobi employees need to demonstrate behaviors in line with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership and Partnership. Are you ready to be on the Sobi team? Come join a culture that empowers every person to be the person that makes a difference for rare disease.

Why Join Us?

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases, and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

Sobi is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions at Sobi are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national, social or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veterans and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status or protected groups by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access this website to apply for a vacancy as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by sending an email to irina.conc@sobi.com
