jobs.title: Middle L1 Technical Support Specialist
jobs.description:
GR8_TECH builds B2B iGaming platforms for operators who play to lead.

We deliver full-cycle, high-impact tech designed to scale — from seamless integrations and expert consulting to long-term operational support. Our platform powers millions of active players and drives real business growth. Call it what it is: the iGaming Platform for Champions.

With 1000+ GR8 people across locations and time zones, we don’t just ship technology — we help operators build success stories across brands, markets, and geos.

Our ambition drives us. Our people make it real.

If you’re a challenger in spirit and a champion in action — join us.

Why this role exists:

This role exists to protect client trust and deliver seamless technical problem resolution for our B2B partners. You’ll help us maintain strict SLA commitments and uninterrupted platform availability by taking full ownership of complex L1 support cases, system alerts, and critical incident coordination.

What you’ll drive:

Ticket Ownership & Technical Investigation

• Independently validate, investigate, and resolve complex B2B tickets using server logs, monitoring tools, and Browser DevTools.

• Replicate user-reported issues to isolate root causes across APIs, client-server interactions, and integration layers.

• Review incoming technical fixes from L2/L3 teams to ensure solutions are fully tested and directly address client needs before closing tickets.

Incident Response & Operational Execution

• Coordinate L1 incident workflows during outages, including hosting incident calls, maintaining technical timelines, and issuing public status updates.

• Monitor real-time platform alerts, instantly triaging anomalies to prevent potential SLA breaches.

• Proactively drive backlog management, ensuring clear client follow-ups and transparent delay notifications.

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

• Translate complex technical root causes into actionable, human-readable updates for clients and non-technical stakeholders.

• Guide Junior Specialists on investigation techniques, log analysis, and effective ticket routing.

• Escalation path management: Route fully documented, edge-case issues to L2/L3 engineering teams with detailed diagnostic data.

What makes you a GR8 fit:

Must-Have

• 1+ years of experience in B2B Customer Support, Technical Support, Service Desk, Application Support, or operations in a B2B SaaS or high-load digital environment.

• Hands-on experience analyzing server logs, administrative back-office tools, and Browser DevTools.

• Practical knowledge of ticketing platforms (Jira/JSM, Zendesk, or ServiceNow) and incident workflows (L1–L3 framework).

• Proven ability to coordinate critical incidents (organizing response calls, tracking timelines, writing client updates).

• Flexibility to work full-time on a shift-based, 24/7 rotating schedule (including nights, weekends, and holidays).

• Upper-Intermediate English level.

Nice-to-Have

• Direct experience in iGaming, fintech, or payment processing ecosystems.

• Basic understanding of API structures and HTTP request/response payloads.

• Prior experience managing incident response tools like Statuspage.

Why you’ll love working here:

Benefits Cafeteria — annual budget you allocate to:

Sports • Medical • Mental health • Home office • Languages.

Work-life & support

• Paid maternity/paternity leave + monthly childcare allowance.

• 20+ vacation days, unlimited sick leave, emergency time off.

• Remote-first + tech support + coworking compensation.

• Team events (online/offline/offsite).

• Learning culture with internal courses + growth programs.

Our culture & core values:

GR8_TECH culture is how we win — through trust, ownership, and a growth mindset. We move fast, stay curious, and keep it real, with open feedback, room to experiment, and a team that’s got your back.

jobs.title: Engineering Consultant (Tradefill)
jobs.description:
TradeFill is building an audit-first trading platform — combining audit, replay, and execution — designed for prop firms, and serious futures traders. We're looking to bring in a small group of senior engineers and architects to provide short, paid consultations on how to architect our core trading functions. 1–2 focused conversations to tap into expertise you've built working on real trading infrastructure, and we're specifically looking for a range of perspectives from people who've tackled similar problems at different companies.

Who we're looking for:

• Senior-level experience (architect, principal engineer, tech lead, head of engineering, or product engineer) at a trading platform such as NinjaTrader, Tradovate, Project X, CQG, Rithmic, or similar

• Direct hands-on experience with the early or active development stages of such a platform — not just maintaining a mature system

• Experience across multiple trading platforms/companies is a strong plus

What we'll consult on
Architecture of core trading functions, primarily:

• Risk plan configuration & enforcement

• Order management

• Fills & matching

• Market data and events/streaming

jobs.title: Speech Language Pathologist, SLP, Senior Living Visits
jobs.description:
BAYADA Home Health Care is currently seeking an experienced Speech Language Pathologist, SLP, for a per diem opportunity performing visits for our office..  This office services adult and geriatric patients in Independent and Assisted Living communities throughout Summit and Medina counties.

Prior home care experience as a Speech Language Pathologist, SLP is a plus, but not required.

As a home care Speech Language Pathologist, SLP, you will be an integral member of a multi-disciplinary health care team that provides rehabilitative care and skilled nursing to clients, affording them the opportunity to receive the medical care required to remain at home.

Speech Language Pathologist, SLP Responsibilities:

• Make home visits to clients in designated geographic territories.

• Perform thorough evaluations to assess, diagnose, and provide therapeutic interventions for clients who are experiencing speech, language, communication, or swallowing difficulties.

• Develop a treatment plan based on the evaluation, physician’s orders, and recommended goals.

• Continually assess and revise the speech therapy care plan, and participate with BAYADA clinicians in the multidisciplinary care plan, as appropriate.

• Educate and instruct patients, family members, or other patient representatives, in rehabilitative care and activities necessary to promote the client's health, safety, and independent living.

• Accurately document observations, interventions, and evaluations pertaining to patient care management and services provided, utilizing a state-of-the-art touch pad tablet.

Speech Language Pathologist, SLP Qualifications:

• A current license as a Speech Language Pathologist in OH.

• Possess a certificate of clinical competence in speech from the American Speech and Hearing Association, or;

• Have the equivalent educational requirements, as indicated by school transcript or diploma, and work experience necessary for such a certificate, and be awaiting the opportunity to take the American Speech-Language-Hearing Association examination for certification, or;

• Have completed the necessary work and education requirements, as indicated by school transcript or diploma, and be in the process of accumulating the necessary supervised work experience required for certification.

• Solid computer skills; prior experience with electronic medical records (EMR) preferred.

Our employees are our greatest asset:

• Comprehensive benefits package including paid time off, health, dental, and vision.

• Be recognized and rewarded for your compassion, excellence, and reliability.

jobs.title: Social Worker – Front Door Team
jobs.description:
Our client based in Worcestershire is seeking an experienced Social Worker to join their Front Door Team. This is an excellent opportunity for a dedicated practitioner to work with adults and carers at the first point of contact, promoting wellbeing, independence, and access to community resources through strengths-based and person-centred practice.

The successful candidate will support adults with complex and fluctuating needs, undertaking meaningful conversations, assessments, support planning, safeguarding interventions, and crisis response work. Working collaboratively with individuals, carers, health professionals, community resources, and partner agencies, you will play a key role in helping people regain control of their lives, reduce risks, and achieve positive outcomes within their local communities.

This role requires a confident and autonomous Social Worker with strong knowledge of Adult Social Care legislation, safeguarding, risk management, and multidisciplinary working.

What will your responsibilities be?

In this role, you will:

Undertaking strengths-based conversations, assessments, reviews, and support planning with adults and carers in accordance with the Care Act 2014.

• Managing complex cases involving adults with fluctuating needs, increased risks, and crisis situations.

• Supporting adults to maximise independence, wellbeing, and access to community resources and informal support networks.

• Working collaboratively with partner agencies to ensure coordinated, multi-agency responses that promote positive outcomes.

• Applying the Care Act 2014, Mental Capacity Act 2005, and Mental Health Act 1983 appropriately within day-to-day practice.

• Undertaking Mental Capacity Assessments and contributing to Best Interest decision-making processes.

• Completing Section 42 safeguarding enquiries and applying the principles of Making Safeguarding Personal.

• Assessing and managing risk effectively whilst promoting positive risk-taking and individual choice.

• Identifying potential Deprivation of Liberty issues and ensuring the least restrictive options are explored prior to legal intervention.

• Completing Continuing Healthcare (CHC) Checklists and contributing to Decision Support Tool processes where required.

• Developing creative, outcome-focused Care and Support Plans that maximise independence and meet eligible needs.

• Working with adults and carers experiencing crisis situations, helping them regain control and plan for the future.

• Promoting the welfare of children and appropriately escalating safeguarding concerns where identified.

• Representing the service and individuals at multidisciplinary meetings, reviews, safeguarding meetings, and legal proceedings where required.

• Participating in duty functions and responding to referrals in line with service requirements.

• Maintaining accurate, timely, and legally compliant records, assessments, reports, and support plans.

• Supporting the development of social care staff, newly qualified social workers, students, and colleagues through mentoring, shadowing, and reflective practice.

Qualifications & Experience:

To be successful in this role you must have:

Professional Qualification: MA, BA, BSc in Social Work, Diploma in Social Work, CQSW, CSS, or equivalent recognised Social Work qualification.

• Registration: Must be registered with Social Work England.

• Experience: Significant post-qualified experience within Adult Social Care services.

• Legislation Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Care Act 2014, Mental Capacity Act 2005, Mental Health Act 1983, Adult Safeguarding legislation, Deprivation of Liberty Safeguards, and Continuing Healthcare processes.

• Assessment Skills: Proven ability to undertake complex assessments, reviews, support planning, and risk management interventions.

• Safeguarding Experience: Experience completing Section 42 enquiries and managing complex safeguarding concerns

Interested?
Apply now or get in touch with us to learn more about this opportunities.

Why Liquid Personnel?

• Free DBS and compliance service

• Twice weekly payroll and ‘Faster Pay’ service, getting you paid more quickly

• Access to exclusive roles that aren’t available from other agencies

• Free access to Liquid’s exclusive social work training and CPD portal

• Your own dedicated consultant with extensive social work knowledge

• Access to a wide selection of social work positions across the UK

• “Refer a Friend” bonus – get £500 for each social worker you refer who we successfully place*

• “Find your own job” bonus – get £250 for bringing your own position to us *

Liquid Personnel is an equal opportunities employer. Liquid Personnel Ltd is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy. * Terms and conditions apply to our bonus schemes.

Reasonable Adjustments:

If you consider yourself to have a disability or require any reasonable adjustment during the recruitment process or within the workplace, please highlight this at the earliest opportunity by contacting our team. With this information, we will provide appropriate support to you throughout the process and into your work placement.

We are unable to support or accept applications from candidates who are residents within the Red or Amber list of the Code of practice for the international recruitment of health and social care personnel in England, based on the World Health Organisation (WHO) Workforce Support and Safeguard List.

jobs.title: Senior Covenant Lawyer - Distressed
jobs.description:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.




THE OPPORTUNITY

9fin is looking for a corporate finance attorney who geeks out about a good credit agreement or indenture and who has broader ambitions to write and be a thought-leader in the industry they love. This role will help our distressed editorial teams understand all the nuances of interesting bond and loan documents that could factor into restructuring and liability management exercises. It is perfect for an experienced finance attorney who is looking to recalibrate their work-life balance to allow for a little more life, but who loves their work. We’re growing our groundbreaking coverage of complex out-of-court restructurings with an emphasis on distressed coverage. The role will report into our New York office with flexibility to work from home / remotely as needed.

This role offers a unique opportunity for a legal professional to use their expertise within a rapidly growing start-up environment, with opportunities to refine an already valuable skillset while learning all of the new skills that comes with working with technologists, credit analysts and journalists.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

 - Reviewing leveraged finance and high yield documentation to produce commercially focused and insightful analysis on distressed scenarios and the primary market

 - Writing topical reports on secondary situations, collaborating closely across 9fin’s team of lawyers and credit analysts

 - Answering client questions about the covenant packages of specific borrowers and issuers

 - Using 9fin’s proprietary technology to build and expand our restructuring and LME databases

 - Delivering seminars, teach-ins and podcast segments as a subject matter expert

 - Representing 9fin in the press and at industry conferences and events




ABOUT YOU

This role will be a great fit if you have the following:

 - JD with 5+ years of experience within a capital solutions, leveraged finance, capital markets, restructuring and/or special situations team at a top-tier law firm

 - Experience drafting, reviewing and negotiating high yield bond and/or leveraged loan documents, restructuring support agreements, and Chapter 11 documentation

 - Keen commercial awareness of leveraged finance and restructuring markets

 - Strong technical understanding of how leveraged finance covenants and definitions operate

 - Existing network of relationships within the leveraged finance community

 - Excellent relationship building skills

 - Effective written and verbal communication skills, able to explain complex covenant concepts to non-lawyers concisely

 - Ability to work both independently and collaboratively

 


OUR BENEFITS

We’re a scaling start up and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people.  We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

 - Competitive Salary: $256,000-$300,000

 - Equity

 - 401(k) (9fin pay 3%, employee contributions are uncapped)

 - Private Health Insurance, with Dental and Vision

 - Paid sick leave

 - Disability Insurance (New York)

 - Commuter Benefit

Time off

 - 25 vacation days per year

 - Local public holiday

 - Hybrid working model, to allow you the flexibility to decide how, where and when you do your best work

 - Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

 - 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

 - Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Training & Culture

 - Professional learning and development budget

 - Bi-annual team socials

 - Summer and Winter company social events
   
   

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

jobs.title: Machine Learning and Data Science Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
About the job

Turn your machine learning coursework into insight that helps AI infrastructure run more reliably.

As a Machine Learning and Data Science Engineer Intern, you will analyze telemetry from data center facilities and engineering infrastructure. You will apply data science and machine learning methods to real operational data.

Your work will help engineers spot patterns, understand anomalies and make better-informed decisions. You will learn how infrastructure data connects to reliability, performance and day-to-day operations.

You will clean and explore datasets, build reproducible analyses and evaluate predictive models. You will also create visualizations, document assumptions and share findings with technical colleagues.

This internship gives you practical experience with real-world infrastructure data, supported by engineers who value curiosity and clear thinking.

The team and culture

You will work with the Facilities Reliability Engineering team in Austin. The team supports infrastructure used to develop and test the next generation of AI systems.

Work happens through clear operational questions, shared data exploration, prototype analysis and practical review with engineers. Decisions are shaped by evidence, operational knowledge, reproducible results and honest discussion of uncertainty.

You will own defined tasks with guidance, feedback and room to ask questions. As an intern, you will build confidence by turning data into insight engineers can use.

What we’re looking for

• Current enrollment at junior or senior undergraduate level, or in a master's program, in data science, AI, machine learning, computer science, statistics or a related field

• Foundational knowledge of machine learning, statistics and data analysis through coursework, research, projects or practical experience

• Programming experience in Python, with familiarity using common data-analysis libraries

• Experience preparing, exploring, analyzing and visualizing datasets

• Understanding of supervised machine learning concepts, including regression, classification, model training and model evaluation

• Clear communication, a methodical approach to problem-solving and willingness to seek guidance when needed

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences.

Benefits

• Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility

• Comprehensive healthcare: Medical, dental and vision coverage to help keep you and your family healthy

• Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success

• Tax-advantaged healthcare savings: Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) and Health Savings Accounts (HSAs) to help you make the most of your healthcare spending

• Peace of mind protection: Disability and life insurance to provide financial security when you need it most

• Retirement planning support: A 401(k) plan to help you invest in your future

• Commuter benefits: Help cover the cost of your daily commute

• Wellbeing resources: Access to wellness services that support your physical and mental health

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Confidential advice and support for you and your family across a range of personal, financial and wellbeing matters

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognize that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, just let us know - we're happy to support you.

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute.

Ready to spend your internship applying machine learning to real infrastructure data?

Apply now to join Graphcore as a Machine Learning and Data Science Engineer Intern.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

Corti is the frontier lab for clinical-grade AI, building world-leading models and infrastructure for the realities of healthcare.


Our technology powers healthcare’s most ambitious software, from EHR vendors and virtual care platforms to the health systems that care depends on. We work with builders ranging from fast-moving startups to global healthcare enterprises, helping them bring clinical AI into real-world care.


Healthcare is full of problems where AI has to do more than simply work. Clinicians are overwhelmed by documentation. Coding errors, backlogs and denials cost health systems billions. And the specialist expertise patients need is not always available when they need it.


We build AI specifically for these environments, trained on real patient interactions, validated against real outcomes, and designed to perform where accuracy, trust and reliability matter. If you want to help define how AI is built for healthcare, you belong at Corti.



The Role

We are seeking a technically curious, execution-focused Product Marketing Manager to sit at the center of Corti’s growth engine.

This role is for someone who can read an API doc, spin up a landing page, and write a launch post that developers actually want to read. You are technical enough to understand what we build, creative enough to make people care, and pragmatic enough to ship instead of overthinking.

You will own the surfaces and campaigns that drive developer awareness, acquisition, and activation. That includes product launches, landing pages, demand generation, developer-facing content, and growth analytics. You will move fast across channels and formats, with real ownership over what ships and how it performs.



What you’ll be doing:

Demand generation

 - Plan and execute campaigns that drive signups, activations, and pipeline across paid, organic, and owned channels

 - Run conversion rate experiments across the signup and activation funnel

 - Manage paid campaigns and track performance against acquisition and activation targets

Product launches and landing pages

 - Design and build landing pages, launch assets, and promotional materials (often coding or prototyping yourself)

 - Collaborate on the end-to-end build and launch process for new products, features, and platform updates

 - Coordinate cross-functionally with product, engineering, and design to bring launches to market

 - Write launch content and developer-facing announcements that inspire our audience to dive in

Content and SEO

 - Produce developer-facing content for blog, social, and community channels

 - Build and execute an SEO strategy targeting developers searching for healthcare AI tooling

 - Write technical blog posts, guides, and tutorials that position Corti as the default platform for healthcare AI development

 - Create sales enablement assets, templates, and collateral as needed

Analytics and reporting

 - Build dashboards and reports to track campaign performance, funnel metrics, and growth KPIs

 - Analyze user behaviour to identify activation patterns and conversion opportunities

 - Report regularly on what’s working, what’s not, and where to invest next

 - Use data to prioritise experiments and allocate resources across channels



What you bring:

 - Strong technical growth or product marketing experience, ideally within a technical product led growth SaaS company or Series A-C startup.

 - Experience building and running successful marketing campaigns across paid, organic, email and content channels for a technical audience and are comfortable building things yourself rather than waiting on others.

 - Comfortable reading API documentation and understanding how developer products work

 - Track record in shipping and “vibe coding” landing pages, launches, growth experiments, and prototypes (or excited to learn)

 - Familiar with developer workflows, tooling, and PLG motions

 - Comfortable with analytics tools like Google Analytics or Posthog and building reports that drive decisions

 - Strong writing skills, particularly for technical and developer-facing audiences

 - Genuine interest in AI and healthcare



What a day looks like:

On any given day, you might push a new landing page live for an API feature launch, review funnel metrics to diagnose a drop in activation, draft a blog post on a new agent capability, and jump on a call with product and engineering to scope the next release.

We don’t care about the exact title on your CV. What matters is that you are technical enough to understand what we’re building, fast enough to ship without waiting for permission, and someone your friends might describe as “one of the smartest people they know.”



Life at Corti

 - You will report into our VP of Growth

 - You will work closely with the Growth, Product, and Engineering teams

 - High autonomy, low bureaucracy, and real ownership

 - Direct impact on how developers discover and adopt Corti’s platform

 - Equipment provided by Corti

 - Working in our New York office

 

 

Ready to dive into the world of Corti? Hit that 'Apply' button, and let's start working together on reshaping the dialogue in healthcare, making a real difference for millions of patient outcomes around the world.

🤝 Bringing in top talent from all backgrounds is crucial in our pursuit to improve the world of healthcare. We encourage applications from all people and do not discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, and/or disability status.﻿

At Corti, experience comes in many forms, and we’re passionate about creating teams with a multitude of perspectives! If you believe your experience is close to what we’re looking for but not an exact match, we still hope you’ll consider applying!

jobs.title: Senior Counsel, Data Privacy (Bangkok-based, Relocation provided)
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

In the age of technology, things are constantly changing. The travel market is much the same, being more dynamic and complex than ever. Agoda’s Legal team is well suited to take on the challenges presented, adopting a proactive mindset to tackle challenges and solve problems. We are quick on our feet, decisive, and collaborate with multiple departments. We hire out-of-the-box thinkers that are well grounded with ethics and legal knowledge to ensure that Agoda achieves the right results, the right way.

The Opportunity:

As Senior Counsel, Data Privacy – you will be part of a leading and innovative team responsible for the legal risk areas of data privacy, cybersecurity and artificial intelligence.

In this role, you will serve as a key legal partner guiding Agoda’s global privacy strategy across high-visibility domains, collaborating closely with our global Product, Marketing, Tech and Customer Experience teams. This is a premier in-house opportunity to handle sophisticated, multi-jurisdictional privacy and AI challenges at a massive consumer tech scale.

Your technical legal knowledge is only half the equation – your real impact will come from your strategic vision and collaborative agility. You will act as an embedded partner and translator, converting complex, shifting data protection laws from around the globe into pragmatic, high-velocity solutions that accelerate Agoda’s growth and enhance consumer trust.

** This position is Bangkok-based and we are open to both local and international candidates, with relocation support available for eligible candidates to ensure a smooth transition to working and living in Bangkok. Please note that remote work or working from locations outside of Bangkok is not available for this role.

In this role, you will be:

• Privacy By Design & Product Counseling: partnering proactively with Product and Tech teams from concept to launch. Conduct privacy impact assessments and translate a complex patchwork of regulations around the globe into practical, scalable product requirements across various initiatives including new verticals. You will need to be able to take responsible risk positions outlining risk while working with other members of the Agoda Legal team and enabling the business to move forward

• Marketing, AdTech & MarTech: expected to understand, navigate and provide practical privacy counsel to our marketing teams across both conventional and cutting-edge marketing strategies and initiatives.

• Contracting, negotiations and templates: heavily involved in the contractual negotiation and drafting of privacy provisions, data protection-related agreements and templates. You will also design practical negotiation playbooks, fallbacks and self-service guidelines for your areas of coverage.

• Regulatory change management for new and amended data protection laws: this includes contributing to the privacy advisory aspects of projects for compliance with such laws.

• Program, auditing and controls: working closely with our Privacy Program team to facilitate and manage key aspects of the privacy program, audits and enable reporting obligations.

• Contribute to brand initiatives within the Booking Holdings Inc. family: you may be expected to contribute and have meaningful impact across brands through cross brand initiatives, forums, networks and offsites etc

• Artificial Intelligence: lead privacy legal advisory on the deployment of generative AI, machine learning models and conduct AI risk assessments for your areas of coverage.

• General privacy support: as may be required in order to support relevant enquiries, authority demand requests and escalations relating to data subject rights

What you'll Need to Succeed:

• 6+ years of post-qualification experience, with at least 2 years at a reputable law firm.

• Law degree from a top law school, and excellent academic credentials.

• Deep practical knowledge of major international privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA, PDPA, PIPA, APPI, DPDPA, PIPL).

• Excellent drafting, negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Demonstrated experience in building trust, forging collaboration and influencing cross-functional partners; thriving in an open, matrixed and culturally diverse environment.

• Strong strategic and commercial risk calibration skills.

It's Great if you have:

• A data privacy qualification, CIPP or equivalent or at least willing to obtain one shortly after joining the company

• Legally qualified in either Singapore, England or another common law jurisdiction.

• Practical, solution-oriented approach to legal advice.

• Experience working in a tech company or with technology-driven products.

jobs.title: PR & Brand Manager (f/m/x) - remote
jobs.description:
Founded in 2017, refurbed is Europe’s fastest-growing marketplace for refurbished products, active in 23 European countries and having surpassed €2Bn in GMV — all while being profitable. With beautiful headquarters in Vienna, we operate as a remote-first company and have been recognised as a Top DACH Employer by Kununu for four consecutive years.

Our mission is to make sustainable consumption the easy choice by enabling customers to buy products up to 40% cheaper while significantly reducing CO₂ emissions.

If you thrive in an environment that values momentum, ownership, and impact, you’ll feel at home here. We’re a fast-paced, high-performance team that works hard and challenges itself everyday. To enable this high-performance every team member enjoys full autonomy over their location (we’re remote-first).

As our PR & Brand Manager (Maternity Cover), you’ll own the day-to-day relationship with our PR agencies across six markets, drive pan-European PR coordination across all our markets, and lead our brand tracking and PR research initiatives. Reporting to our Lead Brand Communications, you’ll be the go-to person for PR excellence, working cross-functionally with Marketing, Supply, Data and other teams to bring refurbed’s brand story to life across Europe.

This is a fixed-term, 18-month contract covering a maternity leave.

WHO YOU ARE:

• You have 2-4 years of experience in PR, communications or brand roles, including experience owning relationships with PR agencies or external partners across multiple markets.

• You have highly professional written and spoken English, plus fluency in another major European language (Swedish is a strong plus, given the content and market responsibilities of this role).

• You can be based remotely anywhere in Europe; occasional travel to our markets and events is part of the role. Our Vienna HQ is available if you’d prefer to be based there.

• You take ownership end-to-end: you’re used to running a project or subarea on your own, and you don’t wait to be told what’s next — you spot gaps, improve ways of working, and raise the quality of what’s around you.

• You build strong cross-functional relationships; people come to you for PR and brand input because they trust your judgment and expertise.

• You’re highly organized and comfortable juggling multiple markets, agencies and stakeholders without losing sight of deadlines.

• You have a strong feel for written language and tone, and experience translating data and company priorities into external-facing stories.

• You have experience working with AI tools and are open to learning more about implementing AI into your daily work

• You’re passionate about sustainability, innovation and creating real impact.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

PR Agency & Market Management:

• Own the day-to-day relationship with PR agencies across SE, DK, FI, IE, BE and NL, including briefing, approving PR materials, developing local angles and following up on performance/KPIs.

• Act as the main internal point of contact for these markets, ensuring agencies have the information, data and materials they need.

Pan-European PR Coordination:

• Own and host the monthly editorial meeting across 16 PR agencies/markets, including agenda, preparation, follow-up and continuous improvement of the format.

• Drive cross-market sharing of PR ideas, opportunities and best practices.

• Manage the press pages across all markets, ensuring the latest press releases and relevant content are published and kept up to date.

Data, Research & Brand Tracking:

• Source and analyse internal data for PR stories, identify relevant trends and coordinate internal data validation.

• Own the refurbed brand tracker, including planning waves, managing research, setting up surveys and reporting results.

• Manage PR consumer studies across markets, coordinating agency input, developing and delivering results and insights.

Content & Language Support:

• Proofread and adapt content for Performance Marketing, CRM and other teams.

• Review and approve UGC/performance content.

Events & Activations:

jobs.title: New Business Administrator
jobs.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description 

The purpose of the New Business Administrator is to ensure the best possible customer experience for Allica’s Asset Finance product from the Banks panel of brokers. Working closely with our Business Development Managers and Commercial Finance Brokers, our Sales Support, and Underwriting teams you will be responsible for a portfolio of AF cases, managing all relevant activity to progress the case efficiently and effectively through from proposal to document handover.



Principal Accountabilities

• Submitting Asset Finance applications, in line with Allica’s credit policies, ensuring sufficient information is provided to the Underwriters to enable them to make sound lending decisions.

• Deliver pre and post-sanction administration to ensure timely release of communications, acceptance conditions and document processing to support the bank’s ethos of fast, high quality service.

• You are able to manage your workload and working day to ensure adherence to the team’s service level agreements and quality expectations, driving efficiency through right first time. 

• Maintain good working relationships with all panel brokers to ensure smooth and timely exchange of correspondence and communication.

• Able to build and maintain relationships with core internal stakeholders also; Underwriting and Business Development Managers being key.

• Maintain true and accurate records for each case including clear sanction audit trail.

• Ensure compliance with Bank’s policies, procedures and guidelines together with all appropriate regulatory and statutory requirements, implementing actions to protect the Bank’s business at all times.

• Adhere to the Bank’s brand and culture values, ensuring that all accountabilities are undertaken in accordance with the Banks policies and procedures, and good client outcomes form the basis of decisions made.

• Communicate relevant information to team members, senior management and other interested parties ensuring essential features of the situation are understood, enabling informed decisions to be taken where appropriate.

• Communicate with Introducers and Business Development Managers to gather any necessary documentation required to assess loan applications.

• Maintain clear and accurate internal records for MI and monitoring.

• Maintain and update customer records, including data entry into Ascent, the Core Banking system.

• Assist Operations team and other departments as and when directed.



Personal Attributes & Experience

• Excellent interpersonal and communication, with well-developed numeracy and written skills.

• Proven track record in providing excellent customer service.

• Capable of working in a fast-paced environment, managing complex, competing, and alternating priorities with a constant focus on delivery. 

• Have resilience and energy for collaborating with others, working flexibly, and driving developments rapidly. 

• Have confidence, creditability, and highly developed interpersonal skills with a ‘can-do’ attitude.  

• A ‘doer’ - happy to roll sleeves up as needed and do whatever is needed to move the business along.

• Organisational and time-management skills.

• Strong technical skills, especially MS Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Outlook, etc.



Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

 - Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

 - Options for flexible working

 - Regular social activities

 - Pension contributions

 - Discretionary bonus scheme

 - Private health cover

 - Life assurance

 - Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave



Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

jobs.title: Full Time Faculty – Computer Science Programme
jobs.description:
ABOUT ALU

ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world.

We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities.

HOW WE WORK

The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new.

The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a computer scientist who is motivated to develop the next generation of Computer Scientists and Software Engineers through experiential learning, not just teaching.

Teaching at ALCHE is hands-on and project-based. Students do not just learn concepts. They build solutions, work with constraints, and engage with real-world problems. You will guide this process by drawing on industry demands while maintaining high academic standards.

Teaching in this role is cross-programme. While the appointment sits within Computer Science, the post holder will be expected to teach modules across the college’s other programmes where their expertise is relevant including Software Engineering, computing, data, and technology modules delivered within other degree programmes.

The role carries a deliberate second dimension. Alongside teaching, you will work directly with the Computer Science Programme Manager on the academic and administrative business of the department: the design and redesign of Computing programmes and modules, accreditation and quality assurance submissions, assessment architecture, policy development, and the design and delivery of short courses in emerging areas of technology. Where appropriate, defined management responsibilities for the programme will be formally delegated to the post holder. We see this as a genuine pathway into academic leadership.

The successful candidate will join a college that is expanding its Computer Science provision, strengthening its quality assurance architecture, and positioning itself as a serious contributor to the national and regional technology skills agenda. There is real scope here to build something that lasts.

Key Responsibilities

Teaching and Learning

• Deliver high-quality instruction across modules in the Computer Science and Software Engineering programmes, using practical, hands-on, and real-world teaching approaches aligned with programme learning outcomes.

• Teach on a cross-programme basis, delivering computing, data, and technology modules within other degree programmes across the college as required, and adapting content and pacing to suit non-specialist cohorts without diluting academic rigour.

• Contribute to shared and service modules taught across multiple programmes, working with the relevant Programme Managers to ensure consistency of standards, assessment, and student experience.

• Facilitate project-based learning by guiding students in applying technical skills to real-world problems, including stakeholder engagement, solution development, and presentation of outputs.

• Design, review, and continuously improve learning materials, learning activities, and reading lists to ensure alignment with academic and industry standards.

• Supervise student capstone and final-year projects, including scoping, technical direction, supervision meetings, and examination.

• Hold regular office hours to provide academic support, guidance, and feedback to students outside of class sessions.

• Deliver effectively across blended and technology-enabled modes of delivery, including the responsible integration of AI tools into teaching and learning.

Assessment, Grading, and Academic Standards

• Design coursework, projects, practicals, and examinations that are valid, reliable, appropriately weighted, and demonstrably mapped to module and programme learning outcomes.

• Administer and run assessments, including the setting of examination papers, coordination with the Examinations Office, invigilation duties as scheduled, and adherence to examination protocols.

• Mark and moderate student submissions accurately and fairly, and provide timely, constructive, and actionable feedback to support student progression and mastery of concepts.

• Participate in internal moderation, second marking, and external examiner processes, and prepare the evidence and sample scripts these processes require.

• Maintain assessment records, mark sheets, and grade submissions to the standards and deadlines set by the college, and contribute to the preparation of results for Assessment Boards.

• Contribute to the annual monitoring of modules, including the analysis of assessment outcomes and the identification of enhancement actions.

Programme Design, Redesign and Accreditation

• Work with the Computer Science Programme Manager on the design and redesign of IT/Computing programmes and modules, including programme structures, credit and level mapping, module descriptors, learning outcomes, and assessment strategies.

• Contribute substantively to accreditation and re-accreditation work, including the preparation of programme specifications, module descriptions, mapping matrices, reading lists, staffing and resource annexes, and supporting evidence.

• Support engagement with the regulators or validating partners, including preparation for site visits, panel meetings, and responses to conditions and recommendations.

• Maintain programme documentation so that it remains accurate, version-controlled, and audit-ready between formal review cycles.

• Benchmark the curriculum against national frameworks, professional body expectations, and the evolving requirements of the technology sector, and propose revisions accordingly.

Programme Administration and Delegated Management

• Support the Computer Science Programme Manager across the administrative operations of the department, including timetabling input, module allocation, faculty coordination, student records and progression tracking, and the maintenance of programme trackers and action logs.

• Assume delegated management responsibilities for defined areas of the programme as agreed with the Programme Manager. These may include ownership of a module cluster or year group, coordination of accreditation workstreams, management of assessment cycles, or deputising for the Programme Manager at internal meetings.

• Coordinate with adjunct and visiting faculty to ensure consistency of delivery, assessment standards, and documentation across the programme.

• Contribute to data-informed programme management, including the review of enrolment, attrition, progression, and student feedback data, and the design of interventions arising from it.

• Liaise with the Student Success Team and the Student Professional Development team on academic support, progression concerns, and employability initiatives for Computer Science students.

Short Courses and Professional Education

• Design and deliver short courses, bootcamps, certificates, and professional development offerings in IT and related areas, for internal and external audiences.

• Identify emerging areas of demand, such as data engineering, cloud, cybersecurity, applied AI, and software craftsmanship, and translate them into credible, market-ready short course offerings.

• Contribute to the costing, scheduling, quality assurance, and evaluation of short courses, and to the partnerships with industry, government, and professional bodies that support them.

Governance, Committees and Policy

• Contribute to the drafting, review, and revision of academic policy documents, including assessment policies, academic integrity provisions, programme handbooks, and quality assurance procedures.

• Serve as a member of departmental, faculty, and institutional committees, boards, and working groups, and represent the Computer Science programme in academic governance processes.

• Participate in department meetings, Assessment Boards, and academic decision-making relating to student progression, awards, and academic standards.

• Contribute to institutional self-evaluation exercises, audits, and accreditation readiness activities as required.

Student Development and Professional Contribution

• Support student employability and career readiness, including portfolio development, exposure to industry practices, and the integration of real-world contexts into teaching.

• Mentor students as they grow into professionals, and contribute to student life and engagement initiatives, including the support of student-led clubs and activities related to technology and innovation.

• Engage in continuous professional development to remain current with emerging technologies, tools, and trends in Computer Science and Software Engineering.

• Contribute to the scholarly and research profile of the programme, applied projects, and external engagement.

Essential Requirements

• A PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related field.

• Experience in industry within software development, IT systems, or a related technical field will be an advantage.

• Strong subject matter expertise across core Computer Science, with the ability to teach both foundational and advanced topics.

• Willingness and ability to teach across programmes, including the delivery of computing and technology modules to non-specialist cohorts in other degree programmes across the college.

• Demonstrated ability to deliver practical, hands-on teaching using real-world problems, case studies, and application-based learning approaches.

• Experience designing assessments and marking to defined criteria, with a clear understanding of validity, reliability, and academic standards.

• Strong organisational and administrative capability, with the ability to manage documentation, deadlines, and multiple concurrent workstreams accurately and independently.

• Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce formal academic and regulatory documentation to a professional standard.

• Willingness and capacity to take on delegated programme management responsibilities, and the judgement to exercise them.

• Experience in project-based or experiential learning environments, ideally including supervision of student projects.

• A strong student-centred mindset, with the ability to engage learners as active participants in their educational experience.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and effectively to diverse learners.

• Adaptability, openness to innovation, and comfort with non-traditional and technology-enabled teaching methods, including the integration of AI tools in education.

• Cultural awareness, empathy, and a deep appreciation of diverse contexts and student backgrounds, aligned with the college’s mission and learning culture.

Desirable

• Prior experience teaching, mentoring, or supervising students in a higher education setting.

• Experience teaching technical content to mixed or non-specialist audiences, or across more than one degree programme.

• Experience contributing to curriculum design, programme development, or programme validation.

• Research experience, including publications in relevant fields, or a willingness to engage in research initiatives and contribute to scholarly activities aligned with the programme.

• An entrepreneurial mindset, or experience in developing or contributing to technology-related ventures.

The Senior Customer Success Manager (CSM) partners closely with Relationship Managers to ensure LinkedIn Enterprise Customers achieve a significant return on investment, and feel successful with their LinkedIn Sales solution.

Taking a consultative and prescriptive approach to our customers is crucial, acting as their trusted advisor and consistently showing the value and ROI our solution can offer.

Sales Navigator is constantly evolving through integrations with CRM, Marketing Automation, Business Intelligence, Sales Acceleration and Web Conferring applications, a core part of this role will be empowering our customers to activate these by showing how critical they are to help their business to thrive.

Our main goal is to achieve our customers outcomes by turning the vision they hold for their business into a reality and delivering and articulating value.

• Experience driving large scale global deployments
• Excellent organizational, project management, consulting and time management skills

jobs.title: Growth Manager, Paid Media
jobs.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

Location: This role is fully remote but must overlap with an East Africa timezone by at least 3 hours. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

About this role

Individual Giving has set an objective to double new donor acquisition in 2027 and expand our awareness through brand ads for key segments. Paid media is the biggest lever we have to get there, and as Growth Manager, Paid Media, you'll own delivery of this important priority. To help get us there, GiveDirectly is planning to expand its spend on paid media.

We are looking for someone who will be a strong cultural fit—curious, keen not to follow industry standards but to look for disproportionately high-leverage opportunities, keen to constantly learn and adjust, and comfortable launching a paid program without agency support. This role would suit someone comfortable in a fast-paced environment, able to pivot and change tactics based on data and changing circumstances.

Reporting to our Director of Individual Giving, you’ll manage all paid acquisition for Individual Giving across Meta, Google, YouTube, and TikTok, and also work closely with the VP of Marketing to manage all upper-funnel media buys (e.g., newsletters, podcasts, etc.) for both the Individual Giving and Marketing teams. This role is responsible for executing our paid media program end to end, including negotiating and managing contracts, creating ads, capturing screenshots for documentation, publishing campaigns, and monitoring performance. You will also build our tracking and attribution systems and use that data to grow both one-time and monthly giving. To do so, we are looking for a strong individual contributor who is comfortable executing within the platforms without a big team or agency.

The Individual Giving team is responsible for generating revenue across donors with an annual gift below $50k. To do so, the Individual Giving team executes compelling public fundraising campaigns, drives creative donor-facing content, and tests new marketing initiatives aimed at expanding our donor base and raising awareness of direct cash transfers. You’ll join a small but high-performing team that runs several campaigns at once and works with a lot of independence. You’ll partner with Brand and Marketing colleagues each campaign cycle to ensure integrated marketing across all public-facing materials.

Level: Manager (we are willing to hire at Senior Manager for more experienced candidates)

Reports To: Director of Individual Giving
Travel Requirement: Must be able to travel ~1–2 times per year to one of our countries of operation for team retreats or field visits

What you’ll bring:

• 3–5+ years in growth or performance marketing with a proven track record running paid media to a conversion or revenue target, in-house or agency, across Meta, Google, YouTube, and emerging platforms. Non-profit experience is a plus, but not required.

• Experience managing a paid media budget of at least US$5M a year with a track record of strong performance measurement, with the discipline to trust your own data over platform recommendations and the judgment to know when to scale a channel, cut it, or admit it isn't working—pause and reset.

• A genuine test-and-learn habit: you design multivariable testing across creative, audience, messaging, and landing pages, using these insights to scale the program.

• Strong written communication, the ability to own creative direction of ads (from conception and drafting through launch), and experience with or a strong eye for graphic design (Figma, Canva). You’ll work with content creation teams for bigger projects, but initial ideation and direction should come from you.

• Strong, succinct communication, and the ability to work productively with a Brand and Marketing team focused on brand awareness.

• Alignment with GiveDirectly’s values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity.

• Experience with tracking and attribution to ensure detailed reports are shared with senior management.

Bonus skills:

• Experience with our tech stack (WordPress, Salesforce, PostHog, Google Analytics, Tableau, Zendesk, Ahrefs) or similar tools.

• Experience with paid ads with a non-profit of a similar size or an agency supporting non-profits.

What you’ll do

Own paid media strategy and performance to execute growth and brand goals

• Develop and execute the paid digital fundraising strategy that acquires new donors, grows revenue, and strengthens long-term supporter value across Meta, Google, YouTube, TikTok, programmatic, and emerging platforms (approx. 50% of time).

• Run top-of-funnel brand ads, from placement and contracting to creative direction and development, including podcasts, OOH, and connected TV (approx. 30% of time).

• Manage and optimize paid investment daily, monitoring spend, pacing, cost per acquisition, and conversion, and reallocating budget as performance dictates.

• Run a continuous test-and-learn program across audiences, creative messaging, channels, landing pages, and donation experiences, and turn results into decisions rather than reports.

• Make key and strategic recommendations to the Director of Individual Giving and VP of Marketing on where budget spend should be allocated based on performance data.

Grow one-time and monthly giving through paid

• Run acquisition and conversion campaigns for both one-time and monthly giving, testing paid tactics to grow the recurring program—the fastest-growing part of our portfolio.

• Optimize the digital supporter journey so paid campaigns connect cleanly to landing pages, donation forms, email, and CRM, maximizing conversion and retention.

• Analyze acquisition, conversion, revenue, and retention trends by segment to inform where the next dollar goes.

Measurement & Reporting

• Stand up standardized paid-channel attribution and UTM tracking so acquisition spend is evaluable outside the ad platforms.

• Build and maintain performance dashboards that connect campaign, website, and CRM data into a single view of what each channel returns.

• Develop a forecasting model that projects cost per acquisition and revenue by channel, so budget increases are decisions rather than bets.

• Report to senior management on budget and paid campaign performance on a bi-weekly basis.

This role might not be for you if

• You are used to relying on an agency for recommendations or ad builds in the platforms themselves.

• You do not have experience/familiarity with both upper-funnel and direct conversion paid advertising.

• You are not comfortable managing projects from A–Z, including ideation, planning, launching, testing, iterating, and evaluating.

What success looks like in 12–18 months

• A clear, measurable contribution to the 2027 goal of doubling new donor acquisition, with a 50–70% share of new monthly donors acquired through paid.

• The Google Ad Grant is fully deployed against upper-funnel objectives, in compliance, and contributing measurable qualified traffic.

• A documented acquisition model forecasts cost per acquisition and revenue by channel accurately enough to justify a materially larger paid budget.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third-party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no-negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here. Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

This role is fully remote, so if you are not based in Kenya, the US, or the UK, we will share an estimated salary benchmark for the country you are based in during the hiring process.

United States

• Base Salary: $99,940

• Bonus at Target Performance: 10%

• Annual Benefits Stipend: $21,393

United Kingdom

• Base Salary: £66,150

• Bonus at Target Performance: 10%

• Annual Benefits Stipend: £2,760

Kenya

• Base Salary: $65,000

• Bonus at Target Performance: 10%

• Annual Benefits Stipend: $8,454

#LI-REMOTE

Working at GiveDirectly

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to the person’s race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Flagging for US applicants: We invite you to "Know Your Rights" as an applicant.

Commitment to Safeguarding

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. We may also employ other robust pre-hire screens, including in-depth reference checks, criminal background checks, and sanctions screens.

These efforts help us continue to build and maintain trust with the communities we work with, and prevent abuse to our recipients and staff.

**GD is committed to observing all local, national and international laws that protect people and basic human rights of all. GD is committed to a policy of “zero tolerance when it comes to preventing,  reporting, or responding to any form of abuse or  exploitation.” and expects anyone who works for GD to uphold the protection and safeguarding of our recipients as a priority.**

Reasonable Accommodations

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment. If you require any accommodations during the application or interview process, or to perform the essential functions of the role, please email us at careers@givedirectly.org with the email subject “Accommodation Needed”. We will work with you to ensure reasonable accommodations are made to support your needs.

Want to put your best foot forward on your GiveDirectly application? Take a look at our Candidate Application Prep Guide!

Referrals

Know the right person for this role? Please consider referring them. We offer a reward of $3,000 for a Senior Manager or above role, and $500 for a Manager role, paid if we end up hiring your referral. Thank you for sending great people our way!

Our promise to our people: Deloitte is where potential comes to life.

Be yourself, and more.

We are a group of talented people who want to learn, gain experience, and develop skills. Wherever you are in your career, we want you to advance.

You shape how we make impact.

Diverse perspectives and life experiences make us better. Whoever you are and wherever you’re from, we want you to feel like you belong here. We provide flexible working options to support you and how you can contribute. Be the leader you want to be.

Be the leader you want to be.

Some guide teams, some change culture, some build essential expertise. We offer opportunities and experiences that support your continuing growth as a leader.

Have as many careers as you want.

We are uniquely able to offer you new challenges and roles – and prepare you for them. We bring together people with unique experiences and talents, and we are the place to develop a lasting network of friends, peers, and mentors. Our TVP is about relationships – between leaders and their people, the firm and its people, peers, and within in our communities.

At Deloitte, we want everyone to feel they can be themselves and to thrive at work—in every country, in everything we do, every day. We aim to create a workplace where everyone is treated fairly and with respect, including reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. We seek to create and leverage our diverse workforce to build an inclusive environment across the African continent.

Application Deadline: 09 October 2026

*Note: Candidates who had previously applied in our Job Advert that closed on 10 April 2026 need NOT apply again. Double/multiple applications would lead to disqualification of your candidature.

At Deloitte, we want everyone to feel they can be themselves and to thrive at work—in every country, in everything we do, every day. We aim to create a workplace where everyone is treated fairly and with respect, including reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. We seek to create and leverage our diverse workforce to build an inclusive environment across the African continent.

We actively support the inclusion of people with disabilities and embrace neurodiversity in the workplace. We recognise and value the unique strengths that neurodivergent individuals bring, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive.

If you require reasonable accommodations in relation to your disability and neurodiverse needs during the recruitment process, please let us know. We are happy to make adjustments to suit your individual needs.

Note: The list of tasks / duties and responsibilities contained in this document is not necessarily exhaustive.  Deloitte may ask the employee to carry out additional duties or responsibilities, which may fall reasonably within the ambit of the role profile, depending on operational requirements.

Be careful of Recruitment Scams: Fraudsters or employment scammers often pose as legitimate recruiters, employers, recruitment consultants or job placement firms, advertising false job opportunities through email, text messages and WhatsApp messages. They aim to cheat jobseekers out of money or to steal personal information.

To help you look out for potential recruitment scams, here are some Red Flags:

• Upfront Payment Requests: Deloitte will never ask for any upfront payment for background checks, job training, or supplies.
• Requests for Personal Information: Be wary if you are asked for sensitive personal information, especially early in the recruitment process and without a clear need for it. Fraudulent links or contractual documents may require the provision of sensitive personal data or copy documents (e.g., government issued numbers or identity documents, passports or passport numbers, bank account statements or numbers, parent’s data) that may be used for identity fraud. Do not provide or send any of these documents or data. Please note we will never ask for photographs at any stage of the recruitment process.
• Unprofessional Communication: Scammers may communicate in an unprofessional manner. Their messages may be filled with poor grammar and spelling errors. The look and feel may not be consistent with the Deloitte corporate brand.

If you're unsure, make direct contact with Deloitte using our official contact details. Be careful not to use any contact details provided in the suspicious job advertisement or email.

jobs.title: Performance Ad Creator | 100% Remote
jobs.description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/b540b9e2-0673-4d2d-91fd-e293658f4f6a/b7561393-0797-4849-9149-363b09bab85c/job%20ad%20visual.png]

Please be informed that Foxelli Group hires exclusively in-house and doesn't work with any external recruitment agencies. Any company or individual claiming to recruit on behalf of Foxelli Group is not affiliated with us.

Foxelli brings together curious people who enjoy building brands, exploring AI and making ideas happen. Our D2C brands reach millions of customers and generate more than $20M a year. Behind them is a team that cares about the products we make and enjoys figuring things out together.

We like people who ask questions, try things and take responsibility for what happens next. If that sounds like how you work, keep reading.

WHY JOIN FOXELLI

You’ll create for our own e-commerce brands. Your ideas can go from a rough concept to a live ad, with real customer response to help you improve the next one.
We make room for experimentation and expect you to bring ideas to the table. AI is part of how we work, and we’re interested in how you use it to make better creative, learn faster and simplify production.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Performance Ad Creator who can take a product, understand why someone would want it and turn that insight into a video ad that sells.
You’ll own the idea as well as the execution: find the angle, write the hook and script, choose how to tell the story and produce the finished ad. You’ll work with our creative lead and media buyers to learn from results and decide what to create next.

If you enjoy:

 - Looking through customer reviews and spotting a reason to buy that others have missed.

 - Figuring out why an opening makes you stop scrolling, then creating your own.

 - Writing copy that sounds like a real person and gives the viewer a clear reason to care.

 - Experimenting with footage, AI and different ways to tell a product story.

 - Seeing how your ads perform and coming back with a better idea.

We’d love to work with someone who brings that curiosity all the way through to a finished ad.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

Customer research and creative concepts

 - Get to know our products and customers. Read reviews, explore objections and study existing creative to find promising angles.

 - Develop original ad concepts for paid social, especially Meta. Choose a clear selling idea and a format that suits the audience.

Copywriting and production

 - Write hooks, scripts, on-screen copy and calls to action in English.

 - Produce complete ads using product footage, creator content and AI-generated assets. Own the edit, voiceover, captions, sound and pacing.

 - Use AI throughout your workflow where it improves the result. Check that the product stays accurate and the visuals and voice feel believable.

Testing and improvement

 - Create different openings and concept variations to test new messages, motivations and storytelling approaches.

 - Review results with media buyers and use what you learn to improve existing ads and develop new concepts.

 - Review your own work before submitting it, apply feedback thoughtfully and communicate clearly about progress and deadlines.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - Experience creating ads. You’ve made direct-response video ads for e-commerce, with responsibility for both the concept and production. Subscription experience is a plus.

 - Customer understanding. You can turn a motivation, frustration or objection into a persuasive angle and clear English copy.

 - Strong production skills. You’re confident editing video and know how to use visuals, pacing, sound and text to keep a viewer engaged.

 - Practical AI skills. You use AI image, video or voice tools in real projects, can spot weak output and know how to improve it.

 - Performance thinking. You understand how watch time, CTR, conversion rate and CPA inform creative decisions, and can turn feedback into something worth testing.

 - Ownership and curiosity. You make decisions independently, care about the details and keep learning. You can take a product and a goal and move the work forward.

FIXED SERVICE FEE 
Up to 2500 euros per month after taxes (depending on your skills, competencies, and experience we'd be happy to negotiate).

PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting, while Apploye ensures transparency and fairness.

 - Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and to keep your physical well-being in check.

 - A personal development budget is at your disposal for your personal and professional growth to ensure you keep growing continuously.

 - Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested.

 - A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like.

 - Strong company culture and a network of unique individuals that celebrate you.



ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS

❕This role is 100% remote.

 - Our tribe works primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET — UTC+2/UTC+3). We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported.

 - For full-time roles, we ask that you’re available for at least 5 hours during typical EET working hours — it keeps collaboration smooth and communication easy.
   (This doesn’t apply to part-time roles.)



Currently, we are hiring in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Czech Republic, Estonia, Greece, Georgia, Kosovo, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Malta, Slovenia, Serbia, Cyprus, Bulgaria, Hungary, Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and South Africa.
