jobs.description:
Job Description:

Assembly and Maintenance team members are an important part of the Bish team!  Assembly and Maintenance team members are responsible for taking our manufactured components and assembling them for delivery to the customer.  This role also provides internal maintenance support for our own equipment, as well as participates in the maintenance and or refurbishment of company and customer agricultural equipment.

Job Responsibilities:

• Equipment and Tools: Maintains good condition and cleanliness of company vehicles inventory, tools, and equipment, including the return of tools to storage areas.
• Safety: Follows all company and common-sense safety policies, while using all required personal safety equipment. Ensures a safe work environment in his bay; reports any issues in the bay or other service work areas to the manager for follow-up.
• Service Diagnostics: Performs basic / complex diagnostics on agricultural / construction / diesel equipment, determining what repairs are needed and/or recommended for future attention / maintenance. This can be for either customer-owned equipment located at the shop or at the customer’s site, or dealer-owned equipment (inspections).
• Service Paperwork: Completes all reports and forms for service operations in a timely and accurate manner. This would include inspection reports, work orders, etc. Uses computers/tablets for data entry as required. Ensure management is aware of any issues/surprises which can impact customer billing or satisfaction. Ensures accurate timekeeping for job costing.
• Service Repairs: Performs repairs on above equipment (electrical, hydraulic, mechanical, diesel) as requested. Accountable for performing quality work and attaining stated goals for efficiency.
• Service Training / Development: Participates in all requested job-related training and development, as well as taking an active interest in improving skills with other training programs.
• Teamwork: Works collaboratively with other technicians, parts, and sales personnel. Mentors Service Technician Apprentices and junior Technicians as able. Works after hours (daily or weekend) as required.

Qualifications:

• Knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic systems.
• Owns mechanic toolset appropriate for the work required.
• Proven knowledge of methods, materials, tools, and techniques used in the repair of Ag, Automotive, & Lifting equipmen.

 - Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

 - Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

 - Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region – du startest nicht allein.

 - Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm).

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to COO
jobs.description:
Bish Enterprises is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and dependable Executive Assistant to support our Chief Operating Officer (COO).

This role is much more than traditional administrative support. The Executive Assistant will help the COO manage priorities, organize information, coordinate communication, track commitments, and keep important projects and follow-ups moving across the company.

The right person will become a trusted administrative partner who can anticipate needs, manage multiple priorities, communicate professionally, and independently close open loops without requiring constant direction.

You should be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change quickly, interruptions happen, and follow-through matters.

Key Responsibilities

Executive & Calendar Support

• Manage and maintain the COO's calendar, appointments, meetings, and scheduling priorities.
• Coordinate and confirm phone calls, Teams/Zoom meetings, appointments, and other commitments.
• Identify scheduling conflicts and help prioritize the COO's time.
• Make sure the COO has the documents, notes, links, background information, and other materials needed before meetings.
• Coordinate travel, accommodations, itineraries, events, and related logistics.
• Help keep the COO prepared for upcoming meetings, deadlines, commitments, and responsibilities.

Email, Communication & Follow-Up

• Help organize and maintain the COO's email inbox and communications.
• Track requests, commitments, deadlines, and follow-up items.
• Draft, format, proofread, and review emails, correspondence, reports, presentations, quotes, and other materials.
• Communicate professionally with employees, customers, vendors, industry partners, nonprofit organizations, and other external contacts.
• Make sure promised information and follow-ups are completed.
• Screen and appropriately direct incoming communications.
• Maintain professional relationship continuity on behalf of the COO.

Project & Team Coordination

• Follow up with team members across administration, sales, marketing, production, engineering, and other departments.
• Track project deliverables, deadlines, open questions, responsibilities, and next steps.
• Follow through on outstanding items until they are resolved.
• Help maintain accountability across projects and departments.
• Take clear meeting notes and turn discussions into organized action items.
• Keep project information, notes, and supporting documents organized.
• Update customer records, notes, CRM information, and project information when requested.

Administrative & Business Support

• Prepare presentations, reports, correspondence, meeting materials, and other documents.
• Organize and maintain electronic files and records.
• Conduct basic research and organize information for executive review.
• Assist with internal and external meetings, events, conferences, and speaking engagements.
• Provide administrative support for industry associations, nonprofit initiatives, and other organizational activities.
• Handle confidential and sensitive information with professionalism and discretion.
• Assist with changing business and executive priorities as needed.

What Success Looks Like

A strong Executive Assistant at Bish does more than complete assigned tasks.

You should be someone who:

• Takes ownership of responsibilities and follows through.
• Notices when something is incomplete and works to resolve it.
• Keeps commitments, deadlines, and follow-ups from falling through the cracks.
• Understands what is urgent, what can wait, and when clarification is needed.
• Learns processes quickly and becomes increasingly independent.
• Takes useful notes and remembers recurring expectations.
• Communicates clearly and professionally with different personalities and departments.
• Is comfortable respectfully following up with coworkers and executives.
• Can manage interruptions and changing priorities without losing organization.
• Identifies practical solutions instead of simply reporting problems.
• Pays close attention to details while still understanding the larger priority.
• Can work independently without needing constant supervision.
• Knows when to take initiative and when to ask for direction.
• Is reliable, discreet, and trusted with sensitive information.

Required

• At least 2 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Office Administrator, or in a closely related support role.
• Strong organizational and time-management skills.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
• Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
• Demonstrated reliability and follow-through.
• Ability to manage multiple responsibilities, deadlines, and changing priorities.
• Ability to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.
• Strong judgment and discretion when handling sensitive or confidential information.
• Professional communication skills when interacting with executives, employees, customers, vendors, and external partners.
• Strong proficiency with Microsoft 365, including:OutlookWordExcelPowerPointTeams
• Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new systems quickly.
• Legally authorized to work in the United States.
• Able to work on-site at our Giltner, Nebraska location.

Preferred

• Experience directly supporting a COO, CEO, business owner, entrepreneur, or senior executive.
• Experience managing executive calendars and email inboxes.
• Experience coordinating projects across multiple departments.
• Experience with CRM systems.
• Experience with project-management tools such as Smartsheet, Trello, Asana, or similar platforms.
• Experience in sales support, marketing, public relations, business operations, or customer communication.
• Experience coordinating travel, conferences, events, or speaking engagements.
• Spanish language skills.
• Interest in agriculture, manufacturing, agricultural equipment, sustainability, or mission-driven organizations.

Agricultural experience is helpful but not required. We are more interested in finding someone who can learn quickly, understand the business, and become a reliable and increasingly independent partner to the COO.

Schedule

• Full-time position.
• Approximately 30–40+ hours per week, depending on workload and business needs.
• Primarily weekday business hours.
• Some flexibility may be required for meetings, events, travel, deadlines, harvest season, or time-sensitive priorities.
• This position is fully on-site in Giltner, Nebraska.

Benefits

Eligible full-time employees may have access to:

• Health insurance options
• HSA plan options
• Dental insurance
• Vision insurance
• Disability insurance
• Paid holidays
• Paid time off
• Company-matched 401(k)
• Partner discounts
• Professional growth opportunities

Benefit eligibility may vary based on employment status.

Equal Opportunity

Bish Enterprises is an equal opportunity employer. We will handle applicant information confidentially in accordance with applicable EEO guidelines.

La persona seleccionada será responsable de impulsar una gestión homogénea, eficiente y basada en datos, coordinando a las distintas sociedades, proveedores y usuarios internos.

El puesto tendrá un alcance nacional y combinará la gestión operativa de vehículos con el análisis de costes, el seguimiento de indicadores y la identificación de oportunidades de mejora.

Principales responsabilidades :

• Gestionar de forma integral la flota de Water Solutions y coordinar la flota de camiones de Veolia en España, asegurando su disponibilidad, mantenimiento, documentación, utilización y eficiencia.
• Supervisar una flota de más de 200 camiones y contribuir a la coordinación de aproximadamente 7.400 vehículos bajo gestión central, utilizando la telemetría y otros sistemas de información para mejorar la toma de decisiones.
• Definir y realizar el seguimiento de indicadores clave de flota: disponibilidad, utilización, kilometraje, mantenimiento, incidencias, coste por vehículo y eficiencia operativa.
• Identificar oportunidades de reutilización y redistribución de camiones entre sociedades, así como sinergias en mantenimiento, componentes y servicios.
• Gestionar y controlar un gasto de combustible mediante el seguimiento de límites por tarjeta, consumos, posibles usos indebidos, bajas de vehículos, gastos en Rydoo y cuadros de mando.
• Detectar desviaciones y proponer medidas de ahorro, control y prevención de fraude, realizando el seguimiento de los resultados obtenidos.
• Impulsar la estandarización de procesos y la mejora continua en la gestión de vehículos, camiones y combustible en las distintas sociedades y centros de Veolia en España.
• Elaborar informes periódicos para facilitar la toma de decisiones y evaluar el impacto económico y operativo de las iniciativas implantadas.

• Estudios de CFGM, CFGS o formación equivalente.
• 4 años de experiencia en gestión de flotas, transporte, logística, movilidad, mantenimiento de vehículos o servicios similares.
• Al menos 2 años gestionando o coordinando vehículos industriales, camiones o flotas distribuidas geográficamente.
• Experiencia en control de costes, combustible, tarjetas de carburante, proveedores, talleres, mantenimiento e indicadores operativos.
• Experiencia trabajando con sistemas de telemetría, bases de datos, cuadros de mando o herramientas de gestión.
• Se valorará experiencia en entornos corporativos con varias sociedades, centros o unidades de negocio.
• Carnet de conducir tipo B.
• Disponibilidad para desplazamientos puntuales por España.

Competencias

• Organización y capacidad de planificación.
• Capacidad analítica y orientación a resultados.
• Orientación a la mejora continua y a la eficiencia.
• Habilidades de coordinación, comunicación y negociación.
• Compromiso con la seguridad, el cumplimiento y la sostenibilidad.

¿Qué podemos ofrecerte? 🚀

• Ser parte de una empresa multinacional líder en el sector.
• Formación durante los primeros meses.
• Contratación indefinida.
• Flexibilidad.

En Veolia, sabemos que los/as profesionales son el pilar fundamental de nuestra identidad corporativa y de nuestros logros. Por eso, promovemos su integración desde un firme compromiso con la igualdad entre hombres y mujeres, compartiendo nuestra cultura corporativa, experiencia y buenas prácticas.

Lo que nos une a los/as empleados/as es la pasión y la excelencia con la que trabajamos cada día para proteger el medio ambiente y garantizar el acceso al agua. Juntos, construimos un presente más verde e inclusivo.

¡Si quieres formar parte de este equipo y sumarte a este gran reto, no dudes en postularte a la oferta!

Como empresa inclusiva, Veolia está comprometida con la diversidad y valora todas las solicitudes sin discriminación.

jobs.title: Sales Team Coordinator | ON-SITE
jobs.description:
Bish Enterprises is seeking a proactive, organized, and customer-focused Sales Team Coordinator to support and coordinate the daily activities of our sales team.

This is a hands-on sales support, customer service, and people-coordination position. The employee will help organize priorities, monitor assignments, follow up with team members, coordinate communication, and make sure sales-related tasks continue moving forward.

The Sales Team Coordinator serves as a central point of communication between sales representatives, customers, management, and other departments.

Work Location

This is a full-time, on-site position located at:

508 S D Road

Giltner, Nebraska 68841

The employee is expected to work from the Bish Enterprises office during normal working hours.

This is not a remote or hybrid position.

Applicants must be able to reliably commute to the Giltner office.

A company laptop may be provided for business use. Receiving a company laptop does not make this a remote or hybrid position.

Travel Requirement

Some business travel is required.

Travel may include:

• Customer visits
• Trade shows
• Agricultural events
• Equipment demonstrations
• Training
• Sales meetings
• Dealer visits
• Other company-related activities

Travel may occasionally involve early mornings, evenings, weekends, or overnight stays.

The amount and location of travel may vary depending on customer needs, company events, sales activities, and the agricultural season.

The employee must be willing and able to travel when required.

Sales Team Coordination

The Sales Team Coordinator will help organize and coordinate the daily work of the sales team.

Responsibilities include:

• Helping communicate daily and weekly priorities to members of the sales team.
• Tracking sales-related assignments, deadlines, customer commitments, quotes, orders, and follow-up activities.
• Contacting team members for updates, missing information, and task completion.
• Reminding team members of deadlines, meetings, customer commitments, and required follow-ups.
• Making sure assigned tasks have a clear owner, deadline, and next step.
• Following up when work is incomplete, overdue, unclear, or missing.
• Helping organize and facilitate sales meetings.
• Preparing meeting agendas, notes, action items, assignments, and follow-up lists.
• Monitoring progress on action items discussed during meetings.
• Helping keep sales representatives aligned with company priorities and customer expectations.
• Identifying stalled opportunities, communication gaps, workload conflicts, or missing information.
• Escalating repeated delays, unresolved problems, or serious concerns to management.
• Helping maintain consistent use of the company’s CRM, calendars, sales procedures, and reporting systems.
• Assisting with onboarding and training coordination for new sales team members.
• Helping organize training materials, system access, schedules, meetings, and follow-up activities.

This role includes meaningful people coordination and day-to-day oversight of sales activities.

The employee may provide direction, follow-up, and accountability to members of the sales team. However, final authority regarding hiring, termination, compensation, formal discipline, and major personnel decisions remains with company management unless otherwise assigned.

Customer Service and Communication

The Sales Team Coordinator will help support customers throughout the sales process.

Responsibilities include:

• Answering customer phone calls, emails, and other inquiries in a friendly and professional manner.
• Gathering the information needed to understand the customer’s request.
• Directing technical, pricing, warranty, service, or product questions to the appropriate team member when necessary.
• Following up with customers regarding quotes, orders, availability, appointments, delivery information, and next steps.
• Providing customers with accurate information based on approved company materials and pricing.
• Communicating delays, changes, and updates clearly and promptly.
• Documenting customer commitments and making sure promised follow-ups are completed.
• Assisting with customer concerns by gathering information and coordinating with the appropriate department.
• Following customer issues through until they are resolved or transferred to the correct person.
• Representing Bish Enterprises professionally when communicating with customers, vendors, dealers, visitors, and industry contacts.

Quotes, Orders, and Sales Support

Responsibilities include:

• Preparing customer quotes, proposals, product information, and sales documents using company templates and approved pricing.
• Reviewing documents for accuracy and completeness before they are sent.
• Receiving customer orders and accurately entering the required information into company systems.
• Confirming customer contact information, products, pricing, delivery details, payment requirements, and other order information.
• Monitoring open quotes and orders to help prevent missed deadlines or incomplete tasks.
• Coordinating with production, parts, service, shipping, accounting, marketing, and other departments.
• Checking order status and identifying possible delays or missing information.
• Communicating order updates to the appropriate sales representative, customer, or manager.
• Scheduling customer calls, meetings, demonstrations, appointments, and follow-ups.
• Maintaining sales calendars and communicating scheduling changes.
• Assisting with preparation for trade shows, customer visits, sales meetings, and equipment demonstrations.

CRM, Reporting, and Administrative Support

Responsibilities include:

• Entering and maintaining customer, lead, quote, order, and follow-up information in the company’s systems.
• Keeping customer contact information, notes, deadlines, sales stages, and next steps complete and current.
• Preparing regular sales reports using information from the CRM, spreadsheets, and other company systems.
• Organizing information clearly for management and the sales team.
• Highlighting overdue follow-ups, open quotes, customer concerns, order issues, and other items requiring attention.
• Completing data entry, filing, document preparation, and record organization.
• Maintaining commonly used sales materials, templates, documents, and office supplies.
• Helping improve sales coordination procedures, tracking systems, and internal communication.

Independence and Accountability

The successful candidate must be able to work independently after receiving appropriate training.

The employee will be expected to:

• Keep track of assigned tasks and deadlines.
• Follow up without needing repeated reminders.
• Ask questions when instructions or information are unclear.
• Identify routine problems and take reasonable action to solve them.
• Find the correct person or resource when assistance is needed.
• Communicate delays, mistakes, or concerns promptly.
• Keep management informed about important customer, sales, or team issues.
• Address incomplete work professionally and respectfully.
• Balance being supportive with maintaining clear expectations.
• Work confidently with different personalities and communication styles.

This position may not be a good fit for someone who requires constant step-by-step direction for routine work or who is uncomfortable following up with coworkers about incomplete assignments.

Work Schedule

This is a full-time position that generally requires approximately 44 to 50 working hours per week.

The normal schedule is Monday through Friday.

Saturday, early-morning, evening, or additional hours may occasionally be required due to:

• Customer deadlines
• Company travel
• Trade shows or events
• Equipment demonstrations
• Agricultural seasonality
• Increased workload during busy periods

Some scheduling flexibility may be available with management approval.

Any schedule adjustment must still allow the employee to meet customer needs, attend required meetings, complete on-site responsibilities, coordinate the sales team, and fulfill travel requirements.

Because Bish Enterprises is a small and growing company, employees may occasionally be asked to assist with reasonable duties outside their normal task list.

• Required QualificationsAbility to work full-time and on-site at the Bish Enterprises office in Giltner, Nebraska.Reliable transportation and the ability to commute consistently to the Giltner office.Willingness and ability to travel for company business when required.Valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record when driving is required.Strong verbal and written communication skills.Friendly, patient, and professional customer-service skills.Ability to communicate clearly by phone, email, video call, and in person.Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.Ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, customers, and team follow-ups.Ability to accurately enter and maintain information in computer systems.Ability to learn and follow company sales, quoting, order, and customer-service processes.Ability to work independently after receiving training.Ability to follow through on tasks without repeated reminders.Ability to recognize problems, ask appropriate questions, and find practical solutions.Ability to work cooperatively with employees from different departments.Ability to remain calm and professional when priorities change or customers are frustrated.Ability to maintain confidential customer, employee, and company information.

People Coordination and Leadership Skills

• Ability to coordinate the daily work of the sales team members.
• Ability to clearly communicate assignments, priorities, deadlines, and expectations.
• Ability to follow up professionally when tasks or customer commitments are incomplete.
• Confidence asking team members for updates and required information.
• Ability to document responsibilities, deadlines, decisions, and next steps.
• Ability to lead or help facilitate sales meetings.
• Ability to identify when work is delayed, unclear, duplicated, or missing.
• Ability to address routine accountability concerns professionally.
• Ability to escalate serious or repeated issues to management.
• Ability to balance supporting team members with maintaining clear expectations.
• Ability to work with different personalities and communication styles.
• Ability to keep people organized and aligned without waiting for management to intervene in every situation.

Computer Skills

The employee must be comfortable using:

• Microsoft Outlook
• Microsoft Word
• Microsoft Excel
• Online calendars
• Customer relationship management systems
• Video meeting platforms
• Web-based business software
• Printers, scanners, telephones, and standard office equipment

The employee should be able to:

• Write clear and professional emails.
• Create, edit, save, and organize documents.
• Schedule meetings and manage calendar invitations.
• Enter data accurately.
• Sort and filter information in Excel.
• Use simple Excel formulas.
• Prepare small spreadsheets and basic reports.
• Create clear lists of assignments, owners, deadlines, and next steps.
• Learn new software with reasonable training.
• Perform basic office-equipment troubleshooting, such as reconnecting equipment or clearing a printer paper jam.

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience is preferred but may not be required:

• Previous experience coordinating employees, sales representatives, projects, schedules, or cross-functional teams.
• Previous experience in sales support.
• Customer-service experience.
• Administrative or office experience.
• Order-entry or order-processing experience.
• Experience preparing quotes or proposals.
• Experience using customer relationship management software.
• Experience leading meetings or tracking team assignments.
• Experience working with agricultural equipment, farming customers, machinery, manufacturing, parts, or service departments.
• Experience supporting trade shows, events, or customer demonstrations.
• Previous sales experience.

Applicants do not need to have held the exact title of Sales Team Coordinator.

Related experience in team coordination, customer service, office support, sales administration, order processing, project coordination, or account support may be considered.

Compensation

Wage is $40,000 base salary plus commission.

Expected yearly earnings are approximately $45,000–$70,000 during the first year. Actual earnings may vary based on performance, eligible sales, and the terms of the company’s commission plan.

Work Schedule

This is a full-time, on-site position located at Bish Enterprises in Giltner, Nebraska.

The normal work schedule is Monday through Friday, generally totaling approximately 44–50 hours per week.

Saturday, early-morning, evening, or additional hours may occasionally be required based on customer needs, company travel, trade shows, events, and agricultural seasonality.

Some scheduling flexibility may be available with management approval, provided that customer coverage, required meetings, on-site responsibilities, team coordination, and travel requirements are met.

This is not a remote or hybrid position.

Travel

Some business travel is required.

Travel may include customer visits, trade shows, agricultural events, equipment demonstrations, training, dealer visits, sales meetings, and other company-related activities.

Travel may occasionally include overnight stays, early mornings, evenings, or weekends.

The amount of travel may vary based on company needs and the agricultural season.

Benefits

Bish Enterprises offers a variety of benefits to eligible full-time employees. Benefits may include:

• Health insurance assistance
• Dental insurance
• Vision insurance
• Life insurance
• Paid time off
• Paid holidays
• Retirement plan options
• Employee discounts
• Professional development and training opportunities
• Company-provided equipment required for the position

Health Insurance

Bish Enterprises does not currently offer a traditional company-sponsored group health insurance plan.

Eligible employees may purchase individual health insurance through the federal Health Insurance Marketplace or another provider of their choice.

The company may provide a monthly health insurance contribution or reimbursement toward an eligible individual health insurance plan, subject to company policy and applicable requirements.

Employees are responsible for selecting, enrolling in, and maintaining their own individual health insurance coverage.

The availability and cost of Marketplace coverage may vary based on the employee’s household, location, income, selected plan, and eligibility for government subsidies.

Specific details regarding the company’s health insurance contribution or reimbursement will be explained during the hiring and enrollment process.

Benefit Eligibility

Some benefits are available only to employees who meet full-time status or other eligibility requirements.

Benefit eligibility, waiting periods, employee costs, company contributions, coverage terms, and plan availability are governed by the applicable company policies and benefit documents.

Benefits may be changed, replaced, or discontinued as permitted by law and company policy.

Other Information

A company laptop and other necessary equipment may be provided for business use.

Providing a company laptop does not make this a remote or hybrid position.

Because Bish Enterprises is a small and growing company, employees may occasionally be asked to perform reasonable duties outside their normal task list to support customers, coworkers, and changing business needs.

Regular and reliable attendance is an essential part of this position.

Employment with Bish Enterprises is at will. This means that either the employee or Bish Enterprises may end the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or advance notice, subject to applicable law.

Bish Enterprises is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Linguist/Transcriber - Chichewa/Nyanja - Remote
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Are you a native Chichewa speaker with strong attention to detail and a passion for working with real-world spoken language? We are building a team of Chichewa language specialists to support a multilingual speech-to-text project focused on African languages.
You will work with existing Chichewa audio recordings (no recording needed), helping to create high-quality, accurate transcripts that support advanced language technology development. 

The project is expected to run for about 2–3 months, with around 20–30 hours of work per week.

 


WHAT YOU’LL DELIVER

You may contribute to one or more of the following workflows:

 1. PII Tagging

 - Identify and tag personal information (PII) in audio content

 - Mark background sounds and non-speech events according to the provided guidelines

 2. Transcription (Chichewa)

 - Review and correct automatically generated transcripts against the audio

 - Ensure high fidelity to spoken content, including noises, cross talk, etc., while following the provided annotation guidelines

 3. Transcription QC

 - Review finished transcripts for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to guidelines

 - Correct errors and provide structured feedback on linguistic issues where needed




QUALIFICATIONS

 - Native-level proficiency in Chichewa

 - Strong listening skills and close attention to detail

 - Prior experience with spoken language transcription or linguistic annotation is a strong advantage

 - A background in linguistics, language studies, or translation is a plus

 - Good-quality headphones and a quiet place to work

 - Availability for around 20–30 hours per week over the 2–3 month project period

Job Description:

Bish Enterprises is seeking a hands-on, performance-driven Sales Team Manager to lead and strengthen our sales organization. This role is designed for a leader who is comfortable managing KPIs, coaching salespeople, improving CRM and follow-up discipline, and remaining directly involved in customer acquisition and sales execution.

As a Sales Manager, you will lead our small but dedicated sales team, drive customer acquisition, increase revenue growth, and oversee direct sales efforts. Collaborating with upper management as well as our marketing team, you'll devise strategic sales and marketing plans, manage the marketing budget, and ensure our campaigns align with our brand identity.  This role will be directly involved with the day-to-day sales, while simultaneously providing coaching, guidance, and accountability to our sales team members.

Your knack for analyzing the effectiveness of these strategies will be critical to optimizing our sales potential. As the primary contact for sales-related issues, we will rely on your proactive problem-solving skills. Join us as we continue to foster growth and success within the agricultural equipment sector.

Job Responsibilities:

• Assist in determining price schedules and discount rates
• Assist in identifying issues with shipping through direct involvement to help provide clarity on invoices and increased efficiency, productivity, and safety within that department
• Assist in the preparation of budgets and budget expenditures
• Collaborates effectively with others for the success of the department; promotes a free flow of information & ideas across departments
• Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates
• Confer with department heads or staff to discuss topics such as contracts, selection of advertising media, or product to be advertised
• Confer with organizational members to accomplish work activities
• Coordinate and/or manage sales activities
• Demonstrate a high degree of business acumen

• Strong customer-facing communication and the ability to build credibility with farmers, equipment operators, business owners, and technically knowledgeable customers.
• Ability to manage customer opportunities from initial contact through follow-up, quoting, closing, and continued customer communication.

• Must be able to work on-site in Giltner, Nebraska. Candidates outside a reasonable commuting distance must be willing to relocate.
• Must be available for the stated work schedule, including seasonal demands and 2–4 Saturdays per month.

Preferred

jobs.description:
Job Description:

As a Fabricator at Bish Enterprises, you will engage in all stages of the manufacturing process, including plasma table cutting, press brake bending, parts cleaning, welding, and assembly. This role requires proficiency with a variety of tools and machines to create high-quality agricultural components.

Job Responsibilities:

• Operate plasma cutting tables and press brakes with precision.
• Clean and prepare parts to ensure high-quality welds and assemblies.
• Perform MIG and TIG welding to construct and repair parts based on technical plans and verbal instructions.
• Assemble parts accurately according to production specifications.
• Maintain a clean and safe work environment, adhering to safety standards and reporting any issues.
• Utilize various hand tools and machinery, ensuring their upkeep and proper storage.
• Collaborate effectively with team members, maintaining open lines of communication regarding operational issues.
• Manage materials movement throughout the facility using appropriate equipment.

• Comprehensive understanding of manufacturing processes including cutting, bending, cleaning, welding, and assembling components.
• Capable of reading and interpreting technical documents, such as blueprints, safety rules, and operating manuals.
• Proficient in basic mathematics and measurements.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Self-motivated with a focus on results and time management.
• Familiarity with common power tools and their maintenance.

jobs.title: CSシステム企画（データ・分析推進担当）
jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼CS本部 CSシステム企画部のご紹介
PayPayのCS部門のミッションである「そもそも困らせない」「困ってもすぐに解決できるようにする」の実現を目指し、ユーザーファーストの視点で日々の業務・運用改善に取り組んでいます。今回、そのなかでCSシステム企画部で複数名の採用募集をしております。急速なサービス成長、顧客数増加に伴いPayPayが提供するカスタマーサポートの利用者も増加しております。「人と機械を融合させて顧客体験を最大・最適化」をMissionに掲げ、ユーザーにより簡単に迅速に問題を解決できるようシステムによる高度化を進めています。配属予定部署は30歳代を中心に総勢20名ほどの組織です。企画から要件定義書の作成、開発依頼、運用保守など幅広くCSシステムに携わり、お客様が努力せず問題解決できるカスタマーサポートを提供できるように業務を進めてます。

▼募集の背景
カスタマーサポート領域では、生成AIの活用が急速に拡大しています。
これまで人が行ってきた問い合わせ対応の一部をAIが担うようになる中、今後は「AIを導入する」だけではなく、「AIの回答が適切だったのか」「どこに改善余地があるのか」をデータから継続的に評価し、精度を高めていくことが重要になります。
また、CSには問い合わせログ、応対履歴、顧客行動など多くのデータが蓄積されています。これらを活用し、顧客体験や業務効率の改善につなげるデータ分析機能についても、さらに強化していく必要があります。
そこで、生成AIとデータ分析の両面から課題を発見し、改善まで推進できる人材を募集します。

【具体的な業務内容】
急成長するPayPayのカスタマーサポート領域において、生成AIエージェントの利用が拡大するなかで、単に定量データやナレッジだけではなく、過去の判断データなどの非定型・データ構造化未対応のデータ整備の重要性がさらに高まっています。また、生成AIによる分析やデータ取り扱いの民主化が進むにつれ、データ分析基盤の整備・高度化も急務になっています。そうした、CS領域のデータ基盤・分析基盤の整備・利活用推進を担当いただきます。

●CSシステム企画担当（データ・分析推進担当）
・生成AIエージェントの品質評価、データ分析、継続的な精度改善
・問い合わせログや顧客行動データ等の収集・統合・分析
・CS領域におけるKPI設計、ダッシュボード構築・可視化
・データ分析を起点とした課題発見、改善施策の立案・効果検証
・生成AI／データ活用に必要なデータ基盤・ガバナンスの整備
・経営、開発部門、CS部門、関連部署とのプロジェクト推進

▼本ポジションの魅力

• カスタマーサポートを支えるシステムについて幅広く触れることができます

• 上流工程（企画設計など）〜下流工程（運用保守）まで一貫して携わることができるため導入後のエンハンスなど結果について追い求めることが可能です

• AIを活用したこれまでにないカスタマーサポートプラットフォームを構築中であり新しい技術、仕組みを体験、習得できます

• 本部署ではコールシステムエンジニア、データアナリスト、プロジェクトマネージャーなど様々な職種の方が在籍しており多くのことを学ぶことができます

必要な経験/スキル

jobs.description:
PayPayについて/About PayPay

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは約50の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

AIを含む最新技術とデータを駆使し、圧倒的なスピードでサービス開発と事業成長を実現します。 日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、ユーザーの為に新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼CS本部 CX推進部のご紹介

【ミッション】
1.ユーザーをそもそも困らせない
2.ユーザーが困ってもすぐ解決する

・PayPayのユーザー体験を正しく理解し、困りごとを最小化すること
・ユーザーが困っても迅速に解決する仕組みを構築すること
・上記を実現するためにステークホルダーと協業し、分析/企画/オペレーションを実行・進捗管理
・ファクトを正しく把握し、現状に満足せず、変革・改善を続けPayPayグループの成長へ貢献する

【組織構成】

・ユーザーがそもそも困らない体験にするため、すぐに解決できるセンターをつくるため、社内や窓口運営の委託先と調整し、リードしていく役割を担っています
・札幌・首都圏・関西・小倉・博多と居住地は多様です
・CS本部全体も多様性のあるメンバー構成です
└ 事業会社、金融機関、BPO等、多様なバックグラウンドのメンバーが揃っています

▼募集の背景
AIを始めとする技術の進化によって、これまでは人でしかできなかったことが、機械でも行えるようになってきています。有人センターでまさにいま行われている業務を単に改善するだけではなく、AIを前提とした再構成も必要となります。どのような人と機械の組み合わせが最適なのか、探り続けていく必要があります。そうした時代の最先端を見据えながら、センター現場の業務を再構成する挑戦を行うため、本募集を行っています。

【具体的な業務内容】

●CX業務推進（業務管理・改善推進担当）（博多センター：正社員）
急成長するPayPayのカスタマーサポート領域の現場を理解し、AIを活用して業務改善をリードする役割です。博多駅より徒歩8分のセンターへの勤務を主にしつつ、リモート勤務も併用可です。
7000万人を超える登録ユーザーを抱えるPayPayサービスのカスタマーサポートの現場（委託先にて運営）に対し、現場のオペレーションを深く理解し、また数値分析をもとに業務改善ポイントを明確にし、改善活動を推進します。
あわせて、AIを前提としたCS関連業務の効率化・業務見直しをリードします。
現場との距離を最小化し、AI施策の検証から定着化までを迅速に推進するため、センター勤務を主としています。

《具体的な業務内容》

・AIや自動化技術を活用した新しい業務フローの設計・ビジネス要件定義

・社内ステークホルダーとの調整、レポーティング

※Uターン・Iターン大歓迎！

▼本ポジションの魅力

• 課題形成から改善提案〜実現まで裁量をもって実行することができます。

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II - Frontend
jobs.location: Boca Raton; Boston; New York City; Seattle
jobs.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

As a Senior Software Engineer II, you will join a world-class engineering team operating the only end-to-end platform in the real estate industry. We are building a high-caliber talent pool of Frontend Senior Engineers to lead technical initiatives across several key domain areas.

Our Key Domains & Focus Areas

Based on your background and interests, you will have the opportunity to align with one of our specialized domains:

• Agent Client Tools - Buy Side: Crafting collaborative, client-facing interfaces and agent tools that guide buyers through every step of the journey, from initial home search to close.

• CRM - Comms: Designing and scaling the communication engines (email, text, and notifications) that enable real-time, personalized interaction between agents and their clients at scale.

• CRM - Contacts: Architecting the high-performance, foundational data models, relationship graphs, and contact-management interfaces that serve as the single source of truth for millions of client records.

• CRM - Insights: Transforming Compass's CRM from a system of record into an intelligent system of action - using AI-driven insights to surface data patterns and proactively guide agents toward high-value activity.

What You Will Do

• End-to-End Design & Build: Shape a strategic, high-visibility product surface, building innovative dashboards, notifications, and reporting interfaces that make those insights actionable for thousands of agents.

• Drive Technical Delivery: Independently define, decompose, and lead the delivery of complex technical projects and subsystems across the entire stack.

• Incorporate Intelligent Automation: Build and operationalize modern software patterns, including integrating AI models, data pipelines, and telemetry systems to automate workflows.

• Champion Engineering Excellence: Perform rigorous code and design reviews, write high-quality automated tests (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and continuously leave codebases cleaner and more performant than you found them.

• Own Your Domain: Act as a subject matter expert, creating clear technical documentation (architecture diagrams, runbooks, and specs) and owning your services and applications throughout their entire lifecycle.

• Collaborate & Mentor: Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to balance requirements, resolve systemic bottlenecks, and actively mentor peers to level up the engineering team.

What We Look For

• Education: BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience: 5+ years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of delivering complex technical projects autonomously. (Candidates with 3+ years of exceptional, fast-tracked execution are also encouraged to apply).

• Frontend Capabilities:

• Deep expertise in modern frontend frameworks (e.g., React), UI/UX execution, and browser performance, paired with a solid understanding of backend APIs and integrations.

• Professional experience with Python is a major plus (highly valued for data pipelines and AI/LLM workflows).

• Experience with Kafka is a plus.

• Domain Expertise (Area Dependent):

• Experience building high-throughput user workflow tools, transactional systems, dynamic user interfaces, or SaaS products.

• Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a strong sense of technical empathy for your end-users (whether they are real estate agents or fellow developers).

Compensation: The base pay range for this position is $176,000-$196,100; however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Bonuses and restricted stock units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location. Minimum wage for the position will always be met.

Perks that You Need to Know About:

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

Do your best work, be your authentic self.

At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive.  Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer competitive compensation packages, robust benefits and professional growth opportunities aimed at helping to improve our employees' lives and careers.

jobs.title: DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role

The DevSecOps Engineer works to execute security engineering activities across A-LIGN's cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and production applications. In this role, you will be responsible for implementing and continuously validating security controls, delivering infrastructure and application improvements, and supporting continuous audit readiness. As the DevSecOps Engineer, you will provide exceptional technical and security strategies to help support the continued growth of our fast-paced company. A-LIGN will depend on you as the DevSecOps Engineer to support management, translate security and compliance requirements into practical engineering solutions, and automate security and audit evidence workflows.

Reports to

Principal Security Engineer

Pay Classification

Full-Time

Responsibilities

• Design, implement, and continuously validate security controls across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and production applications

• Author and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform or similar tools across quality assurance, staging, and production environments

• Deliver production code that addresses security requirements, including authentication, single sign-on, authorization, session security, and vulnerability remediation

• Design and administer identity and access management solutions, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, identity providers, authorization models, and account lifecycle automation

• Manage vulnerability remediation from triage through closure across static application security testing, dynamic application security testing, dependency scanning, and container scanning tools

• Remediate penetration testing findings in code and infrastructure and prepare evidence-based technical responses when findings do not apply

• Translate FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, and other framework requirements into deployed technical controls and repeatable audit evidence

• Maintain cryptographic compliance through validated module configuration, certificate management, and TLS and DNS posture verification

• Develop automation for security operations and evidence collection, including scripts, reports, API integrations, and verified artificial intelligence workflows

• Maintain security architecture documentation, including authorization boundaries, network architecture, and data flow diagrams

• Perform security impact analysis for production changes and maintain pre-production security deployment checklists

• Participate in threat modeling, risk assessments, continuous monitoring, software bill of materials generation, software supply chain security, logging coverage, and user access reviews

Minimum Qualifications

EDUCATION

• Bachelor's degree in information systems, cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

EXPERIENCE

• At least 4 years of combined experience in DevSecOps, security engineering, cloud engineering, or software engineering

• Experience developing production software in Go, Python, TypeScript, or a comparable modern programming language

• Hands-on experience with GCP, AWS, or Azure, including identity and access management, containers or serverless services, build pipelines, secrets management, and log-based troubleshooting

• Experience using Terraform or a similar infrastructure as code platform in production environments

• Working knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SAML, JSON Web Tokens, and identity provider administration

• Experience managing vulnerabilities and responding to penetration testing findings, including code-level remediation

• Experience with scripting and automation using Python, shell, SQL, or similar tools

• Experience working in regulated or compliance-driven environments preferred

• Familiarity with FedRAMP, NIST 800-53, SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar security and compliance frameworks

• Familiarity with FIPS 140-2 or FIPS 140-3 requirements preferred

• Experience with fine-grained authorization models, governance, risk, and compliance platforms, or compliance as code tooling preferred

• Experience operating in a private equity-backed or high-growth environment preferred

CERTIFICATIONS

• Preferred: CISSP, CCSP, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or a similar cloud security certification

SKILLS

• Ability to translate security and compliance requirements into practical engineering changes and implement them directly

• Ability to troubleshoot across content delivery networks, web application firewalls, load balancers, runtime platforms, application code, and logs

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare technical documentation, auditor responses, and repeatable runbooks

• Highly organized with the ability to manage release, remediation, and audit deadlines across multiple concurrent workstreams

• Self-directed with strong follow-through in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

• Ability to work individually as well as collaboratively across technical and business teams

• Demonstrated experience using agentic artificial intelligence development tools to support coding, integrations, workflow automation, and output verification

Benefits

• Employer Paid Life & Health Insurance

• Competitive Bonus Structure

• Home Office Reimbursement

• Technology Allowance

• Certification Reimbursement

• BeneficiaT Discount Loyalty Program

• Personalized Career Coaching

• Generous Paid Time Off

• Paid Office Closure December 25-January 1

• Summer Hours

About A-LIGN

A-LIGN is the leading provider of high-quality, efficient cybersecurity compliance programs. Combining experienced auditors and audit management technology, A-LIGN provides the widest breadth and depth of services including SOC 2, ISO 27001, HITRUST, FedRAMP, and PCI. A-LIGN is the number one issuer of SOC 2 and HITRUST and a top three FedRAMP assessor. To learn more, visit a-lign.com.

Come Work for A-LIGN!

Apply online today at A-LIGN.com and learn about life at A-LIGN by following us on LinkedIn.

A-LIGN is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Minorities, women, disabled, and veterans encouraged to apply!

jobs.title: Analista de Dados
jobs.description:
Presta apoio para garantir que os ativos de dados de referência sejam criados com precisão e mantidos de forma contínua, através da aplicação rigorosa dos princípios da gestão de dados de referência, de modo a assegurar a consistência na utilização desses dados em todas as plataformas (por exemplo, plataformas de sistemas), em conformidade com as normas do setor e as normas internas.

Funções Essenciais

Ajudar na captura de dados de referência e no registo de alterações de dados para garantir que quaisquer atualizações estejam em conformidade com os níveis de serviço definidos. Prestar apoio na comunicação atempada de alterações de dados que tenham um impacto interfuncional, a fim de minimizar o impacto.

Ajudar na identificação de proprietários de dados nos casos em que a propriedade dos dados não exista e processar quaisquer alterações de dados aprovadas pelos proprietários. Compreender as regras de negócio aplicadas para poder monitorizar o cumprimento dessas regras.

Ajudar na aplicação e integração de princípios e políticas de governação aprovados. Escalar quaisquer violações da governação de elementos de dados.

Participar e cumprir os requisitos de governação de alterações de produção de IT.

Realizar uma monitorização contínua dos dados de referência para garantir o cumprimento das regras e normas definidas e assegurar a precisão dos dados, através da realização e comunicação de auditorias periódicas e verificações de integridade dos dados.

Manter-se a par das normas do setor, bem como das melhores práticas, para ajudar a identificar discrepâncias entre estas definições/elementos de dados e os elementos de dados/definições do Grupo. Participar nos fóruns de partilha de conhecimento relevantes (grupos de trabalho, comunidades de prática, etc.) para aprofundar o conhecimento da comunidade de dados em geral.

Apoiar os requisitos de negócio através do desenvolvimento e manutenção de tabelas de dados de referência e garantir que a integridade dos dados é mantida em todos os momentos.

Apoiar as necessidades de integração de dados de referência e dados mestre, apoiando a equipa de dados de referência para garantir o alinhamento dos sistemas dos parceiros.

Apoiar a reconciliação e manutenção contínuas de dados de referência e dados mestre, gerindo versões de referência e réplicas.

Ajudar no planeamento, implementação e controlo de atividades para garantir a consistência com uma versão de referência dos valores dos dados contextuais.

Assegurar que é fornecido feedback contínuo até à conclusão, mantendo uma experiência positiva para o cliente, garantindo a satisfação do cliente e minimizando os riscos e as perdas para a Standard Bank Angola..

Funções Essenciais

Verificar todos os pedidos/questões dos clientes em relação aos dados existentes ou encaminhá-los para a equipa de Gestão de Relações, Contas ou Serviços para aprovação, de modo a garantir que o cliente tem autoridade para solicitar as informações ou alterações à conta do cliente, com vista a salvaguardar as informações e o funcionamento das contas dos clientes.

Registar com precisão as consultas e reclamações encaminhadas no sistema de gestão de consultas para todos os clientes, de modo a garantir que existe um registo do assunto, das etapas para a resolução e da comunicação/feedback, em conformidade com os acordos de nível de serviço relevantes.

Priorizar e gerir a resolução de consultas e reclamações recebidas e entregar o trabalho de forma consistente para cumprir as metas acordadas e mitigar o risco de reputação e as perdas financeiras.

Identificar e resolver rapidamente as consultas e reclamações encaminhadas e gerir e resolver as reclamações de acordo com as metas e os padrões de qualidade, garantindo um feedback rápido ao cliente e a resolução do problema.

Aplicar conhecimentos técnicos (sobre produtos e negócios), técnicas de resolução de problemas, discernimento e sensibilidade às necessidades do cliente e aplicar procedimentos operacionais padrão para identificar a causa principal de consultas, pedidos e reclamações de clientes que tenham sido escalados e/ou sejam complexos, a fim de determinar a melhor forma de minimizar novas escaladas e prevenir ocorrências futuras de natureza semelhante.

Em colaboração com as partes interessadas relevantes, determinar uma resolução ideal (com base no resultado da análise da causa raiz) e, através do envolvimento com as equipas de processamento relevantes, tomar medidas corretivas e/ou preventivas, acompanhar o processo e escalar obstáculos para garantir a resolução e comunicar diretamente com o cliente e/ou a fonte, de modo a cumprir o SLA e prevenir riscos de reputação e perdas.

Identificar e escalar incidentes recorrentes com clientes e recomendar oportunidades para melhorar a prestação do serviço ao cliente. Manter-se a par dos desenvolvimentos de produtos e sistemas e manter-se atualizado sobre os desenvolvimentos relevantes, tanto a nível interno como externo, para identificar, avaliar e contribuir com melhorias inovadoras.

Integrar múltiplas partes interessadas e dados para investigar e resolver questões e reclamações e contribuir para a procura proativa de soluções para evitar a recorrência de problemas no serviço ao cliente.

Interagir com os clientes para fornecer feedback adequado, aconselhar sobre as ações necessárias por parte do cliente para efetuar a resolução (por exemplo, novas instruções), garantindo a resolução dentro de todos os prazos de respost.

Executar e cumprir os controlos, políticas, processos, procedimentos operacionais padrão e instruções relevantes do departamento e da organização. Identificar e comunicar incidentes que tenham um impacto negativo no serviço, na gestão de relações e que acarretem risco reputacional. Gerir o risco reputacional através da prestação de padrões de serviço excecionais e de uma melhor experiência do cliente.

Monitorizar e identificar proativamente irregularidades e riscos potenciais, informar o chefe de equipa sobre todos os incidentes de risco e registar os relatórios de incidentes para garantir que sejam implementadas as medidas corretivas e preventivas adequadas. Encaminhar quaisquer irregularidades para o chefe de equipa / gestor de linha e responsável pela conformidade e risco, conforme os requisitos.

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description:
Workstream is a mission-driven company building the all-in-one HR, payroll, and hiring platform for managing the hourly workforce. There are 2.7 billion hourly workers, making up 80% of the global workforce, but this market has been heavily underserved by technology and deserves better. Workstream has been purpose-built for the hourly workforce from day one so that these businesses and their employees can thrive.

Our customers include leading brands from multiple sectors, including Burger King, Carl's Jr./Hardee's, IHOP, KFC, and Culvers. We are a high growth series B company and quickly expanding our product portfolio to deliver on our vision. We are backed by legendary VCs and industry experts like Founders Fund, BOND, and Coatue.

Grow With Us

We are looking for a highly analytical, proactive, and execution-oriented Chief of Staff to report to our CFO and partner directly with the C-level Executive Team.

This is a highly visible, cross-functional role that works across the Executive Team and departments to help prioritize and drive the company’s most important strategic and operational initiatives. You will operate at the intersection of strategy, operations, and execution—translating company priorities into action, creating alignment across teams, and ensuring critical initiatives move forward with clear ownership and accountability.

As a key partner to the CFO and C-level Executive Team, you will work across Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, People, and Operations. You will help identify the highest-impact opportunities, structure complex problems, coordinate stakeholders, and drive projects from initial definition through execution and measurable outcomes.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity, learns quickly, and is comfortable moving between strategic problem-solving and hands-on execution. The ideal candidate is an exceptional generalist who can quickly understand complex business challenges, bring structure to ambiguity, and help leaders make informed decisions and execute against company priorities.

You should be comfortable operating with limited direction and stepping into whatever problem is most important to the business at a given time.

Day In The Life

• Partner directly with the CFO and C-level Executive Team on company strategy, priorities, and execution

• Drive high-priority, cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through execution and measurable outcomes

• Work across departments to identify, prioritize, and drive operational projects based on business impact and organizational priorities

• Translate strategic priorities into clear action plans, owners, timelines, milestones, and accountability mechanisms

• Serve as a central point of coordination across leadership and functional teams to maintain alignment and momentum on critical initiatives

• Develop analyses, business cases, and recommendations to support strategic and operational decision-making

• Establish and manage operating rhythms, including company goals, KPIs, business reviews, and executive follow-ups

• Work across Finance, Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, People, and Operations to identify and resolve organizational bottlenecks

• Identify opportunities to improve company performance, efficiency, and organizational effectiveness

• Lead special projects that span multiple functions and require rapid execution in ambiguous environments

• Conduct market, competitive, and business research to inform strategic and operational decisions

• Help the CFO and C-level Executive Team prioritize resources, initiatives, and projects based on business impact

• Ensure critical decisions, action items, and initiatives are followed through to completion

• Prepare materials, analyses, and recommendations for leadership meetings and other critical business discussions

• Act as a trusted thought partner to the CFO and C-level Executive Team, providing clear analysis, structure, and perspective

• Step into operational problems directly when needed, taking ownership rather than simply delegating

• Help build scalable processes, systems, and operating mechanisms as Workstream continues to grow

Who You Are

• 4–8+ years of experience in strategy, operations, consulting, investment banking, product, or a high-growth technology company

• Proven track record of owning complex, cross-functional initiatives with measurable business outcomes

• Exceptional analytical and structured problem-solving skills

• Ability to quickly understand unfamiliar industries, businesses, and technical concepts

• Strong business judgment and ability to make decisions with incomplete information

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to influence senior executives and cross-functional teams without direct authority

• High ownership mindset with a strong bias toward action

• Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and constantly changing startup environment

• Ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail

• Strong proficiency with spreadsheets, presentations, and modern productivity tools

• Must be based in or willing to relocate to San Francisco, CA and work onsite 5 days per week

Nice To Have

• Experience working directly with a CEO, founder, or executive leadership team

• Background in management consulting, investment banking, private equity, or venture capital

• Experience at a high-growth, venture-backed technology company

• Experience leading strategic planning, annual planning, or company operating processes

• Exposure to board and investor relations processes

• Experience in SaaS, HR technology, payroll, workforce management, or marketplaces

• Experience managing or launching 0→1 initiatives

• Strong technical or data background and ability to work closely with engineering teams

What We Offer

• A mission-driven and value-based company dedicated to empowering deskless workers and local businesses

• An early employee opportunity at a Series B hyper-growth startup with over $120M in funding

• Work directly with the founding team and industry veterans to accelerate your career

• Competitive salary and equity

• Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, and vision. We pay 95% of premiums for employees and 85% for dependents

• In-office amenities and stocked kitchen

• 401(k) Plan

• Flexible PTO

Salary Range

The base salary range for this role is $160,000 and $180,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this role includes participation in Workstream's stock option program, offering meaningful equity ownership in the company.

Know More About Workstream

• https://www.workstream.us/blog/funding-series-b

• https://techcrunch.com/2021/08/26/workstreams-text-based-recruitment-tool-gets-a-48m-bet-from-bond-and-beyond/

• https://techbuzz.news/buzzworthy-august-27-2021/

Additional Information

Workstream provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

We are committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals.

jobs.title: Finance & Growth Projects Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT US 


QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! 



We are looking for a highly educated, analytically strong professional with a genuine passion for Finance who is energized by variety, problem-solving and getting things done and is ready to jump into anything and everything. This is a broad role within the Finance team, supporting a range of finance improvement, growth, compliance and strategic projects. You will work closely with Finance leadership and collaborate across the organization on topics ranging from process improvement and AI to grants, contracts and international expansion.
The role is ideal for someone who enjoys learning quickly, taking ownership of new topics and moving comfortably between analysis and execution.


What you’ll be doing

 - Finance Projects & Improvement
   
   - Support a variety of finance improvement projects across processes, controls, reporting and systems.
   
   - Identify opportunities to simplify, automate and improve the way Finance works and reports, including through AI and new technology.
   
   - Take ownership of cross-functional projects and turn ideas into practical improvements.

 - Finance Leadership Support
   
   - Support Finance leadership on strategic, analytical and operational priorities.
   
   - Prepare analyses, reporting and decision-ready materials.
   
   - Pick up new projects and business questions as priorities evolve.

 - Grants & Funding
   
   - Identify relevant grants, subsidies and funding opportunities and support the application process.
   
   - Coordinate applications, financial models, documentation and input from internal and external stakeholders.
   
   - Manage grant administration, reporting requirements and supporting documentation.

 - Legal, Compliance & Growth
   
   - Support Finance and legal counsel on commercial, compliance and regulatory topics.
   
   - Help streamline contract processes, including workflows, templates, approvals and contract administration.
   
   - Support new markets, partnerships and initiatives by coordinating relevant finance, tax, legal and compliance requirements.

 - Export & Regulatory Support
   
   - Support the organization on export controls, sanctions and other requirements related to international activities.
   
   - Help assess requirements for new customers, markets, products and transactions.
   
   - Coordinate external specialist support and help translate advice into clear internal actions.

Your Profile

 - Strong academic background and a genuine interest in Finance, business and how companies operate.

 - Analytical, structured and intellectually curious, with the energy to work on many different types of projects.

 - A proactive self-starter who enjoys improving things, learning new topics and taking ownership from analysis through execution.

Nice to have:

 - Experience in a finance role within a high-growth technology company.

 - Experience in a deeptech environment (e.g. semiconductors, photonics, quantum technologies, advanced materials, robotics, AI infrastructure, or other R&D-intensive businesses) is highly desirable.

 - Experience with Capex heavy companies & manufacturing companies (COGS)

 - Experience with ERP systems and leading or participating in ERP implementation and finance transformation projects is a plus.

 - Experience with business intelligence tools is an advantage.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research https://hbr.org/2014/08/why-women-dont-apply-for-jobs-unless-theyre-100-qualified shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. 

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture. 

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

jobs.title: Produktionsmitarbeiter Cube & Unterverteilung (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen.

Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen.



Die Rolle

In unserer Eigenproduktion bauen wir die Komponenten vor, die unsere Installationsteams beim Kunden direkt einsetzen: hydraulische Cubes und elektrische Unterverteilungen für die Wärmepumpe. Je besser sie vorgefertigt sind, desto schneller und sauberer läuft die Installation vor Ort.

Cubes sind unsere vormontierten Hydraulikmodule, die alle wesentlichen Komponenten für den Heizkreis kompakt in einem Gehäuse bündeln. Wir fertigen sie in mehreren Varianten für unterschiedliche Wärmepumpen und Einbausituationen.

Unterverteilungen sind die elektrischen Verteiler, über die die Wärmepumpe abgesichert und angeschlossen wird. Sie werden nach Plan in Standardvarianten je Geräteserie und Leistungsklasse aufgebaut.

Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Produktionsteam innerhalb von Supply Chain, eng verzahnt mit Lager, Kommissionierung und Einkauf. Die Produktion wächst mit unseren Installationszahlen und zieht 2027 in unser neues Hauptlager in Ludwigsfelde.



Deine Aufgaben

 - Montage von Cubes: Rahmen aus Aluprofilen aufbauen, Komponenten einsetzen, Verrohrung in Edelstahl-Pressfitting und Gewinde herstellen, Verkleidung montieren.

 - Aufbau und Verdrahtung von Unterverteilungen nach Bestückungsplan, Stückliste und Stromlaufplan, inklusive Beschriftung der Betriebsmittel.

 - Qualitätsprüfung vor Auslieferung: Dichtheitsprüfung der Cubes, Sicht- und Funktionsprüfung der Unterverteilungen, Dokumentation der Prüfergebnisse.

 - Vorbereitung von Material für die Produktion, z. B. Kabel ablängen, Anschlusssets zusammenstellen, Rohre zuschneiden.

 - Übergabe fertiger Cubes und Unterverteilungen in die Projektkommissionierung, termingerecht zur geplanten Installation.

 - Pflege der Materialbestände am Arbeitsplatz und frühzeitige Meldung von Fehlmengen an Lager und Einkauf.

 - Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Varianten und Arbeitsabläufe: Rückmeldung aus der Montage zu Stücklisten, Bauteilen und Prozessen.

 - Ordnung, Sauberkeit und Arbeitssicherheit in deinem Produktionsbereich.



Dein Profil

 - Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker:in für Energie- und Gebäudetechnik, Anlagenmechaniker:in SHK, Mechatroniker:in oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.

 - Erfahrung in Montage, Verdrahtung oder Rohrinstallation, idealerweise im Schaltschrank-/Verteilerbau oder in der Heizungstechnik.

 - Du liest Stromlaufpläne, Bestückungspläne und Stücklisten sicher und setzt sie genau um.

 - Handwerkliches Geschick und sauberer Umgang mit Werkzeug, z. B. Pressmaschine, Crimpzange, Abisolierwerkzeug.

 - Von Vorteil: Qualifikation als Elektrofachkraft, Erfahrung mit Prüfungen nach DIN VDE 0100-600 bzw. DIN EN 61439 oder Grundkenntnisse zu Wärmepumpen-Hydraulik.

 - Gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. B2), um Arbeitsanweisungen und Pläne sicher zu verstehen.



Zusätzlich sind uns folgende Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften wichtig:

 - Quality Minded: Du arbeitest genau und prüfst dein Ergebnis, bevor es das Haus verlässt – ein Fehler in der Produktion wird beim Kunden teuer.

 - Hands-on: Du packst an, arbeitest zügig und behältst auch bei hohen Stückzahlen den Blick fürs Detail.

 - Structured Thinker: Du organisierst deinen Arbeitsplatz und dein Material so, dass Abläufe reibungslos laufen.

 - Proactive Problem-Solver: Du meldest Fehler in Plänen oder Bauteilen früh und bringst Verbesserungsvorschläge ein.

 - Team Player: Du arbeitest eng mit Lager, Kommissionierung und Einkauf zusammen.



Benefits

 - Werde Teil eines schnell wachsenden und profitablen Climate-Tech-Startups.

 - Attraktive und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung.

 - Feste Arbeitszeiten ohne Montage- und Reisetätigkeit.

 - Strukturierte Einarbeitung in unsere Cube- und Unterverteilungsvarianten.

 - Individuelle Benefits, abgestimmt auf deine Bedürfnisse, z. B. Sportmitgliedschaften, ÖPNV-Ticket oder Learning Budget.

jobs.title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) Quereinstieg - Graubünden
jobs.description:
Du hast noch nie im B2B-Vertrieb gearbeitet, möchtest aber gerne alle wichtigen Werkzeuge erlernen, um so richtig durchzustarten? Bei Salonkee lernst du den Vertrieb von Grund auf kennen und baust dir in Graubünden dein eigenes Netzwerk auf.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software – von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.




DEINE ROLLE

 - Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort

 - Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu – telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise).

 - Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann.

 - Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss.

 - Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt.
   
   


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

 - Vertriebserfahrung ist nicht unbedingt notwendig. Wenn du aus dem Hospitality, Beauty, Retail, Fitness, Event oder einem anderen Bereich mit viel Kundenkontakt kommst, bringst du das Wichtigste schon mit.

 - Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch – egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort.

 - Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken.

 - Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn.

 - Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln.

 - Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

 - Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

 - Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.




DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

 - Vertrieb von Grund auf lernen: Bootcamp zum Start, gezieltes Ramp-Up Programm, Shadowing bei erfahrenen Kolleg:innen, Roleplays und regelmäßiges Coaching.

 - Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region – du startest nicht allein.

 - Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad: von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen.

 - Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

 - Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

 - Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

 - 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

 - Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision.

 - Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.
   
   


WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

 1. Bewerbung & Sichtung – wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

 2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30–45 Minuten).

 3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

 4. Field Day – zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.



Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.
