jobs.title: Working Student – Control System Support (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
ABOUT FOCUSED ENERGY

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial

fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global

fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and

engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial

scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that

promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.




YOUR ROLE

Focused Energy is seeking a Working Student - Control System Support (f/m/d) to join the control-system team within our Laser organization. In this role, you will work directly with our control systems engineers on the practical, hands-on aspects of building and testing the systems that operate our laser platforms. Your responsibilities will include implementation support, testing, debugging, documentation, and following up on issues until they are resolved. This position offers a unique opportunity to work closely with real experimental hardware and control-system engineering in a company tackling one of the most challenging problems in energy.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Support the control-system team with implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation of control-system components.

 - Help investigate issues affecting system progress and follow them through to resolution.

 -  Maintain and improve control-system documentation, test records, interface descriptions, I/O lists, cable schedules, wiring documentation, test procedures, and commissioning records.

 - Work closely with electrical, mechanical, controls, and laser engineers to bring an instrumentation system for high energy lasers into reliable operation.

 - Support integration and verification activities for laser-related systems.

 - Contribute hands-on in a fast-moving, experimental engineering environment.

 - Proactively flag risks, blockers, and deviations early to your technical lead.

 


WHO YOU ARE

 - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related field.

 - Have a basic understanding of control systems, automation, electronics, or real-time systems, acquired through coursework or project experience.

 - Possess some programming experience with Labview, Python, .Net, MATLAB/Simulink, or similar tools.

 - Able to systematically break down and analyze technical problems.

 - Comfortable working with technical documentation and open to learning how to use version-control or issue-tracking tools.

 - Reliable, organized, proactive, and eager to learn in a hands-on environment.

 - Strong communication skills in English.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

 - Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

 - Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

 - Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

 - Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

 - Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

 - Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

 - Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

 - Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

 - Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

 - Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs—whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

 - Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

We are now recruiting a Senior Manager, Product Quality Neurotoxin for our diverse Team, This role will be a 24 month contract.

Reporting to the Product Quality Director, you will be responsible for quality of assigned products and near commercial Neurotoxin Pipeline Products to ensure business objectives are met with regards to on time delivery of product while assuring compliance to local, divisional, and corporate policies and external agency regulations worldwide. Products under your remit include regulatory starting materials, Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), Intermediates, and Drug Products produced by AbbVie plants or by third-party manufacturers, In Licensing relationships, or Co-Marketing relationships. You will act as the primary quality representative for the global supply chain pertaining to manufacturing business relationships and build and maintain relationships with IME Operations, Supplier Quality Management, Commercial QA, Global Supply Chain, Domestic and International AbbVie Plants and Affiliates, Regulatory Affairs, R&D, and S&T to ensure alignment on strategic initiatives.

A snapshot of your key responsibilities would be:

• Direct cross-functional team member to achieve on-time quality deliverables, high customer value, and high quality product to meet patient demands. Ensures delivery of quality elements needed to facilitate lifecycle management that provide products directly to distribution centers, or to AbbVie domestic and International plants for further packaging and/or testing.

• Product Quality contact for Post Marketing Quality Assurance with end-to-end understanding and management of customer complaints across the various nodes within AbbVie. Routine complaint trending and analysis.
• Product Quality Assurance contact for Global Change control system, including Quality Assessment of changes, and oversight of all global changes. Chair of the gCRB.

• Core team member or lead of strategic programs; including Brand Teams, New Product

• Influences the decision making process to ensure quality requirements are included when improvement initiatives take place.

Education & Experience

• Technical or Analytical background required for problem resolution with technical, quality, product and or engineering related issues.
• Minimum of 5+ in Quality Assurance Operations Management, Regulatory, Operations, or Technical Support in a pharmaceutical setting. Required regulatory inspection experience with direct interaction with regulatory inspectors. Direct Plant experience in a pharmaceutical setting with a minimum of 5 years preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Reporter, PharmaVoice
jobs.description:
This role is based in our 275 Grove Street, MA office.

PharmaVoice is seeking a dynamic and experienced Senior Reporter to deliver timely, insightful, and impactful coverage of the biopharma and biotech industries. This role offers the opportunity to craft compelling enterprise stories, in-depth features, and occasional quick-turn news pieces that analyze the trends, challenges, and opportunities shaping the pharmaceutical sector.

About the Role

As a Senior Reporter, you will take ownership of your beat, leveraging your industry knowledge, source-building expertise, and keen observations to pitch and pursue ambitious stories. You will be responsible for producing high-quality content that captures the impact of operational and leadership changes, groundbreaking research, drug developments, and policy or legislative shifts on the pharma industry.

This role also includes daily editing responsibilities, ensuring the highest standards of quality and consistency in our editorial output.

Key Responsibilities

• Industry Coverage: Deliver enterprise reporting, in-depth features, and quick-turn news stories that provide valuable insights into the biopharma and biotech industries.
• Source Building: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key industry stakeholders, newsmakers, and experts to stay ahead of emerging trends and developments.
• Event Reporting: Attend and report on industry events, conducting interviews and gathering insights to inform your stories.
• Editorial Collaboration: Work closely with the PharmaVoice team to brainstorm, plan, and execute larger editorial projects.
• Editing Duties: Perform daily editing tasks to ensure clarity, accuracy, and alignment with PharmaVoice’s tone and standards.

• Proven Expertise: Demonstrated success in reporting and writing on the business of pharmaceuticals, with a strong portfolio of impactful stories.
• Industry Knowledge: Deep interest and understanding of key issues affecting pharma and biotech leaders, including:Commercialization strategiesDrug research and development across various indications (e.g., oncology, obesity)Regulatory trends and policy developmentsThe role of AI in pharma and biotechGlobal industry dynamics, including the rise of China in the sector
• Analytical Skills: Proficient in interpreting and analyzing complex clinical trial data, scientific research, policy changes, earnings reports, and industry trends, with the ability to connect the dots and highlight their implications for stakeholders.
• Beat Ownership: Ability to quickly take ownership of specific beats through original reporting and by cultivating relationships with key and diverse industry sources.
• Deadline-Driven: Thrives in a fast-paced news environment, with strong time management skills and the ability to deliver high-quality stories under tight deadlines.
• Editorial Skills: Experience in writing compelling web headlines and editing copy to ensure clarity, accuracy, and engagement.
• Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Journalism, English, or a related field.
• Professional Experience: A minimum of 5 years of journalism experience, with at least 3 years dedicated to reporting on the pharma or life sciences industries.

ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer – Backend (.NET) to join our client, a fast-growing tech business building highly scalable modern solutions for the future of fundraising. In this role, you will play a key part in shaping, building, and evolving a modern, cloud-based platform—contributing hands-on to architecture, code quality, and engineering best practices.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will spend most of your time coding, reviewing code, and collaborating closely with product and engineering peers to deliver robust, scalable backend systems. We value collaboration, technical excellence, and a pragmatic approach to solving complex problems, and we are looking for an engineer who combines strong technical execution with ownership, sound judgment, and a collaborative mindset.

If you bring solid experience with .NET, relational databases (PostgreSQL), distributed or event-driven systems, and cloud platforms (preferably GCP), we’d love to speak with you.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design & Build: Develop end-to-end backend services and API features using C# .NET with a focus on performance, scalability, and maintainability.

 - Technical Quality: Write high-quality, well-tested code, define testing strategies (integration and contract testing), and apply clean code principles alongside domain-driven design (DDD).

 - Delivery & Planning: Work closely with product and QA to refine, scope, and estimate roadmap items—raising technical risks and dependencies early.

 - System Health & Security: Uphold backend security practices and take shared responsibility for system health, observability (logging, metrics, alerting), leading incident investigations, and driving root-cause fixes.

 - Continuous Improvement: Spot technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and process inefficiencies in the areas you work on, and help prioritize and fix them to elevate developer experience.

QUALIFICATIONS

 - Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (GCP preferred, Azure/AWS also relevant) and containerized environments.

Please be informed that Foxelli Group hires exclusively in-house and doesn't work with any external recruitment agencies. Any company or individual claiming to recruit on behalf of Foxelli Group is not affiliated with us.

At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them.

If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter - you’ll feel at home with us.



WHY JOIN FOXELLI?

Foxelli is a place for people who think deeply, learn quickly, automate repetitive work, enjoy spending time together, and build things that matter. We work hard, joke often, and don’t take ourselves too seriously.

If you’re excited about AI, eager to learn, and want to create work that genuinely means something with people who care, you’ll feel right at home with us - no matter where you are in your career.



THE ROLE


We're a fast-growing team producing AI-generated micro-drama series for US women 35–55. We write, generate and ship short vertical series fast. We need a writer who can own scripts end to end.

What you'll do

 - Write micro-drama episodes (1–3 min) and full series arcs using Claude, GPT and other AI tools.

 - Build hooks that stop the scroll in the first 3 seconds and cliffhangers that force the next episode.

 - Write scenes that turn into strong, real-looking, cinematic AI visuals, not generic AI slop.

 - Test new formats, read the data, and cut what doesn't work.

You're a fit if you

 - Know what makes a story addictive: tension, clear stakes, emotion, payoff.

 - Have taste. You know the difference between good and cheap, and you won't ship cheap.

 - Write with clarity. Every scene has one job, and the viewer always knows what's happening.

 - Catch plot holes and logic breaks in your own work and in AI output.

 - Have sharp attention to detail: names, timelines, continuity; nothing slips.

 - Call out bad ideas, including ours.

 - Think visually and know what looks expensive and believable on screen.

 - Like experimenting and testing new ideas.

 - Watch ReelShort, DramaBox, or similar and know why they work.

 - Write native-level English.

Big plus

 - You can review creators' final episodes against the script, spot what's off or unclear, and send clear notes back for fixes.

Nice to have

 - Experience in short-form video, soaps, telenovelas or romance fiction.

 - Prompting experience for image and video models.
   
   THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

 1. Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world.

 2. Text Task - A small real-world challenge so we can see how you approach problems in action.

 3.  Hire - if you both align, we'll invite you to join our team on a test trial period.



FIXED SERVICE FEE 
Up to 3000 euros per month after taxes (depending on your skills, competencies, and experience we'd be open to discussing your rate).

PERKS & BENEFITS

 - Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting, while Hubstaff ensures transparency and fairness.

 - Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and to keep your physical well-being in check.

 - A personal development budget is at your disposal for your personal and professional growth to ensure you keep growing continuously.

 - Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested.

 - A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like.

 - Strong company culture and a network of unique individuals that celebrate you.



ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS

❕This role is 100% remote.

 - Our tribe works primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET — UTC+2/UTC+3). We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported.

 - For full-time roles, we ask that you’re available for at least 5 hours during typical EET working hours — it keeps collaboration smooth and communication easy.
   (This doesn’t apply to part-time roles.)



Currently, we are hiring in Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Czech Republic, Estonia, Greece, Georgia, Kosovo, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Malta, Slovenia, Serbia, Cyprus, Bulgaria, Hungary, Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and South Africa.

jobs.title: [Now Hiring] Contract IT Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
Our Mission: Bring biblical clarity and daily guidance to people seeking God in a chaotic world.

Before applying, review Core of the Heart https://coreoftheheart.com/ and Johnny Chang's content.

Location: Remote, with the ability to coordinate with someone on-site when physical access is needed
Type: Independent Contractor, project-based with ongoing support as needed
Department: Operations

 


YOUR ROLE

Every video we publish starts as footage that must be stored safely and put in an editor's hands. When files are lost or difficult to access, the work stops before it can reach anyone.

You will own the reliability of our existing 10-bay QNAP NAS and its connection to Dropbox Business. The NAS holds our long-term footage archive. Dropbox holds the active projects our editors and global team need. Your job is to keep that system secure, organized, and easy to maintain.

 


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Keep the QNAP NAS healthy and make sure the storage is configured correctly.

 - Establish a clear workflow for moving active projects into Dropbox and returning completed work to the NAS.

 - Give approved team members secure remote access when they need files from the archive.

 - Review permissions and administrator access so the right people can reach the right files.

 - Create an independent second backup for footage that cannot be replaced, then prove that files can be restored.

 - Document the setup, recovery process, and account ownership so the company is never dependent on one contractor.

 - Provide ongoing maintenance and troubleshooting after the initial cleanup is complete.

 


WHAT WE'D LIKE TO COMPLETE IN THE FIRST MONTH

 1. Review the current NAS, Dropbox, and network setup and provide a written summary of what needs to be fixed.

 2. Complete the approved work and show that files can move between the NAS and Dropbox and be accessed remotely when needed.

 3. Document the finished setup, agree on a separate backup plan, and test a file restore once that backup is in place.

 


THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

 - You only work on a retainer basis and don't have an hourly rate.

 - You are flaky with communication and availability.

 - You're unable to document your work.

 


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

 - Experience building and maintaining business network systems

 - Experience building storage systems that work with cloud platforms, including NAS devices and services such as Dropbox

 


COMPENSATION AND HOW TO APPLY

To apply, please send:

 1. Your hourly rate (please include the currency).

 2. A Loom video (3 minutes max) explaining why you're a good fit for this role and whether you're available for ongoing work.

 3. Clear proof of relevant work. Share a link to one or two examples of network or storage systems you've built or maintained, and say what you personally did. A redacted write-up or diagram is fine.

We're looking for long-term support. If we work well together for three to four months, we're open to discussing a reasonable monthly retainer.

 


OUR CORE VALUES

 1. Keep God First

 2. Radical Accountability

 3. Move with Urgency & Discipline

 4. Committed to Systems & Processes

 5. Embody Grace For Each Other

jobs.title: Pricing & Bid Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Bids, Contracts and Pricing Specialist to lead our commercial bidding strategy and pricing policies. This strategic role requires a professional with 5+ years of experience in similar position who will coordinate commercial committees, manage contractual matters, and ensure pricing coherence across all business units.

KEY RESPONSABILITIES

Commercial Committee Leadership

• Coordinate and supervise commercial committees for each offer, ensuring alignment across all departments (productive and support teams) to guarantee successful project execution.

Risk and Value Assessment

• Identify project risks and unique selling points (USPs) during offer review processes, ensuring comprehensive evaluation of each opportunity.

Contract Management

• Handle contractual topics including payment conditions, billing terms, and project margins. Review sales contracts and coordinate with legal and production teams to ensure compliance with all requirements.

Pricing Management

• Organize and coordinate the definition of pricing policies with product managers, establishing reference prices for each service and ensuring consistency across the organization.
• Analyze the implementation of pricing policies to ensure consistency and effectiveness across the organization.

Strategic Planning

• Coordinate with product managers and country sales managers to define annual objectives. Present objectives to management for approval and coordinate sales action plans across relevant teams.

Profit management

• Conduct comprehensive analysis of profit margins across all products, services, and business units to identify improvement opportunities and areas of concern. Monitor key financial performance metrics including gross margin, net margin, and EBITDA, providing regular reports and actionable insights to senior leadership.
• Identify and eliminate profit leakage through systematic review of pricing structures, discounting practices, and contract terms, implementing corrective measures to protect and enhance organizational profitability.

REQUIREMENTS

• Minimum 5 years of experience in commercial, pricing, or contract management roles
• Strong understanding of commercial processes and contract law
• Proficiency in data analysis and CRM platform usage
• Advanced Excel skills for financial modeling and objective setting
• Excellent coordination and communication skills to work across multiple departments
• Experience in automotive or engineering services industry (preferred)
• Ability to identify risks and value propositions in complex commercial scenarios
• Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail
• Fluency in English and Spanish (additional languages are a plus)

What We Offer

• Strategic role with high visibility and impact across the organization
• Opportunity to work with leading automotive manufacturers and suppliers
• Collaborative environment with cross-functional teams
• Professional development and career growth opportunities
• Competitive compensation package
• Access to cutting-edge technology and industry-leading facilities

jobs.title: Clinical Laboratory Supervisor
jobs.description:
Location: On-Site in Boulder, CO (Foresight Dx business unit, a Natera company)

Foresight Diagnostics is a molecular diagnostics company pioneering non-invasive cancer detection through highly sensitive, cell-free DNA-based liquid biopsy technologies. Our proprietary methods - originally developed at Stanford University - are designed to detect smaller tumors earlier and enable more personalized treatment strategies for patients with cancer.

We sit at the intersection of molecular biology, bioinformatics, and next-generation sequencing (NGS), and we translate rigorous science into clinically meaningful solutions. Following our acquisition by Natera, we now combine the agility of a mission-driven startup with the scale and resources of a global leader in cell-free DNA testing. It’s an exciting moment to join us.

Headquartered in Boulder, Colorado, our team operates in a high accountability, collaborative environment where quality and continuous improvement aren’t just values - they’re how we work every day.

About The Role

The Clinical Lab Supervisor is a leader in Natera's lab operations whose role is to oversee employees' performance and serve as a liaison between employees and senior management to meet company goals and quality objectives. The supervisor is responsible for daily supervision of lab staff performing duties such as laboratory testing and data review. Duties include but are not limited to coaching, motivating, staffing, evaluating, and training staff. The supervisor works closely with the manager to ensure company and team goals are met while adhering to good manufacturing practices and CLIA/CAP guidelines.

What You Will Do

• Responsible for day-to-day staffing/scheduling/setting up sample run schedules.

• Ensures production work is consistently completed according to department goals.

• Ensures all case samples are processed and accounted for.

• Monitors team members to ensure adherence to SOPs and safety procedures.

• Oversees training for new hires: works in conjunction with lead to train new hires.

• Document nonconformance reports and all corrective actions taken when test systems deviate from the established performance specifications as needed. Escalates protocol deviation to lead/supervisor.

• Handles employee issues. Collaborates with Manager and/or Human Resources to resolve issues.

• Assists manager in initiating and completing CAPAs.

• Ensures alignment with team for reasoning behind instructions/processes and changes.

• Meets regularly with individual team members to discuss goals and progress.

• Responsible for staff performance reviews.

• Plans and leads shift meetings.

• Maintains team morale and professionalism of team members, including by acting as role model. Adheres to Departmental Expectations.

• Ensures compliance with all regulatory agency requirements through documentation, audits, and corrective action. Go-to person when manager is not present.

• May assist lab team in day to day tasks.

• Keeps team morale up and maintains professionalism of team members, including by acting as role model.

• Assists the team in day to day lab work if necessary.

• Approves timecards and PTO requests.

• Escalates lab issues and team concerns to manager. Communicates the problem and suggests possible solutions.

• Understands the entire lab process and can identify and troubleshoot issues when they arise. Understands when and how to escalate issues appropriately.

• Makes sure the goals set by manager for the team are being met in the lab.

• Performs and completes side projects assigned by the manager.

• Actively interacts with interdepartmental teams such as OPS, Accessioning, Engineering, Stats, R&D, and Support.

• Receives assignments in the form of objectives with goals and the process by which to meet goals.

• Provides direction to employees according to established policies and management guidance. Administers company policies that directly affect subordinate employees.

• Recommends changes to unit or sub-unit policies.

• Provides direct supervision to professional individual contributors and/or skilled, support individual contributors.

• Acts as advisor to unit or sub-units and may become actively involved, as required, to meet schedules and resolve problems.

• This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and have access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job.

• Employee must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire.

• Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements.

• Employee must pass post offer criminal background check.

• Performs other duties as assigned.

What You Will Bring

• 6+ years of experience as a Medical Technologist or equivalent in a clinical laboratory environment.

• BS/BA degree (or equivalent) in Medical Technology, Biological Sciences, or a related field.

• Current MT/MLS/CLS certification preferable from ASCP, AMT, or AAB.

• Proven leadership experience.

• Able to take on projects with little supervision.

• Excellent interpersonal, communication, computer, troubleshooting, and pipetting skills.

• Experience in Molecular Biology.

• Excellent oral and written communication skills.

• Word processing and data management skills.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT:

• Duties typically performed in BSL-1 to 2 laboratories with potentially hazardous material Standing or sitting for long periods of time may be necessary

• Duties may require working weekends and overtime

• Must be able to lift boxes or supplies up to 35lbs

• Duties require wearing safety goggles, gloves, and laboratory coat.

• Duties may require exposure to cold air due to frequent accessing of refrigeration and/or freezer units.

Compensation & Total Rewards

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

• Annual performance incentive bonus

• Long-term equity awards

• Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

• 401(k) with company match

• Generous paid time off and company holidays

• Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range

$91,100.00 - $100,000.00

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Homes - Oceania Market (Makati-Based)
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get To Know Our Team:

Agoda Homes is a core business line within Agoda that supports a wide range of non-hotel accommodation types, including serviced apartments, homes, private villas, farm stays, chalets, boats, and more. While these properties have always been available on Agoda.com, today's evolving landscape demands a sharper focus on expanding supply and elevating quality. Our team builds long-term, cross-cultural partnerships that create exceptional value for Agoda, our partners, and our customers.

The Opportunity:

As Account Manager, Homes, you will grow and strengthen Agoda's non-hotel accommodation supply for the Oceania market, with a focus on Australia. You will own relationships with key channel managers and accommodation operators, ensure our customers get the best prices and availability, and help raise the quality of our Homes portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining partner relationship management with project management and hands-on problem solving. You will work across markets and time zones, collaborate with regional and central teams, and have a direct hand in shaping how Agoda Homes grows in a high-potential region.

What You'll Do:

You will manage and grow a portfolio of Homes partners in Oceania, using market insights and data analysis to uncover opportunities for mutual business growth. You will report to the Homes Regional Manager and work closely with colleagues across regional and central teams.

• Manage relationships with key channel managers and supply partners in Oceania, ensuring competitive rates and availability for our customers

• Use analytical and problem-solving skills to drive supply health and resolve operational issues such as connectivity, onboarding, and messaging

• Grow the business by partnering with channel managers to onboard and activate their operators, managing the process through to go-live

• Optimize existing supply by offering products that match market demand and improving business performance for partners

• Build trusted relationships with decision makers, using a consultative approach to increase engagement with Agoda's programs

• Prepare materials and business cases to support partner meetings and negotiations

• Report weekly and monthly KPIs and key metrics internally to showcase successes and highlight opportunities

• Support operators of all sizes, from professional property managers to small independent hosts, through setup and day-to-day needs

• Help build a host community network through host events and relevant industry events

• Consolidate host feedback to identify product gaps and feature requests

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field

• Minimum 4 years of experience in e-commerce, technology, or internet industries in B2B sales, account management, or similar partner-facing roles

• Strong business development skills, with the ability to build and grow relationships with key partners and acquire new hosts

• Results-oriented strategic thinker who is detail-oriented, process-minded, and open to innovation

• Proven self-starter with strong project management skills, able to drive outcomes through third parties and stakeholders you do not directly manage

• Fast learner who adapts well to, and is energized by, change

• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders, with a collaborative, "get-it-done" attitude

• Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and similar tools

• Fluency in English, both written and oral

• Eligible to work in the Philippines

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in homes, short-term rentals, or online travel, ideally working with channel managers or property management systems

• Knowledge of the Oceania accommodation market, especially Australia

• Experience managing partners across different markets and time zones

• Strong data analysis skills, with the ability to turn insights into clear recommendations

jobs.title: 社内保健師
jobs.description:
PayPayについて

2018年にサービスを開始してから約8年でユーザー数7500万人を突破したフィンテック企業であるPayPayは、約50か国の国と地域から集まった多様なメンバーで構成されています。

OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED_

我々は自分たちの想像を超える未来を創るためにあえて明確なビジョンは必要ないと考えています。常にDay1であるスタンスを忘れずに、誰もが想像できないようなビジョン（未来）を実現していくのがPayPayです。
この壮大なビジョンに前向きに取り組み、他社に真似できない圧倒的なスピードでプロダクトを磨き上げ、日本のキャッシュレス決済、またそれを使用した金融ライフプラットフォームとしての普及を一気に推進することにプロフェッショナルとして情熱を持って取り組み、自ら課題発見し、周囲と協力して新しい価値創出を共に推進する仲間を募集します。

業務について

▼チーム紹介

「Best condition × Highest Capability = Maximizing Employee Power」をミッションに、従業員一人ひとりが心身ともに良い状態で能力を発揮できる環境づくりを推進しています。
産業医・保健師・人事担当者が連携し、健康診断や保健指導、休復職支援などの産業保健業務に加え、健康施策の企画や業務プロセスの改善、グループ全体を見据えた産業保健体制の高度化にも取り組んでいます。
本ポジションでは、保健師としての専門性を活かしながら、ご経験・専門性に応じて、従業員への個別支援から施策の企画・実行、業務改善まで幅広く携わっていただきます。

▼業務内容

• 保健師面談（メンタル・フィジカル）

• 休職・復職者のサポート

• 健康診断後の事後措置・保健指導

• 職場巡視/衛生委員会への参加

• 衛生委員会の講話資料等の作成

• 健康課題に応じた施策・研修の企画、立案、実行

• 健康関連データの集計・分析

• 各運用の見直し・改善

• 産業医面談の調整・サポート ※業務上必要に応じて、東京オフィス（四谷）への出社があります。

▼本ポジションの魅力

• 保健師の専門性を活かしながら、企画・業務改善まで携われる 健康診断や面談などの個別対応にとどまらず、健康施策の企画や産業保健業務の仕組みづくりにも関わることができます。

• 専門性を広げられる 産業医や人事担当者などと連携しながら、従業員支援や組織課題に向き合うことで、産業保健に加えて人事・労務領域への知見も広げられます。

jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.location: Emeryville, California, United States; Hybrid (2-3 days on-site); Remote
jobs.description:
Profluent is the frontier AI lab for biology. Profluent builds powerful foundation models for all of life's molecules, unlocking solutions that transform medicine, agriculture, and beyond. The Role

A top company goal for Profluent is establishing ourselves as the frontier AI lab for biology. This role is central to achieving that: making the brand match the ambition of the science and shaping how the field, press, talent, and partners perceive us. What the leading AI labs are to knowledge and coding work, we intend to be for biology.

We're looking for a Creative Director to own Profluent's creative function and define how the company looks, feels, and shows up in the world. You'll own the creative process end to end - from concept through published work and balance scientific accuracy, visual craft, and clarity to make works that delight, inspire, and capture attention. This role works in close partnership with the Head of Comms & Brand and the CEO to make final creative decisions.

This is a player-coach role. Today you'll work with the existing team to make much of the work yourself,  including video, design, web, social, events, and over time you'll build and lead a small creative team and manage a creative budget within the Comms & Brand function. On a day to day basis, you'll work closely with the Head of Comms & Brand as well as contractors (e.g. videographers, photographers, illustrators), and our leadership and scientists to turn frontier science into work that resonates with people.

A few rules guide our team:

• Don't be boring. Create things that delight and inspire people

• Avoid jargon. Create content, art, and objects that communicate with people like they're people

If those guiding principles match your own ethos and furthering Profluent’s brand sounds like a fun challenge, please apply!

Responsibilities

• Translate Profluent's frontier science into a brand and public presence that establishes us as the frontier AI lab for biology

• Own the creative process across every brand surface, including driving projects from concept to finished work, balancing tradeoffs, and making final decisions with the Head of Comms & Brand and the CEO

• Own and evolve Profluent's visual identity system including typography, color, imagery, motion, and other visual design standards to cement our brand as a frontier AI lab

• Own the creative budget within the Comms & Brand function and help build the creative function over time, hiring and leading designers, producers, and contractors as the team grows

• Manage vendors and contractors (videographers, designers, agencies) as extensions of the team

• Art direct and produce imagery including photography and illustrations and video including podcast episodes, videos for model/capability releases, social clips, videos for major announcements, and more

• Design decks, white papers, and launch assets that hold up in front of a technical audience

• Lead Profluent’s website through both cosmetic and structural changes, working with design and dev contractors as well as making edits to the website directly

• Create content for social channels as well as executive comms, shipping quickly while maintaining high quality

• Define and shape our presence at conferences (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, JPM, BIO) and Profluent-owned events

• Build and expand Profluent’s brand and design systems (e.g. templates, asset libraries, SOPs) that let our small team punch well above its weight

Qualifications

• 10-12 years in brand and creative roles

• A track record of leading creative as a Creative Director or equivalent, spanning both making and directing content across various mediums

• A portfolio demonstrating creative leadership and includes motion and video, editorial, digital, environmental/event design, and physical merch The ability to translate dense technical material into clear, human, non-hype work

• A background in bio, AI, or deep tech

• Fluency in modern design tools including Figma, Descript/a video editor of your choice, Webflow, Adobe suite as well as the verve and ability to learn new design tools and techniques as needs arise

• Fluency in project management software including Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, and Airtable

• Experience owning a budget and managing people or external teams

• A bias toward shipping: the ideal candidate ensures the work is published, not just handed off

Preferences

• Has worked at the intersection of hard science, design, and culture

• Has worked in high-growth startups

• Experience in service-based industries

• Competitive compensation package with equity participation

jobs.title: Staff AI Research Engineer
jobs.location: 665 Clyde Avenue, Mountain View,  CA, USA
jobs.description:
Lab Summary:

Our mission is to empower people to live healthier lives by leveraging our wearables, smartphones, medical devices, AI, and health services.  We research, develop, and commercialize innovative digital health products and solutions by bringing together the full capabilities of our team, including product strategy and management, clinical expertise, partnerships, UI/UX design, usability research, clinical research and validation, software development, AI / Gen AI, and regulatory. Millions of Samsung users’ lives around the world have been touched by our products, including the Samsung HeartWise for cardiac rehabilitation and the Samsung ECG Monitor App. Samsung’s unique advantage in the consumer electronics market and growing focus on Digital Health and AI / Gen AI provides exciting technical challenges and rewarding career experience.  Join us!

Position Summary:

Samsung Research America Digital Health Team is looking for an outstanding Ph.D.-level Senior AI Research Engineer with solid ML/AI technology background and digital health-related research project experiences in digital biomarker, physiological signal processing and deep learning. You need to have a strong track-record of success in academic and/or industrial settings, with the ability to scale algorithms and models to large, real-world datasets.

You will play a key role in delivering innovation in digital health domain, creating technologies and intellectual properties, deploying and validating novel algorithms, and transferring mature outcomes to production and scientific publications in top-tier venues. We expect candidates who have solid data analytics skills and project experiences in areas such as health foundation models pre and post training, wearable computing, and algorithm development for health applications. Your work will significantly benefit real-world wearable users, seniors, physicians and care givers. Samsung's unique advantage in the consumer electronics market and growing focus on digital health will provide you with exciting technical challenges and a rewarding career experience.

Position Responsibilities:

• Research and develop novel AI/ML algorithms and foundation models for physiological signal processing, sensor fusion, and digital biomarkers in wearable health applications, leveraging self-supervised learning, transformer models, and computer vision models on very large-scale real-world user datasets

• Design and implement deep learning and statistical models to analyze multi-modal biosignals (e.g., EEG, ECG, PPG, motion data) in real-time and batch settings

• Scale algorithms to handle large, multi-terabyte datasets from wearables and biomedical sensors on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) while maintaining algorithmic efficiency

• Collaborate with hardware and software engineers to integrate AI models into wearable platforms, ensuring efficient on-device inference

• Conduct feasibility studies, benchmark AI-driven features, and refine models for accuracy and scalability across diverse populations

• Work with clinical and regulatory teams to ensure model robustness, validation, and compliance with healthcare standards

• Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in digital health, computational neuroscience, and edge AI to drive innovation in wearables

• Generate patents and scientific research papers for top-tier publications

Required Skills:

• PhD in AI, Machine Learning, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

• 3+ years of experience in data analytics and project experiences in areas such as health foundation models pre and post training, wearable computing, and algorithm development for health applications

• 3+ years of experience in ML/DL frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and programming languages (Python, C++)

• Track record of publishing in high-impact AI/ML venues (ICML, ICLR, NeurIPS, etc.) or top-tier journals (Nature, Science, etc.)

• Experience with deep learning on time-series data and sequence models (LSTMs, attention mechanisms, temporal convolutions)

• Experience with time-series analysis, signal processing, and sensor fusion for wearable or biomedical applications

• Familiarity with biomedical sensing modalities (EEG, ECG, PPG, SpO2, etc.) and data-driven health insights

• Experience designing and optimizing algorithms to work efficiently with large-scale datasets and distributed computing environments

• Experience in developing PoCs and exploratory research projects in emerging sensing technologies

Special Attributes:

• Understanding of clinical workflows and healthcare data privacy considerations (HIPAA, FDA, MDR, etc.)

• Knowledge of wearable hardware constraints, power optimization, and real-time processing

• Familiarity with on-device ML optimization and model compression techniques

• Experience scaling algorithms and model training on cloud compute infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) or distributed computing environments

Within the base pay range, individual rates depend on a number of factors—including the role’s function and location as well as the individual’s knowledge, skills, experience, education and training. This is part of our comprehensive compensation package with annual bonus eligibility and generous benefits to help you live life well.

This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, and frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer (LLM & Agents)
jobs.description:
About the company

Trust Wallet is the leading non-custodial cryptocurrency wallet, trusted by over 200 million people worldwide to securely manage and grow their digital assets. Our vision is to give individuals the freedom to own their assets, confidently participate in the future economy, and access opportunities that enhance their lives. Our mission is to be a trusted personal companion — helping users safely navigate Web3, the on-chain economy, and the emerging AI-powered future. With support for over 10 million assets across 100+ blockchains, Trust Wallet offers a seamless, multi-chain experience backed by industry-leading self-custody technology, a vibrant community, and a growing ecosystem of partners.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Lead AI Engineer to own the backend and Agent systems behind our LLM-powered products. The role is end to end: you'll build the Agent workflows, define how we measure quality, keep them reliable in production, and shape where the product goes next.

This role is for someone who has shipped LLM features to real users, stayed with them after launch, and can prove with data that their changes made things better.


JOB SCOPE:

Build and own AI backend and Agent workflows

 - Design, build, and maintain multi-turn conversation systems, including context management, tool calling, knowledge retrieval (RAG), state management, and human handoff.

Drive evaluation and continuous improvement

 - Define success criteria with Product, Design, and QA leads.

 - Turn production failures into evaluation samples and regression tests.

 - Measure the impact and side effects of every change before and after release.

Diagnose problems across the stack

 - Isolate the root cause of failures: model judgment, knowledge gaps, abnormal tool responses, backend instability, or conflicting rules.

 - Apply the right fix for each cause rather than defaulting to prompt tweaks.

Own production reliability

 - Handle timeouts, retries, graceful degradation, async jobs, and third-party dependency failures.

 - Make sure every issue is traceable through logs, every change is versioned, and every failure has a recovery path.

Shape product and technical decisions

 - Give clear, reasoned positions on requirements, covering feasibility, cost, risk, and alternatives.

 - Propose better approaches and break work into phased, shippable deliverables.

Communicate proactively and follow through

 - Share progress, blockers, ETAs, and next checkpoints without needing to be chased.

 - After launch, track real-world impact and leave clear documentation and handover materials.


REQUIREMENTS:

 - Production LLM/Agent experience at scale. You've built LLM or Agent features used by 10,000+ active users, and you've maintained and improved them after launch.

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals. You're comfortable owning production code, APIs, data flows, and incident troubleshooting. Experience designing and implement backend services in Golang and integrate with LLMs and AI systems.

 - Real evaluation discipline. You've built evaluation sets, regression suites, and production monitoring, and you can explain how you confirmed an improvement was real rather than random fluctuation.

 - Ownership mindset. You make decisions, surface risks early, and don't consider a feature done until it's verified in production.

 - Web3 experience. Preferably 1 year of experience in a crypto, DeFi, or Web3 company (wallet, exchange, L1/L2 protocol, or DeFi platform strongly preferred)


ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

This is a global and fully remote role. You must have the right to work for the country you are based.




WHY WORK AT TRUST WALLET?

 - Be a part of the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem that continues to grow.

 - Excellent learning and career development opportunities.

 - Work alongside diverse, world-class talent, in an environment where learning and growth opportunities are endless.

 - Tackle fast-paced, challenging and unique projects.

 - Work in a truly global organization, with international teams and a flat organizational structure.

 - Work fully remotely with flexible working hours.

 - Enjoy competitive salary and benefits.

Apply today to join our team in building the world’s most trusted and secure crypto wallet and enable a decentralized future for everyone.

Trust Wallet is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.



*Due to the large amount of the applications, please consider your application as unsuccessful should you not be contacted within 4 weeks from your application date.

jobs.title: Zambia Field Operations & Performance Specialist (Fixed-Term)
jobs.description:
About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

In Zambia, from our hub in Kabwe, we run a specialised climate-smart input and agroforestry program to address challenges such as irregular rainfall and soil degradation. By partnering with local Tree Nursery Operators, we raise and distribute agroforestry trees that enrich soils and build long-term financial resilience. Supported by a structured frontline field team across Central and Southern Provinces, we use rigorous, data-driven frameworks to measure our impact and ensure we drive meaningful improvements in farmer yields, asset accumulation, and food security.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced, analytical, and resilient Field Operations Specialist to lead and expand our rural field operations. You will act as the key link between field leadership and headquarters, improving performance mainly through the Field Director (FD) layer while working closely with Field Officers (FOs) and Group Leaders.

The ideal candidate can turn complex field data into clear, targeted operational strategies, manage teams effectively under tight deadlines, and design community leadership frameworks that can grow with the programme. You will also lead with strong emotional intelligence, especially in demanding and remote environments.

Responsibilities

Field Performance Management & FD Leadership

• Lead field performance through field directors, ensuring teams deliver against key programme targets, including farmer adoption, tree survival and growth, repayment, and customer service

• Use field performance data to identify gaps, diagnose root causes and drive timely corrective action.

• Regularly engage with field teams and visit sites to validate performance, coach teams and address operational challenges.

Field HR Coordination & Risk Oversight

• Oversee key field staff processes, including onboarding, staff movements, performance management, disciplinary processes and payroll coordination.

• Provide leadership during urgent field staff and operational issues, including staff exits, fraud cases and other high risk incidents.

• Ensure field staff processes, incidents and risks are appropriately documented and managed in line with organisational policies.

Group Leader Management System

• Develop and continuously improve a strong, consistent Group Leader system across field sites.

• Establish clear approaches to Group Leader selection, onboarding, performance management, coaching and incentives.

• Strengthen accountability within groups and ensure underperforming Group Leaders and groups are appropriately supported or managed.

Training, Coaching & Staff Development

• Build the capabilities of Field Directors and field officers through structured training, coaching and mentorship.

• Strengthen communication and feedback between field teams and HQ, ensuring field realities inform programme decisions.

• Develop a strong talent pipeline and support the progression of high-performing field staff into future leadership roles.

Operational Prioritisation & Execution

• Lead the effective execution of multiple field priorities, balancing programme performance, people needs, operational risks and organisational deadlines.

• Ensure teams are focused on the highest-priority activities and that responsibilities are appropriately delegated while maintaining accountability for results.

• Identify opportunities to improve field systems, processes and ways of working as the programme grows.

Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

• 3 to 5+ years leading and growing multi-layered field teams (extension agents) in agriculture, rural development, or social enterprise.

• Demonstrated ability to analyse quantitative operational metrics (adoption rates, loan repayment percentages, yield impact) and translate insights into immediate field action plans.

• Proven track record of operating effectively across expansive, remote geographical regions with limited network connectivity and challenging logistics.

• Experience building or improving systems, training materials, or community leadership models from scratch.

• Excellent communication, coaching, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills with a passion for team development.

• Deep commitment to serving smallholder farmers and living One Acre Fund’s values.

• Bachelor's degree in related fields.

Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

Job Location

Kabwe, Zambia

Benefits

Health insurance, paid time off

Contract Duration

1 year

Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Zambia.

Application Deadline

30 December 2026. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @oneacrefund.org address. Please report any suspicious communication here (globalhotline@oneacrefund.org), but do not send applications or application materials to this email address.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI), and anti-racism are deeply connected to our organization’s mission and purpose. One Acre Fund aspires to build a culture where all staff feel consistently valued, represented, and connected – so that our team can thrive as professionals, and achieve exceptional impact for the farmers we serve.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Your Next Role Could Be Bigger Than Your Caseload

Senior Counsel | Connecticut

Please note: An active Connecticut Bar license is required. Admission in New York is highly valued but not required.

Tyson & Mendes is growing in Connecticut, and we are looking for an experienced trial attorney who wants the opportunity to do more than simply join an established practice.

This is an opportunity to help grow one.

Our Connecticut practice is expanding, creating an opportunity for the right Senior Counsel to take meaningful ownership of cases, develop client relationships, help strengthen our presence in the market, and grow into greater leadership as the office develops.

You will have the autonomy expected of an experienced attorney, along with the support of accomplished trial lawyers and the resources of a national litigation firm.

If you are an experienced Connecticut defense attorney who can independently manage complex litigation, has meaningful trial experience, and is excited by the opportunity to help build something, we would love to meet you.

Why This Opportunity?

Help Build Our Connecticut Practice

We are growing our presence in Connecticut, and the attorneys who join us during this stage will have an opportunity to contribute to what the office becomes.

For the right attorney, this means more than managing cases. It is an opportunity to become a trusted senior member of the practice, help develop teams and relationships, and position yourself for greater leadership as we continue to grow.

Practice With Independence

At the Senior Counsel level, we are looking for someone who knows how to run litigation.

You will be trusted to develop case strategy, manage discovery, take and defend depositions, handle substantive motion practice, communicate directly with clients and carriers, work with experts, evaluate exposure, and prepare matters for mediation and trial.

This is an excellent opportunity for an attorney who appreciates autonomy, takes initiative, and does not need someone managing every step of the process.

Work Under Exceptional Trial Leadership

Our Connecticut attorneys are led by Danielle Pascale, New York and Connecticut Branch Office Managing Partner, an accomplished trial attorney who spent 21 years as a prosecutor before transitioning to civil defense. Her extensive courtroom experience includes trying numerous felony matters and leading highly complex investigations and prosecutions.

The Connecticut practice also falls within the Northeast Region led by Cathleen Kelly Rebar, Northeast Regional Managing Partner, who brings more than two decades of complex litigation and trial experience. Her career includes significant defense results in high exposure matters, prior service as an Assistant District Attorney and Deputy Attorney General, and leadership within private practice.

Together, they bring significant courtroom experience, strong leadership, and a deep understanding of complex litigation.

For an experienced attorney, that creates an attractive combination: room to lead your own matters with highly accomplished litigators behind you.

Bring Your Trial Experience

We are looking for an attorney who has actually been in the courtroom.

Trial experience is important for this position. You should be comfortable developing a matter with trial in mind and confident taking responsibility when a case needs to be tried.

Our practice involves sophisticated civil defense matters, and experience in insurance defense is strongly preferred. Relevant backgrounds may include general liability, premises liability, professional liability, products liability, medical malpractice, employment, toxic tort, or other complex civil defense litigation.

Connecticut litigation experience is particularly important because we need someone who understands the local courts, procedures, and practice environment and can contribute with a high degree of independence.

Admission in both Connecticut and New York would be particularly valuable as our Northeast practice continues to grow, but dual admission is not required.

Who Will Thrive Here?

You are experienced, self directed, and comfortable taking ownership.

You do not wait for someone else to determine what happens next on your cases. You think strategically, communicate proactively, follow through, and understand how to build trust with clients.

You also understand that independence and collaboration are not opposites. You are comfortable leading your own matters while sharing ideas, supporting colleagues, mentoring more junior attorneys, and asking for another perspective when it will make the strategy stronger.

Most importantly, you are interested in what comes next.

Maybe that means developing a team. Maybe it means expanding client relationships. Maybe it means taking on greater leadership as our Connecticut presence grows.

We want someone who sees that opportunity and wants to be part of it.

National Resources. Local Opportunity.

Joining a growing office does not mean building without support.

You will have the resources, technology, training, litigation support, and national platform of Tyson & Mendes behind you while working within a Northeast practice led by experienced trial attorneys.

That gives you the ability to make an impact locally while being connected to something much larger.

Come Help Us Build What’s Next in Connecticut

You have already proven that you can practice law.

Now you may be looking for an opportunity to lead, build, and have a greater impact on what comes next.

If you are an experienced Connecticut trial attorney who values independence, wants to work with excellent leadership, and is excited by the opportunity to help grow a practice, we would like to talk with you.

Join Tyson & Mendes in Connecticut and help us build what comes next.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer I - Platform Billing Core
jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What Is The Role :

Billing powers Elastic's Cloud business. It runs across AWS, GCP, and Azure in over 50 regions. We oversee usage-based metering, consumption billing, and marketplace integrations at global scale.

The Billing Core team owns the data layer that makes billing correct, auditable, and automated. We work across two areas:

• Usage — Collect and process usage and cost data. This data is the foundation of our billing and financial reporting.

• Engine — Turn hourly usage data into customer invoices and revenue records.

We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to drive technical direction within the Billing Core domain. This is a hands-on role. You will design systems, improve how we operate, and work across teams. You will help our billing services grow in scale, reliability, and developer productivity. You will work closely with Product, SRE, and Cloud Infrastructure teams.

What You Will Be Doing :

• Own complex billing and account management systems that span multiple services and cloud providers.

• Build large-scale data pipelines for billing data ingestion, transformation, and reconciliation.

• Improve observability, incident response, and reliability of core billing systems using modern DevOps practices.

• Shape system architecture for scale and modularity. Guide service design, API structure, and data modelling.

• Work with SRE and Cloud teams to improve deployment, monitoring, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Own PostgreSQL data architecture and performance. Focus on query speed, schema quality, and high availability.

• Be the go-to technical reviewer for the billing core stack. Maintain technical consistency and quality standards.

• Mentor engineers and tech leads across the Billing organization. Help raise the bar on design and operational standards.

• Work with Product, Design, and Finance to set roadmap priorities. Make sure plans are feasible and aligned with business goals.

• Take part in on-call rotations. Make sure systems are production-ready through automation, resilience testing, and alerting.

What You Bring :

• 8+ years in backend or platform engineering, with solid skills in Python and PostgreSQL (schema design, performance, high availability).

• Proven experience improving reliability, observability, and incident response in production systems.

• Solid background in cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including networking, IAM, monitoring, and deployment.

• Ability to lead multi-quarter projects across teams — building consensus and delivering results.

• Track record of mentoring engineers, setting technical direction, and raising engineering standards.

• Experience with SaaS billing, metering, or financial systems is a real plus.

• Clear written and verbal communication skills. Able to influence across teams and speak to both technical and non-technical partners.

• Comfortable working on your own in a global, distributed, and async environment.

• Able to work across projects, work across functions and teams, and adapt to changing team structures.

• Track record of using AI to speed up development, debug complex systems, and improve code quality — while owning the outcomes.

• Eligible to work in Department of Defense (DoD) Impact Level 4 or above cloud service environments.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager, Accounting (Bangkok based, relocation provided)
jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The Opportunity
You will own and shape accounting across multiple countries in a fast-moving, global OTA — not just running the books but rethinking how accounting creates strategic value. Partner closely with business leaders, tax authorities, auditors, external advisors, and Agoda’s group brands to deliver timely reporting and enable new product and market launches across multiple legal entities.

This role blends accounting leadership, projects, and internal consulting. You’ll lead cross-functional projects to improve balance-sheet reconciliations, streamline one‑off adjustments, and design scalable end‑to‑end processes that reduce cycle times and strengthen controls. You’ll also help craft a long‑term vision for the teams you influence and mentor colleagues to raise technical and process capabilities.

We encourage experimentation with AI and automation — from intelligent reconciliation to anomaly detection and predictive close timelines — turning novel ideas into production improvements that free the team for higher‑value analysis. If you’re motivated by systems transformation, measurable impact, and working in an agile environment with varied products and stakeholders, this role gives you the autonomy and scope to make it happen

In this Role, you’ll get to:

Financial Accounts

• Prepare complete details and accurate accounts for all entities, including a group consolidation

• Manage month-end and year-end closes in a fast-paced, deadline-driven and regulated environment, and drive continuous improvement of close processes

• Report accurate, timely and insightful monthly management accounts and financial updates for management review

• Motivate management accounting/nominal ledger team to take further responsibility for accounts input and preparation processes, and ensure career development in a supportive manner

• Manage and liaise with auditors, IT review and tax computation processes from planning to filing in an efficient and effective manner

• Collaborate with other finance managers to support overall department goals and objectives

• Advise staff regarding the handling of non-routine reporting transactions

• Manage and oversee the daily operations of the accounting department

Accounting Controls

• Ensure accounting, associated IT systems and internal control environment are in compliance with Corporate policy as well as SOX requirements and US GAAP.

• Responsible for review of journal entries

• Review reconciliations of all significant account balances including bank accounts and fixed assets, debtors and creditors, and report significant exceptions to management

• Guides other departments by researching and interpreting accounting policy, applying observations and recommendations to operational issues

Tax

• Understand key concepts of tax returns (i.e. corporate income tax, withholding tax and indirect taxes) in foreign jurisdictions where the company has legal presence

• Provide tax team with accurate information for the purpose of tax compliance in local and foreign jurisdictions

Projects

• Manage and implement the Company’s initiatives and projects from finance and accounting perspective. This includes providing requirements, designing and performing UAT, designing new workflow, monitoring post-go-live processes, and troubleshooting

• Identify and drive process and technology improvement opportunities

What you’ll Need to Succeed:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.

• 6+ years of accounting experience, with strong knowledge of full-set accounting and financial reporting.

• Practical knowledge of internal controls and compliance and familiarity with international accounting standards.

• Experience working with ERP systems and contributing to system, process improvement, or cross-functional projects.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to improve processes and adapt in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.

• Excellent command of written and spoken English.

It’s good if you have.

• Experience with Oracle ERP

• Familiarity with US GAAP and practical experience with SOX

• Professional accounting qualifications such as CPA, ACCA, CA, CMA, or equivalent.

What you’ll get:

• A relocation package including visa-sponsorship to help you and your family get here comfortably.

• Medical insurance, mental health support line, annual leave, travel discounts, sick days, and the AgodaChoice flexible spending benefit

• Employee resource groups for every culture and background

• Flexibility to help you work in the way that’s best for you with a work from home allowance, 30-day work from anywhere benefit, and hybrid working options.

• Professional growth and learning budget, including several in-person development programs for each stage of your career.

• The chance to live in Bangkok, one of the best cities in Southeast Asia, and a central hub for travel. Within 3 hours, you can hit any of the most popular countries like Vietnam, Singapore, Laos, Malaysia, and Hong Kong, just to name a few.
