jobs.title: Senior Staff Applications Engineer - Spark
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Staff Applications Engineer to own how Spark answers the question of technical fit. You will build and maintain the evaluation framework that determines whether a site, partnership, or commercial opportunity is viable for the Spark modular data center (MDC) and Spark-Liquid (DLC) product lines, and you will support the Energy Development Group (EDG), business development, and partner teams as they apply it. When an opportunity is undefined, unconventional, or contested, you are the Spark team's point of contact, the person who answers the hard product questions and delivers the technical verdict.



Spark is on a path to deploy hundreds of megawatts of modular capacity, and every megawatt of it begins as an unqualified site on a map. Your judgment about where this product can be applied, not the design of the product itself, is what converts that pipeline into deployable capacity.



What You'll Be Working On:

Product Authority & Opportunity Qualification

 - Qualification Framework: Build and maintain the standardized screening criteria, scoring model, decision thresholds, and report format that define what makes a site or opportunity viable for Spark deployments. Keep it current as the product roadmap evolves, and keep a record of past calls and their rationale.

 - Team Enablement: Equip EDG, business development, and partner teams to apply the framework themselves on standard opportunities. Train, document, and iterate so routine qualification does not depend on a single point of failure, you.

 - Escalated Technical Judgment: Serve as the Spark team's point of contact for opportunities the framework cannot resolve, including undefined sites, non-standard configurations, and contested calls. Deliver a clear fit, conditional fit, or no-fit verdict with the engineering rationale behind it.

 - Speed Discipline: Turn around escalated feasibility assessments in days, not weeks. Frame the problem tightly enough that deeper analysis, when required, lands on the respective engineering discipline ready to be worked.

 - Deviation & Exception Management: Identify where an opportunity requires deviation from the standard Spark configuration, quantify the engineering cost and schedule impact, and route it to the responsible engineering discipline for disposition.

 - New Application Assessment: Evaluate technical fit for non-standard applications such as edge deployments, distributed energy assets, co-located industrial sites, and third-party colocation and shell-rent arrangements, and define what the product would need to change to serve them.

 - Roadmap Feedback Loop: Feed recurring field constraints back to Spark design engineering and R&D as prioritized product requirements. You are the closed loop between what the market presents and what the product can absorb.

Site & Partner Engagement

 - EDG Partnership: Serve as Spark's dedicated technical counterpart to the Energy Development Group across the full site pipeline, from initial screen through definitive agreement.

 - Spark Fit Assessment: Evaluate candidate sites and opportunities against Spark module requirements, covering power, thermal, civil, and physical interface, and define what the site must deliver at the module boundary.

 - Field Validation: Conduct site walks alongside EDG, developers, and utility counterparties, converting observations into Spark product requirements and a maintained risk register.

Technical Communication & Diligence

 - Diligence Support: Provide the technical inputs that Finance requires to model an opportunity, including module configuration, power and cooling assumptions, and site-specific efficiency and derate factors.

 - Executive Communication: Translate multi-discipline engineering tradeoffs into clear go/no-go decision frameworks for commercial and executive stakeholders.



What You'll Bring to the Team:

 - Professional Experience: 10+ years of progressive engineering experience spanning data center infrastructure, power generation or utility interconnection, industrial capital projects, or modular and containerized systems.

 - Broad Engineering Fluency: Working fluency across data center infrastructure disciplines including electrical (MV/LV distribution, switchgear, transformers), mechanical/thermal (DLC, CDUs, heat rejection), and civil/structural (foundations, seismic/wind loading, rigging).

 - First-Principles Decision Making: Track record of making feasibility calls from first principles under incomplete information, with direct accountability for recommendations carrying real capital consequences.

 - Technical Counterparty Credibility: Proven ability to hold technical credibility with external developers, utilities, enterprise customers, and executives while keeping opportunities moving rapidly.

 - Unit Economics Command: Ability to connect engineering decisions directly to $/MW, capex, PUE, and deployment schedules.

 - Product Authority Track Record: Demonstrated depth on a specific engineered product or platform, where you were the person others relied on for an authoritative answer on capabilities and limits.

 - Mountaineer Spirit: Relentless technical rigor, comfort with ambiguity, a safety-first culture, the judgment to say no early, and the discipline to make calls when perfect information is unavailable.

 - Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.



Bonus Points

 - Experience with modular, containerized, or prefabricated infrastructure product lines.

 - Familiarity with agency certification and AHJ coordination for modular electrical equipment across varied jurisdictions.

 - Deep familiarity with energy development, interconnection processes/queues, and behind-the-meter site configurations.



This Role Is Not a Good Fit If:

 - You prefer purely theoretical design work over applied, rapid feasibility assessments.

 - You require complete data and fully finalized engineering designs before making a technical recommendation.

 - You struggle to communicate complex engineering tradeoffs to commercial partners or executive stakeholders.



Benefits:

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Restricted Stock Units

 - Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

 - Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

 - Employer contributions to HSA account

 - Paid parental leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Professional development & tuition reimbursement

 - Mental health & wellness support

 - Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

 - Cell phone stipend

 - 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

 - Volunteer time off

 - Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

 - Daily meals allowance

 - Additional perks & programs specific to location



Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $190,000-$215,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

jobs.title: Assistant Cook (On-call)
jobs.description:

• Keeps all refrigeration, storage and working areas in clean, working condition in order to comply with all regulations. Ensures all equipment is in good working condition for safe and efficient operation.

• Visually inspects, selects and uses only the freshest fruits, vegetables, meats, and other food products of the highest standard in the preparation of all menu items. Reads and employs math skills for following recipes. Prepares requisitions for supplies and food items necessary for production.
• Performs general/routine cleaning tasks using standard hotel cleaning products as assigned by supervisor to adhere to health standards.
• Keep floors dry and clean to avoid slip/fall accidents.
• Perform other duties as requested, such as moving supplies and equipment, cleaning up spills, etc., to ensure safe working environment.
• Will assistant kitchen personnel in operating various kitchen posts.
• Works closely with various front of the house staff, kitchen personnel and Stewards.

Skills

• Ability to follow all safety standards including chemical usage, food handling, preparation and storage.
• Keep up to date with and follow all sanitation standards.
• Possess basic knowledge in all areas of cooking fundamentals including sautéing, soup/sauce making, broiling, frying, cold preparation, plating, basic butchering and baking. Familiarity in all types of food cuisines and their preparations.
• Possesses basic knowledge in all types of foods including meats, seafood’s and produce. Will be able to inspect and ensure all foods are up to proper standards.
• Will be able to follow directions and instructions. Must have the ability to learn from others.
• Able to effectively manage time and work under pressure when necessary.
• Must be able to adhere to proper food temperatures for all foods hot and cold, food holding and cooking.
• Knowledge of operating all kitchen equipment (i.e., stoves, ovens, broilers, slicers, steamers, kettles, etc.). Sufficient manual dexterity to properly operate all types of kitchen equipment (i.e., knives, spoons, spatulas, tongs, slicers, etc.)
• Basic mathematical skills necessary to understand recipes, measurements, and portion sizes.
• Ability to read, write, listen and speak the English language in order to communicate effectively with co-workers and guests.
• Ability to grasp, lift and/or carry or otherwise, move, rotate goods weighing a maximum of 200lbs on a continuous schedule. Also able to lift a minimum of 50 pounds.

• Able to stand for long periods.
• Ability to preciously perform duties within extreme temperature ranges and situations. Will be able to work prudently in stressful circumstances.

What Makes Cloudbeds Unique

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our platform powers hotels across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From boutique properties to large hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. As a Customer Support & Onboarding Specialist - Accounting (Latin America), you will help our Latin American hotel customers unlock the full potential of Cloudbeds' financial and accounting capabilities. You will work directly with clients and their accounting teams across the region to guide them through end-to-end accounting configuration — from chart of accounts mapping and tax setup to ERP integrations and country-specific e-invoicing compliance — ensuring every property is set up correctly and running smoothly from day one. This is a customer-facing role requiring equal parts hospitality accounting expertise, technical curiosity, and a genuine passion for helping people succeed. If you thrive behind a spreadsheet but prefer not to engage with customers directly, this role is not the right fit.

Our Onboarding & Accounting Integration Team

We sit at the intersection of hospitality expertise and technical execution — solving real financial challenges that hotel operators face every day. We move fast, collaborate closely with Engineering, Support, and Sales, and take genuine pride in helping customers connect their financial backbone to Cloudbeds. If you love solving problems that actually matter to the people you are helping, you will feel right at home here.

What You Bring to the Team

• Guide Latin American hotel clients through full accounting onboarding including chart of accounts mapping, tax configuration, revenue recognition setup, reconciliation workflows, and country-specific e-invoicing compliance (Mexico SAT/CFDI, Colombia DIAN, Chile SII, and others)

• Translate each customer's unique business processes — night audits, folio management, accounts receivable, month-end close — into a properly configured Cloudbeds environment

• Strong customer-facing communication skills — you are comfortable and confident engaging directly with hotel clients and their accounting teams via phone and video daily

Bonus Skills to Stand Out

Machine Operations Technician III
jobs.location: Long Beach, California, United States; Torrance, California, United States
jobs.description:
Divergent is building the new industrial age. Every day, our teams design, manufacture, and assemble advanced systems for some of the world’s most demanding industries. Our integrated engineering and manufacturing platform transforms complex designs into production-ready solutions, helping customers move faster, build smarter, and deliver critical systems when they matter most. Divergent is a qualified Tier 1 supplier to global automotive OEMs and supports leading U.S. aerospace and defense companies.

Join us and help push the boundaries of what can be built.

Purpose

The Machine Operations Technician III is responsible for operating, monitoring, and supporting large-format laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) 3D printers and associated manufacturing equipment during machine testing, qualification, development printing, and ongoing machine operation.

The role prepares machines, materials, tooling, and work areas for operation; executes defined machine and print processes; monitors equipment and process performance; identifies abnormal conditions; and performs troubleshooting and recovery activities. The Technician works closely with Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Controls, Software, Quality, and other technicians to safely operate equipment, resolve issues, and generate reliable machine and process data.

The Technician III is expected to independently perform complex machine operations, recognize conditions that may affect machine performance or print quality, troubleshoot non-routine operating issues, and provide technical feedback that improves machine operation, print execution, repeatability, and equipment utilization.

The Role

Machine & Print Operations

• Operate large-format LPBF printers and supporting manufacturing equipment in accordance with approved procedures and engineering requirements.

• Prepare machines, materials, tooling, and work areas for testing, qualification, and print operations.

• Verify machine configuration, calibration status, materials, process parameters, and safety conditions before operation.

• Execute test prints, qualification builds, and development builds.

• Monitor machine and process conditions throughout operation and identify abnormal conditions.

• Perform post-print activities including build removal, powder recovery, cleaning, and machine preparation.

• Maintain FOD-free, clean, and organized work areas.

Testing & Qualification

• Support machine commissioning, functional testing, qualification, and development activities.

• Execute approved test sequences and document machine and process results.

• Prepare equipment and materials for qualification activities.

• Support repeat testing following repairs, adjustments, calibration, or configuration changes.

• Provide technical feedback on machine performance, print results, and recurring issues.

Troubleshooting & Equipment Support

• Troubleshoot machine operating issues using alarms, machine data, observations, and technical documentation.

• Perform approved resets, adjustments, cleaning, material recovery, and corrective actions.

• Support troubleshooting and recovery of mechanical, electrical, motion, controls, powder-handling, and supporting equipment.

• Identify issues requiring escalation and work with Engineering and other technical teams to resolve them.

• Verify equipment operation following corrective actions or repairs.

• Document equipment issues, corrective actions, and results.

Material & Supporting Equipment

• Handle, load, recover, and maintain traceability of LPBF powder and associated materials.

• Operate supporting equipment including depowdering, powder recovery, sieving, robotic, and material-handling systems.

• Follow established material-handling, PPE, housekeeping, and safety requirements.

• Identify material or equipment conditions that may affect print quality or machine performance.

Documentation & Process Improvement

• Use ERP and manufacturing systems to record work orders, machine status, material consumption, print activity, and equipment history.

• Maintain accurate machine, material, configuration, and qualification records.

• Identify recurring equipment issues, downtime, process variability, and opportunities for improvement.

• Recommend and support improvements to operating procedures, tooling, print processes, and machine utilization.

• Capture lessons learned and contribute to standardized operating methods.

Team & Cross-Functional Support

• Work closely with Design Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Controls, Software, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and other technicians.

• Provide technical support and knowledge transfer to less-experienced technicians.

• Communicate machine status, technical issues, risks, and required support clearly.

• Support a safe, professional, FOD-free, and quality-focused work environment.

Basic Qualifications

• Ability to lawfully access information and technology that is subject to US export controls

• 4+ years of experience in additive manufacturing, machine operation, manufacturing, equipment testing, automation, or a related technical field; equivalent experience may be considered.

• Experience operating and troubleshooting technical manufacturing or automated equipment.

• Ability to interpret work instructions, drawings, specifications, procedures, and technical documentation.

• Working knowledge of mechanical systems, sensors, actuators, motors, motion systems, and industrial equipment.

• Experience with structured troubleshooting and technical problem-solving.

• Proficiency with computer software and manufacturing systems.

• Strong attention to detail and communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and collaborate across technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) or other additive manufacturing processes.

• Experience operating large-format or multi-laser additive manufacturing equipment.

• Experience with depowdering, powder recovery, sieving, or other AM post-processing activities.

• Experience with lasers, robotics, CNC, motion systems, controls, or automated equipment.

• Experience supporting machine qualification, process development, or production ramp-up.

• Experience in aerospace, automotive, robotics, additive manufacturing, or other advanced manufacturing environments.

• Experience with ERP, MES, or other manufacturing execution systems.

• Experience with Lean or continuous improvement.

Work Environment

• Fully onsite in a development and manufacturing environment.

• Frequent standing, walking, kneeling, bending, reaching, climbing, and hands-on machine operation.

• Work around lasers, large-format machinery, robotics, powder-handling systems, electrical systems, and automated equipment.

• Follow applicable PPE, laser, electrical, inert-gas, powder-handling, ESD, chemical/process, and machine-safety requirements.

• Ability to lift and move up to 50 pounds independently; heavier components require assistance or appropriate equipment.

• May require extended hours, shift work, or weekend support during testing, qualification, development printing, and production ramp-up.

Pay Range

$36—$50 USD

What We Offer:

• Holistic Compensation Package: Enjoy a world-class compensation package that includes a competitive salary, equity plan, and discretionary results-based incentive bonus opportunities, ensuring you're truly valued for your contributions.

• Wellness and Time Off: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with paid vacation, sick time, and company holidays, including a year-end shutdown to recharge. We support growing families with paid parental leave, recognizing the importance of bonding time.

• Comprehensive Health and Wellness: Prioritize your well-being with our comprehensive health and wellness benefits, offering both HMO and Premium PPO options. Additionally, benefit from company-sponsored life insurance and short and long-term disability coverage for peace of mind.

• Investment in Growth: We're committed to your professional development. Take advantage of reimbursement opportunities for learning and development initiatives, empowering you to continuously expand your skill set and reach peak performance.

• Collaborative and High-Performing Environment: Join our collaborative, dynamic, and high-performing team within a fast-paced, mission-driven company. Together, we're disrupting the traditional manufacturing industry, fostering innovation, and integrating people and technology to reduce our footprint.

Equal Employment Opportunity

jobs.title: Research Scientist – Reinforcement Learning (RL)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Percepta’s mission is to transform critical institutions with applied AI. We care that industries that power the world (e.g. healthcare, manufacturing, energy) benefit from frontier technology.

To make that happen, we embed with industry-leading customers to drive AI transformation. We bring together: https://challenge.percepta.ai

 - Forward-deployed expertise in engineering, product, and research

 - Mosaic, our in-house toolkit for rapidly deploying agentic workflows

 - Strategic partnerships with Anthropic, McKinsey, AWS, companies within the General Catalyst portfolio, and more

Our team is a quickly growing group of Applied AI Engineers, Embedded Product Managers and Researchers motivated by diffusing the promise of AI into improvements we can feel in our day to day lives.

Percepta is a direct partnership with General Catalyst, a global transformation and investment company.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Research Scientist - Reinforcement Learning at Percepta, you will work at the intersection of RL research and real-world deployment. You will advance the frontier of capabilities through research on decision-making for critical industries. You will collaborate closely with our Embedded Product Managers (EPMs) and engineers to ensure that our solutions transform how companies operate.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Identifying which real-world challenges are tractable for RL-guided decision making.

 - Develop RL methods to perform complex tasks in domains like planning, decision-making, or optimization.

 - Develop and maintain the experimental infrastructure that powers our research, from simulation environments and data pipelines to training and evaluation frameworks.

 - Conduct in-the-wild evaluations at scale that drive millions of dollars in value.

 - Partner with our applied AI engineers to transition successful research ideas into robust features of our Mosaic platform.

 - Communicate research outcomes to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, making sure everyone understands the “so what” of research and how to apply it.




YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:

 - Have an MS/PhD in Computer Science, ML, or related field, or equivalent experience.

 - Have a track record of effective RL work.

 - Are motivated by impact in critical industries including healthcare, supply chains, energy, and finance.

 - Understand how to perform rigorous RL experimentation.

 - Enjoy extreme ownership.

 - Believe that AI can drive transformative change in critical industries.

The following list can be a sign that you might be a good technical fit:

 - High performance, large scale distributed systems.

 - Large scale LLM training or RL training.

 - Possess strong programming skills, especially in Python.

 - Implementing LLM post-training algorithms.

 - Experience with vLLM/SGLang, Ray, Kubernetes (or AWS EKS).

 - Experience with distributed checkpointing, multi-node, multi-gpu training, custom KV-caching.

 - Experience with asynchronous training and inference, either with VeRL https://github.com/volcengine/verl/tree/main, ROLL https://github.com/alibaba/ROLL, SkyRL https://github.com/NovaSky-AI/SkyRL, AReal https://github.com/inclusionAI/AReaL, or with RL libraries like CleanRL https://github.com/vwxyzjn/cleanrl.

We’re working against an incredibly ambitious mission. It won’t be easy, but it will likely be the most fulfilling work of your career. If this excites you, let's chat, even if you don't meet all of the qualifications above.




OUR VALUES

jobs.title: Technology Alliances Leader
jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is looking for a business owner to lead our most valuable technology alliances. This is not a program-management seat. You'll run each alliance like a business, owning the strategy, the operating plan, and the number. You'll scale our flagship hyperscaler partnership, convert momentum with cloud and data partners, and stand up the next wave of alliances across the AI, productivity, and CRM ecosystem.

This role is based remotely and will report to the Director, GTM Partners.

You Will

• Run each alliance as a business. Own the strategy, operating plan, and joint revenue and sourced-pipeline targets, along with the KPIs beneath them. Report results plainly and drive to them.

• Manage the full 360 relationship as one coordinated motion: sell-with (co-sell, joint pursuits, deal registration, account mapping), sell-to (the partner as a Smartsheet customer), sell-through (Marketplace and private offers), and build-with (integrations, product collaboration, roadmap alignment).

• Build the "better together" thesis and joint GTM plan. Define target segments, priority accounts, use cases, and repeatable plays, then lead Sales, Product, Marketing, and Professional Services to execute them in the field.

• Create net-new value. Find and build new co-sell programs, industry verticals, market segments, and platform-to-platform propositions, always biased toward sourced, originated revenue.

• Build executive sponsorship on both sides. Run joint business planning, QBRs, and the executive sponsor program, and orchestrate "party of three" plays that pair a technology partner with a GSI or consulting firm.

• Set the operating rhythm. Establish clear, data-driven KPIs and a predictable cadence. Hold partners accountable for results, not just intent, and hold Smartsheet's internal stakeholders to their commitments in return.

• Move a portfolio at three stages of maturity: Elevate: scale our most established hyperscaler relationship into sourced revenue across new verticals and geographies. Accelerate: turn momentum with cloud and data platform partners into a live, resourced joint GTM plan. Incubate: establish the thesis, secure sponsorship, and land first plays with emerging AI, productivity, and CRM partners.

You Have

• 10-12+ years owning strategic technology alliances (hyperscaler, ISV, or platform), with direct accountability for joint revenue and pipeline, not solely program or operations metrics.

• Fluency in co-sell and Marketplace mechanics (deal registration, private offers, transactions) and in technical or product integration partnerships.

• A track record of turning "better together" value propositions into joint GTM plans that produced sourced revenue.

• Proven executive sponsorship, joint business planning, and QBR cadences that drive accountability.

• Cross-functional leadership without authority, aligning Sales, Product, Marketing, and Services around a shared plan.

• A business-owner mindset: data-driven, direct, and rigorous about the difference between revenue you source and revenue you merely influence.

• Credibility with both partner executives (a CRO's office) and product leaders, plus a plain-speak style that leads with the bottom line.

• Experience orchestrating "party of three" motions with a GSI or consulting firm. (preferred)

• Background across the cloud, data, and AI ecosystem, credible with commercial and technical audiences.(preferred)

jobs.description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Space Build Reliability Engineer partners closely with the design and manufacturing teams to right-size processes and controls to enable scaling the production of spacecraft hardware. Build Reliability Engineers ensure production processes yield verified, reliable hardware at rate. You will flex beyond Build Reliability to support Quality, Flight Reliability, and Mission Assurance. The ideal candidate is a responsible, collaborative, process-oriented engineer with hands-on hardware design/test/manufacturing/troubleshooting experience.

• Partner with design engineering and manufacturing teams to create test, manufacturability, and inspection plans for all vehicle hardware.

• Contain suspect or known non-conforming product, providing guidance to quality inspectors, technicians, shop supervisors, and engineers.

• Lead failure investigations in production, test, and operation; identifying and mitigating immediate and underlying root causes to reduce risk and improve the reliability of designs and processes.

• Provide critical peer review of hardware during design reviews and acceptance and qualification test campaigns.

• Perform failure modes and effects analyses, build requirements compliance matrix tools, and ensure adequate test coverage, change management, and manufacturability of flight hardware.

• Own vehicle level deliverables for regulatory bodies including requirements compliance, functional or flight hazard analyses, and verification evidence.

• Support Mission Assurance's vehicle level risk management and identification/tracking/execution of mitigations.

• Bachelor's degree in aerospace, computer science, electrical, manufacturing, mechanical, or material sciences engineering.

• 5+ years professional experience in aerospace, design, quality, or related engineering role.

• Hands-on hardware test, qualification, troubleshooting, or failure analysis experience.

• Commitment to lean quality principles without compromising safety or reliability.

• Demonstrated application of process controls in high volume manufacturing, test, and quality environments.

• Experience generating, processing, and/or analyzing data for production insight.

• Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills, with a drive to innovate and improve reliability in cutting-edge technology.

• Full project lifecycle ownership experience (cradle-to-grave).

jobs.title: IT Support Analyst
jobs.description:
Weekly outpatient therapy isn't always enough, and a trip to the ER isn't the only answer. Patients and their families rely on Compass Health Center when in crisis – every day, we help people overcome depression, anxiety, suicidality, obsessions/compulsions, trauma, chronic pain, and other obstacles in order for our patients to live freely.

About This Role

As the largest provider of PHP/IOP programs and psychiatric services in Illinois, Compass Health Center is one of the fastest-growing behavioral health organizations in the country. We are thrilled to expand our exceptionally innovative and highly distinguished programs that redefine our industry and raise the standard for comprehensive care.

Launching in early 2027, our  location in Falls Church, Virginia, will be home to top local talent in behavioral health care. This interdisciplinary team of trailblazers will build our adolescent and adult programs from the ground up alongside the leadership of well-established clinicians and doctors working in PHP/IOP behavioral health care for the past decade.

The IT Analyst II provides user support to resolve issues with computer programs, hardware, and systems. In this role, support analysts may focus on a specific aspect of the IT department, such as Network Administration. i.e. Azure AD, Exchange, GPOS, etc, or they may provide general technical support to end users.  In any case, the support analyst examines issues with IT software, and equipment and develops and deploys solutions to keep computers working, and builds computers for new hires.

Please note that this role is set to start in mid January and will consist of 5 weeks of training prior to launching for patients, and will be 100% onsite at our Falls Church location.

What You'll Do:

• Day to day break fixes of all Compass equipment, including hardware and software.

• Hardware maintenance which includes printers, computers, monitors, phones, servers, etc.

• Software maintenance which includes MS Office suite, Symantec virus protection, Outlook, etc.

• Data room – Maintain data rooms for both locations.

• Licenses – Ensure all software licenses are current; Windows, Adobe, Outlook, VPN, etc.

• Account creation – New hires: AD, Outlook Suite Products, VPN and Phone Admin/Voicemail.

• Incident tracking – Maintain current records through FreshService ticketing system.

• IT equipment moves – Relocations, build-outs, moves between locations, etc.

• Equipment ordering – For new hires or when requested by staff (requires approval).

• Maintain inventory – Spare PCs, phones, printers, etc. Dispose of all retired equipment.

• Research new hardware and/or software that improves functionality.

• Point of contact for vendors: Wiring, printer maintenance, Chicago security system.

• Providing minor technical or operational training.

• Completing IT support logs and be available to work across teams on multiple technology/business projects.

• Provide training for junior staff/new hires within the technology group.

• On call for emergency issues or outages, and for proactive upgrades – nights and weekends.

• Flexible to work long hours including weekends as required and ability to travel on short notice for customer issues.

Who You Are:

• Have a Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology or Computer science.

• If no Degree, 3-5 years of experience in an IT Support or Technology Support requirement

• Have a strong passion for technology and ability to work in an adaptive environment.

• Ability to provide high level of customer service and enjoy helping people resolve their IT questions

• Ability to Create and Implement Procedures

• Team collaboration – support analysts tend to work within larger teams of IT professionals to resolve user issues, so effective collaboration within the department is essential.

• Organizational Skills/Attention to Detail/Effective Time Management Skills

• Honesty, Strong Verbal Communication Skills/Positive Attitude/Friendliness/Kindness/Compassion

• Knowledge of operating systems, office software, enterprise software, and server systems.

• Knowledge of remote desktop support systems including TeamViewer, RDP, LogMeIn, etc.

• Familiarity with networking systems and protocols.

• Time management – support analysts typically handle multiple user issues at once, so they should be able to effectively manage their time, set priorities, and resolve problems in a timely manner.

We are committed to a fair and equitable work environment. The expected compensation range for this role is below. This range includes multiple career path levels across the organization; where you fall in the range is dependent upon a number of factors including, but not limited to, your years of experience, type of experience, location, and education/certifications. Compass reserves the right to update these ranges.

Compensation

$26.44—$33.65 USD

We know job descriptions can be intimidating, so if this sounds like an opportunity for you, please don't hesitate to apply!

Who We Are

Compass Health Center is a recognized leader in crisis-level mental health, bringing passion, connection, and patient-centered care to the Partial Hospitalization and Intensive Outpatient space (PHP/IOP). Based in Chicagoland, we serve hundreds of patients every day, ranging from ages 5 through adulthood, in our onsite facilities or through our flourishing virtual programming. Compass fills a critical gap between outpatient and inpatient care through an intermediate level of Behavioral Healthcare.

A few more things we want you to know: our values are super important to us, and hopefully will be to you, too. Cultural humility, teamwork, continuous improvement, connection, patient centered care, passion, innovation, and agility should be your power sources. Joining Compass is an opportunity to feel fulfilled through a joint mission towards healing our communities.

Benefits & Perks

We know that you will be dedicated to your purpose here. We look at that investment as a two-way street. We are proud to offer plenty of space for growth, and opportunities to pursue continuous development within our organization.

What’s Next?

Compass is committed to cultivating diverse and dynamic teams who exude passion for their craft, so whether or not you check all the boxes, we encourage you to apply – we’d be grateful to hear from you!

jobs.title: Regional Marketing & Communications Consultant – North America

jobs.description:
Based in San Francisco, Santa Monica, New York or Washington DC
 
The Role
Love telling stories? Nice but not enough.
Love helping ambitious New Zealand companies win in the world's largest and most competitive market? Now we're talking.
We're looking for a Regional Marketing and Communications Consultant to join NZTE's North America team.
This isn't a traditional marketing role. You won't wait for briefs to arrive or spend days endlessly refining PowerPoint slides. You’ll be expected to get close to the business, spot what is needed and help make it happen.
You will work with Trade Commissioners, Business Development Managers and exporters to help turn strategy into commercial results. You'll become embedded in industry sector teams, helping them identify opportunities, shape plans, solve problems and connect with the right expertise at the right time.
Think of yourself as part marketing adviser, part project manager, part relationship manager and connector. One day you might be developing the marketing approach for a major conference activation.  The next, you could be helping shape the implementation of a sector growth plan, developing targeted content, or creating collateral to help New Zealand exporters succeed in North America.  
 
Who We Are
Te Taurapa Tūhono | New Zealand Trade and Enterprise (NZTE) is New Zealand’s international business development agency. We work with innovative and forward-thinking companies, helping them grow internationally. Our people are based in 37 offices, working across 24 time zones and 40 languages to support New Zealand businesses in over 100 countries.  
Across North America, we help Kiwi companies grow in some of the world's most dynamic and fiercely competitive markets. We work from offices in New York, Vancouver, Washington DC, San Francisco and Santa Monica, and this role can be based in any one of them.
 
What You'll Be Doing
You'll be the primary Marketing and Communications business partner for two sector teams in North America. 
That means: 
Embedding with your sectors’ Trade Commissioners and Business Development Managers to build trusted relationships. 
Leading MarComs delivery, including events, trade missions, conference booths, campaigns, and integrated marketing initiatives.  
Being the connector between your sector teams and the rest of the Marketing, Communications and Solutions team which includes research, digital solutions, content and event management specialists.
Picking up some region wide marketing and communication responsibilities which may include trade media, social media or brand presence.  
The best relationships, opportunities and insights are built face-to-face, so regular travel to your appointed regional offices will be part of the role. You may also travel to special events and trade shows across North America.  
Success in this role means your sector teams see you as a trusted commercial partner, marketing activity is tied to commercial priorities, and good ideas move from discussion to delivery without drama.
 
What You'll Bring
We're less interested in whether you've followed a textbook marketing career and more interested in whether you can build trust, understand commercial priorities and get things done in a way that makes people want to work with you.
You'll likely bring:
Solid experience in marketing, communications, event marketing, account management, or related customer-facing roles.  
Excellent writing and communication skills.  
Exceptional relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence, collaborate, and build trust across a range of stakeholders.      
Strong commercial curiosity and judgement.
Proven project management skills, with the ability to move initiatives from idea to execution while balancing competing priorities.  
Comfort navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.  
Importantly, you'll enjoy being close to the action and thrive under pressure.
  
Why You'll Love It
This is one of those roles where no two days are alike and you will be stimulated by the diversity.
You’ll work with a dedicated and collaborative global team across the US, Canada and New Zealand. We encourage learning, honest conversations, intellectual challenge and plenty of fun along the way.  
We believe New Zealand is good for the world, and that diversity makes our people, organisation and country stronger. We welcome applicants from every background and are committed to an environment where everyone can contribute and thrive.
 
Interested?

The role can be based in any one of our five North American offices. You must already have the appropriate immigration status to work in the country where you will be based.

jobs.title: Sales Associate (Part-Time), Denver
jobs.description:
About ALSO.

We’re ALSO, an electric mobility company originally conceived as a part of Rivian. We’re a passionate team of builders, dreamers, doers and innovators, focused on creating entirely new (not to mention, innovative and delightful) vertically integrated, small EVs designed to meet the global mobility challenges of today and tomorrow. Our mission is to inspire everyone to ride ALSO—replacing many local car, truck and SUV miles with ones on vehicles that are more affordable, more enjoyable and 10-50x more efficient.




ALSO is looking for a Sales Associate (part-time) to support the launch and growth of our brand in/around Denver. This is a field-based, customer-facing role that works closely with and reports to the Market Manager to bring ALSO to life through mobile demos, retail experiences, and community activations. You’ll be on the front lines—introducing customers to our vehicles, delivering exceptional experiences, and helping build the foundation of ALSO’s presence in Denver.

This role is ideal for someone who is energetic, people-oriented, and excited to be part of an early-stage brand with room to grow.

 


WHAT YOU WILL DO


CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE & SALES SUPPORT

 - Deliver engaging, high-quality customer experiences in both mobile and fixed retail environments.

 - Educate customers on ALSO vehicles, features, and benefits, guiding them through demo rides and early purchase consideration.

 - Support local sales goals by converting interest into qualified leads and sales.

 - Share customer feedback and insights with the Market Manager to improve execution and experiences.


MOBILE DEMO & EVENT SUPPORT

 - Assist with the setup, execution, and breakdown of mobile demo experiences and local activation events, including driving the custom Rivian EV van to/from events.

 - Safely operate and maintain the local demo fleet, ensuring vehicles are clean, charged, and customer-ready.

 - Represent ALSO at community events, pop-ups, and partner activations.


RETAIL STORE OPERATIONS (IN APPLICABLE MARKETS, OVER TIME)

 - Support daily retail hub operations, including opening and closing procedures, merchandising, and general upkeep.

 - Deliver best-in-class customer service and demonstrate active selling skills.

 - Help create a welcoming, on-brand environment that reflects ALSO’s premium and playful ethos.


OPERATIONAL SUPPORT

 - Follow operational, safety, and compliance processes as directed by the Market Manager and/or Market Coordinator.


WHAT YOU WILL BRING

 - 1+ years of experience in retail, events, sales, hospitality, brand ambassador, or customer-facing roles.

 - A positive, proactive attitude and willingness to jump in wherever needed - you actively engage in your professional development.

 - Strong interpersonal and communication skills—you enjoy talking to people, telling a compelling story, and actively selling products and services.

 - Ability to work in a dynamic, field-based environment, including weekends and events - you have a flexible work style and enjoy variety in your work schedule.

 - Interest in cycling, electric vehicles and/or innovative consumer brands - your enthusiasm for our brand is infectious!

 - Ability to work collaboratively while also taking direction and feedback well - you are a charismatic and fun team player!

 - A strong connection to, knowledge of and comfort riding a bike in Denver is a plus!

 - Qualify as an authorized driver, meaning you are at least 21 years of age, have a valid U.S. driver’s license with a minimum of three (3) years of licensed driving experience, and can successfully complete a background screening and motor vehicle review - because you’ll be driving our demo van and fleet of bikes to meet customers where they like to ride!

This position offers an hourly pay rate of $22.00 per hour and is eligible to participate in the sales incentive program in accordance with the terms of the applicable plan. This role is expected to work approximately 20–24 hours per week. As a part-time position working fewer than 30 hours per week, this role is not eligible for company-sponsored benefits.



Why ALSO.

We’re passionate about helping the world find a better way to get there—wherever it is you’re headed.

We’re located in the heart of Silicon Valley and have brought together a world-class team from some of the biggest brands in the technology, automotive, cycling, outdoor recreation and retail spaces. 

Together we’re working hands-on to imagine, design and build an entirely new solution to a global set of transportation challenges.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Health Systems (New York City)

Latent is the enterprise pharmacy intelligence platform. Our clinical AI streamlines prior authorizations, appeals, and 340B compliance, so patients start therapy faster and care teams spend less time on paperwork.

THE ROLE

As an Account Manager at Latent Health, you will own the post-implementation success of our health system customers, operating with deep customer obsession and a strong sense of ownership. You’ll be accountable for driving adoption, delivering measurable clinical and operational outcomes, and clearly demonstrating ROI by tying product usage to real-world impact.

Healthcare is fundamentally relationship-driven. Success in this role requires building trusted, long-term partnerships across complex, matrixed health systems—resulting in satisfied, referenceable customers who advocate for Latent’s impact. You’ll thrive in ambiguity, operate independently, and be energized by transforming healthcare through customer advocacy.

Must be willing to work onsite from our NYC office -  expected 3 days a week.
Must be willing to travel as needed for customer engagements.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and maintain strong executive and operational relationships that drive trust, retention, and long-term customer advocacy across health system accounts

 - Own the post–go-live customer relationship, partnering across clinical, pharmacy, operational, IT, and executive stakeholders while navigating complex governance structures

 - Drive adoption across departments and use cases by defining, tracking, and communicating outcomes tied to quality, efficiency, patient experience, and ROI

 - Proactively identify and mitigate risks related to change management, resourcing, and workflow alignment

 - Own renewals by ensuring customer value is clear, measurable, and aligned with executive priorities

 - Identify and advance upsell and cross-sell opportunities by aligning additional capabilities to customer needs and demonstrated outcomes

 - Partner cross-functionally with Product, Design, Engineering, and Sales to deliver enterprise-grade solutions and resolve complex customer issues

 - Translate customer feedback, usage patterns, and insights into actionable input that informs product priorities and roadmap decisions

 - Build and execute structured account plans, MBRs, and QBRs that highlight results, surface risks, and align on future growth, ensuring consistent communication and follow-through


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Required

 - 5+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or a similar post-sale role

 - Experience supporting health systems, hospitals, or enterprise healthcare customers

 - Proven success driving renewals and expansion in complex, regulated environments

 - Strong executive presence with excellent cross-functional communication skills

Preferred

 - Experience with healthcare IT, AI/ML platforms, or clinical workflow tools

 - Familiarity with hospital operations, pharmacy, clinical informatics, or quality programs

 - Experience working with multiple stakeholder personas and long sales or adoption cycles


NICE TO HAVE

 - Comfort pushing the pace — Latent moves quickly, and adaptability is essential

 - A collaborative mindset paired with clear, thoughtful communication

 - A proactive, ownership-driven approach to problem-solving in a high-growth environment

 - A strong work ethic with a commitment to quality, rigor, and attention to detail


WHY JOIN LATENT

 - Backed by top-tier investors including General Catalyst, Conviction, and Y Combinator

 - Work on mission-critical problems at the intersection of AI and healthcare

jobs.title: Project Electrician
jobs.description:
ABOUT MARIANA MINERALS

Mariana Minerals is a software-first, vertically integrated minerals company on a mission to supply the critical minerals powering modern energy, AI, and defense technologies. We’re reimagining the minerals supply chain by combining deep industry expertise with advanced software, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

As an Electrician on our new Moab project team (formerly Lisbon Mines), you'll handle wiring, instrumentation, and PLC work on new equipment and systems.

The ideal candidate thrives on variety and wants to be part of a growing company. The work varies week to week, from building panels and calibrating instruments to helping bring PLC systems online. As one of the first members of a new project team, you'll often own a job from start to finish and build new skills along the way.

Responsibilities:

 - Install, wire, and terminate equipment, panels, and control systems for new projects

 - Install, calibrate, and troubleshoot field instrumentation

 - Support PLC work, including logic troubleshooting, I/O checkout, and bringing systems online

 - Read and work from electrical drawings, schematics, and control diagrams

 - Plan and carry out small electrical projects independently

 - Partner with the project mechanic and project engineer on installs and startups

 - Follow electrical safety practices, including lockout/tagout and arc flash procedures

Qualifications:

 - 5+ years of experience as an industrial electrician, instrumentation technician, or controls/electronics technician. Journeyman preferred not required.

 - Hands-on experience with PLC-based control systems and industrial controls

 - Strong instrumentation skills, including calibrating and troubleshooting 4–20 mA loops, pressure transducers, and flow meters

 - Advanced diagnostic and root-cause troubleshooting on electrical, electronic, and control systems

 - Experience with industrial networking and communication protocols

 - Comfort working independently and a willingness to jump into unfamiliar systems and learn them quickly

 - Background in oil and gas, mining, manufacturing, or other heavy industrial field environments

 - Experience with VFDs, motor controls, data acquisition, or multiple PLC platforms is a plus

 - Current MSHA training is a plus

Schedule: Monday–Friday, Days

Physical Requirements:

 - Ability to lift a minimum of 50 pounds

 - Ability to stand, kneel, bend, and climb ladders for extended periods

 - Ability to work at heights and in confined spaces using fall protection and other required PPE

 - Normal color vision to identify wire color-coding, plus adequate visual acuity and hearing (with correction/aids if needed) to work safely around energized equipment

 - Ability to work in all weather conditions, including extreme temperatures, and tolerate exposure to fumes, dust, diesel, solvents, sulfuric acid, and other hazardous materials


OUR CULTURE IS BUILT ON FOUR PRINCIPLES:



Everyone Gets Home Safe. We never put speed or cost ahead of people.

Extreme Ownership. We take full responsibility for outcomes, relentlessly driving toward solutions.

Engineer Out Requirements, then Automate. We simplify, optimize, and then automate for scale.

Share Your Legos. We collaborate openly, share knowledge, and empower each other to build bigger, better solutions.



Join us as we build the future of responsible mineral sourcing and supply!

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter

jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Exiger is the AI partner for supply chain and procurement automation. Its centralized 1EXIGER.AI platform allows organizations to manage their entire operating network, from parts to suppliers, regulators, and customers, through an autonomous agentic workforce that learns, adapts, and augments with every decision. The AI-native platform, combined with the largest supply chain knowledge asset, empowers 550+ global customers, including 150 Fortune 500 and 80+ government and defense industrial organizations, to act first. Exiger is FedRAMP® authorized and a 2x Leader in Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management.

Technical Recruiter

Location: McLean, VA or Richmond, VA
Work Environment: Hybrid

Role Summary

Exiger is seeking a Technical Recruiter to support hiring across our Product, Technology, and Government Delivery teams. You will recruit the people who build our technology, implement it for customers, and support government missions, including software and AI engineers, infrastructure specialists, solutions engineers, technical program managers, and customer-facing delivery professionals.

Working alongside our Lead Technical Recruiter and hiring managers, you will own assigned searches from intake through offer and onboarding. You will bring strong outbound sourcing skills, practical market insight, and the judgment to guide hiring decisions as business needs evolve. You will also help improve how we use AI, technical assessments, and interview insights to strengthen the quality and consistency of hiring.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage full-cycle recruiting across Product, Technology, and Government Delivery, including technical delivery and public sector-facing roles, with flexibility to support other business priorities.

• Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, success profiles, compensation expectations, location needs, and interview plans before launching searches.

• Build pipelines through targeted research, LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, talent communities, and personalized outreach to passive candidates.

• Develop sourcing strategies for government-facing roles with specialized requirements, including security clearances, client-site expectations, location constraints, and technical or mission expertise.

• Conduct candidate screens that assess relevant experience, technical fluency, motivation, and capacity to learn, while clearly communicating Exiger’s opportunity and role expectations.

• Use market data and pipeline results to advise stakeholders, clarify requirements, and recommend practical adjustments when searches encounter obstacles.

• Coordinate interviews, ensure timely scorecard completion, manage offer discussions and negotiations, and partner with Talent & Culture on onboarding handoffs.

• Help implement and manage technical assessments through platforms such as Karat and HackerRank, partnering with hiring teams to ensure assessments reflect the skills each role requires.

• Apply AI and automation to sourcing, research, outreach, and recruiting workflows while validating outputs and handling candidate information responsibly.

• Maintain accurate Greenhouse records and use recruiting data to track progress, identify bottlenecks, and improve hiring outcomes.

• Support recruiting and coordination for internship and early talent programs in partnership with program leads and the Talent Acquisition team.

What You Bring

• Ability to understand technical requirements and distinguish the skills needed to build products, deliver solutions, and support government customers.

• Strong sourcing, candidate evaluation, and closing skills, with a track record of engaging talent for difficult-to-fill roles.

• Clear written and verbal communication, with the judgment to advise senior stakeholders, challenge assumptions constructively, and offer practical solutions.

• AI-fluency, with hands-on experience using generative AI and automation to improve sourcing, candidate research, outreach, and recruiting workflows, and the judgment to evaluate outputs critically.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and resilience when managing competing priorities or changing requirements.

• Commitment to fair, consistent hiring practices and a responsive candidate experience.

What You Need

• At least three years of technical recruiting experience in an in-house, agency, or combined environment, including ownership of full-cycle searches.

• Demonstrated success recruiting AI, software engineering, data, infrastructure, or related technical talent.

• Experience using an applicant tracking system, recruiting metrics, and sourcing tools to manage and improve hiring processes. Greenhouse experience is preferred.

• Experience recruiting Product, Technical Delivery, and Public Sector facing talent, including cleared or customer-facing technical roles, is preferred.

• Experience with technical assessments, interview intelligence platforms, or early-career recruiting programs is a plus.

• Bachelor’s degree required.

• Must be a U.S. citizen and authorized to work in the United States on an ongoing basis without current or future sponsorship from Exiger.

Why You Will Love Working at Exiger

We believe people do their best work when they are trusted, supported, and connected to a meaningful mission. At Exiger, you will have the opportunity to:

• Recruit for work with real impact. Help build teams tackling complex supply chain and national security challenges.

• Shape how we hire. Contribute ideas, improve recruiting processes, and help introduce tools that strengthen hiring decisions.

• Expand your expertise. Work across product, technology, and government delivery while growing your career at an ambitious AI company.

We Offer:

• A high-performance culture built on accountability, collaboration, and shared success

• Discretionary Time Off

• Industry-leading medical, dental, and vision benefits

• Competitive compensation

• 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

• A flexible hybrid work environment

• Wellness stipends and programming that support your well-being

• Career development opportunities and education reimbursement to help you keep growing

#LI-Hybrid

Exiger is named a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management, twice selected as one of Fast Company's 'Brands That Matter,' and recipient of the Third Party Risk Association's Innovator Award, Exiger's technology has been recognized by leading analyst evaluations and 50+ awards. Learn more at Exiger.com and follow Exiger on LinkedIn.

At Exiger, our values define how we work and why we lead. We are mission-inspired, imagination-driven, trust-anchored, and compassion-focused—committed to building technology that makes the world safer, more transparent, and more resilient.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

Exiger’s hybrid work policy is periodically reviewed and adjusted to align with evolving business needs.

• Develop trending and forecasting; analyse progress and quantify cost/schedule impacts.
• Prepare reports, calculations and technical cost specifications for project reviews and stakeholders.
• Support invoice review/approval processes for contractors and suppliers.
• Contribute to scope control and change management, assessing cost impacts of changes.
• Participate in project cost review meetings; gather data to improve procedures and reporting.

The qualities that help you thrive

Project Controls spans diverse backgrounds. If you have a solid foundation in cost control, earned value or forecasting, and experience using enterprise finance/project systems, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every point above.

• Proficiency using enterprise financial/project systems and standard project controls processes.
• Working knowledge of accounting principles as applied to project cost management.
• Experience with requirements for earned value, cost/schedule integration and performance measurement.
• Ability to interpret drawings/specifications to establish and maintain cost baselines.
• Familiarity with Australian standards, governance expectations and reporting in major projects.
• Exposure to scheduling concepts and interfaces between schedule, cost, commitments and funding.

Why you’ll love working with us

• Continuous learning and growth - lunch and learns, professional development courses, financial study assistance, 5 days paid study leave, global career opportunities
• Purchase up to 6 weeks additional annual leave per year
• Flex public holidays – swap Easter or other holidays for ones that suit you better
• Flexible work arrangements, including alternative start/finish times, part-time, job-sharing and hybrid work options

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible?

Applications are reviewed as they come in, and the role may close earlier than expected, so if this opportunity sounds like you, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Learn more about life at AECOM: LinkedIn, Facebook , Instagram, X, YouTube - explore our AECOM voices, employee stories, latest projects, and much more!

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician - Mariner's Cove
jobs.description:
We’re hiring a Maintenance Technician to join our team at Mariner’s Cove, our 500-home community in San Diego, CA.

At AIR Communities, our Maintenance Technicians are an important part of creating a great experience for our residents. In this role, you’ll put your skills to work across the community, tackling service requests, apartment turns, preventative maintenance, repairs, and troubleshooting.

You’ll work across a variety of maintenance areas, take on different challenges each day, and be part of a team that takes pride in keeping the community at its best.

Learn more about the community here: Mariner's Cove

What We Offer

We recognize the value experienced maintenance professionals bring to our communities and offer a compensation package designed to reward performance and support long-term career growth:

• Expected hourly rate of $24.00-$26.00 per hour. You will be provided a pay rate that is in line with your skills and experience as they relate to the requirements of the job.
• Monthly Customer Service Satisfaction Bonus opportunity of up to $250 per month
• Monthly Pooled Renewal Commission Plan providing additional earning opportunities tied to community performance.
• 50% Rent Discount available at any AIR Community.
• Career Growth Opportunities. AIR prefers to promote our own teammates whenever possible and provides training and development programs to help prepare you for what's next.
• Additional benefits listed below.

How We Support You

• Innovative maintenance technology that streamlines service requests and helps prioritize work efficiently.
• Well-stocked shops with the tools, parts, and resources needed to do the job right.
• Ongoing training and development opportunities.
• Supportive leadership focused on technician success, development, and advancement.
• Ascend, AIR's maintenance career development program designed to help grow technical and leadership capabilities.
• A professional team environment built on accountability, collaboration, and respect.

What You Will Do

• Deliver outstanding customer service to residents and teammates.
• Complete apartment turns that create exceptional move-in experiences.
• Troubleshoot and repair plumbing, electrical, HVAC, appliance, carpentry, and general maintenance issues.
• Complete service requests efficiently while maintaining high standards of quality and safety.
• Perform preventative maintenance and support the overall appearance and functionality of the community.
• Assist with move-in and move-out inspections.
• Support vendor partners and help maintain quality standards.
• May provide guidance and technical support to fellow maintenance team members.
• Participate in a shared rotating on-call schedule to address emergency maintenance needs.

Who You Are

• A skilled problem-solver who takes pride in delivering quality workmanship and getting the job done right the first time.
• Motivated by diagnosing issues, finding solutions, and seeing the results of your work every day.
• Committed to providing exceptional resident service while maintaining high standards of quality and safety.
• Comfortable using technology to stay organized, manage work orders, and communicate effectively.
• Adaptable, dependable, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
• A collaborative teammate who values professionalism, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What You Have

• At least 2 years of hands-on maintenance experience in multifamily housing, facilities maintenance, commercial properties, hospitality, military facilities, or a related environment.
• Hands-on experience in at least two skilled trades, including plumbing, electrical, HVAC, appliance repair, carpentry, or general building maintenance.
• Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills with a commitment to quality workmanship and safety.
• Ability to adapt to changing priorities and support community needs.
• Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, rotating on-call shifts, and seasonal schedules as needed.
• Reliable transportation to respond to emergency service requests while on-call.
• Ability to safely perform physical work and move equipment, tools, and materials as required.
• Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in English.

• Paid time off including vacation, sick time, and 14 holidays.
• Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance options, HSA/FSA plans, short and long-term disability paid by the company.
• 50% rent discount available at any AIR Community (a rental application is required, and certain exclusions apply).
• 401(k) plan with employer contribution.
• Paid parental leave of up to 16 weeks.
• Tuition assistance program and up to 100% reimbursement for job-related certifications and licenses.
• 15 hours of paid time annually for community service.
• Commuter benefits and pet insurance.
• Consumer discounts on various products and services.
• Opportunities for ongoing professional development, leadership training, and career growth.

What You Need to Know

Application Deadline:  The initial deadline for applications is 10/05/2026. Applications submitted after this date may still be considered on a rolling basis until the position/program is filled. We encourage all interested candidates to apply as early as possible. If a final decision has not been made by the initial deadline, subsequent applications will be reviewed as they are received.

Candidates extended an offer will be required to undergo pre-employment screening that includes checking references, a four-panel drug screening that excludes marijuana testing, employment verification & criminal background check.

AIR will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the California Fair Chance Act and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance.

AIR values diversity and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment. AIR prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Certified Caregiver - The Heritage Tradition
jobs.location: Sun City West, Arizona, United States
jobs.description:
In partnership with the health services team, the Caregiver is responsible for assisting the

residents in all areas of care as assigned by the Director of Assisted Living, or designee.

Our Seniors need assistance with routine daily care. Providing care builds character and makes you feel good. A career at Senior Resource Group helps you express your compassion and desire to help seniors. Our healthcare associates make each day special for our residents.

Essential Duties:

• Adheres to and conveys the SRG philosophy of person-centered care and Genuine Hospitality.
• Maintains a professional appearance, manner, and approach while on duty.
• Wears name tag, uniform, and adheres to SRG cell phone policy.
• Reports to work on time and as scheduled per community policies and procedures
• Receives report from the previous shift, reads Care Staff Assignment and End of Shift report for information and changes before providing resident care.
• Documents care given via CareStream; adhering to policies and procedures.
• Provides report to oncoming shift and documents on the End of Shift Report and CareStream before going off shift.
• Completes incident reports when needed.
• Sign out and carry equipment such as radio, tablet, and keys at onset of shift.
• Answers resident call lights, door, and resident alarms promptly.
• Provides resident assistance with activities of daily living, encouraging, and promoting residents’ self-care to the extent possible as needed or assigned.
• Encourages and assists residents in individual and group program activities.
• Assist residents with meals, housekeeping, and laundry services as needed, requested or assigned.
• Maintains a clean, neat, comfortable, safe environment for residents, staff, and visitors.
• Provides high quality resident care and recommends ways to improve quality.
• Observes for changes in resident physical or mental status and communicates to the Director of Assisted Living, LVN/LPN, and/or manager on duty.
• Responds promptly to residents, staff, or visitor emergencies, follows policies and procedures.
• Demonstrates knowledge of and follows policies and procedures for infection control.
• Familiar with fire, missing resident, and other emergency procedures; follows community policy and procedures detailed in the fire and disaster plans.
• Maintain appropriate levels of confidentiality with resident and family information.
• Attend and participate in training and team meetings as assigned.
• Other duties as assigned

• Arizona Caregiver Certification required
• High School Diploma or GED
• First Aid / CPR certification required
• Experience with Yardi, eMAR, Schedule Pop, ADP, and/or other relevant platforms.
